“Ungaze ulikhankanye ngelize igama lam; kaloku mna Ndikhoyo Thixo wakho andiyi kumxolela ofumana alibize igama lam.
“Hlala uwukhumbula *uMhla wokuPhumla, uwugcine ulusuku olulodwa lukaNdikhoyo.
Sebenza imihla emithandathu, uwenze wonke umsebenzi wakho.

Ke wona umhla wesixhenxe lusuku lwam olulodwa lokuphumla. Ngoko ke makungabikho mntu usebenzayo ngalo mhla; nditsho nawe, umntwana wakho, nesicaka sakho, nemfuyo yakho, ngokunjalo nomngeneleli ohlala phakathi kwenu.

Kaloku mna Ndikhoyo ndênza umhlaba, nesibhakabhaka, nolwandle, nako konke okulapho kwezo zinto, ngeentsuku ezintandathu, ndaza ke ndaphumla ngomhla wesixhenxe. Ngenxa yaloo nto ke lo mhla ndawukhetha ukuze ube lusuku olulodwa lokuphumla.
“Mhlonele uyihlo ndawonye nonyoko, khon' ukuze ube nokuzinza kwelo lizwe ndikunika lona mna Ndikhoyo Thixo wakho.
“Musa ukuba sisibulala-mntu.
“Musa ukukrexeza.
“Musa ukûba.
“Musa ukungqina ubuxoki ngomnye umntu.
“Musa ukunqwenela umzi womnye umntu, nokuba ngumfazi wakhe, nokuba sisicaka sakhe okanye isicakakazi sakhe, nokuba yinkomo yakhe, nokuba yidonki yakhe, okanye nantoni na eyeyomnye umntu.”
Athi ke amaSirayeli akuziva iindudumo, nokuhlokoma kwexilongo, akubona nemibane itshawuza, nentaba ilitsili ngumsi, suka angcangcazela kukoyika, angcachela phaya.
Abhekisa kuMosis, athi: “Mayibe nguwe othetha nathi; siya kukuva. Mayingabi nguThixo ngokwakhe othetha nathi, hleze sife.”
UMosis wathi ebantwini: “Sanukoyika, kuba uThixo uyanivavanya nje, khon' ukuze nihlale nimhlonele, ningawexulwa kukona.”
Kambe ke abantu bona bahlala bechasele, àbavuma ukusondela, yanguMosis yedwa okufuphi kwelo lifu limnyama lingumqondiso wobukho bukaThixo.
*UNdikhoyo wayalela uMosis, wathi: “Yithi kumaSirayeli: ‘Ngoku ke nindivile, mna Ndikhoyo, xa bendithetha nani ndisezulwini.
Ngoko ke, indim nje uThixo wenu, sanukundidibanisa nezithixo ezenziwe ngesiliva okanye igolide.

Mna ndenzeleni iqonga lamadini ngomhlaba, nize nithathe iinkomo, iigusha, okanye iibhokhwe, nenze ngazo amadini atshiswayo ngokunjalo namadini obudlelwane. Naphi na apho ndininike khona indawo yokunqula ndiya kuza ndinithamsanqelise.
Xa nindenzela iqonga lamadini ngamatye sanukuwaqingqa, kuba xa nisebenzisa izixhobo niwaqingqa selexabhelekile kum.
Xa nindakhela iqonga lamadini makungayiwa ngezinyuko kulo, hleze nithi xa ninyukayo zihlubeke izambatho zenu, nibe ze.’ ”
“Nantsi ke imimiselo oya kuyinika amaSirayeli:
Umntu othe wathenga ikhoboka elingumHebhere liya kumkhonza iminyaka ibe mithandathu, lize ngowesixhenxe likhululwe lingahlawulelwanga nto.
Ukuba langena ebukhobokeni lilisoka, liya kumka lilodwa. Kanti ke ukuba langena ebukhobokeni linomfazi, liya kukhululeka kunye naye.
Xa lifike lingenamfazi, yaza inkosi yalo yalinika umfazi, waza wazala abantwana, abo bantwana nalo mfazi ngabenkosi yalo; xa likhululekayo liya kubashiya apho.
Kodwa ke xa lithe ngokuphandle: ‘Hayi, ndiyakholwa yinkosi yam, ndiyamthanda nomkam, ngokunjalo nabantwana bam, ngoko ke ndikhetha ukungakhululeki,’

inkosi yalo ke iya kulithatha ilise *esibingelelweni phambi kukaThixo; apho ke iya kulayamisa elucangweni okanye emgubasini, ize iligqobhoze indlebe ngenyatyhoba. Yakuba ilenjenjalo ke, liya kuba ngumkhonzi wayo bonke ubomi balo.
“Xa umntu ethengise intombi yakhe yalikhoboka, yona ayinakukhululeka okwekhoboka eliyindoda.

Ukuba indoda leyo ibiyithengile ukuba ibe ngumfazi wayo, ize ithi kamva inganeliseki yiyo, kufuneka ivumele abantu bakowayo ukuba bayikhulule ngokuyithenga. Akuvumelekanga ukuba isuke iyithengise kwabasemzini; kaloku izaphule izigqibo.
Ukuba iyithengele unyana wayo, mayiyiphathe njengentombi yayo.
Xa indoda ithatha umfazi wesibini, mayingayeki ukumondla nokumnxiba nokumenza umfazi lo wokuqala.
Ukuba ayiwafezi la malungelo mayimkhulule angahlawulelwa.”
“Umntu obethe omnye wamenzakalisa wafa, makabulawe.
Kodwa ke ukuba umbulele ngengozi, makabalekele endaweni endiyimisele abasabi.
Kambe ke yena umntu obulele omnye ngolunya, nokuba angade abalekele eqongeni lamadini, makasuswe apho abulawe.
“Umntu ohlasela uyise nokuba ngunina, makabulawe.
“Umntu oqweqwedisa omnye aze amthengise okanye abanjwe esenaye, makabulawe.
“Umntu othuka uyise nokuba ngunina, makabulawe.
“Ukuba amadoda amabini axabene, yaza enye yabetha ngelitye okanye ngenqindi yayenzakalisa leyo ibisilwa nayo, kwaza kwafuneka ukuba khe ilale ngandletyana-nye,
ukuba ibuye yakwazi ukuhamba-hamba isimelela, mayingohlwaywa le yenzakalisileyo, nto nje mayihlawule eli xesha liyilahlekeleyo ngokulala igula, futhi iyinyange ide iphile.
“Ukuba umntu ulibethe ngentonga ikhoboka lakhe eliyindoda noba libhinqile, laza lafa ngoko nangoko, makohlwaywe.
Kambe ke ukuba ikhoboka elo life emva kosuku okanye iintsuku ezimbini, akayi kohlwaywa. Kaloku ikhoboka belilelakhe.

“Xa ababini bethe besilwa baya kuphoseka kumfazi okhulelweyo, waza ngenxa yaloo nto akenzakala kodwa sona isisu saphuma, lo usisizekabani sale ntlekele uya kudliwa ngokubona kwendoda yaloo mfazi, yakuba icetyiswe ngabalamli.
Kodwa ke ukuba umfazi lowo uthe wenzakala, ubomi mabubuyekezwe ngobomi,
iliso ngeliso, izinyo ngezinyo, isandla ngesandla, unyawo ngonyawo,
umlilo ngomlilo, uduma ngoduma, umvumbo ngomvumbo.
“Xa umntu elibethe walityhaphaza ikhoboka lakhe, liyindoda okanye libhinqile, makalikhulule ukuhlawula elo liso.
Kanti ke nokuba ulibethe kwapoq' izinyo wolikhulula ukuhlawula elo zinyo.”
“Xa inkunzi yenkomo yomntu othile ithe yahlaba umntu wafa, mayixulutywe ngamatye ide ife, inyama yayo ingàtyiwa. Ke yena umnini wayo akanatyala.
Kambe ke ukuba inkomo leyo ibiqhelile ukuhlaba abantu, abe nomniniyo eyaliwe, kodwa akayigcina, yaza yahlaba umntu yambulala, mayixulutywe ngamatye ife, ngokunjalo nomniniyo abulawe.
Phofu ke ukuba kubonakala ukuba umniniyo lowo makamiselwe umdliwo ukusindisa ubomi bakhe, kofuneka akhuphe loo nto ibizwayo njengoko injalo.
Nokuba inkomo leyo ihlabe yabulala inkwenkwe okanye intombazana, logwetywa kwangaloo ndlela elo tyala.
Xa ke inkomo leyo ihlabe yabulala ikhoboka eliyindoda okanye elibhinqileyo, umniniyo wokhupha intlawulo yeesiliva ezingamashumi amathathu, ke yona inkomo leyo ixulutywe.
“Ukuba umntu ushiye umngxuma uvulekile, okanye umbe umngxuma akawugquma, kwaza kweyela inkomo noba yidonki kuwo, ummbi-mngxuma lowo
makayihlawule loo nto yeyeleyo, kodwa ke lona ixhoba elo loba lelakhe.
“Ukuba ke iinkuzi zeenkomo zabantu ababini zenzakalisene, yaza enye yazo yafa, aba babini mabathengise le iphilayo, ize ixabiso layo bahlulelane ngalo, ngokukwanjalo bahlulelane ngayo nale ifileyo.
Xa le nkomo ibulele enye ibe iqhelile ukwenza lo mkhwa, kodwa akayigcina umniniyo, makavuse le ifileyo ngephilayo; ke yona le ifileyo yoba yeyakhe.”
“Xa umntu ebe inkomo okanye igusha, waza wayixhela okanye wayithengisa, makahlawule iinkomo ezintlanu ngenkomo enye, aze ahlawule iigusha ezine ngegusha enye.
“Ukuba ngaba isela libhaqwe liqhekeza ebusuku, laza labulawa, akanatyala lowo ulibuleleyo.
Kambe ke ukuba le nto yenzeke emini, woba netyala lokubulala lowo ulibuleleyo.

“Into umntu ayibileyo makayihlawule. Ukuba kuthe kanti ungumntu ongenanto, makathengiswe abe likhoboka ukubuyekeza ubusela obo. Ukuba ke inkomo, idonki, okanye igusha, leyo ayibileyo, ifunyenwe kuye isaphila, wohlawula zibe mbini ngenye.
“Ukuba umntu uthe ebhuqisa intsimi yakhe yaza impahla yaphumela kweyomnye, umonakalo lowo makawuhlawule ngemveliso yentsimi yakhe.
“Xa umntu etshisa entsimini yakhe, waza umlilo lowo wanwenwela entsimini yomnye umntu, watshisa ukutya osekuvuniwe okanye okungekavunwa, loo monakalo mawuhlawulwe nguloo mntu uqale umlilo.
“Xa umntu egcinise omnye impahla ethile okanye imali, yaza ke yebiwa apho kuye, xa libanjiwe isela eliyibileyo liya kuyihlawula ngokuphindiweyo;
kanti ke xa lingafumaneki, umgciniswa lo uya kusiwa *esibingelelweni phambi kukaThixo, afunge ukuba ngenene le nto ibiweyo ayikho kuye.

“Kuyo yonke imicimbi yembambano nokuba inxulumene neenkomo, iidonki, iigusha, impahla yokunxiba, okanye nantoni na elahlekileyo, abo babangisanayo mabasiwe esibingelelweni phambi kukaThixo. Lowo uthe wagwetywa ke nguThixo uya kumhlawula ngokuphindiweyo ogwetyelweyo.
“Xa abantu ababini begcinisene iidonki, iinkomo, iigusha, okanye nasiphi na isilwanyana, saza safa okanye senzakala, kungenjalo sibiwe, kungabikho ngqina,
umgciniswa lowo makaye kufunga esibingelelweni phambi kukaThixo ukuba umsulwa kule nyewe. Ukuba ke le mfuyo kubanjenwe ngayo ayibiwanga ngumgciniswa, umniniyo makaselexola, umgciniswa angayivusi.
Kodwa ke ukuba imfuyo leyo ibiwe nguye, makayihlawule.
Kambe ke ukuba kufumanisekile ukuba iqwengwe ngamarhamncwa, lo iqwengwe ikuye makezise ixhwayela, ibe bubungqina; xa kunjalo ke akayi kuyivusa.
“Ukuba ababini babolekene ngemfuyo, yaza ke yenzakala okanye yafa engekho umniniyo, lo ubebolekiwe makayivuse.
Kanti ke ukuba ebekho umniniyo, umbolekwa lowo akanakude ayihlawule. Phofu ke ukuba ibiqeshiwe kohlawulwa imali yengqesho yodwa.”
“Xa umntu one intombi nto engekabonwa lisoka, makayilobole batshate.
Ukanti ke xa uyise wayo engavumi ukuyendisela kuye, makakhuphe intlawulo elingana nekhazi lentombi.
“Ke lona igqwirha malibulawe.
“Umntu olala nesilwanyana makabulawe.
“Umntu obingelela nakwisiphi na *isithixo ngaphandle *kukaNdikhoyo makagwetyelwe ukufa.
“Ningaze nimphathe kakubi nimcinezele umntu obhacele kwelakowenu. Kaloku nani ngokwenu naningababhaceli kwelaseJiputa.
Ningaze nimphathe kakubi umhlolokazi nenkedama.
Ukuba niyenzile loo nto, mna Ndikhoyo ndiya kusiva isikhalo sabo,
ndikhathazeke, nina ndiniyekele nife emfazweni, ukuze abafazi benu babe ngabahlolokazi, abantwana bona babe ziinkedama.
“Xa uboleke omnye kubantu bam abahlelelekileyo imali, mayingabi ngathi ùngumbolekisi-mali; ngoko ke sukumbiza nzala.
Ukuba ke umntu úbambise ngengubo yakhe kuwe, ze uyibuyisele kwakuye lingekatshoni ilanga,
kuba kaloku yena kuphela kwesambatho anaso sokumfudumeza. Kakade ke ùthi úya kulala ngani? Ukuba ke úthe wakhala kum, ndiya kumphendula, kuba kaloku mna ndinovelwano.
“UThixo ungaze umnyelise; ngokunjalo ungayithuki nenkokheli yesizwe sakho.
“Ungathandabuzi ukuthatha kwisivuno nakwiwayini yakho, wenze ngazo umnikelo kum. “Unyana wakho wamazibulo nikela ngaye kum.
Namazibulo enkomo okanye igusha makabe ngumnikelo kum. Makahlale nonina iintsuku zibe sixhenxe qha, aze ngolwesibhozo anikelwe kum.
“Ningabantu bam ncakasana; ke ngoko sanukuyitya inyama yemfuyo eqwengwe ngamarhamncwa asendle – ndaweni yaloo nto yinikeni izinja.”
“Ungaze uhlwayele iindaba zolwimi. Sukuncedisana netshijolo ngokulingqinela ngobuxoki.
Sukuvuma ukona ngenxa yokukhukuliswa sisihlwele. Ungaze uyigqwethe inyaniso ngenxa yefuthe lesihlwele.
Sukuba negobe ngakwihlwempu xa kuthethwa ityala lalo.
“Xa ubhaqe inkomo okanye idonki yotshaba lwakho ilahleka, yithathe uyigoduse.
Ukuba ubona umntu okuthiyileyo eqhuba idonki ebuthisayo isoyiswa ngumthwalo, sukumyekela; mncedise niyivuse.
“Musa ukugqwetha umthetho xa kuthethwa ityala lehlwempu.
Bucezele ubuqhophololo bokutyhola umntu ongenatyala, ungabi sisizekabani sokufa kwelungisa elimsulwa, kuba iqhophololo ndiyaligweba.
Sukuvuma ukunyotywa, kuba unyobo luyamfamekisa, luwawexule amalungisa.
Ungamcinezeli umbhaceli. Kaloku uyazi ukuba kunjani na ukuba ngumbhaceli, kuba wawukhe wangumbhaceli kwelaseJiputa.”
“Amasimi akho walime uwavune iminyaka ibe mithandathu.
Ke ngowesixhenxe wayeke alale. Into evelayo kuwo yoba yeyamahlwempu; eseleyo ke ibe yeyeenyamakazi. Yoba seso nakwisidiliya nesinquma sakho.
“Sebenza iintsuku zibe ntandathu, kodwa ngolwesixhenxe ungawuphathi umsebenzi, ukuze izicaka nababhaceli ngokunjalo nemfuyo yakho ifumane ikhefu ihlaziyeke.
“Wanyamekele amazwi endiwathethileyo kuwe. Ungazinquli *izithixo, ungaze uzikhankanye nokuzikhankanya oku.”
“Ndenzeleni itheko kathathu ngonyaka.

Ngenyanga uAbhibhi enaphuma ngayo eJiputa, yenzani itheko lesonka sentlama engenagwele njengoko ndaniyalelayo. Kwithuba leentsuku ezisixhenxe zeli theko ze nitye sona sodwa. “Sanukuza phambi kukaThixo ningaphathanga mnikelo.
“Yenzani itheko lolibo ukuqala kwenu ukuvuna. “Yenzani itheko lesivuno xa niqokelela iziqhamo zomsebenzi wenu emasimini.
Minyaka le ngexesha lala matheko mathathu amadoda makeze kundinqula mna *Ndikhoyo iNkosi yenu.
“Xa niphalaza igazi, nisenza idini, ze ninganikeli ngaxa-nye ngesonka sentlama enegwele. Ngala mathuba ke amanqatha edini elo makangabekwa mbeko.
“Minyaka le zisa ulibo lwesivuno sakho endlwini kaNdikhoyo uThixo wakho. “Uze ungaze ulipheke itakane lebhokhwe ngobisi lukanina.”
“Uyabona ke, ndiya kukuthumela isithunywa sam, sikulondoloze endleleni yakho, sikuse kuloo ndawo ndikulungiselele yona.
Uze usithobele, ungasivukeli, kuba simele mna; ibe ke asiyi kuba nalusini kulowo usivukelayo.
Kambe ke ukuba uyayiphulaphula ngenyameko into ethethwa siso, wenze ngokomyalelo wam, iintshaba zakho ziya kuba zezam, ndibachase abakuchasayo.
Isithunywa sam siya kukukhokela, sikuse kwilizwe lama-Amori, amaHiti, amaPerezi, amaKanana, amaHivi, namaJebhusi, ndize mna ndiwatshabalalise.
Ungakhe ulinge uguqe unqule *izithixo zawo; ungazingeni neendlela zawo zonqulo. Ndaweni yaloo nto uzuzikhiqe izithixo zawo; uyiqhekeze uyiqethule imifanekiso yazo yamatye.
Ukuba ke uthe wanqula mna *Ndikhoyo uThixo wakho, ndiya kukuthamsanqela ngokutya namanzi, ndikutshayele ukufa kungabikho phakathi kwenu.
Kwelo lizwe lenu akukho mfazi uya kuphuma sisu, kungayi kubakho mfazi ungaphathiyo. Ewe, ndiya kunenza niphile nide nikhokhobe.
“Ndiya kubenza barhwaqele bonke abantu abakuchasayo, ndizenze zidideke zonke izizwe olwa nazo. Ewe, ndiya kuba ngakuwe, utsho uziswantsulise zonke iintshaba zakho.
Ndozithumela ngoonomeva iintshaba zakho, atsho asabe ungekafiki amaHivi, amaKanana, namaHiti.
Andiyi kuwagxotha ngonyaka omnye, khon' ukuze kungabi senkangala kwelo lizwe, uthi wena ufika abe amarhamncwa selegunyile.
Ndaweni yaloo nto ndiya kuthi chu ukuwafifinga oku, ude wena wande ngokwaneleyo, ube nako ukulithatha elo lizwe ulimé.
Imida yakho iya kusuka kuLwandle oluBomvu, iye kuthi xhaxe kulwandle iMeditera; isuke kumlambo iEfrati, iye kuthi gaa ngentlango. Ndiya kubanikezela kuwe abemi belo zwe, ubagxothe phambi kwakho.
Uze ungenzi mnqophiso nabo, okanye *nezithixo zabo.
Uze ungabavumeli beme emhlabeni wakho, hleze bakulukuhle undivukele. Mhla wazinqula izithixo zabo, woba ungenile emgibeni.”
Ke kaloku *uNdikhoyo wathetha noMosis wathi: “Nyuka, wena noAron, uNadabhi noAbhihu, kunye namashumi asixhenxe amadoda amakhulu akwaSirayeli. Nothi ke nisemgama nikhahlele.
Yoba nguwe Mosis wedwa ke oya kuza kufika kum; abanye ke abo basale; ke wona umndilili awuyi kunyuka nokunyuka entabeni.”
UMosis ke wawugqithisela ebantwini loo mlomo kaNdikhoyo, ngokunjalo nemiyalelo. Ke amaSirayeli atsho ngazwi-nye athi: “Konke akuthethileyo uNdikhoyo siya kukwenza.”
UMosis wayibhala yonke imiyalelo kaNdikhoyo. Kusasa ngengomso wakha iqonga lamadini emazantsi entaba, waza wamisa ishumi elinambini leentsika zamatye ngokwezindlu ezilishumi elinambini zikaSirayeli.
Kamva ke wathuma abafana, baya kwenzela uNdikhoyo amadini atshiswayo, babingelela ngeenkomo, benza amadini obudlelwana.
UMosis wathatha isiqingatha segazi elo, waligalela ezityeni, waza isiqingatha wasifefa eqongeni lamadini.
Ngoku ke wathatha umqulu ekubhalwe kuwo imiqathango yomnqophiso kaNdikhoyo, wafundela amaSirayeli. Ke wona aphendula athi: “Siya kumthobela uNdikhoyo, sikwenze konke asiyalele kona.”
Ke kaloku uMosis wathatha elaa gazi lalisesityeni, wafefa ngalo abantu, esithi: “Eli gazi litywina umnqophiso awenze nani uNdikhoyo mhla waninika le miyalelo.”
UMosis, uAron, uNadabhi, noAbhihu, kunye namashumi asixhenxe amadoda amakhulu, benyuka intaba,
baza bambona uThixo kaSirayeli. Iinyawo zakhe zaziphezu komgangatho welitye elibuglasirha eliluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka.
Kambe ke uThixo zange awase sandla la matshawe akwaSirayeli; bambona baza batya basela.
*UNdikhoyo wabhekisa kuMosis, wathi: “Nyuka uze kum apha entabeni, uhlale; ndiza kukunika amacwecwe amatye endiyibhale kuwo imithetho nemiyalelo omawuyifundise amaSirayeli.”
UMosis wanduluka ke nehlakani lakhe uYoshuwa; ke yena uMosis wenyuka intaba kaThixo.
Wathi kumadoda amakhulu: “Lindani kule ndawo side sibuye. Nâba uAron noYuri; wonke umntu onomcimbi makawandlale phambi kwabo bawuphicothe.”
Ngenene ke uMosis wenyuka intaba, laza lona ilifu layambathisa intaba leyo.

Baza ke ubuqaqawuli bukaNdikhoyo bahlala phezu kwentaba iSinayi. KumaSirayeli kwakungathi ngumlilo ovuthayo apho phezu kwentaba. Ilifu elo layifukama intaba leyo iintsuku zantandathu, waza ngolwesixhenxe uNdikhoyo wabiza uMosis esefini apho.
Ke kaloku uMosis wenyuka intaba, waya kungena apho efini. Wahlala apho iintsuku ezimashumi mane.
*UNdikhoyo wathetha noMosis, wathi:
“Xelela amaSirayeli ukuba bonke abaziva beqhutywa yintliziyo mabakhuphe umnikelo, bawuzise kum.
Lo mnikelo ke mawube kwezi ndidi: igolide, isiliva, ubhedu,
nelaphu elizuba, nelimsobo, nelibomvu, nelaphu elicikizekileyo, neloboya bebhokhwe,
nofele olubomvu lwenkunzi yegusha, nofele olusukiweyo, nomngampunzi,
neoyile yesibane, nobulawu bokuqhola, ioyile yesiqhumiso,
namatye ekarneli, namanye amatye okuhombisa *isidanga sombingeleli omkhulu ngokunjalo nesikhuselo-sifuba sakhe.
Mabandakhele indawo eyeyam ndodwa, ukuze nam ndihlale phakathi kwabo.
Ke yona nempahla engaphakathi mayakhiwe ibe matwa nomzekelo endokubonisa wona.
“Thatha umngampunzi, wenze ityesi ngawo. Mayibe ziisentimitha ezilikhulu elineshumi ubude bayo, ibe ngamashumi mathandathu nantandathu ububanzi, ngokunjalo nokuphakama.
Yityabeke ngegolide ngaphandle nangaphakathi, futhi uyiphethe kwangegolide jikelele.
Thatha igolide wenze amakhonkco abe mane, uwanxibelele emanqineni etyesi abe mabini cala-nye.
Yenza imiqobo ngomngampunzi, uyityabeke ngegolide;
yona ke yongena kuloo makhonkco, iphathwe ngazo ityesi.
Mayingakhutshwa, koko mayihlale ngolo hlobo lonke ixesha.
Ngaphakathi ke faka amacwecwe abubungqina bomnqophiso endiza kukunika wona.
“Kwakhona ke thatha igolide, wenze isivalo sibe ziisentimitha ezilikhulu elineshumi ubude, ububanzi zibe ngamashumi amathandathu anesithandathu.
Thatha igolide ubumbe imifanekiso *yezithunywa ezimaphiko ibe mibini; yenze ibe nto-nye nesivalo eso,
imiswe ngapha nangapha phezu kwaso, ijongene; athi ke loo maphiko athe naa asigubungele isivalo eso.
Faka loo macwecwe mabini abubungqina bomnqophiso, uvale.
Kulapho ndiya kuhlangana nawe ke, apho phezu kwesivalo setyesi yomnqophiso, phakathi kwemifanekiso yezithunywa ezimaphiko, ndikunike yonke imiyalelo yamaSirayeli.”
“Thatha umngampunzi, wenze itafile ngawo. Mayibe ngamashumi asibhozo anesibhozo eesentimitha ubude; ibe ngamashumi mane anane ububanzi, kanti ke ukuphakama ibe ngamashumi amathandathu anesithandathu.
Yityabeke ngegolide, futhi uyiphethe kwangayo jikelele.
Mayijikelezwe lungqameko olububanzi bungangesandla, oluphethwe ngegolide jikelele.
Yenza amakhonkco egolide abe mane, abe sezikoneni phezu kwemilenze.
Amakhonkco okubamba imiqobo yokuthwala itafile makasondele kungqameko.
Yenza imiqobo leyo ngomngampunzi, uyityabeke ngegolide.
Yenza iipleyiti, iikomityi, iindebe, nezitya zokusetyenziswa xa kusenziwa idini lewayini. Kambe ke zonke ezi zinto mazenziwe ngegolide.
Kule tafile makusoloko kukho isonka esinikelwa kuThixo.”

“Thatha igolide engangxengwanga, wenze isibane ngayo. Amazantsi kunye nesiqu sesibane masibunjwe ngegolide. Izihombiso ezifana neentyatyambo, nemidumba, namagqabi eentyatyambo, mazibe nto-nye nesibane.
Kwalapho kuso isiqu sesibane nxibelela amasebe aso abe mathandathu, oko kukuthi abe mathathu ngapha nangapha.
La masebe mathandathu makahonjiswe ngomhombiso ofana neentyatyambo zealmondi, ibe nemidumba namagqabi eentyatyambo.
Sona isiqu saso naso masihonjiswe ngomhombiso ofana neentyatyambo zealmondi enemidumbu namagqabi eentyatyambo.
Onke amasebe ngambini makasekelwe ngumdumba.
Imidumba namasebe makabe nto-nye nesiqu sesibane esenziwe ngegolide engangxengwanga.
Kwesi siqu sesibane ke kofakwa izibane ezisixhenxe ngohlobo lokuba ziphose ilitha ngaphambili.
Umcephe wokucima isibane nezithetyana zaso mazenziwe ngegolide.
Iyonke igolide yokwenza esi sibane nobuxhaka-xhaka baso mayibe ngamashumi amathathu nantlanu eekhilogram ubunzima.
Xa iyonke le nto uzuyenze ngokomzekelo endakubonisa wona entabeni.”

“Thatha imiqulu yelaphu elisontwe ngobona buchule ibe lishumi, wenze ngayo umkhusane *wesibingelelo. La malaphu makabe yile mibala: ozuba, omsobo, nobomvu. Makahonjiswe ngemifanekiso *yezithunywa ezimaphiko yenziwe ngobugcisa nobunono.
Yonke imikhusane mayilingane, ibe ziimitha ezilishumi elinambini ubude, zibe mbini ububanzi.
La malaphu wadibanise abe mahlanu ngamahlanu.
Thatha ilaphu elizuba, wenze amarhintyelo phaya emphethweni ngapha nangapha.
Loo marhintyelo ke makabe ngamashumi amahlanu kweli cala; kanti ke nakweliya icala makabe kwangako, alungelelane.
Kwangokunjalo ke thatha igolide, wenze amahaki angamashumi amahlanu, khon' ukuze la macala mabini adityaniswe, intente yesibingelelo ibe yinto enye.
“Isibingelelo eso ke masambathiswe ngentente eyenziwe ngoboya bebhokhwe. Yona ke mayibe yimiqulu elishumi elinanye.
Nayo ke mayilingane ibe ziimitha ezilishumi elinantathu, zibe mbini ke ububanzi.
Dibanisa imiqulu ibe mihlanu kwelinye icala, uze uphinde uyidibanise nale mithandathu iseleyo; kambe ke lo wesithandathu wona uze uwuphinde ngaphambili.
Yenza amarhintyelo angamashumi amahlanu emphethweni weli cala, kanti ke abe kwangako emphethweni weliya icala.
Thatha ubhedu, wenze amahaki angamashumi amahlanu, ukuze la macala mabini adityaniswe abe yinto enye.
Ke sona esi siqingatha siseleyo masijinge ngasemva phaya.
La mashumi mahlanu eesentimitha alabalabayo kobu bude makagqume intente macala.
“Kwakhona yaleke ngofele lwenkunzi yegusha olubomvu nangesikhumba esisukiweyo ngaphandle.
“Yenza izakhelo zokuxhasa intente leyo ngezibonda zomngampunzi.
Isakhelo ngasinye masibe ziimitha ezine ubude neesentimitha ezingamashumi amathandathu anesithandathu ububanzi.
Uze uzenze ziphume ngapha nangapha, khon' ukuze zibe nokuhlanganiswa. Ewe, zonke izakhelo mazenziwe ngolu hlobo.
Yenza izakhelo zangezantsi zibe ngamashumi amabini.
Isakhelo ngasinye masibanjwe ziziseko ezibini zesiliva, zibe ngamashumi amane zizonke.
Mayibe zizakhelo ezingamashumi amabini ngasentla,
zixhaswe ngamashumi amane eziseko zesiliva, zibe zibini esakhelweni esinye.
Ngasentshona izakhelo mazibe zithandathu,
zibe zibini ezikoneni.
Ezi zakhelo zeekona maziqhagamshelwe emazantsi, ziye kuqhina phezulu. Kunjalo ke okwezi zakhelo zibini zeekona.
Ngoko ke zoba sibhozo zixhaswe lishumi elinesithandathu leziseko zesiliva, zingambini kwenye.
“Yenza imiqadi ngomngampunzi; mayibe mihlanu ngapha nangapha,
ngokunjalo nakwicala lasentshona ngasemva.
Lo mqadi uphakathi mawube sesizikithini sesakhelo, unqamleze usuke ngapha uye kuthi ngqu ngaphaya.
Izakhelo zityabeke ngegolide, uzenzele amakhonkco ngegolide apho iya kungena khona imiqadi; kambe ke nayo uya kuyityabeka ngegolide.
Esi sibingelelo senze ngokomzekelo endakubonisa wona entabeni.
“Thatha imiqulu yelaphu elisontwe kakuhle, wenze umkhusane. Malibe yile mibala: ozuba, omsobo, nobomvu. Lo mkhusane mawuhonjiswe ngemifanekiso *yezithunywa ezimaphiko, yenziwe ngobugcisa nobunono.
Lo mkhusane ke mawuxhonywe kwiintsika zomngampunzi ezityatyekwe ngegolide ezinamahaki, zixhaswe ngeziseko ezine zesiliva.
Lo mkhusane wuxhome kulaa mahaki aphezulu, uze emva kwawo ubeke laa tyesi inobungqina bomnqophiso. Umkhusane lo ke uya kwahlula igumbi elingcwele kwingcwele kangcwele.
Ityesi yomnqophiso yivale ngesivalo sayo.
Apha nganeno komkhusane beka itafile kwicala elingasentla, ize isibane sona sibe ngasezantsi.
“Esangweni xhoma umkhusane welaphu elisontwe kakuhle elizuba, elimsobo, nelibomvu. Maliqhoqhonywe lihonjiswe ngobugcisa nobunono.
Lenzele iintsika ezintlanu ngomngampunzi. Mazityatyekwe ngegolide, zifakwe amahaki egolide. Ke zona mazisekelwe ngeziseko zobhedu ezihlanu.”

“Ke lona iqonga lamadini uze ulenze ngomngampunzi lilingane macala, libe ziimitha ezimbini neesentimitha ezimashumi mabini ubude ngokunjalo nobubanzi, ukuphakama kube yimitha enye neesentimitha ezimashumi mathathu.
Izibonda zeekona zalo zone mazilabalabe phezulu phaya, zenze iimpondo, futhi ke zityatyekwe ngobhedu.
Lenzele iimbiza zokukhongozela olo thuthu lunamafutha, wenze neefotsholo, izitya, iifolokhwe, neepleyiti zomlilo. Zonke ke ezi zixhobo mazenziwe ngobhedu.
Thatha ubhedu, wenze isisefu, uze usenzele amakhonkco ezikoneni zone.
Esi sisefu sifake phantsi kongqameko olujikeleze iqonga, ngohlobo lokuba sithathe isiqingatha sokuphakama kwalo.
Yenza imiqobo yokubamba ngomngampunzi, uyityabeke ngobhedu.
Yifake macala kuloo makhonkco, ibe ziindawo zokuphatha.
Lenze libe ngumhaba-haba nje wamaplanga, ngokwalaa ndlela ndandikubonise ngayo entabeni.”
“Esi *sibingelelo ke senzele inkundla ngomkhusane owenziwe ngelaphu elisontwe ngobuchule. Ngezantsi malibe ziimitha ezingamashumi amane anesine ubude.
Umkhusane lo mawume ngeentsika zobhedu ezimashumi mabini, ezixhaswe ziziseko zobhedu ezimashumi mabini, zibe namahaki nemiqadi eyenziwe ngesiliva.
Uya kwenza kwangolu hlobo ke nakwicala langasentla.
Kwicala lasentshona umkhusane mawube lilaphu eliziimitha ezimashumi mabini nambini ubude, ube neentsika ezilishumi ezixhaswe ziziseko ezikwalishumi.
Ngasempuma kwicala lesango umkhusane mawube kwaziimitha ezimashumi mabini nambini ububanzi.
Ngapha nangapha esangweni ilaphu malibe ziimitha ezintandathu neesentimitha ezimashumi mathandathu, ime ngeentsika ezintathu ezixhaswe ziziseko ezithathu.

Inkqu yesango ke yona yovalwa ngelaphu eliziimitha ezilithoba ubude, elisontwe ngobuchule. Malibe yile mibala: ozuba, omsobo, nobomvu; liqhoqhonywe ngobugcisa nobunono. Loxhaswa ziintsika ezine ezimi ngeziseko ezine.
Xa zizonke iintsika zenkundla le zodityaniswa ngemiqadi yesiliva, aze namahaki enziwe ngesiliva; ke zona iziseko zibe zezobhedu.

Ubude bale nkundla mabube ziimitha ezingamashumi amane anesine, ububanzi zibe ngamashumi amabini anambini, ukuphakama ke kona ibe ziimitha ezimbini neesentimitha ezimashumi mabini. Umkhusane mawenziwe ngelaphu elisontwe ngobuchule, ke zona iziseko zenziwe ngobhedu.
Xa zizonke izixhobo zesibingelelo ngokunjalo nezenkundla, nditsho nesikhonkwane sembala, mazenziwe ngobhedu.”
“Yitsho amaSirayeli eze neyona icwengileyo ioyile yomnquma, khon' ukuze isibane sihlale sivutha njalo-njalo.

Kweli cala linganeno phambi komkhusane wetyesi yomnqophiso, uAron noonyana bakhe mabasoloko bejonge ukuba izibane ziyavutha phambi *koNdikhoyo, ukususela ngorhatya kude kube kusasa. Lo mmiselo ke mawuhlale uthotyelwe nanini na ngamaSirayeli nezizukulwana zawo.”
“Ke wena biza umkhuluwa wakho uAron noonyana bakhe: uNadabhi, uAbhihu, uElazare, noItamare. Bakhuphe kumaSirayeli, ubamisele babe ngababingeleli bam.
Umntakwenu uAron menzele izivatho zobubingeleli eziya kumtsho abe nesidima nomfaneleko.
Yalela abantu abanesiphiwo sobugcisa nobuchule, utsho benzele uAron izinxibo, khon' ukuze amiselwe umsebenzi wobubingeleli.
Mabenze isikhuselo-sifuba, *isidanga, umnweba, ihempe ehonjisiweyo, iqhiya, kunye nomxwayo. Ezo mpahla ke mabazenzele uAron nooyana bakhe, ukuze bangene kulo msebenzi uwodwa wobubingeleli.
Kulo msebenzi ke mabasebenzise igolide, nelaphu elizuba, elimsobo, nelibomvu; ibe ngamalaphu asontwe ngobuchule.
“Isidanga mabasenze ngolu hlobo: umbala ozuba, omsobo, nobomvu, basebenzise igolide nelaphu eliqhoqhonywe lahonjiswa ngobugcisa.
Masibe nemixwayo eqabela emagxeni, idibanise amacala aso omabini.
Masibe nebhanti eyenziwe kwangelo laphu layo, sibe yinto enye nje, ithungwe ngobugcisa nobuchule obukhulu.
Thatha amatye ekarneli abe mabini, ukrole kuwo amagama oonyana bakaSirayeli,
ngokokuzana kwabo, abe ngamathandathu ngamathandathu.

La magama oonyana bakaSirayeli ke makabhalwe ligcisa lomkroli. La macwecwe anala magama makaqhotyoshelwe ngesipeliti segolide kule mixwayo isemagxeni esidanga, ukuze ahlale esisikhumbuzo ngoonyana bakaSirayeli. Ngale ndlela ke uAro uya kuhlala ewathwele emagxeni la magama, ukuze abe sisikhumbuzo *kuNdikhoyo.
Thatha igolide, wenze izipeliti zokubamba la matye zibe zibini.
Mazibe namatsheyini amabini aphothwe ngemingqa yegolide.”
“Yenza isikhuselo-sifuba esiya kunceda umbingeleli omkhulu xa efuna ukuqonda intando kaThixo. Masenziwe kwangezaa zinto senziwe ngazo *isidanga, nangobugcisa obukwanjalo.
Masibe ngumphindo olinganayo, ubude bube ziisentimitha ezingamashumi amabini nambini, nobubanzi bube kangako.
Masihonjiswe ngemiqolo emine yamatye exabiso. Kuludwe lokuqala ibe yirubhi, itopazi, negarneti;
kolwesibini ibe yiemeraldi, isafire, nedayimani;
kumqolo wesithathu ibe yitekoyisi, iagati, neamatiste;
kowesine ibe yibherile, ikarneli, nejaspa. Onke ke makabanjwe ngesipeliti segolide.
Kuya kubakho amatye alishumi elinambini. Kwilitye ngalinye ke kokrolwa igama lomnye woonyana bakaYakobi abamele izindlu zakwaSirayeli.
Isikhuselo-sifuba masibe namatsheyini amabini aphothwe ngemingqa yegolide.
Kwiikona zaso zangasentla nxibelela amakhonkco amabini egolide,
uze ke uqhinele la matsheyini mabini kuwo.
Kambe ke la macala mabini amatsheyini aseleyo orhintyela kwezaa zipeliti zibini, ukuze ngolo hlobo abhijele ngaphambili aye kuqhagamshela kwimixwayo yesidanga.
Kwakhona ke yenza amakhonkco amabini ngegolide, uwanxibelele phaya kwezaa kona zaso zingezantsi ngaphakathi phezu kwesidanga.
Ngokukwanjalo yenza amanye amakhonkco abe mabini ngegolide, uwanxibelele kumazantsi emixwayo yesidanga ngaphambili, kude kufuphi kodwa ngaphezu kwalaa bhanti ithungwe ngobugcisa nobuchule.
Amakhonkco esikhuselo-sifuba wadibanise namakhonkco esidanga ngomtya ozuba, ukuze isikhuselo-sifuba sihlale phezu kwesidanga singabhakuzeli.
“Ngoko ke xa uAron engena egumbini elingcwele makanxibe esi sikhuselo-sifuba sinamagama ezindlu zikaSirayeli, ukuze mna *Ndikhoyo ndingaze ndibalibale abantu bam.
Kwalapho kwisidanga faka *iiurim neethumim, ukuze uAron ahambe nazo xa esiza kum. Ewe, ngala maxesha makanxibe isikhuselo-sifuba, ukuze asoloko enako ukuyiqonda intando yam mayela namaSirayeli.”
“Ke wona umnweba ophezu *kwesidanga mawulukwe ube lilaphu elizuba.
Mawugqojozwe indawo yokungena intloko, ize iqukunjelwe iqine, ukuze ingakrazuki.
Kumazantsi awo uze wenze imifanekiso yeerharnati ibe zuba, emsobo, nebomvu. Ezi zihombiso ke mazibolekisane neentsinjana ezenziwe ngegolide.
Lo mnweba ke uAron uya kuwufaka xa ekumsebenzi wakhe wobubingeleli. Iintsimbi ezo ke ziya kukhenkceza xa angenayo egumbini elingcwele, ngokunjalo naxa aphumayo. Ngokwenjenjalo uya kusinda ekufeni.
“Thatha igolide ecocekileyo, wenze icwecwe elihle. Uze ukrole amagama kulo athi: ‘*OkaNdikhoyo pheleleyo.’
Liqhagamshele ngomsonto ozuba eqhiyeni yakhe ebunzi.

Eli cwecwe ke liya kuthi nca ebunzi kuAron, khon' ukuze mna *Ndikhoyo ndiwamkele amadini amaSirayeli, nangona angade abe nempazamo xa anikelayo. Ewe, eli cwecwe malibe sebunzi kuye lonke ixesha. Ngokwenjenjalo abantu bam amaSirayeli baya kuhlala bamkelekile kum.
“UAron uze umthungele ihempe ngelaphu elisontwe ngobugcisa. Uze umenzele iqhiya kwangelo laphu, ngokunjalo nomxwayo ohonjiswe waqhoqhonywa ngobona bugcisa.
“Oonyana baka-Aron benzele iminweba nemixwayo neminqwazi, ukuze babe nesidima nomfaneleko.
Ezi zivatho ke zinxibe uAron ngokunjalo noonyana bakhe. Wakukhov' ukwenjenjalo ke bathambise ubamisele ukuze bangene emsebenzini wobubingeleli.
Kwakhona thatha ilaphu, ubenzele iibhulukhwe zangaphantsi ezisuka esinqeni zime emathangeni, ukuze bangahambi ze.

UAron ndawonye noonyana bakhe mabasoloko bezinxibile xa bengena *esibingelelweni, noba bakwezamadini okwababingeleli, hleze bafe ngenxa yokuba behamba ze. Lo ke ngummiselo ongasoze washukunyiswa kuAron ndawonye nezizukulwana zakhe.”
“Nantsi ke imigqalisela omawuhambe ngayo xa umisela uAron noonyana bakhe kumsebenzi wabo wobubingeleli. Thatha inkunzana yenkomo kunye neenkunzi ezimbini zeegusha, zonke ke zibe zezingenasiphako.
Thatha umgubo wengqolowa wodidi oluphambili, wenze isonka sentlama engenagwele, namaqebengwana anamafutha, nemiqathane yentlama engenagwele ethanjiswe ngamafutha.
Ezo zonka zifake ebhaskitini, wenze ngazo umnikelo xa ubingelela ngezaa nkunzi, eyenkomo nezeegusha ezimbini.
“UAron noonyana bakhe mabeze esangweni lesibingelelo, ubahlambe ngamanzi.
UAron ke makanxibe ezobubingeleli: ihempe, *isidanga, umnweba, isikhuselo-sifuba, nebhanti;
umthwalise iqhiya, ulebele ngelaa cwecwe libhalwe ukuthi: ‘*OkaNdikhoyo pheleleyo.’
Wakukhov' ukwenjenjalo ke, mthi jize ngamafutha entloko, umthambise.
“Thatha oonyana bakhe, ubafake iminweba;
bafake imixwayo, bathwale iminqwazi yabo. Le ke yindlela oya kummisela ngayo uAron noonyana bakhe; ububingeleli iya kuba ngummiselo wabo nanini nanini.
“Uze uthathe inkunzi yenkomo, uze nayo ngasesangweni lesibingelelo. UAron noonyana bakhe mababeke izandla zabo phezu kwentloko yayo.
Yixhelele phambi koNdikhoyo apho ngasesangweni lesibingelelo.
Yithi nkxu igazi ngomnwe, uqabe iimpondo zeqonga lamadini ngalo. Inxalenye yegazi ke yigalele emazantsi eqonga elo.
Ngoku thatha umhlehlo, nenxalenye yesibindi, izintso zombini, ndawonye namanqatha azo, uzitshise phezu kweqonga lamadini.
Ke yona inyama yenkunzi leyo, ufele, ndawonye nezibilini, uya kuzitshisela ngaphandle komzi. Eli ke lidini lokususa izono.
“Kwakhona thatha enye yeenkunzi zegusha, aze uAron noonyana bakhe babeke izandla zabo phezu kwentloko yayo.
Yixhele, uze uthathe igazi layo uliphose macal' omane kwiqonga lamadini.

Inyama leyo yihlahle, ke zona izibilini uzihlambe ndawonye namanqina. Ezi ndawo ndizibalileyo ke, nenyama xa iyonke, ngokunjalo nentloko, zidibanise uzitshisele phezu kweqonga lamadini. Eli ke lidini elitshiswayo. Litsho ngevumba elimyoli kuNdikhoyo.
“Kananjalo thatha enye inkunzi yegusha leyaa, utsho uAron noonyana bakhe babeke izandla zabo phezu kwentloko yayo.

Yixhele, uthathe kwigazi layo, uqabe isithinzi sendlebe yasekunene kuAron nakoonyana bakhe. Kwakhona qaba oobhontsi babo basekunene ezandleni, ngokunjalo noobhontsi basekunene beenyawo zabo. Igazi eliseleyo ke lisarhaze macal' onke apho kwiqonga lamadini.

Thatha kwigazi elilapho phezu kweqonga lamadini, ndawonye neoyile yokuthambisa, ufefe uAron noonyana bakhe ndawonye neempahla zabo. Xa bebonke ke, ngokunjalo neempahla zabo, baya kumiselwa banikezelwe emsebenzini wam.
“Thatha amanqatha enkunzi yegusha leyo ke, iketelele lomsila, umhlehlo, inxalenye yesibindi, izintso zombini, ndawonye namanqatha azo, nomlenze wasekunene.
Phaya ebhaskitini caphula kwiintlobo zonke: isonka, iqebengwana, nomqathane.
Zibeke ezandleni zika-Aron noonyana bakhe, baziwangawangise, bandenzele ngazo umnikelo owodwa.
Kamva ke uya kuzithatha kubo, uzitshise ndawonye nedini elitshiswayo. Elo ke lidini elivumba liyolileyo kuNdikhoyo – kaloku lidini elitshiswayo.
“Ke kaloku uya kuthatha incum yale nkunzi yegusha, uyiwangawangise, uyenze umnikelo kum. Kambe ke esi iya kuba sisabelo sakho.
“Xa kumiselwa umbingeleli incum nomlenze waloo nkunzi yegusha isetyenzisiweyo zingumnikelo kum, omawubekelwe bucala, ube sisabelo sababingeleli.
Lo ke ngummiselo wam ongasoze uthini. Nanini na abantu bam besenza idini lobudlelwane, incum nomlenze sisabelo sababingeleli; ngoko sisipho esinikelwa kuNdikhoyo.
“Xa engasekho uAron, izivatho zakhe zobubingeleli ziya kunikwa oonyana bakhe, banxitywe zona mhla bethanjiswa bemiselwa.
Lo nyana ka-Aron ungena esikhundleni sakhe asebenze *esibingelelweni endaweni engcwele, wonxitywa ezi zivatho iintsuku zibe sixhenxe.
“Inyama leyo yenkunzi yegusha amiselwa ngayo uAron noonyana bakhe wòyiphekela endaweni enyulu.
Baya kuyithatha ke bayitye kunye nesaa sonka besisele ebhaskitini, bayityele apho esangweni lesibingelelo.
Ke zona eziya ndawo ziseleyo xa bekusenziwa idini lokungxengxeza ekumiselweni kwabo, baya kuzitya. Kambe ke ngababingeleli bodwa abanelungelo lokukutya oku kutya, kuba kunyulu.
Inyama okanye isonka esiseleyo kwada kwakusasa, mazitshiswe, zingàtyiwa; kaloku zinyulu.
“Uyabona ke lo msitho wokumisela uAron noonyana bakhe mawube ziintsuku ezisixhenxe njengoko ndakuyalelayo.
Mini nganye ke uya kwenza idini lokungxengxezela izono ngenkunzi yenkomo ibe nye. Ngokwenjenjalo uya kuhlambulula iqonga lamadini, uze ke ngokunjalo ulithambise ngeoyile libe nyulu.
Uya kwenjenjalo ke iintsuku zibe sixhenxe. Xa kunjalo ke iqonga lamadini liya kuba nyulu ngokugqibeleleyo, aze athi nabani na okanye nantoni na elichukumisayo ibe nyulu nayo.”
“Ukusukela ngoku, yonke imihla yenza idini ngamaxhwane amabini phaya kwiqonga lamadini.
Thatha elinye kusasa, lize eli liseleyo libe lelasemalanga.
Kweli lakusasa nikela nomgubo wengqolowa wodidi oluphambili, ube yikhilogram enye ubunzima, uwudibanise nelitha enye yamafutha omnquma acwengileyo. Yenza idini ngelitha yewayini.
Nakweli lasemalanga idini sebenzisa umgubo, amafutha, kunye newayini, kwangalaa ndlela wenze ngayo kusasa. Eli ke lidini elitshiswayo – litsho ngevumba eliyolileyo *kuNdikhoyo.
Ukusukela ngoku eli dini litshiswayo mandilenzelwe phaya esangweni *lesibingelelo. Kaloku apho kulapho ndiya kuhlangana khona nabantu bam, ndithethe nawe khona.
Ewe, ndiya kuhlangana khona namaSirayeli; baye ubuqaqawuli bam buya kuyitsho loo ndawo ibe yekhethekileyo.
Ndiya kusenza nyulu isibingelelo ndawonye neqonga lamadini. Ke yena uAron noonyana bakhe ndiya kubachonga ukuze babe ngababingeleli bam.
Ndiya kuhlala phakathi kwamaSirayeli, ndibe nguThixo wawo.
Kananjalo ke aya kundiqonda ukuba ndinguNdikhoyo uThixo wawo owawakhulula eJiputa, ukuze ndihlale phakathi kwawo. Ngenene ndinguNdikhoyo uThixo wawo.”
“Thatha umngampunzi, wenze iqonga lesiqhumiso.
Amacala alo makalingane, abe ziisentimitha ezingamashumi amane nantlanu ubude, ngokunjalo nobubanzi; umphakamo ke wona zibe ngamashumi asithoba. Izibonda zeekona mazilabalabe zenze iimpondo.
Eli qonga ke lityabeke lonke ngegolide: umphezulu, amacala, neempondo; futhi ke uliphethe ngegolide jikelele.
Lenzele amakhonkco amabini ngegolide, uwanxibelele apha phantsi komphetho macala, khon' ukuze apho kuwo kungene imiqobo yokuliphatha.
Nayo le miqobo yenze ngomngampunzi, uyityabeke ngegolide.
Eli qonga malibe nganeno komkhusane ophambi kwetyesi enobungqina bomnqophiso evalwe ngesivalo sokungxengxezela, apho ndiya kuhlangana nawe khona.
Miso le xa uAron eze kulungisa izibane, uya kufaka isiqhumiso esivumba limnandi kweli qonga.
Nasemalanga ke, xa eze kulumeka izibane, makenze kwangolo hlobo. Lo mnikelo ke wesiqhumiso mawungatyeshelwa kude kube zizizukulwana ngezizukulwana.
Kweli qonga ke ungaze uqhumise ngasiqhumiso simbi, okanye idini elitshiswayo, kungenjalo idini lokutya; phezu kwalo ungenzi mnikelo uthululwayo.

Kanye ngonyaka uAron makalihlambulule eli qonga ngokwenza idini lokucamagusha. Uya kuthatha igazi lelo dini lesono, aqabe iimpondo zalo. Lo mmiselo ke mawenziwe minyaka le, ungaze uyekwe. Ngokwenjenjalo ke eli qonga liya kuba nyulu ngokugqibeleleyo kuNdikhoyo.”
*UNdikhoyo ke wathi kuMosis:
“Ngexesha lobalo lwamaSirayeli umntu ngamnye aze akhuphe umrhumo wokucamagushela ubomi bakhe, khon' ukuze kungabikho shwangusha elubalweni apho.
Wonke umntu obalwayo makakhuphe iqhekeza lesiliva liqulunqwe ngokomlinganiselo ovunyiweyo. Ewe wonke ubani makahlawule le mali, ibe ngumnikelo wakhe kum.
Lilonke ke, mntu wonke ubalwayo ukuqalela kominyaka ingamashumi amabini ukunyuka, makawukhuphe loo mrhumo.
Uyabona ke, kuloo mrhumo wobomi babo akukho sityebi nahlwempu, koko bonke baya kukhupha ngokulinganayo umlinganiselo lowo umisiweyo.
Le mali ke yiqokelele kuwo onke amaSirayeli, ize isetyenziswe ekuxhaseni *isibingelelo. Lo mrhumo ke sisicamgushelo sobomi babo, khon' ukuze ndihlale ndibakhumbula ndibakhusele.”
*UNdikhoyo wathetha noMosis wathi:
“Yenza isitya sokuhlambela ngobhedu, usihlalise phezu kwesiseko sobhedu. Masime phakathi kwegumbi elingcwele neqonga lamadini, usigalele amanzi.
UAron noonyana bakhe baya kuhlamba izandla neenyawo kuloo manzi
xa bangenayo egumbini elingcwele okanye besiya kwenza idini elitshiswayo kwiqonga lamadini, ukuze bangafi.
Ewe, mabahlambe izandla neenyawo ukuze bangafi. Lo ke ngummiselo amabawuthobele bona nezizukulwana zabo.”
*UNdikhoyo wayalela uMosis wathi:
“Thatha obona bulawu bodidi: iikhilogram ezintandathu zemore engamanzi, iikhilogram ezintathu zesinamon evumba limnandi, iikhilogram ezintathu zezele elivumba limnandi, neekhilogram ezintandathu
zekasiya; zonke mazilinganiswe ngokomlinganiselo ovunyiweyo. Xa zizonke ke zidibanise neelitha ezine zamafutha omnquma,
wenze isiqholo esingamafutha anyulu avumba limnandi, axutywe lichule.
Ngawo ke thambisa intente *yesibingelelo, ityesi enobungqina bomnqophiso,
itafile namasolotya ayo, isibane nobuxhaka-xhaka baso, iqonga lesiqhumiso,
iqonga lamadini nokwalo, kunye nesitya sokuhlambela nesiseko saso.
Wakuba uzihlambulule ngolu hlobo ke ezi zinto ziya kuba nyulu ngokupheleleyo, ngokunjalo ke nantoni na ezichukumisayo iya kuba nyulu.
Thambisa uAron noonyana bakhe, ubamisele babe ngababingeleli bam.
Waxelele amaSirayeli ukuba la mafutha ngawam kuphela kude kube zizizukulwana ngezizukulwana.
Umntu nje ongomnye angàze athanjiswe ngawo. Kwaye futhi ungàze uthathe le migqalisela axutywe ngayo wenze amafutha nje. Kaloku anyulu; ngoko ke wahloniphe.
Nabani na owenza amafutha afana nawo, okanye osebenzisa la mafutha mntwini wumbi ungengombingeleli, uya kusikwa phakathi kwabantu bam.”
*UNdikhoyo wayalela uMosis wathi: “Thatha umlinganiselo ofanayo wezi ntlobo zobulawu: isitakate, ionirha, igalbhano, nentlaka yokuqhumisa yoqobo.
Yenza ngazo umxube wesiqhumiso esivumba liyolileyo. Sithi saa ityiwa, sihlambuluke sibe nyulu.
Thatha inxalenye yaso, uyicole ibe ngumgubo, ungene nayo *esibingelelweni, uyibeke phambi kwetyesi yomnqophiso apho ndiya kuhlangana khona nawe. Esi siqhumiso masihlonipheke; sinyulu.
Ningaze nithathe imigqaliselo yalo mxube waso nizenzele esenu. Siphatheni ngentlonipho, sibe sesam ndedwa.
Nabani na ozenzele isiqhumiso esifana naso, okanye osebenzisa esi njengesiqholo, uya kusikwa phakathi kwabantu bam.”
*UNdikhoyo waxelela uMosis wathi:
“Uyabona ke, uBhezaleli unyana kaUri umzukulwana kaYuri wendlu kaJuda, ndimnyule.
Ndimzalise ngoMoya wam, ndamthi jize ngokuqonda, ubuchule, nabo bonke ubugcisa;
ukucwangcisa nokuyila esebenza ngegolide, isiliva, nobhedu;
ukukrola nokuqingqa amatye, nokuchwela, nawo wonke umsebenzi wobugcisa.

Kanti ke noHoliyabhi, unyana ka-Ahisamaki wendlu kaDan, ndimtyumbile ukuba ancedisane noBhezaleli. Naye ke ngokunjalo bonke ubuchule nobugcisa ndimphile, khon' ukuze babe nako ukuyenza yonke into endiyalela ukuba yenziwe:
*isibingelelo, ityesi yomnqophiso nesivalo sayo, nezixhobo nako konke okuhamba nesibingelelo;
itafile namasolotya ayo, isibane esenziwe ngegolide yoqobo nokwaso, iqonga lesiqhumiso,
iqonga lamadini atshiswayo nezixhobo zalo, isitya sokuhlambela nesiseko saso;
ezo zivatho zingayiwayo zobubingeleli zika-Aron noonyana bakhe, abaya kuzisebenzisa xa befezekisa umsebenzi endibanike wona;
amafutha okuthambisa, neso siqhumiso sivumba limnandi segumbi elingcwele. Zonke ke ezi zinto mabazenze matwa nendlela endikuyalele ngayo.”
*UNdikhoyo wathi uMosis
makayalele amaSirayeli athi: “Wuhloneleni *uMhla wokuPhumla, uyimini yam; ewe, ungumqondiso phakathi kwam nani kwizizukulwana ngezizukulwana, uxela ukuba mna Ndikhoyo ndanenza naba ngabam ncakasana.
Ngoko ke wuhloneleni uMhla wokuPhumla, kuba kuni ungumhla owodwa. Umntu ongawuhloneliyo, koko osebenzayo ngawo, makabulawe.
Kaloku zikho iintsuku ezintandathu ukuba nenze wonke umsebenzi wenu, kodwa ke wona umhla wesixhenxe ngumhla onendili wokuphumla olibango lam. Nabani na ke owenza umsebenzi wakhe ngawo makabulawe.
AmaSirayeli makaluhlonele olu suku, lube ngumqondiso ngokomnqophiso kwizizukulwana ngezizukulwana.
Lona lungumqondiso ongasoze ujike phakathi kwam namaSirayeli. Kaloku mna Ndikhoyo ndênza izulu nehlabathi liphela ngeentsuku ezintandathu, ndaza ke ndaphumla ngomhla wesixhenxe.”
Akukhov' ukuthetha uThixo noMosis entabeni yeSinayi, wamnikezela amacwecwe amatye amabini, apho uThixo ngenkqu wayeyibhale khona imimiselo.
AmaSirayeli akubona ukuba uMosis akabuyi entabeni, asuka amgungela uAron, athi: “Senzele *uthixo oza kusikhokela. Okokwakhe yena laa Mosis wasikhupha eJiputa, asiyazi into emhleleyo.”
UAron wayalela ukuba bathathe amacici ebafazini, koonyana, nasezintombini zabo, beze nawo kuye.
Bawakhulula ke amacici lawo, beza nawo kuAron.
Wawathatha ke, wawanyibilikisa, waza igolide leyo enziwe ngayo wayibumba ngezixhobo zokubumba, wenza inkunzana yenkomo ngayo. AmaSirayeli ke athi: “Sirayeli, nanku uThixo wakho owakukhupha eJiputa!”
Akuyibona le nto uAron wakha iqonga lamadini apho phambi kwaloo nkunzana yenkomo, waza wenza isaziso esithi: “Ngomso kobhiyozelwa uNdikhoyo.”
Kwangentseni ngomhla olandelayo benza amadini atshiswayo kwanatyiwayo. Ke kaloku abo bantu batya, basela, bahakaza, bada barheletya.
*UNdikhoyo wayalela uMosis wathi: “Khawuleza uhle! Aba bantu bakho wabakhupha eJiputa babhatyazile;
sebekhawuleze bawushiya umyalelo endabanika wona. Ngoku bazibumbele inkunzana yenkomo, bayinqula; futhi banikela amadini kuyo. Bathi: ‘MaSirayeli, lo nguThixo wethu owasikhupha eJiputa.’ ”
UNdikhoyo waqhuba wathi: “Ngoku ndiyabaqonda aba bantu inkani yabo – nqwa neyesele!
Ngoko ke wena ndiyeke, kuba ndiza kubacim' igama, wena ndikwenze ube sisizwe esikhulu.”
Kambe ke uMosis watarhuzisa kuNdikhoyo uThixo wakhe, wathi: “Awu, *Mhlekazi, ungathini kaloku ukusuka ulwe kanjalo nabantu bakho owabahlangula wabakhulula ngobungaka bona ubungangamsha kwelaseJiputa?

Xa kunjalo amaJiputa angatsho ngakhona athi: ‘UThixo wamaSirayeli wawakhupha eJiputa eneenjongo zokuwatshabalalisela ezintabeni, awatshayele angabikho ehlabathini.’ Awu, ndiyakubongoza, Mhlekazi, lala ngenxeba, uxole, ungabi sabahlisela le ntlekele abantu bakho.

Khawukhumbule izicaka zakho, uAbraham, uIsake, noSirayeli. Kaloku wazifunga kwawena siqu, usithi: ‘Inzala yenu ndiya kuyandisa, ibe ninzi njengeenkwenkwezi ezisesibhaka-bhakeni. Eli lizwe ndinithembise ngalo liya kuba lilifa lezizukulwana zenu ngonaphakade.’ ”
Ngenene ke *uNdikhoyo wabuya nganeno kuloo ntlekele wayethe uza kubahlisela yona abantu bakhe.
UMosis ke wehla apho entabeni, ewaphethe loo macwecwe mabini amatye abhalwe ubungqina bomnqophiso macal' omabini.
La macwecwe ke ayengumsebenzi kaThixo ncakasana, nombhalo lowo wawukrolwe nguye ngenkqu.
Akuyiva ingxolo yabantu bekhwaza, uYoshuwa wabhekisa kuMosis wathi: “Ndiva intsholo esikhululweni ngathi lifile.”
UMosis waphendula wathi: “Kum le ntsholo ingathi asiyiyo eyoloyiso, okanye ukoyiswa; ivakala ngathi yeyeziyolo nje.”

Uthe ke uMosis akuba kufuphi, ebone loo nkunzi yenkomo, ngokunjalo nabantu beduda bexhentsa, suka wasisifu ngumsindo. Apho kanye phantsi kwentaba wasuka wawalahla phantsi loo macwecwe wayewaphethe, aphuka.
Wayithatha loo nkunzi babeyibumbile, wayiphosa emlilweni, waza wayicola yangumgubo, wawugalela emanzini aselwa ngamaSirayeli.
UMosis wabuza kuAron wathi: “Aba bantu bakwenze ntoni na ukuze ubafake kwesinje sona isono?”
UAron waphendula wathi: “Ungakhathazeki, mntakwethu; kaloku nawe uyabazi aba bantu ukuba baqinel' enyaleni ngesono.
Basuka bathi kum: ‘Senzele uThixo oza kusikhokela, kuba asiyazi into emhleleyo laa Mosis osikhuphe eJiputa.’
Ndithe ke kubo: ‘Ndinikeni izinto zegolide eninazo,’ baza ke benjenjalo. Ndasuka ke ndaziphosa emlilweni, kwee gqi le nkunzi.”
UMosis ke waqonda ukuba uAron uvule zabhuqa, baza abantu benza unothanda, bazenza intlekisa nasezintshabeni.
Ngoko ke wasuka wema esangweni, wathi: “Bonke *abangakuNdikhoyo mabaphume ngapha!” Ke kaloku kwaphuma yonke indlu kaLevi,

waza wathi kubo: “Utsho uNdikhoyo uThixo kaSirayeli ukuthi: ‘Umntu ngamnye kuni makathathe ikrele, aqale kweli sango, aye kuphuma kweliya lingaphaya, ebinza elalis' ugodo, kumtakwabo, isihlobo, ngokunjalo nommelwane wakhe.’ ”
AbaLevi abo ke benza ngokwaloo myalelo, baza ke babulala amawaka amathathu amadoda ngaloo mini.
UMosis ke wathi kubaLevi: “Niyabona ke, namhlanje, ngokubulala abantakwenu noonyana benu, niye naba ngababingeleli bokubusa uNdikhoyo. Ngoko ke uNdikhoyo unithamsanqele.”
Ngengomso ke uMosis wathi ebantwini: “Nenze isono esilumezayo. Naxa kunjalo ndiza kuphinda ndiye entabeni kuNdikhoyo, ukuze ndenze isingxengxezo ngenxa yesono senu.”
UMosis waya kuNdikhoyo, wafika wathi: “Aba bantu benze isono esilumezayo. Basuke bazibumbela isithixo ngegolide, basinqula.
Ngoku ke ndiyakubongoza, baxolele; ukuba akunakuba njalo wosewulicima igama lam encwadini yakho oyibhalileyo.”
UNdikhoyo wathi kuMosis: “Abantu abamagama ndiwacimayo encwadini yam, ngabo bandonileyo bodwa.
Ngoko ke hamba, ukhokele aba bantu, ubase kulaa ndawo ndandithethe ngayo kuwe. Ke sona isithunywa sam siya kukukhokela. Kambe ke lakufika ixesha ndiya kubohlwaya aba bantu ngenxa yesi sono.”
Ke kaloku uNdikhoyo wawabetha ngobhubhani wesifo amaSirayeli ngenxa yokuba amnyanzelayo uAron ukuba awenzele inkunzi yenkomo yegolide.

*UNdikhoyo wathi kuMosis: “Hamba apha, wena nabo bonke abantu owabakhokelayo waphuma nabo eJiputa, usingise kwilizwe endabathembisa lona ngesifungo uAbraham, uIsake, noYakobi, ndisithi: ‘Loba lelezizukulwana zenu.’
Ndiya kuthumela isithunywa sinikhaphe, siwagxothe amaKanana, ama-Amori, amaHiti, amaPerezi, amaHivi, namaJebhusi.
Hambani niye kwelo lizwe lendyebo nentlutha. Kambe ke mna andizukuhamba nani, hleze ndisuke ndinitshabalalise ningekafiki, kuba niluhlanga oluneenkani.”
Athe ke amaSirayeli akuziva ezi ndaba zibuhlungu, asuka azila, azikhulula iintsimbi awayehomba ngazo.

Kaloku uNdikhoyo wayethe kuMosis: “Xelela amaSirayeli: ‘Niluhlanga oluneenkani, ngoko ke andizukuhamba nani, kuba xa bendinokuhamba nani nomzuzwana lo, bendiya kusuka ndinitshabalalise. Zikhululeni iintsimbi zesihombiso; ndisaza kuyibona into endiza kunenza yona.’ ”
Ngoko ke amaSirayeli azikhulula iintsimbi nezinye izihombiso zawo ukunduluka kwawo kwintaba iHorebhe.

Ke kaloku kolu hambo lwawo amaSirayeli ayesithi apho emise khona, uMosis agxumeke iintente, emise enye intente mganyana nje nendawo leyo bahlala kuyo. Le ke yayiyintente yokuhlangana; nabani na owayefuna ukuva *kuNdikhoyo wayesiya kuyo.
Wayesithi uMosis xa esiya ententeni yokuhlangana amaSirayeli wona eme emnyango ezintenteni zawo, ambukele ade aye kungena.
Wayesithi nje ukuba angene uMosis, umqulu welifu uhle ufike uhlale emnyango ententeni apho, aze ke yena uNdikhoyo athethe noMosis.
AmaSirayeli ayesithi akuwubona umqulu welifu usemnyango apho ententeni yokuhlangana, asuke ee guqaqa anqule.

Ke yena uNdikhoyo wayeye athethe noMosis ubuso ngobuso, njengaye nabani na othetha nomhlobo wakhe. UMosis ke wayesithi akugqiba agoduke, kodwa yena uYoshuwa umfana olihlakani lakhe, unyana kaNune, wayesala apho ententeni yokuhlangana.

UMosis wathetha *noNdikhoyo, wathi: “Kaloku undiyalele ukuba ndikhokele aba bantu, ndibase kwelo lizwe, kodwa akutshongo ukuba kolu hambo ndokhatshwa ngubani na. Ewe, utshilo nokuthi: ‘Ndikwazi ngokupheleleyo; kwaye futhi ndikholisekile nguwe.’
Ngoko ke, xa kunjalo, ndazise intando yakho, ukuze ndikwazi, ndihlale ndikholisekile kuwe. Kwakhona khumbula ukuba olu hlanga ngabantu bakho ncakasana.”
UNdikhoyo waphendula wathi: “Hayi kaloku, ndiza kuhamba nani ngenkqu, ndinithi jize ngokuphumla.”
Ke yena uMosis waleka ngelithi: “Ukuba akuhambi nathi, sukuba sasindulula simke apha.
Xa ungahambi nathi kuya kwaziwa njani ukuba ukholisekile ndim naba bantu? Kanti ke xa ukho phakathi kwethu, siya kutsho sahluke kulo lonke uluntu.”
UNdikhoyo wathi: “Ndiza kwenza kanye ngokwesicelo sakho, kuba kaloku ndikholisekile nguwe, futhi ke ndikwazi kakuhle.”
UMosis waphinda wenza isicelo, wathi kuNdikhoyo: “Ke ngoku khawundivelele ngobuqaqawuli bakho.”

UNdikhoyo wathi: “Ndiza kukubonisa isidima sam njengoko sinjalo, futhi ndilikhankanye igama lam ezindlebeni zakho, mna Ndikhoyo. Kaloku ndiya kuba nenceba kwabo ndinenceba kubo, ndibe novelwano kwabo ndinovelwano kubo.
Andizukukubonisa ubuso bam; kaloku akukho mntu unokububona aphinde aphile.
Kambe ke nantsi indawo ecaleni kwam apho ungema khona phezu kweliwa.
Ndiya kuthi ke xa ndidlula khona ngobuqaqawuli bam, ndikufihle emfanteni yeliwa, ndize ndikugqume ngesandla ndide ndidlule.
Ndakuba ndidlule ke, ndiya kusisusa isandla, ukuze ube nokundibona ndifulathele, hayi ebusweni.”
*UNdikhoyo wayalela uMosis wathi: “Qingqa amanye amacwecwe amatye amabini afana nalawa okuqala, ukuze mna ndiwabhale kuwo amazwi awayebhalwe kulawa wawaphulayo.
Ngomso kusasa uze unyuke intaba iSinayi, apho uya kundibona nam khona.
Makungabikho mntu uhamba nawe okanye usondelayo nakuliphi na icala lentaba; nditsho kwaiigusha neenkomo mazingasondeli entabeni.”
UMosis ke wawaqingqa amacwecwe amabini amatye, waza ngengomso kusasa wenyuka nawo entabeni iSinayi ngokokutsho kukaNdikhoyo, ewaphethe ngezandla.
Ke kaloku uNdikhoyo wehla ngelifu, waza wema noMosis apho entabeni, walikhankanya igama lakhe – uNdikhoyo.
Waza ke wadlula phambi kwakhe, wandula wathi: “UNdikhoyo nguThixo onemfesane nesisa, oza kade umsindo, ophuphuma izibele nokunyaniseka.

Ukunyaniseka kwakhe akujiki nakwizizukulwana ngezizukulwana; abakhohlakeleyo nabanxaxhayo nabonayo uyabaxolela. Kambe ke abanetyala ubohlwaya ade ohlwaye nesizukulwana sabo, aye kufikelela kwesesithathu nakwesesine ngenxa yeziphoso zooyise.”
UMosis wasuka wee guqaqa wakhahlela;
wambongoza wathi: “Ukuba ngenene ukholisekile ndim, Mhlekazi, sikhaphe. Nakuba siluhlanga oluneenkani nje, buxolele ubugwenxa nesono sethu, samkele sibe lilifa lakho.”

UNdikhoyo wathi kuMosis: “Ngoku ke ndenza umnqophiso nani. Ndiya kwenza imimangaliso engazange yenziwe ehlabathini liphela, ngokunjalo nakwizizwe zalo. Kaloku mna Ndikhoyo ndiza kwenza into erhwaqelisayo phakathi kwenu.
Yithobeleni imithetho endininika yona namhlanje. Xa ningenayo ndiya kuwagxotha ama-Amori, amaKanana, amaHiti, amaPerezi, amaHivi, namaJebhusi.
Ningakhe nilinge nenze izivumelwano naba bantu ningena emhlabeni wabo, kuba ngokwenjenjalo ningazifaka esigwini.
Ndaweni yaloo nto wadilizeni amaqonga abo amadini, niyifohloze imifanekiso yabo; ke sona *isithixo sabo uAshera ze nisityoboze.
“Ningaze ninqule thixo wumbi, kuba mna Ndikhoyo ndinguSobukhwele; ndinguThixo onekhwele.
Sanukwenza zivumelwano nabantu belo lizwe; kuba hleze bathi, xa benqula besenzela izithixo zabo amadini amanyumnyezi, banimeme nani, nilukuhleke, nitye loo madini azo.
Nani ningasuka nibathathele oonyana benu abafazi kwezo ntombi zabo, zithi ke ngaloo ndlela zibahende banqule izithixo.
“Ningaze niziqingqele izithixo.

“Ningaze niyeke ukwenza itheko lesonka sentlama engenagwele. Yenzani njengoko ndaniyalelayo, nitye isonka esinganyuswanga iintsuku zibe sixhenxe kwinyanga ka-Abhibhi. Kaloku leyo yinyanga enaphuma ngayo eJiputa.
“Unyana wamazibulo ngokunjalo neduna lemfuyo lamazibulo lelam.
“Ke lona iduna lamazibulo ledonki nolihlawulela ngedini letakane. Kungenjalo ke niya kulaphula ilungu lentamo. Wonke unyana wamazibulo makahlawulelwe. “Akukho mntu makeze kum engaphathanga mnikelo.
“Iintsuku ezintandathu evekini zezokwenza wonke umsebenzi wenu. Kodwa ke ngosuku lwesixhenxe ze niphumle; nditsho nkqu nangamaxesha okulima nokuvuna.
“Xa nivuna ingqolowa yenzani itheko lolibo; kanti ke ningalityesheli netheko lesivuno ngexesha lokuvuna iziqhamo.
“Onke amadoda makeze kunqula mna Ndikhoyo Thixo kaSirayeli kathathu ngonyaka.

Ndiya kuzigxotha izizwe phambi kwenu, itsho inabe imida yenu, kungabikho namntu uya kuzama ukulihlutha elo lizwe kuni xa nisiya kundinqula mna Ndikhoyo Thixo wenu ngazo zozithathu ezi zihlandlo enyakeni.
“Xa nindenzela idini ze ningasisebenzisi isonka sentlama enegwele. Ngexesha letheko *lePasika inyama yedini ize ingabekwa mbeko.
“Minyaka le zisani ulibo lwesivuno endlwini kaNdikhoyo. “Ningaze nilipheke ngobisi lukanina itakane lebhokhwe.”
UNdikhoyo wayalela uMosis wathi: “Wabhale la mazwi. Kaloku umnqophiso wam nani uxhomekeke kuwo.”
Ke kaloku uMosis wahlala apho iintsuku ezingamashumi amane engatyi engaseli. Amazwi omnqophiso wawabhala apho emacwecweni, oko kukuthi imithetho elishumi.
Ukubuya kwakhe entabeni uMosis ephethe loo mithetho ilishumi, ubuso bakhe babukhazimla, kuba ethethe *noNdikhoyo; kambe ke yena wayengayiqondi loo nto.
UAron namaSirayeli onke babubona ukuba ubuso bakhe buyakhazimla, batsho boyika ukusondela kuye.
Kodwa uMosis wababiza, waza uAron nazo zonke iinkokheli zamaSirayeli beza kuye, waza wathetha nabo.
Kamva ke onke amaSirayeli aqokelelana kuMosis, waza ke wawaxelela yonke imiyalelo ayinikwe nguNdikhoyo entabeni iSinayi.
Wathi ke akugqiba ukuthetha nabo uMosis, wabufaka isigqubuthelo ubuso bakhe.
Wayesithi xa eza kuthetha noNdikhoyo asisuse isigqubuthelo. Ekubuyeni kwakhe ke wayewaxelela konke akuyalelwe nguNdikhoyo amaSirayeli.
Wona ke ayebubona ukuba ubuso bakhe buyakhazimla. Kambe ke wayeye afake isigqubuthelo, ade aphinde kwakhona aye kuthetha noNdikhoyo.
UMosis waliqokelela lonke ibandla lamaSirayeli, wathi: “Nantsi imiyalelo *kaNdikhoyo:

iintsuku zokusebenza imisebenzi yenu zintandathu evekini, kodwa lona usuku lwesixhenxe ngumhla owodwa okhethekileyo; ngumhla kaNdikhoyo, umhla wokuphumla. Nabani na ke owenza nawuphi na umsebenzi ngawo wobulawa.
Ngawo akunakubaswa nomlilo lo emizini yenu.”
UMosis waliyalela lonke ibandla lamaSirayeli, wathi: “*UNdikhoyo uthi
wonke umntu oziva elangazelela ukunikela kuye makathathe kwinto anayo: igolide, isiliva, ubhedu,
nelaphu elihle, elizuba, elimsobo, nelibomvu, nelaphu loboya bebhokhwe,
nofele lwenkunzi yegusha olubomvu, nesikhumba esisukiweyo; nomngampunzi,
neoyile yezibane, nobulawu bokuqhola ioyile nokuqhola isiqhumiso sitsho sibe nevumba elimnandi;
amatye ekarneli namanye amatye exabiso okuhombisa *isidanga nesikhuselo-sifuba sombingeleli omkhulu.”
Waqhuba uMosis wathi: “Onke amagcisa omsebenzi wezandla akhoyo phakathi kwenu makeze azokwenza *isibingelelo nezinto ayalele ukuba zenziwe *uNdikhoyo:
intente kunye nesigqubuthelo sayo, amahaki, uphahla lwentente, izakhelo, imiqadi, kunye neziseko;
ityesi yomnqophiso, inemiqobo yokuyiphatha, nesivalo, kunye nomkhusane;
itafile, inemiqobo namasolotya ayo, kunye nesonka esingumnikelo kuThixo;
isibane nobuxhaka-xhaka baso, neoyile;
iqonga lesiqhumiso nemiqobo yokuliphatha, amafutha okuthambisa, isiqhumiso esivumba limnandi, umkhusane wesango lesibingelelo;
iqonga lamadini linxityelelwe isisefu esenziwe ngobhedu, imiqobo yalo nako konke okwalo; isitya sokuhlambela nesiseko saso;
umkhusane wenkundla neentsika neziseko zayo; umkhusane wesango lenkundla;
izikhonkwane neentsontela zomphakathi ngokunjalo nenkundla;
kunye nezo zivatho zingayiwayo zinxitywa ngababingeleli xa bebusa kwigumbi elingcwele, ngokunjalo nezivatho ezizodwa zika-Aron kunye noonyana bakhe.”
Ke kaloku lonke ibandla lamaSirayeli lamshiya uMosis,

waza uwonke-wonke kulo owayeziva elangazelela ukunikela *kuNdikhoyo khon' ukuze kwakhiwe *isibingelelo, weza ephethe umnikelo. Beza nayo yonke into eyayiyimfuneko kwezonqulo nasekwenzeni izivatho zababingeleli.
Amadoda nabafazi ababeziva belangazelela ukunikela beza nezipeliti zokuhombisa, amacici, imisesane, amaso, nazo zonke iintlobo-ntlobo zobunewu-newu begolide, bazenza umnikelo owodwa kuNdikhoyo.
Bezisa amalaphu amahle, azuba, amsobo, nabomvu; ilaphu loboya bebhokhwe, ufele olubomvu lwenkunzi yegusha, nesikhumba esisukiweyo.
Kanti ke nabathanda ukunikela ngesiliva okanye ubhedu benjenjalo. Abanye banikela ngomngampunzi, khon' ukuze usetyenziswe nakuwuphi na umsebenzi.
Onke amakhosikazi angamagcisa okusonta ezisa amalaphu amahle nemisonto ezuba, emsobo, nebomvu, awayeyisontile.
Benza umsonto ngoboya bebhokhwe.
Iinkokheli zona zeza namatye ekarneli namanye amatye okuhombisa *isidanga nesikhuselo-sifuba,
iziqholo neoyile yesibane, neziqholo zeoyile, neziqhumiso ezivumba limnandi.
Onke amaSirayeli awayeziva enolangazelelo ezisa iminikelo kuNdikhoyo, khon' ukuze kufezekiswe umsebenzi owawuyalelwe uMosis.
UMosis wathi kumaSirayeli: “Niyabona, *uNdikhoyo unyule uBhezaleli unyana kaUri umzukulwana kaYuri wendlu kaJuda.
Umzalisile ngoMoya wakhe, wamthi jize ngobugcisa nobuchule nengqiqo ephangaleleyo,
ukuze akwazi ukucwangcisa nokuyila nokusebenza ngegolide, isiliva, nobhedu,
ukukrola nokuqingqa amatye, nokuchwela, nawo wonke umsebenzi wobugcisa.
Yena enoHoliyabhi unyana ka-Ahisamaki wendlu kaDan ubaphile ubuchule bokufundisa abanye ubugcisa.

Ubaphe ubuchule beendidi zonke kumsebenzi wabakroli nabayili, nomsebenzi wokusonta amalaphu azuba, amsobo, nabomvu, nazo zonke iindidi zamalaphu. Ewe, bangamachule angawo kuyo yonke imisebenzi yobugcisa nokuyila.

“Ngoko ke uBhezaleli noHoliyabhi, nawo onke amagcisa anikwe ezi ziphiwo nokuqonda, anabo ubuchule bokuzenza zonke ezi zinto zifunekayo ekwakhiweni *kwesibingelelo, makazenze zonke zibe matwa nomyalelo kaNdikhoyo.”
Ke kaloku uMosis wathetha noBhezaleli noHoliyabhi, nabo bonke abaphiwe ubugcisa nababelangazelela ukunceda, wathi mabaqalise ukusebenza.
UMosis wazigqithisela kubo zonke izinto zokusebenza ezazingumnikelo ovela kumaSirayeli ngeenjongo zokwakha *isibingelelo. Baza abantu bathi rhoqo ukuzisa iminikelo yabo ngeentsasa zonke.
Amagcisa lawo ayesebenza awuyeka umsebenzi,
aya kuMosis, athi: “Lo mnikelo bawuzisayo aba bantu ngoku mninzi ngaphezu kwemfuneko yomsebenzi esiwuyalelwe *nguNdikhoyo.”

Ngoku ke uMosis wakhupha umyalelo, kwaza kwavakaliswa kumzi wonke kwathiwa: “Makungabikho bani, nokuba yindoda okanye obhinqileyo, ozisa omnye umnikelo esibingelelweni.” Ngoko ke abantu banqumama ekunikeleni.
Lo mnikelo wawuselugqithisiwe wawungaphezu kwemfuneko.

Awona madoda angamagcisa kulawo ayesebenza, enza *isibingelelo ngemikhusane elishumi yelaphu elihle kunene, linombala ozuba, omsobo, nobomvu; lihonjiswe laqhoqhonywa ngemifanekiso *yezithunywa ezimaphiko, ezenziwe ngobugcisa nobunono.
Le mikhusane yayilingana, iziimitha ezilishumi elinambini ubude, nesibini seemitha ububanzi.
Imikhusane leyo ke bayithunga bayidibanisa ngamihlanu ngamihlanu.
Benza amarhintyela ngelaphu elizuba phaya emphethweni ngapha nangapha.
Bafaka amarhintyela angamashumi amahlanu kuloo macala omabini, bawenza alungelelana.
Benza namashumi amahlanu amahaki ngegolide, khon' ukuze la macala mabini emikhusane ahlanganiswe abe yinto enye.
Baza ke benza intente yangaphandle ngemiqulu elishumi elinanye eyenziwe ngoboya bebhokhwe.
Bayenza yalingana yaziimitha ezilishumi elinantathu ubude, zambini ke ububanzi.
Isihlanu sayo ke basithunga basidibanisa sayinto enye; ngokunjalo nesithandathu eso basithunga basidibanisa sayinto enye naso.
Bafakela amarhintyela angamashumi amahlanu emphethweni wecala ngalinye.
Bathatha ubhedu, benza ngalo amahaki angamashumi amahlanu, khon' ukuze la macala mabini adityaniswe.
Baza intente bayenzela izigqubuthelo ezibini, esangaphantsi senziwe ngofele olubomvu lwenkunzi yegusha, esangaphezulu ngesikhumba esisukiweyo.
Benza izakhelo zokuxhasa intente leyo ngomngampunzi.
Isakhelo ngasinye sasiziimitha ezine ubude neesentimitha ezingamashumi amathandathu nesithandathu ububanzi.
Bazenza ke zalabalaba ngapha nangapha, ukuze zibe nokuhlanganiswa. Zonke ke izakhelo zenziwa ngale ndlela.
Izakhelo ezo zaba ngamashumi amabini ezangezantsi.
Ngokunjalo bazenzela iziseko ngesiliva zamashumi mane, zazibini esakhelweni, ukuze zibambe nale ndawo ilabalabayo.
Amantla bawenzela izakhelo ezingamashumi amabini,
ngokunjalo neziseko zesiliva ezingamashumi amane, zazibini esakhelweni.
Kwicala langasemva entshona benza izakhelo zazithandathu,
baza benza izakhelo zazibini ezikoneni.
Ezi zakhelo zeekona zaziqhagamshelwe emazantsi, zaya kuqhina phezulu. Kunjalo ke okwezi zakhelo zibini zeekona.
Ngoko ke zazisibhozo izakhelo, zixhaswe ngeziseko ezilishumi elinesithandathu – zizibini esakhelweni.
Kwakhona benza imiqadi yezakhelo ngomngampunzi. Yayimihlanu ngapha
nangapha, ngokunjalo nakwicala langasentshona ngasemva.
Lo uphakathi bawubeka esizikithini, wasuka ngapha waya kuthi ngqu ngaphaya.
Izakhelo ezo bazityabeka ngegolide, bazinxibelela amakhonkco enziwe ngegolide apho kwakungena khona imiqadi – miqadi leyo eyayityatyekwe ngegolide nayo.

Baza ke bathatha imiqulu yelaphu elisontwe kakuhle, benza umkhusane. Wawuyile mibala: ozuba, omsobo, nobomvu. Futhi ke wawuhonjiswe ngemifanekiso *yezithunywa ezimaphiko, eyenziwe ngobugcisa nobunono.
Lo mkhusane ke wawuxhonywe kwiintsika zomngampunzi, bezityabeke ngegolide, bazenzela amahaki; zona ke zazixhaswe ngeziseko ezine zesiliva.
Esangweni lesibingelelo bafaka umkhusane owenziwe ngelaphu lisontwe kakuhle, linale mibala: ozuba, omsobo, nobomvu; baza ke baliqhoqhonya balihombisa ngobugcisa nobunono.
Lo mkhusane ke bawenzela iintsika ezintlanu, bazifakela amahaki. Iintloko zeentsika, ngokunjalo nemiqadi, bayityabeka ngegolide, baza bazenzela iziseko ezihlanu ngobhedu.
UBhezaleli wayenza ityesi yomnqophiso ngomngampunzi. Yayiziisentimitha ezilikhulu elineshumi ubude, zingamashumi amathandathu nantandathu ububanzi kwanomphakamo wayo.
Wayityabeka ngegolide ngaphandle nangaphakathi, waza ke wayiphetha kwangayo jikelele.
Kumanqina ayo omane wayifakela amakhonkco enziwe ngegolide, amabini kweli cala, amabini kweliya.
Kwakhona wenza imiqobo yokuphatha, wayityabeka ngegolide,
wayifaka kulaa makhonkco ngapha nangapha, ukuze ibe nokuthwalwa.
Wathatha igolide, wenza isivalo setyesi. Sasiziisentimitha ezilikhulu elineshumi ubude, zingamashumi amathandathu anantandathu ububanzi.

Wathatha igolide, wabumba *izithunywa ezimaphiko zambini, wazenza zaba yinto enye nesivalo eso, zamiswa ngapha nangapha phezu kwaso zijongene, athi ke naloo maphiko azo athe naa agubungela isivalo eso.
Wathatha umngampunzi, wenza itafile. Yona yayingamashumi asibhozo anesibhozo eesentimitha ubude, zingamashumi amane anane ububanzi; kanti ke ukuphakama zazingamashumi amathandathu anesithandathu.
Wayeyityabeka ngegolide ecwengileyo, futhi wayiphetha kwangayo jikelele.
Ngokunjalo wayenzela ungqameko oluyijikelezileyo, lungangesandla ububanzi, waza waluphetha ngegolide jikelele.
Wayifakela amakhonkco amane, enziwe ngegolide, wawanxibelela ezikoneni zone apho imilenze yayifakelwe khona.
La makhonkco okungena imiqobo yokuphatha wawenza alungelelana nongqameko olo.
Ke yona imiqobo leyo wayenza ngomngampunzi, wayityabeka ngegolide.
Itafile leyo wayenzela izitya ngegolide: iipleyiti, iikomityi, iindebe, nezitya zokwenza idini lewayini.

Wathatha igolide ecwengileyo, wenza isibane. Amazantsi kunye nesiqu saso wasibumba ngegolide naso. Wasenzela izihombiso ngeentyatyambo, imidumba, namagqabi eentyatyambo; zonke ke zaba yinto enye nesibane eso.
Kwalapho kuso wanxibelela amasebe aso: amathathu ngapha nangapha.
La masebe mathandathu aphuma esiqwini sesibane wawahombisa ngeentyatyambo zealmondi, nangemidumba, nangamagqabi eentyatyambo.
Nesiqu sesibane wasihombisa ngeentyatyambo ezine zealmondi, wasivathisa ngemidumba namagqabi eentyatyambo.
Onke amasebe lawo wawasekela ngomdumba.
Imidumba namasebe lawo, ngokunjalo nesibane siphela, zazenzwe ngegolide ecwengileyo, kuyinto enye nje.
Esi sibane ke uBhezaleli wasenza ngohlobo lokuba sibe zizibane ezisixhenxe. Umcephe wokusicima ngokunjalo nezithetyana zaso wazenza ngegolide.
Ekwenzeni esi sibane ngokunjalo nobuxhaka-xhaka baso wasebenzisa igolide eziikhilogram ezingamashumi amathathu nantlanu ubunzima.
UBhezaleli wathatha umngampunzi, wenza iqonga lesiqhumiso. Amacala alo wawenza alingana, aziisentimitha ezingamashumi mane nantlanu, zangamashumi alithoba ukuphakama. Iimpondo zalo zazintwinye nalo.
Eli qonga lonke walityabeka ngegolide: umphezulu, amacala, neempondo; futhi waliphetha kwangegolide jikelele.
Walenzela amakhonkco amabini ngegolide. Wawanxibelela apha phantsi komphetho macala, khon' ukuze apho kuwo kungene imiqobo yokuphatha.
Wathatha umngampunzi, wenza imiqobo, waza wayityabeka ngegolide.
Kananjalo wenza amafutha awodwa okuthambisa. Ngokukwanjalo wenza nesiqhumiso esivumba liyolileyo. Xa zizonke ke wazixuba okwechule.

Ke kaloku uBhezaleli wenza iqonga lamadini ngomngampunzi. Lalilingana macala, liziimitha ezimbini namashumi amabini eesentimitha ubude nobubanzi; ukuphakama kuyimitha enye namashumi amathathu eesentimitha.
Izibonda zalo ezikoneni phaya wazenza zalabalaba zenza iimpondo. Walityabeka ngobhedu jikelele.
Ngokunjalo ke walenzela izixhobo zalo: iimbiza zokukhongozela uthuthu, iifotsholo, izitya, iifolokhwe, neepleyiti zomlilo. Zonke ezi zixhobo wazenza ngobhedu.
Wenza isisefu ngobhedu, waza wasifaka phantsi kongqameko olujikeleze iqonga, ngohlobo lokuba sithathe isiqingatha sokuphakama kweqonga.
Ezikoneni phaya wafakela amakhonkco okungena imiqobo yesisefu.
Wenza nemiqobo yokuphatha ngomngampunzi, wayityabeka ngobhedu,
waza wayifaka kulaa makhonkco ngapha nangapha. Iqonga elo ke walenza langumhaba-haba nje.

Waza ke uBhezaleli wenza isitya sokuhlambela ngobhedu; nesiseko saso wasenza kwangobhedu. Olu bhedu ke baluthatha kwizipili zobhedu ezanikezelwa ngamakhosikazi awayelungiselela apho esangweni *lesibingelelo.
*Isibingelelo ke uBhezaleli wasenzela inkundla ngomkhusane owenziwe ngelaphu elisontwe ngobuchule. Kwicala langezantsi lo mkhusane wawuziimitha ezimashumi mane nane ubude.
Wawumisa ngeentsika zobhedu ezimashumi mabini, zixhaswe ziziseko zobhedu ezimashumi mabini, waza wenza namahaki nemiqadi ngesiliva.
Nakwicala langasentla ke wayenza kwangolu hlobo.
Ngasentshona ke umkhusane wawenza ngelaphu eliziimitha ezimashumi mabini nambini ubude, wawenzela neentsika ezilishumi, zaxhaswa ziziseko ezikwalishumi; wenza namahaki nemiqadi ngesiliva.
Kwicala lasempuma, apho kwakukho isango, umkhusane wawuziimitha ezimashumi mabini nambini ububanzi.
Ngapha nangapha esangweni umkhusane wawenza waziimitha ezintandathu mashumi omathandathu eesentimitha; wawenzela neentsika ezintathu, zaxhaswa ziziseko ezikwazithathu.
Umkhusane wenkundla jikelele wawenza ngelaphu elisontwe ngobuchule.
Iziseko zeentsika wazenza ngobhedu; ke wona amahaki nemiqadi wayenza ngesiliva, futhi neentloko zeentsika wazityabeka kwangayo. Iintsika zenkundla zonke wazidibanisa ngemiqadi yesiliva.

Umkhusane wesango lenkundla wawenza ngelaphu elisontwe ngobuchule, liyile mibala: ozuba, omsobo, obomvu, wawaqhoqhonya wawahombisa ngobunono. Umkhusane wawuziimitha ezilithoba ubude, zimbini ukuphakama, kwanjengalowo wenkundla.
Lalixhaswe ziintsika ezine, zimi ngeziseko ezikwazine zobhedu. Iintloko zeentsika wazityabeka ngesiliva, futhi namahaki nemiqadi wayenza kwangayo.
Zonke izikhonkwane zesibingelelo ndawonye nenkundla jikelele wazenza ngobhedu.

Nabu ubungakanani bezinto ezasetyenziswayo ekwakhiweni *kwesibingelelo apho kwakuhlala khona amacwecwe amabini amatye ekwakubhalwe kuwo imithetho elishumi. Uludwe olu lwagunyaziswa nguMosis, lwenziwa ngabaLevi, bekhokelwa nguItamare unyana ka-Aron.
UBhezaleli unyana kaUri, umzukulwana kaYuri wendlu kaJuda, wenza yonke into ngokomyalelo *kaNdikhoyo.
Ugxa wakhe uHoliyabhi, unyana ka-Ahisamaki, wendlu kaDan, wayengumkroli nomyili, engumluki wamalaphu asontwe ngobugcisa: azuba, amsobo, nabomvu.
Iyonke igolide eyanikelwa kuNdikhoyo ngenjongo yokwakha isibingelelo yayiliwaka leekhilogram ubunzima ngokomlinganiselo ovunyiweyo.
Yona isiliva yomnikelo wababaliweyo yayingamawaka amathathu, makhulu omane anamashumi amathathu eekhilogram ubunzima.

Le mali ke ngumrhumo owakhutshwa ngabo bonke abantu ababalwayo, bekhupha ngokomlinganiselo omisiweyo. Inani lamadoda abalwayo angaphezu kwamashumi amabini ubudala ayengamakhulu mathandathu nantathu amawaka, makhulu mahlanu, mashumi omahlanu.
Kule siliva ke amawaka amathathu anamakhulu amane eekhilogram asetyenziswa ekwakheni ikhulu leziseko zesibingelelo nomkhusane. Iikhilogram ezingamashumi amathathu anane zaba zezesiseko ngasinye.
Ke wona amashumi amathathu eekhilogram aseleyo esiliva uBhezaleli wenza ngawo imiqadi, amahaki eentsika, nokutyatyekwa kweentloko zazo.
Ubhedu olwanikelwayo kuNdikhoyo lwaluziikhilogram ezimawaka mabini, makhulu omane, namashumi amabini anantlanu.
Ngalo ke wenza iziseko zesango lesibingelelo, iqonga nesisefu salo, nazo zonke izixhobo zeqonga,
iziseko zenkundla jikelele, kunye nesango layo, ngokunjalo nezikhonkwane zesibingelelo nenkundla.

Ke kaloku ezo zivatho zingayiwayo zobubingeleli ooBhezaleli bazenza zayile mibala: ozuba, omsobo, nobomvu. Ezi mpahla ke ababingeleli babezinxiba xa besebenza endaweni engcwele. Izivatho zika-Aron ke bazenza ngokomlomo *kaNdikhoyo kuMosis.
*Isidanga basenza ngelaphu elisontwe ngobunono. Laliyile mibala: ozuba, omsobo, nobomvu; ngokunjalo basebenzisa negolide xa bayenzayo.
Bathatha igolide, bayibumba bayincwela, bakhupha imisonto, baza bayithungela ngobugcisa nobunono kweli laphu limabala-bala.
Bayenzela imixwayo eqabela emagxeni, idibanise amacala ayo omabini.
Ibhanti yayo entle kunene, eyenziwe kwangelo laphu, bayithungela ngokomlomo kaNdikhoyo kuMosis.
Bathatha amatye ekarneli, bawalungisa bawafakela izipeliti zegolide. Kula matye ke kwakukrolwe ngobugcisa obukhulu amagama oonyana bakaYakobi abalishumi elinambini.
Bawafakela kwimixwayo yesidanga ukuze abe sisikhumbuzo ngoonyana bakaSirayeli abalishumi elinambini ngokomyalelo kaNdikhoyo kuMosis.
Isikhuselo-sifuba basenza kwangezaa zinto senziwe ngazo *isidanga, nangobugcisa obukwanjalo.
Basenza sangumphindo olinganayo, ubude nobubanzi baziisentimitha ezingamashumi amabini anambini.
Basiqhoqhonya ngemiqolo emine yamatye exabiso. Kowokuqala yaba yirubhi, itopazi, negarneti;
kowesibini yaba yiemeraldi, isafire, nedayimani;
kuludwe lwesithathu yaba yitekoyisi, iagati, neamatiste;
kwaza kolwesine yaba yibherile, ikarneli, nejaspa. Onke ke bawaqhobosha ngesipeliti segolide.
Kwilitye ngalinye ke bakrola amagama oonyana bakaYakobi abamele izindlu ezilishumi elinambini zikaSirayeli.
Isikhuselo-sifuba basenzela amatsheyini amabini aphothwe ngemingqa yegolide.
Benza izipeliti zazibini ngegolide, ngokunjalo namakhonkco amabini egolide, baza bawanxibelela kwiikona zesikhuselo-sifuba ezingasentla.
La matsheyini mabini bawarhintyela kula makhonkco mabini egolide,
baza baqhagamshela la macala mabini amatsheyini aseleyo kula makhonkco mabini, bawabamba ngezaa zipeliti zibini. Ngolo hlobo ke abhijela ngaphambili aya kuqhagamshela kwimixwayo yesidanga.
Kwakhona benza amakhonkco amabini egolide, baza bawanxibelela phaya kwezaa kona zaso zingezantsi ngaphakathi phezu kwesidanga.
Kwangokunjalo benza amanye amakhonkco amabini ngegolide. Bawanxibelela kumazantsi emixwayo yesidanga ngaphambili, kude kufuphi kodwa ngaphezu kwalaa bhanti ithungwe ngobugcisa nobuchule.
Kanye ngokomlomo *kaNdikhoyo kuMosis amakhonkco esikhuselo-sifuba bawadibanisa namakhonkco esidanga ngomtya ozuba, ngohlobo lokuba isikhuselo-sifuba sihlale phezu kwesidanga singabhakuzeli.
Ke wona umnweba onxitywa phezu *kwesidanga bawenza ngelaphu elizuba.
Indawo yokungena intloko bayivula, baza bayiqukumbela yaqina, khon' ukuze ingakrazuki.
Kumazantsi awo bawenzela imifanekiso yerharnati ezuba, emsobo, nebomvu. Ezi zihombiso ke bazenza zabolekisana neentsinjana ezenziwe ngegolide ngokomlomo *kaNdikhoyo kuMosis.
UAron noonyana bakhe babathungela iihempe,
iqhiya, umnqwazi, iibhulukhwe zangaphantsi,
ngokunjalo nomxwayo osontwe ngelaphu elihle. Laliyile mibala: ozuba, omsobo, nobomvu. Balihombisa, baliqhoqhonya ngobugcisa ngokomyalelo.
Bathatha igolide, benza icwecwe elihle, baza kulo bakrola umbhalo owodwa othi: “OkaNdikhoyo pheleleyo.”
Baliqhagamshela ngomsonto ozuba eqhiyeni ebunzi, kanye ngokomlomo kaNdikhoyo kuMosis.
Ke kaloku umsebenzi wokwakhiwa *kwesibingelelo wada wagqitywa. AmaSirayeli ayenza yonke into ngokomlomo *kaNdikhoyo kuMosis.
Zonke izinto ezaziyimfuneko azinikezela kuMosis: intente nezixhobo zayo, amahaki, izakhelo, imiqadi, iintsika, neziseko zayo;
isigqubuthelo esenziwe ngofele lwenkunzi yegusha olubomvu; kunye neso sesikhumba esisukiweyo; umkhusane;
ityesi yomnqophiso enamacwecwe amatye, imiqobo yokuyiphatha, nesivalo sayo;
itafile nezinto ezibekwa phezu kwayo, isonka esinikelwa kuThixo;
ubuxhaka-xhaka besibane senziwe ngegolide nokwaso; ioyile yezibane;
iqonga legolide; amafutha okuthambisa, isiqhumiso esivumba limnandi; umkhusane wesango;
iqonga lobhedu, nesisefu salo sobhedu, imiqobo yokuliphatha, nezixhobo zalo; isitya sokuhlambela, ngokunjalo nesiseko saso;
umkhusane wenkundla, iintsika neziseko zayo; umkhusane wesango lenkundla; iintsontela nezikhonkwane zentente; nazo zonke izixhobo zentente;
ngokunjalo nezo zivatho zingayiwayo zinxitywa ngababingeleli kwigumbi elingcwele – ezo zivatho zizodwa zika-Aron noonyana bakhe.
Ewe, amaSirayeli ayenza yonke into kanye ngokomlomo kaNdikhoyo kuMosis.
UMosis wawuhlola loo msebenzi, wafumanisa ukuba ngenene yonke into bayenze ngokomyalelo kaNdikhoyo. Ngoko ke wasuka wabathamsanqela.
*UNdikhoyo wayalela uMosis wathi:
“Ngomhla wokuqala ngenyanga yokuqala uze umise *isibingelelo.
Uya kuthatha ityesi enobungqina bomnqophiso, uyifake esibingelelweni, uyivalele ngomkhusane.
Uze ungenise itafile, ngokunjalo nezinto ezibekwa phezu kwayo, uyimise ngohlobo lwayo. Phezu kwayo uze ubeke nesibane nobuxhaka-xhaka baso.
Ngoku ke faka iqonga lesiqhumiso, eliya lenziwe ngegolide, phambi kwetyesi yomnqophiso; uze ufake umkhusane wesango lesibingelelo.
Apho ke phambi komnyango wesibingelelo misa iqonga lamadini.
Faka isitya sokuhlambela phakathi kweqonga lamadini nesango lesibingelelo, usigalele amanzi.
Ngoku ke twabulula uthango lwenkundla jikelele, ufake umkhusane esangweni.
“Wakukhov' ukwenjenjalo ke, uya kuthatha amafutha, umisele isibingelelo ngokusithambisa ngawo xa sisonke ndawonye neempahla zaso. Wakuba uyenzile ke loo nto, siya kuba yindawo eyodwa ekhethekileyo.
Kamva ke uya kuthambisa iqonga lamadini ndawonye nezixhobo zalo. Nalo ke liya kutsho libe yindawo ekhethekileyo.
Kwangokunjalo ke uze uthambise nesitya sokuhlambela nesiseko saso.
“Kwakhona ke uya kubiza uAron noonyana bakhe, beze esangweni lesibingelelo, ubahlambe ngamanzi.
Ngoku ke uAron makavathe ezobubingeleli, umthambise ummisele abe ngumbingeleli.
Noonyana bakhe bathi wambu ngeyabo iminweba.
Kwanjengoyise nabo bathambise, ubamisele ebubingelelini. Ewe, ngokubathambisa uya kuba ubamisela ukuba babe ngababingeleli bona nazo zonke izizukulwana zabo.”
Ke kaloku yonke le nto uMosis wayenza kanye ngokomyalelo lowo kaNdikhoyo.
Ngoko ke kwathi ngomhla wokuqala, kwinyanga yokuqala, ngonyaka wesibini bemkayo eJiputa, samiselwa isibingelelo.
Ukumisa kukaMosis isibingelelo wenjenje: wazimisa iziseko eendaweni zazo, wazimisa izakhelo zaso, wafaka imiqadi, wamisa neentsika.
Wasuka ke wayitwabulula intente yesibingelelo, wayambathisa nangesigqubuthelo sayo kanye ngokomlomo kaNdikhoyo.
Ngoko ke wathatha amacwecwe amabini anobungqina bomnqophiso, wawafaka kwityesi yomnqophiso. Wathatha nemiqobo, wayifaka kuloo makhonkco etyesi, waza wayivala ngesivalo sayo.
Emva koko wathatha ityesi yomnqophiso leyo, wayingenisa esibingelelweni, wavala ngomkhusane. Ngale ndlela ke wayivalela ityesi yomnqophiso ngokwelizwi likaNdikhoyo.
Ke kaloku wathatha itafile, wayingenisa esibingelelweni, wayibeka kwicala langasentla nganeno komkhusane,
waza wathatha isonka esinikelwe kuNdikhoyo, wasibeka phezu kwayo ngokomyalelo.
Wathatha nesibane, wangena naso, wasibeka kwicala langasezantsi, sajongana netafile.
Zimi njalo phambi koNdikhoyo wazilumeka izibane ngokomyalelo kaNdikhoyo.
Wangenisa iqonga legolide ngaphakathi, walibeka phambi komkhusane,
watshisa eso siqhumiso sivumba limnandi ngokwelizwi likaNdikhoyo.
Waxhoma umkhusane esangweni lesibingelelo,
waza wemisa iqonga lamadini apho ngasesangweni. Belisenziwa apho ke idini elitshiswayo kunye nedini leenkozo ngokomlomo kaNdikhoyo.
Wabeka isitya sokuhlambela phakathi kweqonga lamadini nentente yesibingelelo, waza wasizalisa ngamanzi.
UMosis, uAron, noonyana bakhe, babehlamba izandla neenyawo zabo apho kuloo manzi,
ngalo lonke ixesha bengena esibingelelweni okanye besiya kwiqonga lamadini, ngokwelizwi likaNdikhoyo.
Ke kaloku uMosis wabiyela inkundla yangqonga isibingelelo neqonga lamadini, waza walivala ngomkhusane isango layo. Waba ke ngoko uwufezile umsebenzi.
Kwesi sithuba ke lasuka ilifu lasigubungela *isibingelelo, saza isibingelelo sathi qhakra bubuqaqawuli *bukaNdikhoyo.
Ngenxa yale meko uMosis akabanga saba nako ukungena esibingelelweni.
Kolu hambo lwawo ke amaSirayeli ayesithi apho lisuke khona ilifu esibingelelweni athabathise eluhambeni kwakhona.
Kanti ke ayelinda anganduluki xa lisafukamile ilifu elo.
Kaloku kolu hambo lwawo amaSirayeli ayesoloko elibona ilifu elalatha ubukho bukaNdikhoyo likhakhaba apho esibingelelweni xa kusemini, lisuke ke ebusuku lithi qhakra umlilo.
*UNdikhoyo wabiza uMosis, wathetha naye *esesibingelelweni, wathi
