xa nisitya ukutya kwelo zwe, maze ninikele inxalenye kuNdikhoyo.
Kwisivuno sengqolowa iqebengwana lokuqala malinikelwe libe ngumnikelo wesivuno.
Apha ke nakwixa elizayo noqhuba njalo nenze umnikelo kuNdikhoyo womgubo wesivuno sokuqala.”
Waqhuba wathi *uNdikhoyo: “Xa kwenzekile ukuba umntu othile ayaphule ngempazamo le miyalelo inikwe uMosis nguNdikhoyo,
mhlawumbi kwenzeke ukuba izizukulwana ezizayo zamaSirayeli ziyiphazame ngokungaqondi le miyalelo, koqhutywa ngolu hlobo:

Ukuba loo mpazamo yenzeke ngokungaqondi kwebandla liphela, kofuneka kuthathwe inkunzi eselula yenkomo, kwenziwe idini elitshiswayo ngayo – dini elo ke lithandekayo kuNdikhoyo – likhatshwe ngokomgaqo ngumnikelo wokutya nothululwayo, kongezwe nenkunzi yebhokhwe, ibe lidini lesono.
Ngezi zinto umbingeleli uya kucamagushela ibandla lamaSirayeli, lize lixolelwe. Kaloku impazamo leyo yeyokungaqondi, ibe ke futhi elenzile idini ngomlilo elikwalidini lesono.
Ibandla liphela ndawonye nabangeneleli baya kuxolelwa, kuba kaloku xa bebonke iyababandakanya le mpazamo.
“Xa umntu one ngempazamo, makenze idini lesono ngethokazi lebhokhwe elinyaka mnye.
Umbingeleli uya kumngxengxezela phambi koNdikhoyo loo mntu wone ngempazamo, aze ke axolelwe.
Koqhutywa ngaloo ndlela ke nakubani na owone ngokungaqondi, noba ngowomthonyama, okanye umngeneleli.
“Kambe ke yena umntu owone ngabom, engowomthonyama okanye umngeneleli, woba netyala lokunyelisa uNdikhoyo. Ngoko ke makabulawe,
kuba akalikhathalelanga ilizwi likaNdikhoyo, waza wawaphula umyalelo wakhe ngabom. Xa kunjalo ke woba uzenzakalise ngokwakhe.”
Ngamhla uthile amaSirayeli eselapho entlango kwabhaqwa umntu etheza *ngoMhla wokuPhumla.
Wabanjwa wasiwa kuMosis noAron nebandla liphela.
Waza wakhe wavalelwa, kuba ingekacaci into emayenziwe ngaye.
*UNdikhoyo ke wayalela uMosis, wathi: “Makabulawe! Ibandla liphela malimkhuphele ngaphandle komzi, limxulube ngamatye ade afe.”
Ngoko ke amaSirayeli ephela amkhuphela ngaphandle, amkhanda ngamatye wada wafa ngokomyalelo kaNdikhoyo.
*UNdikhoyo ke wathi uMosis
makathethe namaSirayeli, athi: “Nanini na fakani iintshinga kumasondo eempahla zenu. Intshinga nganye ke mayibe nomtya omzuba.
Ezo ntshinga zoba sisikhumbuzo, nize nithi maxa onke nizibona zitsho nikhumbule imiyalelo kaNdikhoyo niyithobele, khon' ukuze ningahendeki nibhaduliswe ziinkanuko zenu.
Zona ziya kuhlala zinikhumbuza ukuthobela imiyalelo yam; nize ke ngokwenjenjalo nibe libango lam ncam.
Mna ndinguNdikhoyo, uThixo wenu, owanikhupha kwelaseJiputa, khon' ukuze ndibe nguThixo wenu. Ngenene mna ndinguNdikhoyo uThixo wenu!”

UKora unyana kaIzare, umKohati wendlu kaLevi, wagaya amadoda athile, baza bamvukela uMosis. Wayekunye namaRubhen, uDatan noAbhiram, oonyana bakaEliyabhi, no-On unyana kaPelete. Babexhaswa naziinkokheli ezaziwayo zamaSirayeli ezazalathwe ngumzi ukuba zibe liqoqo, zingamakhulu amabini anamashumi amahlanu.

Beza belihlokondiba elichase uMosis noAron, baza bathi kubo: “Kungokunje nigabadele! Ubonanje ibandla liphela lamaSirayeli libango *likaNdikhoyo; kwaye futhi uNdikhoyo ukho phakathi kwalo. Ngani ke ukuba nizenze bhetele kangaka kunebandla lamaSirayeli?”
UMosis ke uthe akuweva la mazwi, wawa ngamadolo.
Waza ke wabhekisa kuKora nabalandeli bakhe, wathi: “Ngomso kusasa uNdikhoyo uza kukhe asibonise ukuba ngubani na kanye umnyulwa wakhe. Lowo ke ungowakhe ncam, lowo amkhethileyo, uya kumsondeza.

Ngomso kusasa kufuneka wena Kora nabalandeli bakho nithathe imicephe yomlilo, niyifake amalahle avuthayo, nigalele isiqhumiso, niye nayo eqongeni phambi koNdikhoyo. Uya kucaca ke oyena unyuliweyo nguNdikhoyo. Nini kanye baLevi aba bagabadeleyo!”
UMosis waqhuba wathi kuKora: “Khanitsho, baLevi,
ngaba niyidelile into yokuba uThixo kaSirayeli anibekele bucala kumaSirayeli ephela, ukuze nisondele kuye, nisebenze *esibingelelweni sakhe, nibuse ngenxa yamaSirayeli?
Nakuba nina baLevi niphela eninike eli wonga nje, ngoku senitsazele nasebubingelelini?
Eneneni nguNdikhoyo lo nimvukeleyo, wena nehlokondiba lakho, engubani yena uAron nide nimkhalazele nje.”
Ke kaloku uMosis wathumela wabiza uDatan noAbhiram, kodwa bona baphendula bathi: “Asizi!
Akwanelanga yile nto uyenzileyo yokusikhupha eJiputa, ilizwe lamasi nobusi, uze kusibulala kule ntlango? Ngoku sowuzenza itshawe phezu kwethu,
ngoku ungekasifikisi kwelaa lizwe lamasi nobusi, ungekasiniki nelifa lamasimi nezidiliya! Ucinga ukuba siziimfama? Asizi!”
Wabhabhama ngumsindo uMosis, wathi kuNdikhoyo: “Uze ungawamkeli amadini ala madoda. Mna ndimsulwa kuwo; zange ndithathe nedonki le yawo.”

UMosis wathi kuKora: “Ngomso wena naba bantu bakho bangamakhulu amabini anamashumi amahlanu ze niye esibingelelweni; noAron uya kubakho. Umntu ngamnye ke kuni aze athathe umcephe womlilo, awufake isiqhumiso, awuzise kwiqonga phambi koNdikhoyo.”
Ngenene ke indoda nganye kubo yathatha umcephe womlilo, yawufaka amalahle nesiqhumiso, yema esangweni lesibingelelo kunye noMosis noAron.
Ke kaloku uKora wabaqokelela bonke abangakuye, bema bajonga kuMosis noAron esangweni lesibingelelo. Kuthe kusenjalo suka kwavela ubuqaqawuli bukaNdikhoyo kumaSirayeli ephela,
waza ke uNdikhoyo wabhekisa kuMosis noAron, wathi:
“Khwelelani kwaba bantu. Ndiza kubatshabalalisa ngephanyazo!”
Kambe ke uMosis noAron bakhahlela, bawa ngamadolo, badanduluka bathi: “Awu, Thixo, wena mthombo wobomi, kaloku kone umntu wamnye qha, ungathini ke ukusuka ulwe namaSirayeli ephela?”
UNdikhoyo wayalela uMosis ukuba
athi kumaSirayeli: “Khwelelani kwimizi yooKora noDatan noAbhiram.”
Ke kaloku uMosis wahamba waya kuDatan noAbhiram elandelwa ziinkokheli zamaSirayeli.
Wabhekisa kumaSirayeli, wathi: “Khwelelani kwimizi yala madoda akhohlakeleyo, ningakhe nichukumise nento le yawo, hleze nani nitshayelwe kunye nawo ngenxa yezono zawo.”
Ngoko ke amaSirayeli azikhwebula kwimizi yooKora noDatan noAbhiram. Ke kaloku uDatan noAbhiram babephumile, bema kwiminyango yezindlu zabo, ndawonye nabafazi nabantwana kwaneentsana.
Ke uMosis wabhekisa kumaSirayeli, wathi: “Ngoku kuza kucaca kuni, kuba ngenene ezi zinto andizenzeli ngokuthanda kwam, koko nguNdikhoyo ondithuma ukuba ndizenze.
Ukuba la madoda abulewe zizifo nje eziqhelekileyo, ze nazi ukuba akandithumanga uNdikhoyo.

Kambe ke ukuba uNdikhoyo wenze into engazange ihle nanini na, kwavuleka umhlaba, waginya la madoda nako konke okwawo, ngohlobo lokuba ehle aye kwelabafileyo ehleli, ze niqonde kakuhle ke ukuba aba bantu bamdelile uNdikhoyo.”
Wathi ke egqiba nje ukuthetha, suka waqhekeka umhlaba!
Bimbilili wabaginya ooDatan noAbhiram ndawonye nemizi yabo, ngokunjalo nabalandeli bakaKora nako konke ababenako.
Ngoko ke bangcwatywa behleli, baya kwelabafileyo ndawonye nako konke okwabo. Wabuya wavaleka ke umhlaba, banyamalala ke bona.
Onke ke amaSirayeli awayelapho acela kooxhongo akusiva isikhalo sabo. Akhwaza athi: “Kunyembelekile! Sabani, hleze nathi usiginye umhlaba!”
Kwaza ke kwaphuma umlilo uvela kuNdikhoyo, wawalenya atsha loo makhulu mabini anamashumi amahlanu amadoda awayesondeza isiqhumiso.
*UNdikhoyo ke wayalela uMosis, wathi:
“Yithi kuElazare unyana wombingeleli uAron asuse imicephe yomlilo yobhedu kuthuthu lwalaa madoda atshileyo, aze wona amalahle akuyo awasarhaze, kuba imicephe leyo ingcwele.

Kaloku yaba ngcwele ukusondezwa kwayo kuNdikhoyo. Makayithathe imicephe leyo yaloo madoda afe ngenxa yesono sawo, aze ayikhande ibe ngamacwecwe amcaba, agqume ngayo iqonga lamadini. Loo nto yoba sisikhumbuzo kumaSirayeli.”
Ngenene ke uElazare umbingeleli wayithatha imicephe leyo, yaza yakhandwa yangamacwecwe okugquma iqonga lamadini.

Esi ke yaba sisikhumbuzo kumaSirayeli, khon' ukuze angalibali ukuba akukho mntu uvumelekileyo ukuba aye kwiqonga lamadini, enze isiqhumiso phambi koNdikhoyo, engenguye owomlibo ka-Aron. Ngapha koko ke owenze into enjalo uya kutshatyalaliswa, axel' uKora nabantu bakhe. Yonke ke le nto yenziwa ngokomyalelo owathunyelwa nguNdikhoyo kuElazare ngoMosis.
Ngomhla olandelayo ke ibandla lakwaSirayeli liphela lakhalazela uMosis noAron lisithi: “Nina nibulele abantu *bakaNdikhoyo.”
Emva kokuba beqokelelene bagwayimbela uMosis noAron, bajika basingisa *ngasesibingelelweni, baza balibona ilifu lisigqumile ngequbuliso, ngokunjalo kwabonakala nobungangamsha bukaNdikhoyo.
UMosis noAron baya kuma phambi kwesibingelelo.
Ke uNdikhoyo wathetha noMosis, wathi:
“Buy' umva, nikhwebuke kwaba bantu; ndiza kubatshabalalisa ngephanyazo!” Kwesi sithuba ke bobabini bawa ngamadolo;

waza ke uMosis wabhekisa kuAron wathi: “Thatha umcephe wakho womlilo, ugalele amalahle owathatha kwiqonga lamadini, uthi saa isiqhumiso. Wakugqiba ke, khawuleza uye phaya ebantwini ubacamagushele. Khawulezisa, kuba uNdikhoyo uyavutha ngumsindo, ibe ke sezibonakala iimpawu zikabhubhani.”

Ngoko nangoko ke uAron wawuthobela umyalelo kaMosis, wawuthatha umcephe wakhe, wakhawuleza waya kungena phakathi kwebandla lamaSirayeli. Wathi akubona ukuba ubhubhani seleqalisile, wafaka isiqhumiso apho emalahleni, wawacamagushela amaSirayeli.
Wema phakathi kwabahleliyo nabafi, wanqamka ubhubhani lowo.
Ke kaloku abantu abafa ngeso sihlandlo sodwa yaba lishumi elinesine lamawaka anamakhulu asixhenxe, ngaphandle kwabo bafa mhla ngogwayimbo lukaKora.
Akuba enqamkile ke ubhubhani lowo, uAron wabuyela kuMosis esangweni lesibingelelo.
*UNdikhoyo wathi kuMosis:
“Thetha namaSirayeli, uthathe iintonga zibe lishumi elinambini kwiinkokheli zakwaSirayeli; ibe nye intonga kwindlu nganye. Kwintonga yenkokheli nganye bhala igama layo,
uze ubhale igama lika-Aron kwintonga yendlu kaLevi. Ngoko ke inkokheli yendlu nganye yoba nentonga yayo.
Zithathe ezo ntonga, uye nazo *esibingelelweni, uzibeke phambi kwetyesi enobungqina bomnqophiso apho ndidibana khona nani.
Intonga yendoda endiyinyulileyo iya kuntshula amagqabi. Ngaloo ndlela ke ndiya kuluphelisa uzenge-zenge lwezikhalazo zamaSirayeli ngakuwe.”

Ngenene ke uMosis wayalela amaSirayeli ukuba inkokheli nganye imnike intonga; zaza ke zenjenjalo. Inkokheli yendlu nganye yakhupha intonga; zaza ke zaba lishumi elinambini zizonke, neka-Aron ikwalapho.
Xa zizonke ezo ntonga ke uMosis wangena nazo esibingelelweni, wazibeka phambi kukaNdikhoyo.

Ngengomso ke uMosis akungena esibingelelweni wafumanisa ukuba intonga ka-Aron, emele indlu kaLevi, intshule amagqabi. Ewe, yantshula yanamathupha, yaza yavelisa neentyatyambo ngokunjalo neziqhamo zealmondi!
UMosis ke wazithatha zonke ezo ntonga, waphuma nazo, wazibonisa amaSirayeli. Ke wona ayibona into eyenzekileyo, yaza ke yayileyo inkokheli yathatha eyayo.

UNdikhoyo wayalela uMosis ukuba athathe intonga ka-Aron, ayibeke kwaphambi kwetyesi yomnqophiso. Watsho esithi mayigcinwe apho, khon' ukuze ibe sisikhumbuzo kumaSirayeli agwayimbayo, khon' ukuze ayeke ukukhalaza, hleze afe.
UMosis ke wenza ngokwaloo myalelo kaNdikhoyo.
AmaSirayeli ke athi kuMosis: “Xa kuyiloo nto ke sifile; kuphelile kuthi!
Nomntu othe cakatha nje ukusondela esibingelelweni uza kufa. Ngaba ke siza kufa sonke?”

*UNdikhoyo wathi kuAron: “Wena noonyana bakho ndawonye nabaLevi nithwala uxanduva ngaso nasiphi na isigqitho esinxulumene nokubusa esibingelelweni; kodwa nguwe kuphela noonyana bakho abaya kuthwala uxanduva ngesigqitho esinxulumene nobubingeleli.
Phuthuma abo uzalana nabo bendlu kaLevi, usebenze nabo bakuncedise xeshikweni wena noonyana bakho nibusayo esibingelelweni.
AbaLevi baya kujongwa nguwe ngokwemisebenzi yabo esibingelelweni, kodwa mabangasondeli nokusondela kwimpahla yegumbi eliyingcwele okanye eqongeni lamadini, kungenjalo baya kufa kunye nani.
Umsebenzi wabo baya kuwufezekisa ngokuncedisana nani esibingelelweni, ke yena umntu ongomnye ongenalungelo angaze asebenze nanini esibingelelweni.
“Nini emanithwale uxanduva lokulungiselela egumbini eliyingcwele nakwiqonga lamadini, khon' ukuze uNdikhoyo angaphindi awavelele ngomsindo amaSirayeli.
Ndim ngokwam ozinyulele abanakwenu abaLevi kumaSirayeli. Basisipho kuni babingeleli, khon' ukuze benze imisebenzi esibingelelweni.

Nguwe noonyana bakho kuphela abanoxanduva lokulungiselela mayela neqonga lamadini ndawonye negumbi eliyingcwele kangcwele. Lo msebenzi wenu wobubingeleli sisipho enisinikwa ndim. Nabani na othe wasondela kwizinto ezingcwele engenalungelo wobulawa.”
*UNdikhoyo wathi kuAron: “Iminikelo eyenzelwa mna yolawulwa nguwe; yonke iminikelo eyenziwe ngamaSirayeli kum ndiyinika wena noonyana bakho ibe yinxaxheba nesabelo senu esisisigxina.
Inxaxheba yeminikelo engayi kutshiswa eqongeni yeyenu – nditsho yonke iminikelo eyodwa, nokuba yeyokutya, okanye yeyentlambululo, okanye yeyembuyekezo. Loo nxaxheba yeyakho noonyana bakho.
Ezi zinto ze niqonde ukuba zingcwele, nizityele endaweni engcwele, zityiwe ngamadoda kuphela.
“Nayiphi na eminye iminikelo enikelwa kum ngamaSirayeli yeyenu. Ndiyipha wena noonyana neentombi zakho, isisabelo senu esisisigxina. Yona ke yotyiwa nguye nabani na *ongenamlaza kwintsapho yakho.
“Ndikunika lonke ulibo lwezilimo oluziswa ngamaSirayeli kuNdikhoyo: amafutha omnquma, iwayini, nengqolowa. Zonke ke zoba zezakho, zityiwe ngabo bonke abangenamlaza kwintsapho yakho.
“Yonke into kwaSirayeli enikelwe kuNdikhoyo qwaba yeyakho.
Lonke izibulo, elomntu nelemfuyo, elinikelwa ngamaSirayeli kum, lelakho. Kodwa ke makahlawulelwe umntwana wamazibulo, nezibulo lesilwanyana esingàtyiwayo ngokunjalo.
Amazibulo makahlawulelwe xa anenyanga enye ezelwe, kukhutshwe ixabiso eliziingqekembe zesiliva ezintlanu ngokomlinganiselo ovunyiweyo.

Kambe ke amazibulo eenkomo, iigusha, neebhokhwe, wona akayi kuhlawulelwa. Wona ngakaNdikhoyo poqo; makenziwe idini. Igazi lazo makufefwe ngalo iqonga lamadini, amanqatha azo atshiswe abe lidini ngomlilo – dini elo livumba liyolileyo kuNdikhoyo.
Ke yona inyama yazo yoba yeyakho, njengencum nomlenze wasekunene kwidini eliwanga-wangiswayo.
“Yonke iminikelo eyodwa evela kumaSirayeli ndiyipha wena noonyana neentombi zakho zisisabelo senu esisisigxina. Lo ke ngumnqophiso ongasoze uthini endiwenza nawe nesizukulwana sakho.”
UNdikhoyo wathetha noAron, wathi: “Ke wena apha kwaSirayeli akuyi kuzuza sabelo sililifa lakho, ungayi kuzuza namhlaba. Kaloku esakho isabelo, ndawonye nelifa, ndim mna Ndikhoyo.”
*UNdikhoyo wathi: “Sonke isishumi esivela kumaSirayeli soba yinxaxheba yabaLevi ngenxa yoxanduva lokujonga *isibingelelo.
Ke wona amaSirayeli angawambi akufuneki nganto ukuba abe nento ayenzayo esibingelelweni, khon' ukuze angasifumani isohlwayo sokufa.

Ngoko ke ukusukela ngoku ngabaLevi kuphela amabajongane nesibingelelo, sibe luxanduva lwabo ngokupheleleyo. Lo mthetho ke uya kuhlala umi nakwizizukulwana ezizayo. AbaLevi abasayi kuze babe nalifa lilelinye kwaSirayeli,
kuba kaloku bona ndibanike isabelo esizizishumi endizinikwa ngamaSirayeli. Kungenxa yaloo nto ke ndisithi nje bona abasoze babe nalifa lilelinye kwaSirayeli.”
*UNdikhoyo wayalela uMosis
ukuba athi kubaLevi: “Xa nisamkela isishumi esinikelwa ngamaSirayeli kuNdikhoyo njengesabelo senu, kwalapho kuso khuphani isishumi enisinikela kuNdikhyo.
Lo mnikelo ke uya kuba njengomnikelo okhutshwa ngumlimi kwingqolowa newayini yakhe.
Ngale ndlela ke nani noba nako ukunikela kuNdikhoyo nicaphula kuzo zonke izishumi enizamkelayo kumaSirayeli. Kwezi zishumi inxaxheba kaNdikhoyo maze niyinike uAron umbingeleli.
Ewe, nikelani ngezona-zona kwenizifumanayo, nditsho ezo zimfaneleyo uNdikhoyo.
Xa ninikela ngezona-zona kuya kuba njengaxa umlimi akhupha izishumi zengqolowa newayini.
Ke into eseleyo yeyenu neentsapho zenu; ningayityela naphi na, kuba niyinikwa ingumvuzo womsebenzi wenu *esibingelelweni.
Xa ninikela ngezona-zona anisayi kuba natyala. Ngokwenjenjalo aniyi *kuyigqwalisa iminikelo engcwele yamaSirayeli, ningayi kufa nokufa.”
*UNdikhoyo wathetha noMosis noAron,
wabanika le miyalelo, wathi: “Ngokommiselo kaNdikhoyo amaSirayeli makeze nethokazi lenkomo elibomvu, elingenasiphako, elingazange libotshwe,
alinikezele kuElazare umbingeleli. Lothathwa ke likhutshelwe ngaphandle komzi wamaSirayeli, apho loxhelelwa khona ekho.
UElazare ke uya kuthi nkxu umnwe egazini apho, aze atshize kasixhenxe ejongise kwisango lesibingelelo.
Xa iyonke ke loo nkomo, ufele nenyama, igazi namathumbu, mazitshiswe apho phambi kombingeleli ejongile njalo.
Ke yena uya kuthatha ukhuni lomsedare, ihlamvu lehisopu, nomtya obomvu, aziphose phezu kwelo thokazi litshiswayo.
Kamva ke makahlambe iimpahla zakhe, ngokunjalo nomzimba, aze ke abe nokubuyela emzini. Kambe ke uya kuhlala engekahlambuluki kude kuhlwe.
Naloo mntu ubetshisa le nkomo kufuneka ahlambe iimpahla nomzimba, kodwa naye akayi kuhlambuluka de kube ngorhatya.

Uthuthu lweli thokazi ke maluwolwe yindoda ehlambulukileyo, ilubeke endaweni ehlambulukileyo, kwalapho ngaphandle komzi wamaSirayeli, apho luya kugcinwa khona libandla, ukuze amaSirayeli alusebenzise xa esenza amanzi entlambululo okususa isono.

Loo mntu ubebutha uthuthu makazihlambe iimpahla zakhe, kodwa ke akayi kuhlambuluka kude kuhlwe. Lo mmiselo ke soze uthini nanini nanini; ngoko ke mawuthotyelwe ngamaSirayeli ngokunjalo nabangeneleli.”
“Nabani na ochukumise isidumbu woba *ugqwalisekile iintsuku ezisixhenxe.

Ngoko ke kofuneka azihlambulule ngamanzi entlambululo kusuku lwesithathu, ngokunjalo nangolwesixhenxe, ukuze abe uhlambulukile. Kambe ke ukuba akazihlambululanga kuzo zombini ezi ntsuku, olwesithathu nolwesixhenxe, akayi kuhlambuluka.
Ke yena ochukumise isidumbu waza akazihlambulula, ugqwalisa *isibingelelo *sikaNdikhoyo. Umntu onjalo makasikwe kwaSirayeli; kaloku akatshizwanga ngamanzi entlambululo. Wohlala egqwalisekile.
“Nanku ummiselo ophathelele malunga nomntu ofele endlwini: nabani na olapho ngelo xesha, okanye ongenayo, uya kuba ugqwalisekile iintsuku zide zibe sixhenxe.
Ngokunjalo nayiphi na ingqayi okanye imbiza engacikwanga yogqwaliseka nayo.
Nomntu othe engaphandle phaya wachukumisa umntu ogetyengiweyo okanye ozifele nje, okanye ochukumise ithambo lomntu okanye ingcwaba, uya kugqwaliseka iintsuku ezisixhenxe.
“Xa kuhlanjululwa umntu onjalo ke, kofuneka kucatshulwe kuthuthu lwethokazi elibomvu, lona luhlambululayo, lufakwe embizeni, luxutywe namanzi angcwengileyo.

Wosuka ke umntu ohlambulukileyo athathe ihlamvu lehisopu, alithi nkxu apho emanzini, atshize indlu nako konke okukuyo, ngokunjalo nabantu ababelapho kuyo. Okanye umntu ohlambulukileyo uya kuthatha loo manzi atshize lowo uchukumise ogetyengiweyo, okanye ofileyo, mhlawumbi ochukumise ithambo noba lingcwaba.

Kusuku lwesithathu, ngokunjalo nakolwesixhenxe, loo mntu uhlambulukileyo uya kutshiza lowo ugqwalisekileyo. Ngosuku lwesixhenxe ke uya kuhlambuluka loo mntu, akuba ezihlambile iimpahla zakhe, naye ngokwakhe ehlambe umzimba. Matshona kwelanga ke woba uhlambulukile.
“Umntu ogqwalisekileyo, waza akazihlambulula, umelwe kukusikwa ebantwini, kuba unyelise isibingelelo sikaNdikhoyo. Kaloku akatshizwanga ngamanzi okuhlambulula; ngako oko uhlala egqwalisekile.
Lo mmiselo mawuthotyelwe nini nanini. Umntu otshiza ngamanzi okuhlambulula makazihlambe iimpahla zakhe. Kanti ke nabani na ochukumisa amanzi okuhlambulula, uhlala engahlambulukanga kude kuhlwe.
Nantoni na echukunyiswe ngumntu ogqwalisekileyo nayo iba njalo; futhi nabani na oyichukumisayo naye uhlala enjalo kude kuhlwe.”
Kwathi ngenyanga yokuqala uSirayeli ephela wagaleleka kwintlango iZin, waza wamisa eKadeshe. Apho ke kulapho wafa waza wangcwatyelwa khona uMiriyam.
Ke kaloku kwakungekho manzi kuloo ndawo. Ngoko ke amaSirayeli aqokelelana kuMosis noAron,
alwa noMosis, athi: “Akwaba nathi sasife nabantakwethu phambi *kwesibingelelo *sikaNdikhoyo.
Ngani ukuba thina bantu bakaNdikhoyo nisizise kule ntlango? Benifuna size kufela apha ndawonye nemfuyo yethu?
Kakade, kwakutheni ukuze nisikhuphe eJiputa, nize kusifaka kwenje yona indawo, emhlaba ungavelisi nento le? Akukho ngqolowa namakhiwane, kungekho diliya narharnati; ke wona amanzi tu!”
UMosis noAron balishiya ibandla, baya kuma esangweni lesibingelelo. Baguqa phantsi, baza ke babubona ubungangamsha bukaNdikhoyo.
UNdikhoyo wathi kuMosis:
“Thatha intonga ephambi kwetyesi yomnqophiso, uze wena nomntakwenu uAron nilihlanganise ibandla, uze ke uthethe neliwa bejongile. Kothi kumpompoze amanzi kulo, baze abantu nemfuyo yabo basele.”
Ke uMosis wayithatha intonga leyo esibingelelweni ngokomyalelo kaNdikhoyo.
Yena noAron bawaqokelela onke amaSirayeli apho phambi kweliwa, waza wathi uMosis: “Phulaphulani, nina baqhankqalazi! Ngaba nifuna sikhuphe amanzi kweli liwa?”
UMosis wayiphakamsa intonga, walibetha kabini iliwa elo, kwaza ke kwampompoza amanzi, abantu ndawonye nemfuyo basela.
UNdikhoyo wabhekisa kuMosis noAron wathi: “Ngenxa yokungandithembi nokungandiniki imbeko phambi kwamaSirayeli, anisayi kulikhokela eli bandla nilingenise kwelo lizwe ndalithembisa lona.”
Esi siganeko ke sehla eMeribha apho amaSirayeli amkhalazela khona uNdikhoyo. Ke yena wazibonakalisa kuwo ukuba ungcwele.
Ke kaloku uMosis wakhupha abathunywa, baya kukumkani wase-Edom, esithi: “Nanku umyalezo ovela kubantakwenu amaSirayeli: ‘Uyazazi iinzingo ezasihlelayo.
Kaloku ookhokho bethu bafudukela eJiputa, apho sahlala khona iminyaka ngeminyaka. AmaJiputa ke abaphatha kakubi ndawonye nathi.
Sasuka ke sazibika *kuNdikhoyo, waza ke yena wasabela, wathumela isithunywa sakhe, wasikhupha eJiputa. Ngoku ke naku silapha eKadeshe, idolophu esemideni yakho.

Sicela ukuba usivumele sinqumle kulo mhlaba wakho. Siyathembisa ukuba thina nemfuyo yethu siya kuhamba ngqo ngendlela, singaphambukeli emasimini nakwizidiliya zakho, singayi kukhe sisele nakumaqula akho. Ewe, siya kuthi ngqo ngohola, singaphambuki side siphume emhlabeni wakho.’ ”
Ke wona amaEdom aphendula athi: “Unotshe! Akuyi kucanda apha. Ukungena oku kwakho ndiya kuphuma ndikuhlasele.”
AmaSirayeli aphendula esithi: “Siya kuhamba ngqo ngohola. Ukuba thina okanye impi yethu ithe yasela amanzi akho, siya kuwahlawulela. Inye into esiyifunayo, kukunqumla ngeenyawo.”
AmaEdom athi: “Anizukunqumla!” Aza ke amaEdom asuka nomkhosi omkhulu, afunza kumaSirayeli.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli ajika athatha ndlela yimbi, kuba amaEdom ewalela ukuba anqumle emhlabeni wawo.
USirayeli ephela wanduluka ke eKadeshe, waza waya kugaleleka kwintaba iHore
kufutshane nomda wase-Edom. Apho ke *uNdikhoyo wathetha noMosis noAron, wathi:
“Wena Aron, uza kufa; akuzi kuya kufika kwelo lizwe ndamthembisa ngalo uSirayeli. Kaloku nina nobabini nawuvukela umthetho wam eMeribha.
Ngoko ke, wena Mosis, thatha uAron nonyana wakhe uElazare, uye nabo kwintaba iHore.
Khona apho ke uze uyithathe iminweba ka-Aron yobubingeleli, uyinxibe uElazare unyana wakhe, kuba uAron yena uza kufa.”
UMosis wenza ngokwelizwi likaNdikhoyo. Benyuka baya kwintaba iHore, lonke ibandla libukele,
waza uMosis wayikhulula iminweba yobubingeleli kuAron, wayinxiba uElazare. Ke yena uAron wafela apho phezu kwentaba, baza ke uMosis noElazare behla entabeni.
Athi ke amaSirayeli, akuva ukuba uAron akasekho, amzilela iintsuku ezimashumi mathathu.
Ke kaloku ukumkani waseAradi, umKanana, owayemi emazantsi eKanana, wathi akuva ukuba amaSirayeli ayeza ngendlela esinga eAtarim, wawahlasela, wada wawathimba amanye.
AmaSirayeli ke asuka enza isifungo *kuNdikhoyo, athi: “Ukuba usiphile amandla, saboyisa abo bantu, inene siya kubatshabalalisa ngokupheleleyo ndawonye nezixeko zabo.”
Ngenene ke uNdikhoyo waweva amaSirayeli, waza wawanceda awoyisa awatshabalalisa tu amaKanana ndawonye nezixeko zawo. Loo ndawo ke ayithiya igama eliyiHoma.
Ukumka kwawo kwintaba iHore amaSirayeli ahamba ngendlela esinga kuLwandle oluBomvu, khon' ukuze bawucezele umhlaba wamaEdom. Endleleni ke apho amaSirayeli akruquka,
aza amkhalazela uThixo ndawonye noMosis, athi: “Kwakutheni kakade ukuze usikhuphe eJiputa, sizokufela kule ntlango? Akukho kutya namanzi apha! Okokwayo ke yona le nkatshu-nkatshu isikruqule!”
Ke *uNdikhoyo wawathumela isibetho seenyoka ezinobuhlungu, zawaluma amaSirayeli, kwafa amaninzi.

AmaSirayeli ke athi akuqonda ukuba enze imposiso, aya kuMosis, avuma athi: “Sonile ngokukrokrela uNdikhoyo ndawonye nawe. Khawusitarhuzisele, uNdikhoyo azisuse ezi nyoka.” Ngoko ke uMosis wawathandazela amaSirayeli.
UNdikhoyo ke wathi kuMosis: “Yenza umfanekiso wenyoka, uwuxhome esibondeni, khon' ukuze athi nabani na olunywe yinyoka akhangele kuyo, aphile.”
Ngenene ke uMosis wayenza inyoka ngobhedu, wayixhoma esibondeni. Nabani na ke olunywe yinyoka wayekhangela apho kuloo nyoka yobhedu, atsho aphile.
AmaSirayeli ke anduluka, aya kumisa eObhoti.
Nalapha ke anduluka, aya kutsho kwi-Iye-abharim kwintlango esempuma yomhlaba wamaMowabhi.
Ukusuka apho ke aya kumisa kwintili yaseZerede.
Ukuphuma apha ke aya kumisa kwicala elingentla komlambo iAnoni, kwintlango ehamba iyokuthi xhaxhe kumhlaba wama-Amori. Ke iAnoni le yayingumda owahlula amaMowabhi kuma-Amori.
Yiyo loo nto ke iNcwadi yamaDabi *kaNdikhoyo ithetha ngezi ndawo nje: “Idolophu iWahebhi kwingxingwa kaSufa; umlambo iAnoni,
namathambeka eentili eziyokuthi xhaxhe ngedolophu iAra, ukuya kuqhina kumda wamaMowabhi.”
Ukuphuma apho ke aya kufika kwindawo ekuthiwa kuseBhere. Lelaa qula ke eli apho uNdikhoyo wathi uMosis makawaqokelele amaSirayeli, azokuwapha amanzi.
Ngelo thuba ke amaSirayeli amemelela enjenje: “Khawutsabis' amanzi, qulandini! Ke thina sowamkela ngengoma.
Iqula elimbiwe ngamatshawe, elingumsebenzi wezikhulu zasebantwini; elimbiwe ngomsimbithi wasebhotwe, ngokunjalo neentonga zakhona.” Ukuphuma apho entlango ke baya kugaleleka eMatana;
baza ke ngokunjalo bagqitha eNahalile naseBhamoti,
bandula ke ukuya kufika kwintili ekumhlaba wamaMowabhi, phantsi kwentaba iPisga ekrobele umqwebedu.
AmaSirayeli athumela izigidimi kuSihon ukumkani wama-Amori, athi:
“Sivumele sinqumle elizweni lakho. Asiyi kuphambukela emasimini okanye ezidiliyeni, okanye sisele amanzi emaquleni. Siya kuhamba ngqo ngohola, side siphume emhlabeni wakho.”
Kambe ke uSihon akavumanga ukuba amaSirayeli anqumle emhlabeni wakhe. Ndaweni yaloo nto waphuma nomkhosi wakhe, waya eJaza entlango, wawahlasela amaSirayeli.
Kodwa ke amaSirayeli alwa alalis' ugodo, aloyisa utshaba ada awuthimba umhlaba walo, ukusukela kumlambo iAnoni ngasentla, ukuya kwiJabhoko; lelama-Amon ke elo. Kaloku umda wama-Amon wawukhuselwe.
Ngoko ke amaSirayeli azithatha zonke izixeko zama-Amori, ngokunjalo neHeshbhon needolophu eziyingqongileyo, aza ema kuzo.
IHeshbhon le ke yayisisixeko esilikomkhulu likaSihon, ukumkani wama-Amori. Wayelwe nokumkani wamandulo waseMowabhi, waza wawuhlutha umhlaba wakhe ukuya kuma ngomlambo iAnoni.
Kuthe ke kwakuba nje zadanduluka iimbongi zathi: “Sangena ke thina boonomthina eHeshbhon, tsotsololo phakathi kwisixeko sikaSihon ukumkani! Hayi kambe, masisivuse sime ngeenyawo.
Andithi na kanene kwalapha kuwe, sixekondini Heshbhon, yayisakuphum' imikhosi kaSihon, ilenya njengomlilo? Yadangazela yaleny' isixekw' iAra kwaMowabhi, yazitshayel' iinduli ezingunozala weAnoni.
Mawoo! Lixubayele kuwe, Mowabhi! Banquli bakaKemoshe, aphelil' amahlathi! Kalok' ubayekil' oonyana bakhe baziimbacu, iintombi zangamaxhoba kaSihon, ukumkani wama-Amori.
Kunamhlanje nje isizukulwana sibhangile kusukela eHeshbhon kuye kuthi gaa ngeDibhon; sivuthulule eNofa, sada saya kuthi xhaxhe ngeMedebha.”
Aba ngaloo ndlela ke amaSirayeli ayawuma umhlaba wama-Amori.
UMosis wathumela iintlola, zaya kujonga indlela yokuhlasela isixeko iJazere. Ngenene ke amaSirayeli ayihlasela iJazere needoluphu eziyingqongileyo, bawagxotha ama-Amori awayemi apho kuzo.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli ajika ajonga eBhashan. UOgi, ukumkani waseBhashan, waphuma nomkhosi wakhe, wawahlasela e-Edreyi.

*UNdikhoyo wathetha noMosis, wathi: “Ungaxhali wena; naye lo ndiza kumenza abe lixhoba lakho ndawonye nomkhosi nomhlaba wakhe. Qhuba kwangalaa ndlela wawenze ngayo kuSihon ukumkani wama-Amori owayehlala eHeshbhon.”
Ngoko ke amaSirayeli ambulala uOgi noonyana bakhe, ngokunjalo nabo bonke abantu bakhe, akashiya nempunde le. Ke wona loo mhlaba wakhe ema kuwo.
Ke kaloku amaSirayeli anduluka, aza aya kumisa kumathafa aseMowabhi, kwimpuma yeJordan, malunga neJeriko.
Uthe ke uBhalaki, ukumkani waseMowabhi, unyana kaZipore, akuziva izigigaba zamaSirayeli phakathi kwama-Amori,
akubuqonda nobungakanani bawo, suka yena nabantu bakhe bankwantya.
Ke amaMowabhi athetha neenkokheli zamaMidiyan, athi: “Eli hlokondiba losuka livuthulule nje konke kule ngingqi yethu, kanye oku kwenkunzi yenkomo igramza ingca edlelweni.” Ngoko ke ukumkani uBhalaki

wathumela kuBhalam unyana kaBhehore owayesePetore ngakumlambo iEfrati, kumhlaba wamawabo. Umyalezo lowo wawusithi: “Ndiyakwazisa ukuba kukho isizwe esifikileyo apha siphuma eJiputa. Abantu baso banwenwele kulo lonke eli, futhi sebefike kwimida yam.

Ngokwamanani bangaphezu kwethu; ngoko ke nceda uze kubaqalekisa. Mhlawumbi xa ubaqalekisile singanako ukuboyisa, sibadudule baphume kweli lizwe. Kaloku ndiyazi ukuba xa uthe wabathamsanqela abantu, bayathamsanqeleka; ukanti xa uthe waqalekisa, abantu bahlelwa lishwangusha.”
Zasuka ke iinkokheli zamaMowabhi nezamaMidiyan zahamba ziphethe intlawulo kaBhalam. Zakufika kuye zawugqithisa umyalezo kaBhalaki.
UBhalam wathi kuwo la madoda: “Lalani. Mna ndonazisa ngomso into endiyixelelwe *nguNdikhoyo.” Ngenene ke amatshawe amaMowabhi alala apho kwaBhalam.
UThixo wafika, wabuza uBhalam, wathi: “Ngoobani la madoda unawo apha?”
Ke yena waphendula wathi: “UBhalaki, ukumkani waseMowabhi, unyana kaZipore, uthumele kum, wathi:
‘Kukho isizwe esifikileyo siphuma eJiputa. Ngoku sinwenwela kuwo wonke umhlaba. Yiza usiqalekise eso sizwe, khon' ukuze ndibe nako ukusoyisa ndisidudule simke.’ ”
UThixo wathi kuBhalam: “Uze ungahambi nala madoda; uze ungabaqalekisi abo bantu, kuba bathamsanqelekile.”
Ngengomso ke uBhalam wabandulula abathunywa bakaBhalaki, wathi: “Buyelani ezweni lenu, kuba uNdikhoyo akavumi ukuba ndihambe nani.”
Ngoko ke bagoduka, bafika bamxelela uBhalaki ukuba uBhalam walile ukuhamba nabo.
Ngoku ke uBhalaki waphinda wathumela iqela leenkokheli ezaziwayo elikhulu kuneliya.
Zaya kuBhalam, zafika zathi: “UBhalaki unyana kaZipore uthi mawuncede uye kuye, ungavumeli nasiphi na isithintelo,
kuba uza kukuhlawula, waye uzimisele ukukwenzela nayiphi na into oyifunayo. Ngoko ke nceda uye kuqalekisa abaya bantu.”
Kambe ke uBhalam waphendula wathi: “Noba uBhalaki ubeza kundinika ibhotwe lakhe lizele yigolide nesiliva bendingeze ndawaphula umyalelo kaNdikhoyo uThixo wam.
Kodwa ke nani khanilale kwanjengabanye abaya, ukuze ndiphinde ndibuzise, hleze uNdikhoyo andinike myalelo wumbi.”
Ngobo busuku uThixo wafika kuBhalam, wathi: “Njengoko la madoda eze kukulanda nje, lungisa uhambe nawo. Kambe ke uze wenze loo nto ndikuxelela yona.”
Ngentsasa elandelayo ke uBalam wabopha idonki yakhe, wakhwela, wahamba nezo nkokheli zamaMowabhi.
Uthe ke uBhalam akuba ehamba, suka wavutha ngumsindo uThixo. Wayesahamba njalo ekhwele kuloo donki yakhe enezicaka zakhe ezibini, suka isithunywa *sikaNdikhoyo saxaba endleleni yakhe.
Idonki ithe yakusibona isithunywa eso sixabile endleleni, siphethe ikrele, yacebuka endleleni, yangena emasimini. Suka ke uBhalam wayibetha, wayibuyisela endleleni.
Ngoku ke isithunywa eso sema apho indlela imxinwa khona phakathi kwezidiliya ezibini, kwaye kukho uthango lwamatye ngapha nangapha.
Idonki leyo ithe yakusibona isithunywa eso, yayama uthango olo, latsho lagruzuka unyawo lukaBhalam. Kwakhona uBhalam wayibetha idonki leyo.
Kwakhona isithunywa sahambela phambilana, safika sema apho indlela yayimxinwa kangangokuba kungabikho sithuba sakudlula ngapha nangapha.
Kwesi ke isihlandlo idonki ithe yakusibona isithunywa eso yalala phantsi. UBhalam wacaphuka, waza wayingena ngenduku idonki yakhe.
Kwesi sithuba ke uNdikhoyo wayenza ukuba ikwazi ukuthetha idonki leyo, yaza ke yathetha yathi kuBhalam: “Kodwa kodwa ndikwenze ntoni? Yintoni kanye ondibethela yona kwezi zihlandlo zozithathu?”
UBhalam waphendula wathi: “Kungoba uyandibhanxa! Ndiswele nje ikrele, ngendikubulele.”
Idonki yaphendula yabuza yathi: “Andithi na kanene ndiyidonki yakho, le yasoloko ikuthwala bonke ubomi bakho? Ke, kukangaphi ndikuphatha ngolu hlobo?” UBhalam waphendula wathi: “Zange nakanye.”
UNdikhoyo ke wenza ukuba uBhalam asibone isithunywa eso sixabe endleleni siphethe ikrele. Akusibona ke, waziphosa phantsi ngobuso.
Isithunywa sabuza sathi: “Ubuyibethela ntoni kangaka le donki yakho kude kube kathathu? Ndize kukunqanda, kuba uzifaka engozini ngolu hambo.
Ke yona idonki yakho indibonile, yaza yaphambuka kwada kwakathathu. Ukuba ibingaphambukanga ngendikubulele ndasindisa kwayona.”
UBhalam waphendula wathi: “Hayi, ndonile. Bendingaqondi ukuba uxabile endleleni yam, kambe ke ngoku xa ubona ukuba akufanelekanga ukuba ndihambe, ndiyajika, ndiyagoduka.”
Ke sona isithunywa sathi kuye: “Hayi, sowuhamba nala madoda; kodwa ke uze uthethe loo nto ndithi thetha yona.” Ngoko ke uBhalam wahamba nazo iinkokheli zakwaBhalaki.
UBhalaki uthe akuva ukuba uBhalam uyeza, wamhlangabeza, wadibana naye kwisixeko esiphezu komlambo iAnoni, kumda welaseMowabhi.
UBhalaki wambuza wathi: “Kwakutheni ukuze ungezi ngokuya ndandikuthumele kuqala? Ngaba wawukrokrela ukuba sobe ndibe nako ukukuhlawula?”
UBhalam waphendula wathi: “Andithi na kaloku ndizile? Kambe ke gunya lini endinalo? Hayi kaloku, ndothetha loo nto athi mandiyithethe uThixo.”
Ngoko ke uBhalam wahamba noBhalaki, baya eKiriyati-huzoti.
UBhalaki waxhela iinkabi zeenkomo ndawonye neegusha, wamkela uBhalam nezo nkokheli wayehamba nazo.
Ngengomso ke uBhalaki wamthatha uBhalam, wamsa eBhamoti-bhali, apho wayeza kuba nako ukubona inxalenye yamaSirayeli.
UBhalam waxelela uBhalaki ukuba akhe amaqonga amadini apho abe sixhenxe, aze amzisele isixhenxe seenkunzi zeenkomo ngokunjalo nesixhenxe seenkunzi zeegusha.
UBhalaki wenza ngokomyalelo lowo, baza ke noBhalam banikela inkunzi yenkomo neyegusha kwiqonga ngalinye.

UBhalam ke washiya uBhalaki kuloo ndawo, wathi kuye: “Yima ngakweli dini litshiswayo, ngeli lixa mna ndiza kukhe ndithi gu. Mhlawumbi *uNdikhoyo uza kudibana nam. Ndiya kukwazisa nasiphi na isityhilelo andinika sona.” Wahamba ke, wenyuka inkqantosi yenduli.
UThixo ke wadibana naye, uBhalam wathi: “Ndakhe amaqonga asixhenxe; kulo ngalinye ndenze idini ngenkunzi yenkomo neyegusha.”
UNdikhoyo ke waxelela uBhalam oko makakuthethe, wathi: “Buyela kuBhalaki, umazise oku.”
Ekubuyeni kwakhe ke wamfumana uBhalaki esemi apho ngakwidini elitshiswayo, enezo nkokheli zamaMowabhi.

UBhalam ke wathetha la mazwi andilisekileyo, wenjenje: “Ukumkani uBhalaki wamaMowabhi undisuse kwelama-Aram; undiphuthume kwiintaba ezisempumalanga. Uthe: ‘Yiza ushwabulele uYakobi egameni lam. Yiza kaloku, umqalekise uSirayeli.’
Xa bendingubani ke mna ukuba ndiqalekise ongaqalekiswanga nguThixo, ndambathise ngeshwangusha ongashwatyulelwanga nguNdikhoyo?
Kaloku nanko ndimbona ndisencochoyini yeentaba; nanko ndimbukele ndiphezu kweenduli. Ewe, luhlanga olungumth' uzimele; lona aluzibandakanyi nezinye izizwe.
Izizukulwana zikaYakobi yintlaninge njengentlabathi. Ngubani ke ongamcukucezayo ambale uSirayeli? Hayi bo! Masendisifa ukufa kwelungisa. Ewe, isiphelo sam masibe njengesabakhe.”
UBhalaki wabuza uBhalam wathi: “Yintoni le undenza yona? Ndingakuzisa apha ukuba uqalekise iintshaba zam, uze usuke wena uzithamsanqele!”
Waphendula ke yena wathi: “Mandingakuthethi oko ndikuxelelwe nguNdikhoyo?”
Ke kaloku uBhalaki wathi kuBhalam: “Hamba siye kwenye indawo apho unokubona inxalenye yamaSirayeli kuphela, uze ke uthi ulapho uwaqalekise.”
Waya naye kwintsimi kaZofim phezu kwentaba iPisga. Nalapho ke wenza amaqonga asixhenxe, waza wanikela ngenkunzi yenkomo neyegusha kwiqonga ngalinye.
UBhalam wathi kuBhalaki: “Yima ngakweli dini litshiswayo, ngeli lixa mna ndiye kuhlangana naye qelele.”
*UNdikhoyo ke wadibana noBhalam, wathi: “Buyela kuBhalaki, uthethe naye wenjenje.”
Wabuyela kwakuBhalaki ke, waza wamfumana esemi ngakwelo dini litshiswayo ndawonye neenkokheli zamaMowabhi. UBhalaki ke wambuza wathi: “Utheni uNdikhoyo?”
Waza ke yena uBhalam wathetha la mazwi andilisekileyo, wenjenje: “Hoyina ke, Bhalaki, khawubaz' iindlebe; khawundiphulaphule, nyana kaZipore!
UThixo yena akamntu; akaxoki, akaguqu-guquki okomntu. Akakufezekisi na akuthembisileyo? Akakuphumelelisi na akuthethileyo?
Nangoku ke kuthiwa mandithi jize ngentsikelelo; ethamsanqele nje yena, mna andinakulicima.
Akubonwa sikhwa kuYakobi; hayi, akubonwa shwangusha kwaSirayeli. UNdikhoyo uThixo wabo ungakubo; ewe, kuvakala intswahla kuba uKumkani uphakathi kwawo.
UThixo uwakhuphile eJiputa; iimpondo zakhe zibaze okwenyathi.
Nemilingo ingabuya nemband' esikhova kuYakobi; nabuqili nabugqwirha buza ze kuSirayeli. Yona ngundaba-mlonyeni ngoYakobi noSirayeli, kusithiwa: ‘Khawubone ke imisebenzi kaThixo!
Khawukhangele ke olu hlanga! Lucondoba njengemaz' engonyama; luvungama okwengwanyalal' engonyama. Aluphumli lungazenzang' iziqweng' utshaba, luze lulithi qongqololo igazi lamaxhoba!’ ”
UBhalaki wabhekisa kuBhalam wenjenje: “Xa usala ke ukuwaqalekisa la maSirayeli musa ukuwathamsanqela!”
UBhalam waphendula wathi: “Andithi na kanene ndikuxelele ukuba mna ndenza loo nto ndiyixelelwa nguNdikhoyo kuphela?”
UBhalaki waphinda wathetha noBhalam, wathi: “Hamba siye kwenye indawo. Mhlawumbi uThixo angakuvumela uwaqalekise amaSirayeli xa ukuloo ndawo.”
Ngoko ke wamsa phezu kwentaba iPehore evelele intlango.
UBhalam wathi: “Yenza amaqonga abe sixhenxe apha, futhi uze nesixhenxe seenkunzi zeenkomo ngokunjalo nezeegusha.”
Ngenene ke uBhalaki wenza ngokomyalelo kaBhalam, wanikela ngenkunzi yenkomo neyegusha kwiqonga ngalinye.
Ngeli xesha ke uBhalam wayeseleqonda ukuba *uNdikhoyo uzimisele ukumthamsanqela uSirayeli, ngoko ke akabanga sabhenela kwimilingo njengangaphambili. Wajonga ngasentlango,
waza wawabona amaSirayeli eqokelelene izindlu ngezindlu. Wasuka ke wonganyelwa nguMoya kaThixo;
waza wadanduluka wathetha kwavokotheka wenjenje: “Nal' udaba olundilisekileyo lukaBhalam, unyana kaBhehore, amazwi andilisekileyo omfo obona cacileyo,
izihlabo zomfo owevayo amazwi kaThixo, othwetyulweyo, kambe ethe ntsho ngamehlo, walamile, unombono kaSomandla.
Hay' ubuhle beentente zikaYakobi! Ewe, athe dwe amanqugwala kaSirayeli!
Zithe tyaba okweentili; zithe thande okomyezo ecaleni komlambo, ngathi ngumngcelele wekhala elityalwe nguNdikhoyo, sengathi yimisedare phezu komlambo.
Kuwo imvula iya kuhlala ingunogumbe, imbewu ayityale kumhlaba otofo-tofo. Ukumkani wawo woba mkhulu kunoAgagi, ulawulo lwakhe lubalasele ngodumo.
UThixo wawakhupha eJiputa, iimpondo zakhe zibaze okwenyathi. Iintshaba zawo azithi nqwam-nqwam, amathambo azo awacole. Ke lona utolo lwawo luyahlabanisela.
Luhlanga olubuthuma njengengonyama; lunjengemaz' engonyama, lungavuswa ngubani? Uthamsanqelekile osikelela uSirayeli! Hay' ishwangusha kulowo umqalekisayo!”
Ke kaloku uBhalaki wabhabhazela ngumsindo, wabetha ngenqindi phantsi, wathi kuBhalam: “Ndakulanda ukuba uze kuqalekisa iintshaba zam, kodwa ngoku kude kwakathathu uzithamsanqela!
Yini le! Chitheka; goduka! Ndathembisa ukuba ndiya kukuvuza ungakrokri, kambe ke lo Ndikhoyo ukwalele ukuba uwufumane loo mvuzo.”
UBhalam waphendula wathi: “Abathunywa bakho ndandibaxelele
ukuba noba ungade undinike lonke ibhotwe lakho lizele yisiliva negolide andingekhe ndiwutsibe umyalelo kaNdikhoyo, ndenze ukuthanda kwam. Kuphela ndiya kuthetha oko athe mandikuthethe.
Ke ngoku ndiyagoduka; ndiya kwabakowethu. Kodwa ke, phambi kokuba ndihambe, ndifuna ukukhe ndikulumkise ngento aya kuyenza uSirayeli kubantu bakho.”
Wathetha ke kwavokotheka uBhalam, wathi: “Nal' udaba olundilisekileyo lukaBhalam, unyana kaBhehore, amazwi andilisekileyo omfo obona cacileyo,
izihlabo zomfo owevayo amazwi kaThixo, olwamkelayo ulwazi oluvela kuPhezukonke, othwetyulweyo, kambe ke ethe ntsho ngamehlo, walamile, unombono kaSomandla.

Ewe, ndiyambona; nankuya phambili phaya. Ndiyamalama, umgama, phambili qelele. Ndibon' inkwenkwez' iphuma kwaYakobi; ndiwujongile umsimbithi usithi thaphu kwaSirayeli. Uya kuzintlekez' iinkokheli zikaMowabhi, abafohloz' oonyana bakaSeti.
Uya kuzivuthulula iintshaba zakhe kwaEdom; ewe, iSeyire ibe yeyakhe, abe ke yena uSirayeli ekhula ngokomelela.
Kothi qhaphu umlawuli kwaYakobi, abasindileyo e-Edom abatshayele kuthi nya.”
UBhalam wabona nama-Amaleki, waza wathetha kwavokotheka wathi: “UAmaleki fudula elelona hlanga lomeleleyo, kambe ke ekugqibeleni uya kutshabalala kuthi tu!”
Kwangokunjalo wabona amaKeni, waza wathetha kwavokotheka wathi: “Ikhaya lakho ngumankankela wenqaba, ngathi yindlwana ekwiimfanta zeenkelekethe zamawa.
Kambe ke, nani maKeni, niya kutshabalala, akugaleleka uAsiriya anithimbe.”
UBhalam waqhuba wathetha kwavokotheka wenjenje: “Yaz'ba ngoobani abanokuphila engafuni uThixo?
Abahlaseli bovela ngaseKiti, behamba ngezikhephe. Baya kumtshabalalisa uAsiriya noHebhere. Kambe nabo ngokwabo baya kutshabalala naphakade.”
Ke kaloku uBhalam wev' endleleni wagoduka, waza ke noBhalaki wahamba eyakhe indlela.
AmaSirayeli athi xa ayemise kwintili yeShitim, asuka arheletya neentokazi zamaMowabhi.
AmaMowabhikazi amema amaSirayeli ukuba aye kwizidlo zamadini awayesenzelwa *izithixo zamaMowabhi. AmaSirayeli akutya oko kutya, amnqula
uBhali wasePehore. Ngoko ke *uNdikhoyo wavutha ngumsindo,
waza wathi kuMosis: “Thatha iinkokheli zamaSirayeli, uzibulale, uzixhome esidlangalaleni phambi *kwesibingelelo, khon' ukuze udambe umsindo wam ngakumaSirayeli.”
Ke kaloku uMosis wathi kwizikhulu zakwaSirayeli: “Ngamnye kuni makabulale amawabo azibandakanye noBhali wasePehore.”
Omnye umSirayeli wathatha umMidiyanikazi, wangena naye kwakhe, ebonwa nguMosis nangamaSirayeli ephela, ngexesha awayesazilile esesangweni lesibingelelo.
Uthe akuyibona le nto uPineyasi, unyana kaElazare, umzukulwana wombingeleli uAron, wee sululu, wemka apho kuloo ndibano, wathatha umkhonto,
walandela loo ndoda naloo mfazi, wangena apho ententeni, wabinza ngomkhonto, wabadibanisa bobabini. Ngaloo ndlela ke ubhubhani owayephethe amaSirayeli wanqamka.
Kambe ke wayeselesube wabulala abantu abangamashumi amabini anane amawaka.
*UNdikhoyo wathi kuMosis:
“Ngenxa yale nto yenziwe nguPineyasi, umsindo wam uthothile ngakumaSirayeli. Kaloku yena ngenxa yenzondelelo yakhe usiphuhlisile isidima sam ebandleni, ndaza ke ngoko andalitshabalalisa.
Ngoko ke mxelele ukuba ndenza naye umnqophiso wobudlelwane.
Yena ngokunjalo nenzala yakhe boba ngababingeleli abangasoze bathini. Kaloku yena ube nekhwele ngoThixo wakhe, waza ke ngaloo ndlela wamngxengxezela uSirayeli.”
Igama lomSirayeli owabulawa kunye nomMidiyanikazi yayinguZimri, unyana kaSalu, inkulu yomzi othile kwindlu kaSimon.
Lona igama lomfazi lowo yayinguKozibhi. Uyise uZure wayeyinkosi yezindlu ezithile zamaMidiyani.
UNdikhoyo wathi kuMosis:
“AmaMidiyani ziintshaba zenu; watshabalaliseni,
kuba abonise ubutshaba kuni ngokunikhohlisa, nangenxa kaKozibhi owabulawa mhla ngobhubhani obangwe sisithwakumbe sasePehore.”
Emva kwaloo bhubhani ke *uNdikhoyo wathetha noMosis noElazare unyana wombingeleli uAron, wathi:
“Libaleni ibandla lamaSirayeli liphela ngokwezindlu, nibale amadoda ukususela kubudala obuyiminyaka emashumi mabini ukunyuka, lawo afanelekileyo ukungena emkhosini.”

Ngenene ke bawuthobela loo myalelo, bawaqokelela onke amadoda ayiloo ntanga. Ke kaloku ahlanganisana kuloo mathafa aseMowabhi phesheya kweJordan malunga neJeriko. Lawo ke yayingamaSirayeli awayevela eJiputa:
Indlu kaRubhen (uRhubhen ke wayeyinkulu kaSirayeli); imizi yayo: amaHanoki, amaPalu,
amaHezeron, namaKarmi.
Inani lamadoda ale mizi ke yayingamashumi amane anesithathu amawaka, anamakhulu asixhenxe, namashumi amathathu.
Inzala kaPalu yayinguEliyabhi

noonyana bakhe uNemuweli, uDatan, noAbhiram. Lo Datan nalo Abhiram ke ngabaya babenyulwe ngamaSirayeli. Bamvukela uMosis noAron, baza bazibandakanya nehlokondiba likaKora ngexesha ababevukela *uNdikhoyo.
Kaloku umhlaba wavuleka wabaginya, baza bafa kunye noKora nabalandeli bakhe abatshatyalaliswa ngumlilo bengamakhulu amabini namashumi amahlanu amadoda. Ke bona baba sisilumkiso kumaSirayeli.
Kambe umlibo kaKora zange uphele.
Indlu kaSimon; imizi yayo: amaNemuweli, amaJamin, amaJakin,
amaZera, namaShawuli.
Inani lamadoda ale mizi ke yayingamashumi amabini anambini amawaka anamakhulu amabini.
Indlu kaGadi; imizi yayo: amaZefon, amaHagi, amaShuni,
amaOzeni, amaEri,
ama-Arodi, nama-Areli.
Inani lamadoda ale mizi yaba ngamashumi amane amawaka anamakhulu amahlanu.
Indlu kaJuda; imizi yayo: amaShela, amaPerezi, namaZera. Isizukulwana samaPerezi ngamaHezeron namaHamuli. Isibini koonyana bakaJuda, uEre no-Onan, bafela eKanana.
Ke amadoda ale mizi ayengamashumi asixhenxe anantandathu amawaka, namakhulu amahlanu.
Indlu kaIsakare; imizi yayo: amaTola, amaPawu,
amaYashubhi, namaShimron.
Amadoda ale mizi ke ayengamashumi amathandathu anane amawaka, namakhulu amathathu.
Indlu kaZebhulon; imizi yayo: amaZerede, amaElon, namaJaleli.
Amadoda ale mizi ke aba ngamashumi amathandathu amawaka, namakhulu amahlanu.
Indlu kaJosefu: Ke yena uJosefu wayenoonyana ababini, uManase noEfrayim.
Indlu kaManase: uMakiri unyana kaManase wazala uGiliyadi.
Ke yona inzala kaGiliyadi yile: amaIyezere, amaHeleki,
ama-Aseriyeli, amaShekem,
amaShemida, namaHefere.
UZelofehadi unyana kaHefere wayengenanyana, iziintombi zodwa. Nanga amagama azo: uMala, uNoha, uHogela, uMilika, noTiza.
Inani lamadoda ale ndlu yayingamashumi amahlanu anambini amawaka, namakhulu asixhenxe.
Indlu kaEfrayim; imizi yayo: amaShutela, amaBhekeri, namaTahan.
AmaEran ayinzala kaShutela.
Amadoda ale mizi ke ayengamashumi amathathu anambini amawaka, mashumi amahlanu. Le ke yinzala kaJosefu.
Indlu kaBhenjamin; imizi yayo: amaBhela, ama-Ashbhele, ama-Ahiram,
amaShefufam, namaHufam.
Ama-Ardi namaNaman yinzala kaBhela.
Inani lamadoda ale ndlu yayingamashumi amane anesihlanu amawaka, namakhulu amathandathu.
Indlu kaDan: inzala yayo iphuma kumaShuham.
Inani lamadoda ale ndlu yayingamashumi amathandathu anane amawaka, makhulu amane.
Indlu ka-Ashere; imizi yayo: amaImna, amaIshvi, namaBheriya.
AmaHebhere namaMalekiyeli yinzala kaBheriya.
UAshere wayenentombi egama linguSera.
Amadoda ale ndlu ke ayengamashumi amahlanu anantathu amawaka, namakhulu amane.
Indlu kaNafetali; imizi yayo: amaJazeli, amaGuni,
amaJezere, namaShilem.
Inani lamadoda ale ndlu yaba ngamashumi amane anesihlanu amawaka, namakhulu amane.
Lilonke inani lamaSirayeli angamadoda yaba ngamakhulu amathandathu ananye amawaka, namakhulu asixhenxe, anamashumi amathathu.
*UNdikhoyo wayalela uMosis wathi:
“Umhlaba wahlulele le mizi ngokobubanzi bayo, ube lilifa layo.
Umzi obanzi ilifa lawo malibe likhulu, elomzi onganeno libe nganeno. Umzi ngamnye uya kufumana ilifa lawo ngokwenani lababhaliweyo.
Qiniseka ukuba umhlaba wahlulwa *ngamaqashiso. Isabelo somzi sohamba ngokobubanzi bawo.
Ewe, ilifa elo liya kwabiwa ngamaqashiso kwimizi ebanzi nenganeno ngokunjalo.”
Nalu uludwe lwemizi yakwaLevi: amaGershon, amaKohati, namaMerari.
Kwinzala yayo kukho nale mizi: amaLibheni, amaHebron, amaMali, amaMushi, namaKora. UKohati nguyise ka-Amram
owathatha umLevikazi uJokobhedi owazalelwa eJiputa. Ke yena wazalela uAmram oonyana ababini, uAron noMosis, nentombi uMiriyam.
UAron wayenoonyana abane, uNadabhi, uAbhihu, uElazare, noItamare.
UNadabhi noAbhihu ke bona bafa ngokwenzela uNdikhoyo umlilo ongafanelekanga.
Ke bona abaLevi abangamadoda ababudala buyinyanga nangaphezulu baba ngamashumi amabini anantathu amawaka. Phofu ke bona baba noludwe lwabo bodwa, kuba zange banikwe mhlaba kwaSirayeli.
Le ke yimizi eyadweliswa nguMosis noElazare xa babesenza ubalo lwamaSirayeli kumathafa aseMowabhi phesheya kweJordan malunga neJeriko.
Kumadoda awayebalwe nguMosis noAron kwintlango yeSinayi, kubalo lokuqala, kwakungasekho nob' ibe nye.
Kaloku *uNdikhoyo wayethe onke aya kufela entlango, kusinde uKalebhi unyana kaJefune, noYoshuwa unyana kaNune. Nangoku ke kwaba njalo.
UMala, uNowa, uHogela, uMilika, noTiza, ziintombi zikaZelofehadi unyana kaHefere, kaGiliyadi, kaMakire, kaManase. Ngoko ke ziintombi zakwaManase unyana kaJosefu.
Ke zona zaya kuMosis noElazare umbingeleli, benamadoda amakhulu ndawonye noSirayeli ephela. Babehlanganisene esangweni *lesibingelelo.
Zafika zathi: “Utata wafela entlango engazalanga nyana. Akadibananga neqela likaKora elavukela *uNdikhoyo, koko yena wafela isono sakhe.
Ngani ukuba igama likabawo liduke kwaSirayeli ngokuba wayengenanyana? Sincede usinike isabelo nathi phakathi kwamawethu.”
Lo mcimbi uMosis wawusa kuNdikhoyo,
waza ke yena wathi:
“Iintombi zikaZelofehadi zenze isicelo esifanelekileyo, ngoko ke mazinikwe isabelo phakathi kwamawazo. Ilifa likayise maliwele kuzo.
“Yithi ke kumaSirayeli: ‘Xa indoda ife ingenanyana, ilifa layo malityiwe yintombi yayo.
Ukuba ke ayinantombi, ilifa layo loba lelabantakwayo.
Xa kuthe kanti ayinabantakwayo, ilifa malibe lelooyisekazi.

Kambe ke ukuba ayinabantakwayo nayisekazi, ilifa elo malinikwe nabani na osesona sizalwana sayo sisondeleyo. Eli siko ke amaSirayeli makalithobele njengomqathango ongundoqo, alenze njengoko ndikuyaleleyo mna Ndikhoyo.’ ”
*UNdikhoyo wathetha noMosis, wathi: “Nyuka uqabele intaba iAbharim, ulijonge ulibuke elo lizwe ndiza kulinika amaSirayeli.
Wakuba ulibonile ke, nawe uza kufa kwanjengoAron umntakwenu.

Kaloku nobabini nawuvukela umyalelo wam kwintlango iZin. Wathi uSirayeli akundikhalazela ngenxa yemeko yamanzi eMeribha nina nala ukusiphuhlisa isihomo samandla am phambi kwakhe.” (IMeribha ke ngumthombo oseKadeshe kwintlango iZin.)
Ke kaloku uMosis wathetha wenjenje:
“Ndikhoyo, Thixo wam, wena mthombo wobomi, nceda utyumbe indoda eya kulikhokela ibandla lakho,
enako ukungena iphuma ilikhokela, khon' ukuze usapho lwakho lungafani neegusha ezingenamalusi.”
UNdikhoyo wayalela uMosis wathi: “Thatha uYoshuwa unyana kaNune, oyindoda endiyixhobise ngoMoya wam, ummisele ngokumbeka izandla.
Biza uSirayeli ephela, nombingeleli uElazare, uze uYoshuwa ummisele angene ezihlangwini zakho apho phambi kwabo.
Mahlulele amagunya akho, khon' ukuze ibandla lonke limthobele.
Ke yena uya kuxhomekeka kumbingeleli uElazare, kuba kaloku yena intando yam uya kuyaziswa *ziiurim neethumim. Ngale ndlela baya kubhexeshwa nguElazare kuyo yonke imicimbi yabo.”
Ke uMosis wenza ngokomyalelo kaNdikhoyo. UYoshuwa wammisa phambi kombingeleli uElazare ndawonye nebandla loonyana bakaSirayeli.
Ngokunjalo uMosis wambeka izandla uYoshuwa, wammisela ukuba angene ezihlangwini zakhe ngokwelizwi likaNdikhoyo.
*UNdikhoyo wathi uMosis
makayalele amaSirayeli athi: “Ngamathuba amisiweyo ndinikeni amadini akukutya okunikelwa kum ngomlilo, idini elivumba limnandi.
“Nanga ke loo madini okutya kufuneka anikelwe ngomlilo kuNdikhoyo: amadini atshiswayo emihla ngemihla, isibini samaxhwane angamaduna angenasiphako.
Elokuqala malinikelwe kusasa, lize elesibini linikelwe ngorhatya.
Ixhwane ngalinye ke malihambe nomnikelo weenkozo ongumgubo wengqolowa obunzima buyikhilogram enye, udityaniswe nelitha yamafutha omnquma acwengileyo.
Elo ke lidini lomlilo lemihla ngemihla; laqala ukwenziwa entabeni iSinayi, ilidini lokutya elivumba likholekileyo kuNdikhoyo.
Kumnikelo wewayini ohamba neli dini lokuqala kothathwa ilitha yewayini ithululwe phambi koNdikhoyo.
Ngorhatya kothathwa elaa xhwane liseleyo, kuqhutywe njengakusasa; ngokunjalo nangomnikelo othululwayo ohamba nalo. Elo ke lidini lomlilo elivumba liyolileyo kuNdikhoyo.”

“*NgoMhla wokuPhumla makwenziwe idini ngesibini samaxhwane angamaduna angenasiphako: iikhilogram ezimbini zomgubo wengqolowa udityaniswe namafutha omnquma ube ngumnikelo weenkozo, ngokunjalo nomnikelo wewayini.
Eli dini litshiswayo ke malenziwe ngayo yonke imihla yokuphumla, lisongeza kwidini elitshiswayo lemihla ngemihla elihamba nomnikelo othululwayo.”
“Ekuqaleni kwenyanga nganye makwenzelwe *uNdikhoyo idini elitshiswayo: iinkunzi zeenkomo eziselula zibe mbini, inkunzi yegusha, isixhenxe samaxhwane angamaduna angenasiphako onke.

Umnikelo weenkozo mawube ngumgubo wengqolowa odityaniswe namafutha omnquma. Inkunzi nganye yenkomo yohamba neekhilogram ezintathu zomgubo wengqolowa; ize inkunzi yegusha yona ihambe neekhilogram ezimbini;
ke lona ixhwane ngalinye lohamba nekhilogram enye. La ngamadini atshiswayo; angumnikelo wokutya osondezwa ngomlilo, ivumba elithandekayo kuNdikhoyo.

Inkunzi yenkomo ihamba nomnikelo oziilitha ezimbini zewayini; inkunzi yegusha ihamba nomnikelo oyilitha enesiqingatha sewayini; lize lona ixhwane ngalinye lihambe nomnikelo oyilitha yewayini. Lowo ke ngummiselo mayela nedini elitshiswayo lomhla wokuqala wokuthwasa kwenyanga nganye enyakeni.
Ngaphezu kwelo dini litshiswayo lemihla ngemihla ke lihamba nomnikelo othululwayo, makwenziwe idini lesono ngebhokhwe eliduna.”
“Umbhiyozo *kaNdikhoyo ngethuba *lePasika mawube ngomhla weshumi elinesine kwinyanga yokuqala.
Ngomhla weshumi elinesihlanu koqala umbhiyozo. Ke kwiintsuku ezisixhenxe kosetyenziswa isonka esinganyuswanga.
Ngomhla wokuqala yoba yintlanganiso eyodwa yokunqula, kungàsetyenzwa.
UNdikhoyo makenzelwe idini lomlilo, libe lidini elitshiswayo. Yoba ziinkunzi zeenkomo eziselula zibe mbini, inkunzi yegusha, nesixhenxe samaxhwane angamaduna, angenasiphako onke.
Makwenziwe umnikelo weenkozo ngomgubo wengqolowa oxutywe namafutha omnquma: iikhilogram ezintathu zohamba nenkunzi yenkomo nganye; iikhilogram ezimbini zihambe nenkunzi yegusha,
ize ikhilogram ihambe nexhwane ngalinye.
Ngokunjalo ke makwenziwe idini lesono ngebhokhwe eliduna, khon' ukuze ibe ngumsitho wokucamagushela amaSirayeli.
La ke ongeza kwelaa dini litshiswayo lemihla ngemihla kusasa.

Kwangaloo ndlela ke, isithuba seentsuku ezisixhenxe, nikelani kuNdikhoyo idini lomlilo elivumba likholekileyo kuye. Eli ke longeza kwidini elitshiswayo lemihla ngemihla elihamba nomnikelo othululwayo.
Ke ngomhla wesixhenxe makube yintlanganiso eyodwa yokunqula, kungàsetyenzwa.”
“Iiveki ezisixhenxe emva *kwePasika ngosuku lokuqala kumsitho wesivuno xa ninikela ulibo oluziinkozo *kuNdikhoyo, makube yintlanganiso yokunqula, kungàsetyenzwa.
Makwenziwe idini elitshiswayo elivumba likholekileyo kuNdikhoyo: Yoba ziinkunzi zeenkomo eziselula zibe mbini, inkunzi yegusha, kunye nesixhenxe samaxhwane angamaduna, angenasiphako onke.
Makwenziwe umnikelo weenkozo ngomgubo wengqolowa oxutywe namafutha omnquma; iikhilogram ezintatu zohamba nenkunzi yenkomo, zize iikhilogram ezimbini zihambe nenkunzi yegusha;
ke yona ikhilogram ihambe nexhwane ngalinye.
Ngokunjalo ke makwenziwe idini lesono ngebhokhwe eliduna. Niya kucanyagushelwa ngaloo ndlela ke.
La ke, kunye nomnikelo othululwayo, ongeza idini elitshiswayo lemihla ngemihla ngokunjalo nedini leenkozo. Ngenene ezi zilwanyana mazingabi nasiphako.”
“Ngomhla wokuqala kwinyanga yesixhenxe makube yintlanganiso eyodwa yokunqula, ningawuphathi umsebenzi. Ngaloo mini ke makukhaliswe amaxilongo.
Yenzelani *uNdikhoyo idini elitshiswayo elivumba likholekileyo kuye: inkunzi yenkomo eselula, inkunzi yegusha, nesixhenxe samaxhwane angamaduna, angenasiphako onke.
Makwenziwe umnikelo weenkozo ngomgubo wengqolowa oxutywe namafutha omnquma: iikhilogram ezintathu zomgubo wengqolowa zohamba nenkunzi yenkomo, iikhilogram ezimbini zihambe nenkunzi yegusha,
ixhwane ngalinye lihambe nekhilogram enye.
Ngokunjalo makwenziwe nedini lesono ngebhokhwe eliduna ukuze nicanyagushelwe.

La madini ke ongeza laa madini atshiswayo enziwa rhoqo kusuku lokuqala enyangeni nomnikelo weenkozo, ngokunjalo nedini elitshiswayo lemila ngemihla elihamba nomnikelo weenkozo nothululwayo. La madini omlilo alivumba elimnandi kuNdikhoyo.”
“Ngomhla weshumi kwinyanga yesixhenxe makube yintlanganiso eyodwa yokunqula, ukutya nomsebenzi kuzilwe.
Yenzani idini elitshiswayo; lona lilivumba eliyolileyo *kuNdikhoyo: inkunzi yenkomo eselula, inkunzi yegusha nesixhenxe samaxhwane angamaduna, angenasiphako onke.
Yenzani umnikelo weenkozo ngomgubo wengqolowa oxutywe namafutha omnquma: iikhilogram ezintathu zihambe nenkunzi yenkomo, iikhilogram ezimbini zihambe nenkunzi yegusha;
ikhilogram enye yona ihambe nexhwane ngalinye.
Makwenziwe idini lesono ngebhokhwe eliduna ukongeza kulaa bhokhwe yocamagushelo nedini elitshiswayo lemihla ngemihla elihamba nomnikelo weenkozo nothululwayo.”
“Ngomhla weshumi elinesihlanu kwinyanga yesixhenxe makube yintlanganiso eyodwa yokunqula, ningawuphathi umsebenzi. Yenzelani *uNdikhoyo itheko iintsuku zibe sixhenxe.

Ngalo mhla wokuqala yenzelani uNdikhoyo idini lomlilo elivumba limnandi kuye: ishumi elinesithathu leenkunzi zeenkomo eziselula, iinkunzi zeegusha zibe mbini, neshumi elinesine lamaxhwane angamaduna, angenasiphako onke.
Yenzani umnikelo weenkozo ngomgubo wengqolowa oxutywe namafutha omnquma: iikhilogram ezintathu zomgubo zihambe nenkunzi yenkomo nganye, iikhilogram ezimbini zihambe nenkunzi yegusha nganye,
ize ikhilogram yomgubo ihambe nexhwane ngalinye ngokunjalo neminikelo ethululwayo.
Makwenziwe nedini lesono ngebhokhwe eliduna. Onke ke la madini ongeza idini elitshiswayo lemihla ngemihla elihamba nomnikelo weenkozo nothululwayo.
“Ngosuku lwesibini makwenziwe amadini ngeenkunzi zeenkomo eziselula zibe lishumi elinambini, iinkunzi zeegusha zibe mbini, neshumi elinesine lamaxhwane angamaduna, angenasiphako onke.
La madini ke ohamba nalawo ayimfuneko ndawonye neminikelo kusuku lokuqala.
“Ngosuku lwesithathu makunikelwe ishumi elinanye leenkunzi zeenkomo eziselula, isibini seenkunzi zeegusha, neshumi elinesine lamaxhwane angamaduna, angenasiphako onke.
Ngokunjalo ke ohamba naloo madini ayimfuneko ndawonye neminikelo kusuku lokuqala.
“Ngosuku lwesine makunikelwe ishumi leenkunzi zeenkomo eziselula, isibini seenkunzi zeegusha, neshumi elinesine lamaxhwane angamaduna, angenasiphako onke.
Ngokunjalo ke makahambe naloo madini ayimfuneko ndawonye neminikelo kusuku lokuqala.
“Ngosuku lwesihlanu makunikelwe iinkunzi zeenkomo eziselula zibe lithoba, iinkunzi zeegusha zibe mbini, neshumi elinesine lamaxhwane angamaduna, angenasiphako onke.
Ndawonye nawo ke makwenziwe nalaa madini kwaneminikelo eyimfuneko kusuku lokuqala.
“Ngosuku lwesithandathu makunikelwe isibhozo seenkunzi zeenkomo eziselula, iinkunzi zeegusha zibe mbini, namaxhwane angamaduna alishumi elinesine, angenasiphako onke.
Lawo ayimfuneko ndawonye neminikelo kusuku lokuqala nawo makangasileli.
“Ngosuku lwesixhenxe konikelwa isixhenxe seenkunzi zeenkomo eziselula, neenkunzi zeegusha ezimbini, ndawonye neshumi elinesine lamaxhwane angamaduna, angenasiphako onke.
Ngokunjalo ke makwenziwe naloo madini ayimfuneko ndawonye neminikelo kusuku lokuqala.
“Ngosuku lwesibhozo makube yintlanganiso eyodwa yokunqula, ningasebenzi.
Makwenziwe idini elitshiswayo libe lidini lomlilo elimkholisayo uNdikhoyo: inkunzi yenkomo eselula, inkunzi yegusha, nesixhenxe samaxhwane angamaduna, angenasiphako onke.
Ngokunjalo ke namadini ayimfuneko ndawonye neminikelo ngosuku lokuqala makangasileli.

“Le ke yimimiselo mayela namadini atshiswayo, neminikelo yeenkozo nethululwayo, neyobudlelwane, ekufuneka niyenzele uNdikhoyo ngokusesikweni ngamaxesha ayo. La madini neminikelo ongeza kumadini ezithembiso okanye awokuqhutywa yintliziyo.”
Ngenene ke uMosis wawaxelela amaSirayeli konke awayekuyalelwe nguNdikhoyo.
Iinkulu zezindlu zikaSirayeli uMosis wazinika le mimiselo *kaNdikhoyo ilandelayo, wathi:
“Indoda xa ithe yenza isibhambathiso kuNdikhoyo, okanye xa ithe yenza isifungo sokuzibophelela, mayingasaphuli eso sifungo, koko mayikufezekise konke ekuthembisileyo.
“Ukuba intombi engekendi ithembisa ukunika uNdikhoyo into, okanye yafungela ukuzila into ethile,
mayenze ngokwesifungo nesithembiso sayo, ngaphandle kokuba uyise uthe akuyiva loo nto, wayichasa.
Kodwa ke xa athe akuva ngale nyewe uyise, wala ukuba isifezekise eso sithembiso, ayisabophelelekanga kuso. UNdikhoyo uya kuyixolela, kuba yalelwe nguyise ukuba mayisifezekise.
“Kambe ukuba intombi yenze isithembiso, iqonda okanye ingaqondi, mhlawumbi yafungela ukuzila into ethile, yaza ke kamva yenda,
ke yena wathi akusiva umyeni wayo akathetha nto, isifungo eso okanye isithembiso sohlala siyibophile.
Kodwa ke ukuba ithe yakuva ngesi sifungo indoda yayo yasichasa eso sifungo okanye isithembiso, siya kuba sitshitshile; futhi ke xa kunjalo noNdikhoyo uya kuyixolela.
“Ke yena umhlolokazi okanye umfazi owahlukene nendoda yakhe, xa ethe wenza isithembiso okanye isifungo, uya kunyanzeleka ukuba asifezekise.
“Ke ukuba umfazi owendileyo wenze isithembiso okanye isifungo,
yaza yathi yakuyiva loo nto indoda yakhe ayathetha nto, ayasichasa eso sithembiso okanye isifungo, uya kunyanzeleka ukuba asifezekise.

Kambe ke ukuba ithe yakusiva eso sifungo indoda yakhe yasichasa, soba sitshitshisiwe eso sithembiso okanye isifungo, kuba kaloku indoda yakhe imalele ukuba asifezekise; ngoko ke noNdikhoyo uya kumxolela.
Indoda inelungelo lokusixhasa okanye isichithe isithembiso nokuba sisifungo esenziwe ngumfazi wayo.

Ukuba ke indoda leyo ithe yakuva ngeso sifungo yathatha ithuba ingathethi nto, yoba iyasixhasa eso sithembiso okanye isifungo azibophe ngaso umfazi wayo; ewe, yoba isixhasile xa ingathethanga nto yakuba ivile ngaso.
Phofu ke ukuba ithule yathula yajika ngengomso yasitshitshisa eso sifungo, ityala lokungafezekiswa kwaso loba semagxeni ayo.”
Nantso ke imimiselo eyanikwa uMosis nguNdikhoyo mayela nendoda nomfazi wayo, ngokunjalo mayela nentombi ekowayo.
*UNdikhoyo wathetha noMosis, wathi:
“Phambi kokuba ungabikho amaSirayeli makaziphindezele kumaMidiyani ngenxa yento awayenzayo.”
Ngoko ke uMosis wayalela amaSirayeli, wathi: “Xhobisani amadoda omkhosi ukuze ahlasele amaMidiyani, aphindezele ngenxa kaNdikhoyo.
Indlu nganye mayikhuphe iwaka lamadoda.”
Indlu nganye ke yakhetha yakhupha iwaka lamadoda, aza ke ewonke alishumi elinambini lamawaka alibophe aligangatha.
UMosis ke wawukhupha lo mkhosi, uhamba nombingeleli uPineyasi unyana kaElazare. Yena waya edabini ephethe izitya ezingcwele namaxilongo okuhlaba umkhosi.
Ngokomlomo kaNdikhoyo ke bawahlasela amaMidiyani, bawatshabalalisa onke amadoda,
kunye neekumkani ezintlanu zamaMidiyani: uEvi, uRekem, uZure, uYuri, noRebha. Bambulala noBhalam unyana kaBhehore.
AmaSirayeli athimba abafazi bamaMidiyani nabantwana bawo, ayithatha yonke imfuyo yawo, azenzela nakubutyebi bawo.
Ke zona iidolophu nemizana azitshisa ngomlilo zonke.
Amabanjwa nemfuyo nako konke ababekuthimbile bakuthatha
bakusa kuMosis noElazare noSirayeli ephela. Bona ke babemise kumathafa aseMowabhi phesheya kweJordan malunga neJeriko.
UMosis, noElazare, neenkulu zezindlu zamaSirayeli, baphuma baya kuhlangabeza umkhosi.
UMosis wakhathazeka sisenzo sabaphathi neengqwayi-ngqwayi zamabutho namaqela awayevela emfazweni.
Wabuza wathi: “Ngani ukuba ningababulali aba bafazi?
Senilibele ngoku ukuba yayingabafazi abâlandela icebo likaBhalam, baza bawawexula amaSirayeli, amvukela *uNdikhoyo ePehore? Kaloku nantso into eyehlisela abantu bakaNdikhoyo ngobhubhani.
Ngoko ke wabulaleni onke amakhwenkwe ngokunjalo nabafazi.
Ke wona amantombazana kunye neentombi zigcineleni.
Bonke ke kuni ababuleleyo nabathe bachukumisa izidumbu mabahlale ngaphandle komzi iintsuki zibe sixhenxe. Ngosuku lwesithathu nolwesixhenxe zihlambululeni ndawonye nâbo nibathimbileyo.
Ngokunjalo ke hlambululani yonke into eyeyokunxiba, nayo yonke into eyenziwe ngofele, uboya bebhokhwe, okanye umthi.”
Umbingeleli uElazare wathetha naloo madoda awayevela emfazweni, wathi: “Nantsi imimiselo enikelwe uMosis nguNdikhoyo.

Uthe yonke into engatshiyo enjengegolide, isiliva, ubhedu, intsimbi, inkcenkce, okanye ilothe, mayihlanjululwe ngokufakwa emlilweni, ize ifakwe emanzini okuhlambulula. Izinto ezizezinye ke zona zohlanjululwa ngamanzi okuhlambulula kuphela.
Ngosuku lwesixhenxe ke kofuneka nizihlambe iimpahla zenu; xa kunjalo ke noba nihlambulukile ngokusesikweni, nibe nako nokungena emzini.”
*UNdikhoyo wayalela uMosis, wathi:
“Thatha uElazare neenkulu zezindlu zamaSirayeli, nibale yonke into eniyithimbileyo kunye namabanjwa nemfuyo.
Onke amaxhoba lawo wahluleni kubini ngokulinganayo. Esinye isahlulo soba sesamajoni, esinye ke sibe sesebandla lonke.
Kwisahlulo samajoni thathani umrhumo kaNdikhoyo; wona ke woba libanjwa elinye kwangamakhulu amahlanu. Nosebenzisa kwaloo mlinganiselo ke nakwimfuyo.
Ezi zinto ke nozinika umbingeleli uElazare, zingumrhumo owodwa kaNdikhoyo.
Ke kwisahlulo samaSirayeli thathani libe linye kumabanjwa angamashumi amahlanu, niqhube kwangaloo mlinganiselo ke nakwimfuyo. Ezi zinto ke zona zinikeni abaLevi abo balusa *isibingelelo.”
UMosis noElazare ke bazenza zonke ezi zinto ngokwelizwi likaNdikhoyo.
Nalu ke uludwe lwamaxhoba awathinjwa ngumkhosi xa ewonke: amakhulu amathandathu namashumi asixhenxe anantlanu amawaka eegusha neebhokhwe;
amashumi asixhenxe anambini amawaka eenkomo;
amashumi amathandathu ananye amawaka eedonki;
namashumi amathathu anambini amawaka amantombazana kunye neentombi.
Ke isahlulo samajoni saba ngamakhulu amathathu namashumi amathathu anesixhenxe samawaka namakhulu amahlanu eegusha neebhokhwe;
waza ke umrhumo kaNdikhoyo wangamakhulu amathandathu anamashumi asixhenxe anantlanu.
Zona iinkomo zangamashumi amathathu anesithandathu amawaka; aza ke amashumi asixhenxe anambini aba ngumrhumo kaNdikhoyo.
Iidonki ke zona zazingamashumi amathathu amawaka namakhulu amahlanu; waza ke wona umrhumo kaNdikhoyo waba ngamashumi amathandathu ananye.
Iintombi namantombazana zaba lishumi elinesithandathu lamawaka; umrhumo kaNdikhoyo ke waba ngamashumi amathathu anambini.
Ngokomlomo kaNdikhoyo ke uMosis wawugqithisela kuElazare loo mrhumo uwodwa kaNdikhoyo.
Ke isahlulo samaSirayeli sasifana, silingana neso samajoni:
amakhulu amathathu anamashumi amathathu anesixhenxe amawaka, namakhulu amahlanu eegusha neebhokhwe;
amashumi amathathu anesithandathu amawaka eenkomo;
amashumi amathathu amawaka namakhulu amahlanu eedonki;
kunye neshumi elinesithandathu lamawaka eentombi namantombazana.
Kwesi sahlulo ke uMosis wathatha lalinye kumashumi amahlanu amabanjwa, ngokunjalo nakwimfuyo, wanika abaLevi ababesalusa isibingelelo ngokwelizwi likaNdikhoyo.
Ke kaloku abaphathi neengqwayi-ngqwayi zamabutho namaqela omkhosi baya kuxelela uMosis,
bathi: “Mhlekazi, siwabalile amajoni ebesiphume nawo; akukho nalinye elingekhoyo.
Nanku umnikelo ke ophuma kwizinto zegolide esizifumeneyo sonke ngabanye: imixhaka, iibhengile, imisesane, amacici, namaso. Sizinikela ukuba zibe sisicamagushelo sobomi bethu kuNdikhoyo.”
Ke uMosis noElazare bayamkela loo golide; yonke ke yayizizihombiso.
Uwonke ke loo mrhumo wabaphathi waba kwisituba samakhulu amabini eekhilogram ubunzima.
Ke ijoni ngalinye lazithathela amaxhoba.
Ngoko ke uMosis noElazare bayithatha igolide leyo, bayisa esibingelelweni, khon' ukuze ibe sisikhumbuzo samaSirayeli kuNdikhoyo.
Ke kaloku amaRubhen namaGadi ayenemihlambi emikhulu yeenkomo. Athe ke akuwuqonda umhlaba waseJazere naseGiliyadi ukuba uyifanele imfuyo,
aya kuMosis nombingeleli uElazare kunye nezinye iinkokheli, acela athi:

“Lo mhlaba amaSirayeli awuphiwe *nguNdikhoyo – sitsho ezi dolophu: iAtaroti, iDibhon, iJazere, iNimra, iHeshbhon, iElale, iSebham, iNebho, neBheyoni – ungumhlaba olungele iinkomo, ibe ke nathi sineenkomo ezininzi.
Ngoko ke kunganjani xa lo mhlaba unikwa thina, ube sisabelo sethu, sime apha kuwo, singabi sayiwela iJordan? Siyakubongoza.”
UMosis waphendula wathi: “Ngaba ke nina nifuna ukuhlala apha nisonge izandla xa wona amawenu esiya emfazweni?
Ningathini kaloku ukusuka niwatyhafise ngolo hlobo amaSirayeli, xa wona ewela iJordan, esiya kuthatha umhlaba awuphiwe nguNdikhoyo?
Ooyihlo benza kwale nto ngokuya ndandibathuma siseKadeshe-bhaneya ukuba beze kuhlola lo mhlaba.
Bahamba baya kuma ngentili ye-Eshkoli, bawubona lo mhlaba, kodwa bathi bakubuya bawatyhafisa amaSirayeli, khon' ukuze angezi kweli lizwe aliphiweyo nguNdikhoyo.
Ke yena uNdikhoyo wakhathazeka, waza wafunga wathi:
‘Ngenxa yokuba bengakholosanga ngam, kula madoda akwiminyaka emashumi mabini nangaphezulu aphuma eJiputa akukho nanye iya kungena kwelo lizwe ndabathembisa ngalo ooAbraham, uIsake, noYakobi.’
“Esi sifungo ke sabandakanya bonke ngaphandle kukaKalebhi unyana kaJefune umKeni, noYoshuwa unyana kaNune. Kaloku bona bakholosa ngoNdikhoyo.
UNdikhoyo ke wakhathazeka, waza amaSirayeli wawabhadulisa entlango isithuba seminyaka engamashumi amane, sada safa saphela eso sizukulwana sasimonile.
Nina ke eningene ezihlangwini zooyihlo, nisisizukulwana esitsha esigwenxa esizimisele ukuhlisela umsindo kaNdikhoyo phezu kwamaSirayeli kwakhona.
Nani ke, maRubhen namaGadi, ukuba niyala ukunamathela kuye ngoku, uya kuphinda awalahle entlango amaSirayeli, ize ke intshabalalo yawo ibe yimhemhe yenu.”
Ke wona asuka aya kuMosis, ambongoza athi: “Sivumele sakhele iigusha zethu iintlanti, futhi sakhele iintsapho zethu iidolophu.

Sizimisele ukuxhoba siwakhokele amawethu emadabini, siwancedise ade awume loo mhlaba uza kuba ngowawo. Ke zona iintsapho zethu siya kuzishiya zihleli kwiidolophu ezinqatyisiweyo, zingabi nakuchukunyiswa ngabantu beli lizwe.
Thina ke soze sibuye ngaphandle kokuba ade onke amaSirayeli asifumane isabelo sawo kwelo lizwe.
Ngokunjalo ke thina soze sifumane sabelo samhlaba phaya phesheya kweJordan, kuba kaloku esethu nasi ngeneno empuma yeJordan.”
UMosis waphendula wathi: “Xa kunjalo ke, zilungiseleleni apha phambi kukaNdikhoyo, nizimisele ukuya edabini.
Onke amajoni enu kufuneka awele iJordan ekhokelwe nguNdikhoyo, azihlasele iintshaba zakhe ade azoyise, uNdikhoyo
awohluthe umhlaba wazo. Emva koko ke noba nako ukubuya; kaloku noba nimanelisile uNdikhoyo ndawonye namawenu. Ke wona lo mhlaba woba sisabelo senu enisinikwe nguNdikhoyo.
Kambe ke ukuba anisifezekisanga esi sithembiso, ze nazi ukuba nimonile uNdikhoyo, ibe ke sona isono senu siya kuba yinto kuni.
Ngoko ke yakhelani iintsapho zenu iidolophu, nakhele nemfuyo yenu iintlanti, kambe nisifezekise isithembiso senu.”
Ke kaloku amaGadi namaRubhen aphendula athi: “Izicaka zakho ziya kwenza ngokwelizwi lakho, mhlekazi.
Iintsapho zethu neenkomo neegusha zona ziya kusala apha kwezi dolophu zaseGiliyadi.
Ke thina sonke sesilungele ukungena phantsi koNdikhoyo. Soxhoba siyiwele iJordan; siya kulwa emfazweni ngokomyalelo wakho.”
UMosis wayalela uElazare, uYoshuwa, nezinye iinkulu zezindlu zamaSirayeli,
wathi: “Ukuba amaGadi namaRubhen ayiwelile iJordan, aza alwa kumkhosi kaNdikhoyo, naza ke noyisa nalithimba elo lizwe, ke wona ze niwanike umhlaba waseGiliyadi, ibe sisabelo sawo.
Kambe ke ukuba akayiwelanga iJordan aya kulwa kunye nani, isabelo sawo osifumana kwelaseKanana kunye nani.”
Ke wona amaGadi namaRubhen aphendula athi: “Ewe, siya kwenza njengoko athethileyo uNdikhoyo.
Siya kuwela siye kwilizwe laseKanana, silwe siphantsi kwakhe, ukuze singaphulukani nesabelo sethu apha kwimpuma yeJordan.”

Ngoko ke uMosis wabela amaGadi, amaRubhen, nenxalenye yabakwaManase, wonke ummandla kakumkani uSihon wama-Amori, ndawonye nokakumkani uOgi waseBhashan, ngokunjalo needolophu namaphandle awujikelezileyo.
AmaGadi abuya azakha iidolophu ezinqatyisiweyo zaseDibhon, iAtaroti, iArohere,
iAteroti-shofan, iJazere, iJogebheha,
iBhete-nimra, neBhete-haran.
AmaRubhen ahlaziya iHeshbhon, iElale, iKiriatayim,
iNebho, iBhali-mehon (eli ke igama latshintshwa), neSibhema. Iidolophu abazakhayo bazithiya ngokutsha.
Ke bona abakwaMakire, unyana kaManase, bahlasela umhlaba waseGiliyadi, bawagxotha ama-Amori awayelapho, baza bema kuwo loo mhlaba.
Ngoko ke uMosis umhlaba waseGiliyadi wawunika indlu kaMakire, yema kuwo.
UJayire wendlu kaManase wahlasela iidolophana ezithile, waza wazithatha wazibiza ngokuba ziidolophana zikaJayire.
NoNobha wahlasela iKenati needolophana zayo, waza wayithiya ngaye, wathi yiNobha.
Le yimbali echaza ngeendawo awathi emisa kuzo ngokwezindlu zawo amaSirayeli ukuphuma kwawo eJiputa ekhokelwa nguMosis noAron.
Ngokuyalelwa *nguNdikhoyo ke uMosis wawabhala amagama eendawo abathi bemisa kuzo.
AmaSirayeli anduluka eJiputa ngomhla weshumi elinesihlanu kwinyanga yokuqala enyakeni, kusuku olulandela *iPasika, aphuma engafihlakalanga eRamesi, ekhokelwa nguNdikhoyo, ebonwa ngamaJiputa
awayexakeke kukungcwaba oonyana bawo abangamazibulo ababebulewe nguNdikhoyo. Ngesi senzo ke uNdikhoyo wazicacisa ukuba ungumakhonya *nakoothixo bamaJiputa.
Ukunduluka kwawo eRamesi amaSirayeli aya kumisa eSukoti;
aza ukuphuma kwawo apho emisa e-Etam ekungeneni kwentlango.
Ukusuka kwawo ke apho aphindela ePi-hahiroti kwimpuma yeBhali-zefon, aza emisa ngaseMigdoli.
Ayishiya iPi-hahiroti, awela uLwandle oluBomvu, angena kwintlango yase-Etam; aza ke athi emva kweentsuku ezintathu aya kugaleleka emisa eMora.
Ukunduluka kwawo apho ke aya kumisa e-Elim, kuba khona kwakukho imithombo yamanzi elishumi elinambini nemithi yesundu engamashumi asixhenxe.
Ukushiya kwawo iElim aya kumisa ngakuLwandle oluBomvu.
Nalapho aphuma aya kungena kwintlango yeSin.
Akuphuma apho aya kumisa eDofeka
naseAlushe.
Kamva ke aya kutsho eRefidim, apho afika engekho amanzi okusela.

Ukuphuma kwawo eRefidim esiya kwintaba iHore, emisa kwezi ndawo zilandelayo: kwintlango iSinayi, iKibroti-hatava, iHazeroti, iRitema, iRimon-pereze, iLibhena, iRisa, iKehelata, intaba iShefere, iHarada, iMakeloti, iTahati, iTera, iMiteka, iHashemona, iMoseroti, iBhene-yakan, iHori-hagidegadi, iYotebhata, iAbrona, iEziyon-gebhere, eKadeshe kwintlango yeZin, nangakwintaba iHore emideni yase-Edom.

Ke kaloku ngokuyalelwa nguNdikhoyo umbingeleli uAron waqabela kwintaba iHore. Ke yena wafela apho ngomhla wokuqala kwinyanga yesihlanu kunyaka wamashumi amane amaSirayeli andulukayo eJiputa. Wayeneminyaka elikhulu elinamashumi amabini anantathu walibonayo ilanga.
Ke kaloku ukumkani waseAradi owayekumazantsi eKanana weva ngokuza kwamaSirayeli.

Ukuphuma kwintaba iHore, ukuya kumathafa aseMowabhi amaSirayeli emisa kwezi ndawo zilandelayo: eZalmona, ePunon, eObhoti, eIye-abharim emdeni womhlaba waseMowabhi, eDibhon yakwaGadi, eAlmon-diblatayim, kwintaba iAbharim, ngakwintaba iNebho, nakumathafa aseMowabhi phesheya kweJordan malunga neJeriko phakathi kweBhete-yeshimoti neentili zeShitim.
Ke kaloku kwathi xa alapho kuloo mathafa aseMowabhi phesheya kweJordan malunga neJeriko, *uNdikhoyo wanika uMosis le miyalelo,
wathi makayigqithisele kumaSirayeli, wathi: “Nakuyiwela iJordan, ningene kwelaseKanana,
ze nibakhuphe nibagxothe abemi bakhona. *Izithixo zabo ezenziwe ngobhedu nangamatye ze nizitshabalalise ndawonye neendawo abanqulela kuzo.
Ze nime nizinze kuloo mhlaba wabo, kuba niwuphiwa ndim.
Loo mhlaba wabo ze niwahlula-hlulele izindlu nemizi yenu *ngamaqashiso; imizi leyo ke ze niyabele ngokobubanzi bayo.
Kambe ke ukuba anibagxothanga bonke abemi balo, abo baseleyo boba yinkathazo njengeliso eliphandliweyo kuni, okanye kufane nokuba nihlatywe ngameva; ewe, bojika banilwe.
Ngaphezu koko ke ukuba anibagxothanga ndonitshabalalisa njengoko ndandizimisele ukutshabalalisa bona kakade.”
*UNdikhoyo wanika uMosis
le miyalelo, wathi makayigqithisele kumaSirayeli, athi: “Nantsi ke imida yelizwe laseKanana endinipha lona.
Umda wangezantsi uya kusuka kwintlango iZin, ubhijele kumda wase-Edom. Ngasempuma uya kuthatha kumazantsi oLwandle oluFileyo,
uhle ujonge kwinkalo yeAkrabhim, utyhutyhumeze ungene eZin, uyokuthi gaa ngeKadeshe-bhaneya. Ukuphuma apho uya kujonga emantla-ntshona, uye eHazare-adare, uphumele eAzemon,
apho uya kujika, ujonge kwiintili zemida yeJiputa, uyokuma ngolwandle olukhulu.
“Ngasentshona umda uya kuba lulwandle olukhulu.
“Ngasentla umda uya kusuka kulwandle olukhulu, uye kurheca intaba iHore,
uye kuthi xhaxhe kwinkalo yeHamati; uze ke uye kurheca iZedada
neZifron, uye kuthi gaa ngeHazare-enan.
“Owasempuma uya kuphuma eHazare-enan, uye kuthi xhaxhe ngeShefam.
Uya kuhla uye eRibhela kwimpuma yeAyin, utyhutyhumeze kwiinduli ezikwimpuma yonxweme loLwandle lwaseGalili;
uze ke wenjenjeya ukuhla ngomlambo iJordan, uye kuthi gaa ngoLwandle oluFileyo. “Yomine ke le yimida yelizwe lenu.”
UMosis ke waxelela amaSirayeli, wathi: “Nâlo ke ilizwe eniza kulizuza *ngamaqashiso, ilizwe elabelwe izindlu ezilithoba ezinesiqingatha *nguNdikhoyo.
Ke zona izindlu zikaRubhen, uGadi, kunye nesiqingatha sikaManase, zisifumene isabelo sazo ngokwemizi yazo ngaphesheya kwimpuma yeJordan malunga neJeriko.”
*UNdikhoyo wayalela uMosis, wathi:
“Umbingeleli uElazare noYoshuwa unyana kaNune ngabo abaya kwabela amaSirayeli umhlaba.
Ngokunjalo ke khetha inkokheli ibe nye kwindlu nganye bancedise.

Nanga ke amagama eenkokheli ezo: Indlu Inkokheli KwaJuda uKalebhi unyana kaJefune KwaSimon uShemuweli unyana ka-Amihudi KwaBhenjamin uElidade unyana kaKiselon KwaDan uBhuki unyana kaJogeli KwaManase kaJosefu uHaniyeli unyana kaEfodi KwaEfrayim kaJosefu uKemuweli unyana kaShiftan KwaZebhulon uElizafan unyana kaParnaki KwaIsakare uPaltiyeli unyana ka-Azana Kwa-Ashere uAbhihudi unyana kaShelomi KwaNafetali uPedayeli unyana ka-Amihudi.”
Nango ke amadoda âmiswa nguNdikhoyo ukuba abele amaSirayeli umhlaba kwelaseKanana.
Kuloo mathafa aseMowabhi phesheya kweJordan malunga neJeriko *uNdikhoyo wathetha noMosis, wathi:
“Xelela amaSirayeli ukuba kuloo mihlaba ayinikiweyo makahlulele abaLevi iidolophu ezithile ndawonye namadlelo azingqongileyo.
Zona ke zoba zezabaLevi, bahlale kuzo. Ke wona amadlelo oba ngawemfuyo yabo.
Amadlelo makasuke kwiindonga zesixeko abhekele phaya isithuba esingamakhulu amane anamashumi amahlanu eemitha macala,
khon' ukuze ubekho ummandla olinganayo ongamakhulu asithoba eemitha ngapha nangapha, isixeko sona siphakathi.
AbaLevi ze nibanike iidolophu zibe ntandathu, apho umntu angabalekela khona xa abulele omnye ngengozi. Ngaphezu koko ke banikeni ezinye iidolophu zibe ngamashumi amane anambini
ndawonye namadlelo azo, ukuze ke zibe ngamashumi amane anesibhozo zizonke.
Inani leedolophu ezinikwa abaLevi kwindlu nganye loxhomekeka kubungakanani bomhlaba waloo ndlu. Kweneedolophu ezininzi phungula kakhulu; kweneedolophu ezimbalwa phungula kancinci.”
*UNdikhoyo wathetha noMosis,
wathi makathethe namaSirayeli, athi: “Nakuba niyiwelile iJordan nangena kwelaseKanana,
ze nimise iidolophu apho umntu angabalekela khona xa ebulele omnye ngengozi.
Xa elapho ke woba usindile kwimpindezelo yesizalwana sikamfi. Umntu otyholwa ngokubulala omnye akufuneki abulawe lingakhange lithethwe enkundleni ityala lakhe.
Khethani iidolophu zokuphephela zibe ntandathu,
zibe ntathu ngaphesheya empuma yomlambo iJordan, zibe kwantathu nganeno kwelaseKanana.
Ezi dolophu zoba yindawo yokubalekela kumaSirayeli, kanti nakwiintlanga ezingabangeneleli okanye abemi. Nabani na ke obulele umntu ngengozi woba nokubalekela kwenye yazo.
“Kambe ke yena umntu obulele omnye esebenzisa isixhobo esiyintsimbi, ilitye, okanye umthi, woba netyala lokubulala, isigwebo sakhe ibe kukubulawa.
Uxanduva lokubulala isigwinta eso loba phezu kwesizalwana esingumphindezeli. Apho sisifumene khona masisibulale eso sigwinta.
“Ukuba umntu unomntu amzondayo waza wambulala ngokumeyelisela, ukumgibisela ngento, okanye ukumlalela,
noba kukumbetha ngamanqindi, loo mntu unetyala lokubulala, makabulawe. Uxaduva lokubulala eso sigwinta loba kwisizalwana esingumphindezeli womfi lowo; ngoko ke masisibulale apho sisifumene khona.
“Kambe ke ukuba umntu ubulele omnye ngengozi, kungengakuba ebemzonda, noba umbulele ngokumeyelisela okanye ukumgibisela ngento,
okanye mhlawumbi umntu ubethe omnye ngelitye engamboni, engenazinjongo, engelulo natshaba lwakhe,
kwimeko enjalo ityala maligwetywe yinkundla, nayo ke igwebele lo ubuleleyo, ingesiso isizalwana sikamfi esifuna impindezelo.

Inkundla mayimhlangule umbulali lowo kwisizalwana sikamfi; makabuyiselwe kwakuloo dolophu ebephephele kuyo. Umbulali lo ke makahlale apho kude kufe loo mntu ungumbingeleli omkhulu kwelo thuba, lowo uthanjiswe ngamafutha angcwele.
Kambe ke ukuba umbulali lowo umkile apho kuloo dolophu ebephephele kuyo,
waza ke wabhaqwa, wabulawa sisizalwana sikamfi, eso senzo sempindezelo asilotyala lakubulala.
Loo mntu ubuleleyo makahlale apho kuloo dolophu yokuphephela kude kufe umbingeleli omkhulu; emva koko ke angagoduka.
Le mimiselo ke iya kubopha nina nezizukulwana zenu noba seniphi na.
“Umntu otyholwa ngokubulala angáfunyanwa enetyala aze abulawe kuphela xa kukho amangqina; ke lona ingqina elinye alanele ukuxhasa isityholo sombulali.
Isigwinta masibulawe. Mayingamkelwa intlawulo yokusindisa ubomi baso.
Ukuba umntu ubalekele kwidolophu yokuphephela makangavunyelwa akhuphe intlawulo khon' ukuze abe nokugoduka engekafi umbingeleli omkhulu.
Ze ningalifaki *umlaza ilizwe lakowenu. Kaloku ubugwinta buyalingcolisa ilizwe. Ibe ke ucamagushelo alunakwenzelwa ilizwe ekuphalazwe igazi kulo, ngaphandle kokuba kuphalazwe igazi lesigwinta eso.
Ningaze nilifake umlaza ilizwe enihlala kulo; kaloku mna ndinguNdikhoyo, ndihlala phakathi kwabantu bam amaSirayeli.”
Iinkulu zendlu yakwaGiliyadi unyana kaMakire umzukulwana kaManase unyana kaJosefu, zaya kuMosis enezinye iinkokheli.
