Isikhohlakali simfimfitha ubuhlungu bamaphimpi, buze busibinze kanye oku kobuhlungu berhamba.
Asihlali side sibone imilambo empompoza amanzi, okanye iintlambo ezinkcenkceza ubusi namasi.
Ukubulaleka kwaso kufuneka sikuncame singakhange sikuxhamle; kaloku asilifumani ithuba lokubutya ubutyebi baso, sinambithe imveliso yokurhweba kwaso.
Andithi na kaloku sona saphila kukucinezela abahlelelekileyo; izindlu sizifumana singazakhanga?
“Kaloku ukunyoluka komntu okhohlakeleyo akunasiphelo; ulixhoba leminqweno yakhe.
Utya konke, angashiyi nto; ngoko ke ngoku inkqubela yakhe isuke yanqamka.
Uthi xa asencotsheni yempumelelo ahlelwe ziinzima; zisuke zimfikele ngamandla iinkathazo.
Angatya yena ahluthe mpu, kodwa uThixo wosuka amnisele ngengqumbo yakhe, amohlwaye ngokumzisela imfazwe.
Xa azama ukuphepha ikrele elenziwe ngentsimbi uya kuchanwa lutolo lobhedu, lumbinze luphumele.
Xa elikhupha emqolo, encothula intloko yalo ekhazimlayo enyongweni, wosuka onganyelwe kukunkwantya.
Yonke indyebo yakhe yovuthuluka iphele, kuthi gqi umlilo ongaphenjwanga mntu utshabalalise okushiyekileyo endlwini yakhe.
Amazulu osuka awadandalazise amatyala akhe, ke lona ihlabathi lisuke limvukele.
Indlu yakhe iya kukhukuliswa, imke nomsinga wamanzi ngemini yengqumbo kaThixo.
Naso ke isabelo uThixo asinika abakhohlakeleyo; ewe, elo lilifa abamisele lona uThixo.”
UYobi ke waphendula wenjenje:
“Khanibek' iindlebe nindiphulaphule; leyo ke yoba yeyona ntuthuzelo kum.
Khanindinyamezele nam ndikhe ndithethe; emva koko ke ningaqhubela phambili niphoxise.
“Ke mna ndifanele ukukhathazeka; kaloku andixabananga nomntu nje.
Jongani kum: niya kumangaliswa, nibamb' ongezantsi.
Nam ndithi ndakuyicinga le nto indihleleyo ndisuke ndikhwankqiswe, ndize ndifikelwe kukungcangcazela komzimba.
Ngani ukuba abakhohlakeleyo bayizuze inyhweba yokukhula bade babe badala, baxhamle ukomelela nenkqubela?
Bakhula babe nabantwana nabazukulwana; ewe, baba nenyhweba yokusibukela isizukulwana sabo.
Emizini yabo bonwabile, abakhathazwa nto; uThixo akabayekeli ngezibetho.
Kubo iinkunzi ziyazizalisa iimazi, zingashiyi nanye; ibe ke neemazi zabo ziyazala zingaphunzi.
Owabo umlisela utaka-taka ngokwamatakane; abantwana babo bayadloba-dloba.
Ungafika bememelela bekhatshwa ziintambula neengqongqo; bangqungqa benemincili bebetha iifluthi.
Obabo ubomi babudla ngentlutha nenzolo, baze bathi nyubelele baye kutshona kwelemimoya ngaphandle kwamagingxi-gingxi.
Izikhohlakali zithi kuThixo: ‘Suka kuthi! Asinamdla wakuzazi iindlela zakho.’
Zisuka zithi: ‘Kuxa engubani yena uSomandla ukuba singade simbuse? Khona, nzuzoni esiyifumanayo ngokumnqula?’
Kambe impumelelo yazo ayixhomekekanga ezandleni zazo. Mna andihambisani necebo lâbo bantu bakhohlakeleyo.
“Kukangaphi isibane sesikhohlakali sicinywa? Kukangaphi zingundaniselwa zizibetho? Andithi na kaloku uThixo abakhohlakeleyo ubahlomlela ingqumbo yakhe,
aze abavuthele baphephetheke njengengca enqunqiweyo, bavuthuluke njengomququ unyuka nesaqhwithi?
Ngaba uThixo usibekela abantwana isohlwayo sabazali? Hayi bo; makohlwaye abo bonileyo ngokwabo, khon' ukuze nabo baqonde.
Abo bonileyo mabaxhamle isohlwayo, basele ingqumbo kaSomandla.
Kakade ke, umntu uwukhathalele ngani umzi wakhe xa yena engasekho, xa iinyanga zakhe azibalelweyo kobu bomi seziphelile?
“Ngubani ongafundisa uThixo ulwazi? Nezithwala-ndwe zaphezulu zisesandleni sakhe nje!
Bambi bafa bethe gabhu kwintlala-kahle nenkqubela; bafa bengazele nto bekhuselekile.
Ewe, bafikelwa kukufa iimvaba zabo zizele ngamasi; nangokwasempilweni bayimiqaba-qaba.
Ukanti ke bambi bafa benxunguphele, bengazange bayive nokuyiva intlala-kahle.
Kambe ke bonke bayafa bangcwatywe, baze ke babe lixhoba leempethu.
Ewe, ndiyakubona ukuyila kweengqiqo zenu, ngokunjalo naloo mayelenqe niwayilayo ukuchasana nam.
Niyawaza kubuza ke nithi: ‘Uphi umzi wesikhulu xa kunamhlanje-nje? Iphi loo ndlu sasiyenzela kuyo inkohlakalo?’
Ngaba anikhe nibuze na kwabalikhenkethileyo ilizwe? Ke, ngaba anikayiqondi ingxelo yabo?
Le yokuba ngomhla wesithwakumbe isikhohlakali siyasinda, sihlangulwe kuyo ingqumbo!
Akukho mntu ujongana naso asimangalele, kungekho bani usibuyekezayo ngezenzo zaso.
Sisiwa emangcwabeni, lilindwe ingcwaba laso.
Amagada entlambo alala athi ncwaba phezu komzimba waso. Bonke abantu bayasilandela ukuya apho; kanti sandulelwe linani elingenakubalwa.
“Ningathini ke ukufuna ukundithomalalisa ngamazwi alambathayo? Zonke iingxoxo zenu bubuvuvu obungeyonyaniso.”
Ke kaloku uElifazi umfo waseTeman uphendule wenjenje:
“Ngaba ukhona na umntu oluncedo kuThixo? Ngaba angazuza lutho na kwinkintsela yesilumko?
Uthi ngaba uSomandla unolutho aluzuzayo ukuba wena ulilungisa? Khona sekusithiwa awunabala, imnceda ntoni loo nto?
“Ngaba uThixo angakohlwaya na ngenxa yokuba umthobela, aze akumise enkundleni?
Akungebi ngokuba wone gqitha, nobugwenxa bakho bungenasiphelo?
Kaloku wena amawenu uwamisele isibambiso ngaphandle kwesizathu; ude uwohluthe nempahla yawo yokunxiba, asale eze.
Abadiniweyo benxaniwe awuluthobanga unxano lwabo, nabalambileyo ubavimbile ukutya.
Wena ubusisinhanha esinemihlaba; ubungummi obekekileyo.
Kanti awanelanga kukungancedi bahlolokazi, koko ude waxhaphaza wacinezela neenkedama ezi!
Ngoko ke ngoku ubhijelwe zizabatha; uminxwe naliphaphu.
Ngoku ukhulelwe bubumnyama, awuboni; ugutyungelwe naziimpuphuma.
“Andithi na kaloku uThixo yena uhlala emajukujukwini amazulu? Neenkwenkwezi ngokwazo kuloo malenga-lenga zikuwo yena uzivelele.
Ube ke wena usithi: ‘Wazi ntoni uThixo? Esithwe ziingqimba zamafu nje, angasigweba njani?’
Uthi: ‘Akaboni; uvalelwe ngamafu; kuphela uhamba-hamba phaya esibhakabhakeni.’
Ngaba usazimisele ukuhamba indlela yamandulo, ulandele ikhondo labantu abakhohlakeleyo?
Kaloku bona baxhwilwe kwangaphambi kwexesha labo; izikhukula zemka neziseko zabo.
Aba ngabo babesithi kuThixo: ‘Suka kuthi. Angasenza ntoni na uSomandla?’
Kambe ke ikwanguye ozalisa imizi yabo ngobuqhele-qhele. Phofu ke mna andihambisani neqhinga lezikhohlakali.
“Amalungisa ayakubona ukutshabalala kwezikhohlakali, asuke avuye; abamsulwa bahlekisa ngazo besithi:
‘Inene, iintshaba zethu zitshatyalalisiwe, nobutyebi bazo budliwe ngumlilo.’
“Ngoko ke wena zilahlele kuThixo, ube noxolo kunye naye; kwakuba njalo ke uya kuzuza okulungileyo.
Yamkela imfundiso ephuma emlonyeni wakhe, uwamilisele entliziyweni yakho amazwi akhe.
Ewe, ukuba uyabuyela kuSomandla uya kwakheka; nto nje wena lahla la manyondololo aqhubeka kulo mzi wakho.
Igolide yakho yilahle, neyona yodidi yaseOfire yithathe njengamatye nje aphaya entlanjeni.
Kuphela igolide yakho mayibe nguSomandla, neengqumba zesiliva yakho mayibe kwanguye.
Wakuba wenjenjalo ke uya kukholosa ngoThixo uSomandla, ubujongise kuye ubuso bakho.
Uya kuthandaza kuye eve; ngokunjalo ke nezibhambathiso zakho uzifezekise.
Izigqibo zakho ziya kuphumelela, ngokunjalo nendlela yakho ibe mhlophe.
Xa abantu bekhahlelwe phantsi uze uthi: ‘Nceda ubaphakamise.’ UThixo uya kubahlangula abazithobileyo;
ewe, ude ahlangule nongekho msulwa, emsindisa ngobunyulu bezandla zakho.”
UYobi uphendule wenjenje:
“Nanamhlanje ndisamkhalazela ndikrakra uThixo, kuba undiphethe gadalala nakuba sendincwina kangaka nje!
Akwaba bendimazi apho akhoyo, ndiyazi nendlela eya apho ahlala khona.
Bendiya kusibeka isikhalo sam phambi kwakhe, ndixoxe ndizithethelele.
Bendiya kukhe ndimve ukuba uthini na; ndive ukuba uthetha ntoni na.
Ngaba angasunduzana nam ngaloo mandla akhe? Hayi, uThixo ngeke akwenze oko.
Kaloku enkundleni yakhe amalungisa aphuma phambili. Ke ngoko uMgwebi wam ebeya kundigwebela kuphele.
“Ndikhangele ndamfuna empumalanga, kodwa andimfumani; ukanti nasentshonalanga andimbhaqanga.
Nokuba usebenza kwelasentla andimboni; xa ebuyela kwelasezantsi usithele emehlweni am.
Phofu ke uThixo uyayazi indlela endiyihambayo; ukuba unokukhe andivavanye ndingafumaneka ndimsulwa okwegolide.
Kaloku iinyawo zam zilandela emkhondweni wakhe; indlela yakhe ndiyigcinile, andaphambuka kuyo.
Andiyishiyanga imiyalelo yemilebe yomlomo wakhe; andenzanga ngokufuna kwam, koko ndiwathobele amazwi akhe.
Xa enze isigqibo ngubani ongamjikayo? Oko afuna ukukwenza uyakwenza.
Ngoko ke uya kukufezekisa konke oko andimisele kona, nditsho nokuba yintoni na ayicebileyo ngam.
Ngoko ke ndisuka ndirhwaqele phambi kwakhe; ewe, ndithi ndakucinga ngaye ndinkwantye.
NguThixo lo unditsho ndoyika kangaka! Ewe, nguSomandla lo undirhwaqelisayo.
Phofu bona ubumnyama abundivalanga umlomo, nditsho esi sithokothoko sigqume ubuso bam.”
“Ngani ukuba uSomandla angalimisi ixesha lokugweba? Kutheni ukuba nâbo bamaziyo bangayiboni loo mini?
Abantu bayawushenxisa umlima-ndlela. Ewe, beba iigusha bazifuye emadlelweni.
Bayayohlutha idonki yenkedama; babambisa ngenkabi yenkomo yomhlolokazi.
Amahlwempu bayawagila aphume endleleni, babanyanzelisele ekuzimeleni abaziintsizana belizwe.
Ewe, abahlelelekileyo bavuka kusasa, bexelengela ukutya kwabo, oku kweqwarha elibhadula ezindle lifuna ukutya koozintlango; yinkqantosi kuphela ebonelela abantwana babo ngokutyiwayo.
Ukutya kwabo bakuvuna efusini, bakhwahlaze izidiliya zezikhohlakali.
Ebusuku balala ngengub' esele; abanazo iingubo zokubakhusela engqeleni.
Ezintabeni phaya iimvula zibatsho babe manzi tixi, bemana bezikhusela ngokuncathama emaweni.
Abakhohlakeleyo bathimba iintsana eziziinkedama ezisesebeleni; bathatha iintsana zamahlwempu zibe sisibambiso.
Ewe, amahlwempu ahamba ze engenampahla; athwala izithungu izisu zithe nca!
Akhama ioyile eminqumeni, axovule newayini ezidiliyeni; kodwa wona ngokwawo abe enxaniwe.
Ezixekweni kuncwina amadoda, iingxwelerha ziyahlahlamba zicela uncedo, kodwa yena uThixo akazisi enkundleni izikhohlakali.”
“Kukho abantu abangafunaniyo nokukhanya, abangafuni nokuziqonda iindlela zako, futhi bengahambisani nako mpela!
Izikrelemnqa zivuka ekuseni ziye kugebenga abahlelelekileyo, kuze kuthi kwakuhlwa zijike zibe ngamasela.
Ke bona abakrexezi balinda ungcwalazi, ufike sebefihl' ubuso, besithi: ‘Andiyi kubonwa.’
Ebusuku amasela aqhekeza izindlu, aze kwakuba semini azimele angafunani nokukhanya.
Isithoko-thoko sobumnyama sifana nemini kubo; ubusuku oboyikekayo bunjengomhlobo kubo.
“Isikhohlakali sikhukuliswa sisikhukula; amasimi asisabelo saso ashwatyulelwe, akusekho bani usebenzayo ezidiliyeni zaso.
Ikhephu liyanyibilika lakudibana nobushushu nembalela; ngokunjalo naboni bayavuthuluka kwelabafileyo.
Nditsho nonina uyamlibala; kaloku umemethwe ziimpethu, akabi sakhunjulwa. Ewe, isikhohlakali sinkumka oku komthi owomileyo.
Kaloku sona siphanga abafazi abaziindlolo, singabenzeli inceba abahlolokazi.
Ngamandla akhe uThixo uyazishenxisa izihandiba; ewe, uThixo uthi akusebenzisa amandla akhe zitsho ziphelelwe lithemba lokudla ubomi.
UThixo noba angaziyeka zihlale zithe zava, kodwa usoloko ezijongile ukusuka nokuhlala kwazo.
Abantu abakhohlakeleyo bahluma babe nenkqubela okwexeshana, kodwa yonke loo nto iphela ngokukhawuleza; bayadaka bafe njengamntu wonke, bayabuna oku kwesikhwebu sengqolowa esivuniweyo.
“Ngubani ongayiphikisayo le nyaniso? Makavele ongandiphikisayo, athi nditheth' amampunge!”
Kwesi sithuba ke kuphendule uBhildadi umfo waseShuwa, wathi:
“Kaloku uThixo nguSomagunya, nguDuma-barhwaqele; yaye ke ulugcinile ucwangco kweliphezulu.
Ngaba ukhona na ongazibalayo izinxiba-mxhaka zakhe? Khona ngaba kuphi apho lungabonakaliyo ukhanyiso lwakhe?
Ngaba kungenzeka ukuba umntu afumaniseke emsulwa enkundleni kaThixo? Uthi ingenzeka into yokuba umntu ozelwe ngumfazi angabi nabala?
Kaloku nenyanga ngokwayo ayiqaqambanga kangako phambi kwakhe; kanti neenkwenkwezi ezi azingcwenganga kangako kuye.
Kuxa engubani ke yena umntu, eyimpethu nje? Uthi unaxabiso lini unyana womntu kuThixo, engumbungu nje?”
Ke yena uYobi uphendule wenjenje:
“Kuthi mandivume ndithi ùluncedo kwababhetye-bhetye! Hayi kambe ukubahlangula kwakho abo baswele amandla!
Ewe, uzicebise kakuhle izityhakala; hayi, ubulumko obubonakalisileyo!
Phofu uthi ngubani ongade aweve la mazwi akho? Khona futhe lini eli uthetha uphantsi kwalo?”
“Abafileyo bayabhinyalaza kukunkwantya, kanti ke nelo lamanzi liyazibhija-bhija kunye nabemi balo.
Ewe, elabafileyo lityhilekile phambi koThixo; ayinasigqubuthelo inzonzobila.
Kaloku uThixo wasitwabulula isibhakabhaka ngasentla phaya, waza umhlaba wawujingisa enyanyeni.
Nguye ofaka amanzi kwiingqimba zamafu, aze loo mafu awabophe angagqajuzwa bobo bunzima bamanzi.
Uyayifihla inyanga ingabonakali; ewe, utwabulula ilifu lithi zinzi, itsho ifihlakale.
Wakwahlula ukukhanya ebumnyameni ngeso sazinge sizotywe elundini lolwandle.
Uthi angakhalima zitsho zihexe iintsika ezixhase isibhakabhaka; ewe, zitsho zizama-zame zingcangcazele kukoyika.
Kaloku yena ngaloo mandla akhe waluthomalalisa ulwandle, waza kwangobo buchule bakhe wamvikiva uRahabhi isilo saselwandle.
Ngomoya wakhe ufutha sitsho sicwenge isibhakabhaka; kanti ke ikwasisandla sakhe esangxwelerha inyoka enyubelezayo.
Kambe ke la ngamagqabantshintshi nje amandla akhe. Thina esikuvileyo lumingi-mingi nje! Ibingubani ke ongade akuqonde ukuzongoma kwamandla kaThixo?”
Ke kaloku uYobi uphinde wathathisa wenjenje:
“Ekho nje uThixo, lo undivimb' ubulungisa, nditsho uSomandla lo uwenze umphefumlo wam wangcamla ubukrakra:
Ukuba ndisaxomoloza ndisadl' amazimba, xa ngaba ndisaphila ndinomphefumlo kaThixo emathatheni am,
imilebe yam ayisokuze ithethe inkohlakalo, ngokunjalo nolwimi lwam alusoze luthethe inkohliso.
Andisoze ndithi ninyanisile, futhi ndiya kude ndife ndibambelele kwinyaniso yokuba ndimsulwa.
Ndiya kuthi nca kwinto yokuba ndililungisa; andisoze ndibe nasazela yonke imihla yam.
“Akwaba utshaba lwam lwafumana isohlwayo sabakhohlakeleyo, ngokunjalo nombandezeli wam azuze isiphelo sabangenabulungisa.
Liyintoni na ithemba labangenaThixo mhla wabunqumla ubomi babo uThixo?
Xa sele kunyembelekile kubo, uthi uThixo angaze asive isikhalo sabo?
Khona bangaziyolisa na ngoSomandla? Bangamnqula na uThixo ngamaxesha onke?
“Makhe ndinifundise ngobukhulu bamandla kaThixo; mandingazifihli izicwangciso zikaSomandla.
Hayi gxebe, senizibonele nje ngokwenu; ngani ke ukuba nibe sathetha imfungu-mfungu enje?
“Naso ke isabelo sezikhohlakali kuThixo; elo ke lilifa lezibhoja kuSomandla.
Noba zingade zibe nenyambalala yoonyana bosuka babe lilifa lekrele emfazweni; ewe, inzala yazo yasoloko ithiwe nca liphango!
Nemingqandanda esindileyo itshayelwa ngubhubhani, baze nabahlolokazi bazo bangalili nokulila.
Noba zingade zibe nemfumba yesiliva ngathi luthuli, zibe nempahla yokwambatha efumbe okodongwe,
kosuka kuthi gqi lungisa lithile inxitywe lilo loo mpahla; kosuka kuvele abantu abamsulwa babelane ngaloo siliva.
Isikhohlakali sakha indlu efana nesingxobo seqonya; sakha into engathi liphempe labalindi.
Isikhohlakali silala sinobutyebi, kodwa siyagqibelisa – sivuka sebuphel' emehlweni.
Sisuka sirhwaqele ngathi siyarhaxwa; kaloku sitshayelwa sisaqhwithi ngobhadakazi.
Kufika umoya wasempuma usitshayele, usuke usinqukrule singabi sazana nekhaya laso.
Usuka usilenge ungenalusini tu; nakanjani kufuneka siwasabe amandla awo.
Ewe, umoya usiqhwabela izandla, usihewule isikhohlakali simke endaweni yaso.”
“Ewe, ikho imigodi yesiliva; ngokunjalo zikho neendawo zokuhluza igolide.
Abantu bemba isinyithi emhlabeni, baze banyibilikise ubhedu olusematyeni.
Nenzonzobila yobumnyama abantu bayayihlola-hlola; baphicotha namathumbu omhlaba, baze bembe bacubungule kwimiwewe enzongo-nzongo yenzonzobila.
Kude lé kwelimiweyo, apho kungazange kwathi cakatha mntu, abantu bayemba bavule imigodi, bajinga-jinge kwalunkcwe, bebotshelelwe ngeentambo.
Phezulu apha lo mhlaba uvelisa ukudla; kanti ngaphantsi phaya ubhukuqwa ngathi ngumlilo.
Kumatye omhlaba kuphuma iisafire, kanti ke lona uthuli lwawo luvelisa igolide.
Amaxhalanga ngokwawo akazazi iindlela zasemigodini phaya, ngokunjalo zange zalanywa naliliso likakhetshe.
Amarhamncwa anyalasayo akazange athi cakatha unyawo apho, nkqu nengonyama ayizange yadlula khona.
Kaloku abantu baqhekeza bagqale nditsho nenyengane le; ewe, neentaba ngokwazo bayazibhukuqa, bazisiphule neengcambu.
Basuka bagqobhoze iitonela emaweni, lize iliso labo liwabhaqe amatye axabisekileyo.
Imithombo yakhona bayayivingca ingampompozi, baze bazidandalazise izinto ezifihlakeleyo.
“Kambe ke, bungaze bufumaneke phi ubulumko? Khona lona ulwazi lungazuzwa phi?
Ewe, ubulumko abunakufumaneka ebantwini; kaloku akukho namnye ulaziyo nexabiso labo.
Andithi na kaloku kwankqu neenzonzobila ezinzongo-nzongo, nditsho neelwandle, ziyabulandula?
Kaloku bona abungekhe bufumaneke nangegolide ecikizekileyo, kanti nentabalala yesiliva ayinako ukubuhlawula.
Neyona golide yaseOfire iyalaba-laba kwixabiso labo; nditsho namatye exabiso, nokuba yionike okanye yisafire.
Ewe, abunakulinganiswa negolide, ukanti abunakuthelekiswa nayo nemveliso yegolide, nditsho nayo neglasi yodidi.
Asisathethi ke ngeekorale neekristale, kuba kaloku bona ubulumko bubalasele ngexabiso, ndithi bugqwesa kwaiiperile.
Ewe, netopazi yaseKushe ayinakulinganiswa nabo, ngokunjalo abunakuthengwa nangeyona ihluziweyo igolide.
Ke, ngaba uphi owona mthombo wobulumko? Umntu angalufumana phi ulwazi?
Abubonakali kuzo zonke izinto eziphilileyo, nditsho nakweyona intingayo intaka.
Ewe, nokufa nentshabalalo, zombini ziyavuma, zithi: ‘Luvakele nje umingi-mingi ngabo ezindlebeni zethu!’
NguThixo kuphela owaziyo ngobulumko; nguye owaziyo umthombo wabo.
Kaloku yena ubona nditsho namaphethelo ehlabathi, kuba kuye akukho nanye into efihlakeleyo phantsi kwamazulu.
Ngokuya uThixo wayemisela umoya amandla awo, namanzi ewacandela umda wawo,
nemvula eyenzela ummiselo wayo, nombane ewalathisa indlela,
kanye ngelo thuba ke uThixo wabubona wabuphicotha ubulumko, waza ke wabumisela wabugoca-goca.
Ke uluntu waluyalela wathi: ‘Niyabona, ofuna ubulumko makathobele uThixo; ofuna ukuzuza ulwazi makabucezele ububi.’ ”
Ke kaloku uYobi wathathisa wathetha wenjenje:
“Awu, akwaba ibinokubuyiselwa kum imihla yamandulo, ngokuya uThixo wayesandilondolozile,
xenikweni isibane sakhe besikhanya phezu kwentloko yam, xa ndanditabhata nasebumnyameni endikhanyisela.
Ewe, ngaloo mihla yamfamlibe ndandimi kakuhle; bendilala ngangubo-nye noThixo emzini wam.
USomandla wayengakum ngoko, ndiphahlwe ngabantwana bam.
Ngaloo mihla amasi ayedlal' abantwana kwam; ke yona iminquma ichuma nasematyeni, ithulula ioyile.
“Ndandisithi ndakufika enkundleni ngasesangweni, ndakuthi zinzi phakathi kwamadoda amakhulu,
abafana bathi gu bucala, ke zona iingwevu zime ngeenyawo.
Ewe, ayesuka aphel' emqaleni kumatshawe, ufike selethe khebevu!
Izikhulu zazisithi cwaka ngathi ulwimi lukhulekiwe enkalakahleni.
Abandiva ndithetha babendincoma, kanti ababona izinto endizenzayo babendingqinela.
Kaloku ndandisabela ndiwahlangule amahlwempu esakukhala; ukanti ndazibonelela neenkedama ezazingenamncedi.
Ababesindakala ndaza ndabanceda babendincoma, ukanti nabahlolokazi ndandibanceda batsho baba neengoma ezintliziyweni zabo.
Ndandivatha ubulungisa njengesinxibo sam; ukwenza okulungileyo kwakuyingubo yam neqhiya yam.
Ndandingamehlo kwiimfama, ndiziinyawo koqhwalelayo.
Ndandingutata kumahlwempu, neengxaki zabasemzini bendizithabathela kum.
Yayindim umaphul' iimpondo kwizibhoja, amaxhoba azo ndiwathi hlasi emilonyeni yazo.
“Ndandisithi: ‘Ndiya kukhula ndide ndikhokhobe endlwini yam, nemihla yam ibe mininzi njengentlabathi.’
Ndandifana nomthi ongcambu zinabele emanzini, omasebe asoloko elalelwa ngumbethe.
Udumo lwam lwaluhlala luhlaziyeka, amandla am engapheli nokuphela.
“Ndandisithi ndakuthetha kutsho kuthi cwaka, abantu bewaphulaphula amacebiso am.
Ndandilebela xa ndithethayo, kungekho mntu unokongeza; kaloku amazwi am ayezika njengemvula.
Ndandilangazelelwa oku kwemvula, amazwi am bewaginya oku komhlaba uginy' imvula entlakohlaza.
Babekhuthazeka ndakuncuma; ukukhululeka kobuso bam bekubomeleza.
Ndandingqendeva njengomnumzana, ndithethe kume ngam; ndandibakhokela njengenjengele kwimikhosi yayo; ndandibaxhasa njengothuthuzela abadakumbileyo.”
“Xa kunamhlanje-nje sendisisigculelo nakubafana abayise bendingabazele nto, ebendingeze ndabashiya nezinja zam ezalusa iigusha.
Bebeligquba nje ekungekho yalo, amabhetye-bhetye angenakwenza nto tu!
Bangamahlwempu alambayo, ahamba ngobusuku, ufike enqunquda iingcambu emqwebedwini phaya.
Balamba kangangokuba ungafika besimba iinqoba emqwebedwini, bade batye neengcambu zemithi.
Abantu babagxothile phakathi kwabo; basuke babahewula bangathi bachil' isela!
Kuye kwanyanzeleka ukuba baye kuhlala emiqolombeni, emingxunyeni, nasezimfanteni emaweni.
Bakhonya phakathi kwamatyholo, ufike sebethe buthalala phantsi kwemithi.
Awu, ziinjubaqa; sisizukulwana soongantweni eside sagxothwa nakwelakowazo!
“Ngoku ke sebendicabela nasezingomeni zabo; ewe, sendisisimbo nesigculelo sabo.
Ewe, ngoku bandidelile, bayandenyanya; bathi bangandibona banditshicele ebusweni!
Ngenxa yokuba uThixo undiyekele ndatsho ndangugqush' eluthulini, nabo ke ngoku baziqhawule iintambo zokulawulwa ndim.
Ngasekunene bafunzela ukundihlasela belihlokondiba; ewe, bayandijoka, futhi sebezimisele ukundihlabanisela.
Bayandiqhiwulela endleleni, befuna ukundigqiba, besithi: ‘Akanabani ongamncedayo.’
Bandihlasela ngathi batyhoboza kwindawo ebanzi; baphoseka kum becanda amabhodlo.
Ngoku ke sendirhawulwe kukunkwantya; isidima sam sivuthuluke ngathi siyavuthelwa, ukukhuseleka kwam kubhange oku komfankungu.
“Ngoku ndisebugxwayibeni, kuba imihla yenkathazo indibambile.
Ebusuku ndiqaqanjelwa nangamathambo la; iintlungu ezindidlayo azipheli.
Ndigxavulwa ngeempahla zokunxiba, ndidlakazeliswe; ndiyakrwitshwa sisambatho, ndibanjwe ngobhongwana.
UThixo undiphose eludakeni; andisento, sendifana nothuli nothuthu.
Ndiba ngakhala ndikubongoza, akundiphenduli; ndiba ngazibika kuwe, akundihoyi.
Wena ngoku ujike wandikhohlakalela, undihlasela ngengalo yakho enamandla.
Uyandiphakamisa undiyekele ngomoya undibhudle; ndiyaqotha-qotheka ndiqwengwa sisaqhwithi.
Ndiyaqonda ke ukuba undinikezela ekufeni, apho baya kuphelela khona bonke abaphilayo.
“Kambe akukho hlwempu elizibikayo endingalincedanga, nditsho elaliphakamisela izandla kum licela uncedo.
Andithi na kaloku ndandilila kunye nabasezingxakini, umphefumlo wam udandatheka ngenxa yamahlwempu?
Mna ndithe ndijonge okuhle kwathi gqi okubi; bendilindele ukukhanya, suka kwathi nyalulu ubumnyama.
Ndithiwe fithi lunxunguphalo, alundiphe thuba; imihla ngemihla ndihlangatyezwa yinkathazo.
Ukukhanya akukho, ndihamba ndigutyungelwe bubumnyama; into endiyenzayo embizweni kukuzibika.
Ngoku sendingumlingane woodyakalashe; ewe, ndiliqabane leenciniba.
Ulusu lwam selujike lwamnyama, futhi luyaxobuka, ibe ke nomzimba wam lo uyagcadeka.
Ihapu yam ngoku seyijike yaba yeyesililo, nefluthi yam ngoku seyisenza isijwili.”
“Ke mna ke sendazimisela ngomxhelo wam wonke ukuba kungáze kubekho ntombi ndiyincwasayo.
Ke, siyintoni isabelo somntu kuThixo? Liyintoni ilifa kuSomandla kweliphezulu?
Abangalunganga ubathwaxa ngezibetho, aze abo bangamatshijolo abayekele ngentlekele.
Andithi na kaloku yena uyazazi iindlela zam, ewabala onke amanyathelo am?
“Ndiqinisekile andizange ndenze buqhophololo, ndingazanga ndakhohlisa mntu.
Makhe ndibekwe esikalini kungekho xanasi ukuze uThixo aqonde ukuba ndimsulwa.
Ukuba ngaba nditenxile endleleni, ndaza ke ndabhaduliswa yiminqweno, okanye ukuba izandla zam zidyojwe bububi,
izilimo zam mazixhatshazwe mntu wumbi, yonke into endiyilimileyo mayincothulwe neengcambu.
“Ukuba ngaba ndikhe ndancwasa omnye umfazi, okanye ndaya kumxhwarhela ngasemasangweni ommelwane,
umfazi wam ngamana wagubela enye indoda; ewe, ngamana wambathwa bantu bambi.
Kuba eso ingaba sisenzo esigwenxa, ingaba lityala elifanelwe kukugwetywa.
Loo nto ingaba njengomlilo otshabalalisayo, otshisa yonke imveliso yam.
“Ukuba ndakha ndasigatya isikhalazo sesicaka sam, okanye andasihoya isicakazana xa sinesikrokro ngakum,
bendingathini ke ukujongana noThixo? Ndingathini ukuphendula xa efuna ingxelo?
Andithi na kaloku kwalo Thixo udale mna zikwadalwe nguye nezicaka zam!
“Mna andizange ndikumangale ukunceda amahlwempu, nabahlolokazi abazange bemke belambatha kum.
Andizange ndaneliseke kukutya ndedwa, ibe yona inkedama ingenayo into etyiwayo.
Kaloku ndayikhulisa njengoyise kwasebuntwaneni bayo, ndayondla ndayithantamisa kwasekuzalweni kwayo.
Ndakubona usizana oluze, oluhlwempuzeke kangangokuba lungabi nayo impahla yokunxiba,
bendilunika impahla eyenziwe ngoboya obuyimveliso yeegusha zam, lutsho lundincome luhambe lundidumisa.
Ngaba ndakha ndayivuyelela inkedama kuba ndiqhayisa ngokuyitshonisa nasenkundleni?
Xa kunjalo ke ngamana ndakroboka iingalo; akwaba zingancothuka emagxeni am.
Hayi bo! Ngenxa yokoyika isohlwayo sikaThixo, nangenxa yokuhlonipha ubuhandiba bakhe, into enjalo andizange ndayenza.
“Xa bendingaqamelela ngegolide, kwecikizekileyo ndisithi: ‘Ulithemba lam!’
ukuba bendivuye ndada ndaqholosa ngenxa yentabalala yobutyebi bam, nangenxa yokwanda kwemveliso yam,
ukuba bendisuke ndanqula ilanga ngenxa yokuqaqamba kwalo, okanye inyanga ngenxa yomfaneleko wayo,
ukuba ngaba bendiwexulekile ndasanga isandla sam, ndibusa zona ezi zinto,
nale ke into ibingaba bubugwenxa obufanele isohlwayo esiqatha, kuba ukwenjenjalo ingaba kukuvukelana noThixo kweliphezulu.
“Andizange ndavuyiswa kukubandezeleka kotshaba lwam, ndingazange ndakuthakazelela ukuminxeka kwalo.
Andizange umlomo wam ndiwuvule wone ngokusuka ndilushwabulele utshaba lwam.
Namadoda andisebenzelayo akazange athi: ‘Yhu, besilamba phaya kwaYobi!’
Abahambi abazange balale ecaleni lendlela ndikho; ndiyabamema beze, kuba iingcango zomzi wam zahlala zivulekile.
Bambi bayazigusha bazifihle iziphoso zabo, kambe ke mna andibufihli ubugwenxa bam.
Kuba mna andiboyiki abantu, andithi cwaka okanye ndizivalele endlwini, kuba ndisoyika ukunyenjwa zizalamane.
“Akwaba bekukho ondiphulaphuleyo! Ndiwandlalile umcimbi wam; uSomandla makandiphendule. Akwaba izityholo endibekwa zona ngondimangalelayo bezibhaliwe.
Bendiya kuzithwala emagxeni, ndizithi jize ngazo entloko njengentshinga.
UThixo bendiya kumanekela konke okwam, ndingqiyaze phambi kwakhe njengetshawe.
“Ukuba ngaba umhlaba wam ubundenzela isijwili, zindigxeka neefolo zawo,
ukuba nditye imveliso yawo ndingabahlawulanga abaniniwo, ndaza bona abalimi bawo ndabavimba,
ewe, endaweni yengqolowa mawuvelise imithi enameva, ukuze endaweni yerhasi uvelise ukhula.” Waba njalo ke uyaphetha uYobi: ncincilili-i-i!
Ke kaloku la madoda mathathu ade amncama uYobi, kuba yena wasuka wanje, esithi umsulwa yena.
Ke yena uElihu unyana kaBharakeli wendlu kaRam eBhuzi uthe akuyiqonda le meko wasuka wakhathazeka, kuba kaloku uYobi wayezenza ilungisa esola uThixo.
Futhi wakhathazwa nayinto yokuba ezi zihlobo zikaYobi zithathu zisuke zoyiswa kukuphendulana noYobi, zingabanga nako ukudandalazisa ubutyala bakhe, kodwa zimtyhola.
UElihu lo wayesalindele ukuthetha noYobi, kuba abanye aba babebadala kunaye.
Athe ke la madoda mathathu akuba selethethe koma umqala esoyiswa bubuciko bukaYobi, wakhathazeka,

wangenelela ke yena uElihu unyana kaBharakeli waseBhuzi, wathi: “Kambe ke ndiyimveku ngeminyaka, ke nina senikhulile, niziingwevu, nto leyo ke esuke yanditsho ndamathidala, ndoyika ukuphuhlisa olwam uluvo.
Ndithe: ‘Mandiyekel' iminyak' isiphakele.’ Bendisithi: ‘Izilimela zingasiph' ubulumko.’
Kambe ke ngoku ndiyaqonda ukuba ngumoya osemntwini, ewe, lifuthe likaSomandla elimthi jize ngokuqonda umntu.
Hayi, abuyi ngaminyaka ubulumko, kungayi nangabudala ukuqonda imfanelo.
“Ngoko ke bekan' iindlebe, khe ndiniphakele; makhe ndinivakalisel' olwam uluvo.
Ewe, ndiniphulaphule xa beniphakula ubulumko benu; ndibuvisisile xa benidimbaza nigalela.
Bendiziindlebe ndonke xa benithetha; akukho namnye umchaniley' uYobi, kungekho namnye ukwaziy' ukuchan' amagama.
Ke nina sanukuthi: ‘Sibuzuzile ubulumko.’ Kaloku nguThixo yedwa ongaphendulanayo noYobi, hayi umntu.
UYobi ubebhekisa kuni, ingekum. Kambe ke bendingamphenduli njengani mna.
“Hayi, Yobi, bathethe kom' umqala; kungokunje basik' umlomo.
Mandithini na ke mna? Uthi mandithi cwaka kuba nabo bethule? Ewe, nâbo bethe bhuxe, inkukw' isik' umlomo!
Hayi bo! Nam makhe ndenze owam umda, ndiluvakalise nolwam uluvo.
Hayi, mna andisenakuzibamba ndithi cwaka, kuba kuninzi ukuthetha kum.
Hayi, ngenene ndifana nemvaba yewayini ebila ingavulwanga – xa ndingaphokozi ndosuka ndigqabhuke.
Ewe, manditheth' ukuze kuthi qabu; mandiwuvule umlomo wam ndiphendule.
Mna andiz' ukuceng' usolala phi, ndiza kutheth' utyhatyhiwe ndingalalanisi.
Kambe akunto yam ukulalanisa; xa bekunjalo uMdali wam ebengandicim' igama ngoko nangoko!
“Ewe ke ngoku, Yobi, khawukuve ukuthetha kwam, uwaphulaphule onke amazwi am.
Khawundibolek' iindlebe, nam khe ndikuphokozele. Phulaphula, ulwimi lwam selubeth' inkalakahla.
Ewe kaloku, ndithetha ndinyanisekile; andikufihli oko ndikwaziyo.
Kaloku nam ndidalwe nguMoya kaThixo; ukuphefumla kukaSomandla kundidlise ubomi.
Ndiphendule ukuba unako; qula uzilungiselele amagama.
Kaloku phambi koThixo siyafana sobabini; ewe, sobabini sabunjwa nguye ngodongwe.
Ngoko ke uzungatatazeli, mwethu; noko nesandla sam asingeke sikucinezele.
“Ngokuya ubuthetha ndikuvisisile; kaloku uthethe wenjenje:
‘Mna ndimsulwa, andinatyala; andinachaphaza, ndingenasiphoso.
Koko uThixo uyandidlelelela nje; ewe, ufumana endityhola ngokuba ndilutshaba!
Iinyawo zam uzikhonkxa ngezikhuni; uyazigqala zonke iindlela zam.’
“Uyabona, uphazamile ngayo le ndawo; mandikuphendule, kuba uThixo yena mkhulu kunomntu.
Ngani ke ukuba umangalelane naye, usithi yena akaphenduli mntu?”
“Kaloku uThixo uthetha nomntu ngandlela zonke, kambe ke yena umntu akahoyi.
Xa umntu ekobunzulu ubuthongo, elele emandlalweni wakhe, uThixo uthetha ngamaphupha nemibono yasebusuku.
Ewe, uzivula ngelo xesha iindlebe zabantu, ebalumkisa batsho barhwaqele.
Ethethanje ke uthintela ukona; unqanda umntu angazigwagwisi.
Ukhusela umphefumlo womntu engcwabeni, amhlangule kwintshabalalo yekrele.
“Kananjalo umntu wolulekwa nangezigulo ezibuhlungu, aphanjwe ziingqaqambo emzimbeni.
Ewe, ude angabi sakulangazelela nokutya, nokona kumnandi akucekise.
Ubhitya abe ngumcinga, nezo mbanjana zakhe bezifihlakele zithi gqi ngaphandle.
Kaloku selejinga phezu kwengcwaba; ubomi bakhe bukhwetywa kukufa.
Mhlawumbi ke angeza kulamlelwa sisithunywa, esinye kuloo mawaka-waka, simkhumbuze ngeemfanelo zakhe.
Singatsho ngovelwano sithi: ‘Mkhulule; makangehli aye kwelabafileyo. Nantsi kaloku intlawulo.’
Ulusu lwakhe luya kuhlaziyeka njengolosana, lubuyiselwe kwimihla yobutsha bakhe;
athi ke akuthandaza eviwe nguThixo, atsho amnqule ngothakazelelo, abuye abe ngumntu oziphethe ngaloo ndlela ayifunayo uThixo.
Uya kuvuma esidlangalaleni athi: ‘Ndonile ndaphambuka endleleni, kodwa uThixo akandohlwayanga ngako oko bekundifanele.
Ewe, undihlangule engcwabeni, nobomi bam abuyi kucinyelwa langa.’
“Zonke ezi zinto ke zenziwa nguThixo; ewe, uzenza umhla nezolo.
Umntu uyamhlangula engcwabeni, ukuze naye axhamle ubomi.
“Ngamana wandiphulaphula ke, Yobi; ewe, yithi cwaka khe ndithethe.
Kambe ke uphendule xa unako; nam ndizimisele ukukulungiselela.
Phofu ke, xa ungenamazwi, yithi tu, mna ndikufundise ubulumko.”
Ke uElihu utyatyadule wenjenje:
“Hoyina, nani nina zilumko; khanibek' iindlebe, nani zingqondi!
Ukutya kungcanyulwa lulwimi, ke yona intetho iviwa ziindlebe.
Makhe sikhethe oko kulungileyo; ewe, masiphicothe oko kufanelekileyo.
“Kaloku uYobi uthi: ‘Ndimsulwa, kodwa uThixo undivimb' ubulungisa.
Nangona ndinyanisekile, ndiphathwa okwexoki; nangona ndingenatyala, utolo lwakhe lundingxwelerhile.’
Wakha wakho phi ofana noYobi lo, osoloko ehlalele ukuphoxisa,
umnt' osoloko ethene mbende nabenzi bobubi, ohlal' eqhogene nezikhohlakali?
Kaloku yena uthi: ‘Akumncedi lutho umntu ukuzimisela ukukholisa uThixo.’
“Kambe ke ndiphulaphuleni, zingqondi: kukude lé kuThixo ukwenza ububi, kuSomandla ukwenza ubugwenxa.
Kuye umntu uvuna loo nto ayilimileyo; umntu umphatha ngokwehambo yakhe.
Hayi bo, uThixo akayenzi inkohlakalo; uSomandla akabugqwethi ubulungisa.
Kakade ngubani owammiselayo ukuba alawule ihlabathi? Ngubani owambeka ukuba alongamele lonke elimiweyo?
Xa ebenokusuka azimisele awunqamle umoya wakhe nempefumlelo yakhe
konke okuphilayo kungasuka kutshabalale, noluntu lonke lubuyele kwaseluthulini.
“Ngaba uyaqiqa na – phulaphula ke! Bek' iindlebe ndithethe.
Umchasi-mthetho angalawula njani? Ke wena ungamgweba njani uThixo eyingangalala yelungisa nje?
Kaloku nakukumkani yena unokuthi: ‘Awunto yanto;’ aze kwizidwangube athi: ‘Nizizinto ezikhohlakeleyo.’
UThixo akakhethi buso nakumatshawe; nesityebi akasilungiseleli ngaphezu kwehlwempu; kaloku bonke bangumsebenzi wezandla zakhe.
Bafa ngephanyazo ezinzulwini zobusuku; bayagungqiswa abantu, bafe; kwanezihandiba ziyawa zingawiswanga mntu.
“Kaloku yena uzijongile iindlela zabantu; uwabona onke amanyathelo abo.
Kaloku akukho thunzi nantsunguzi yabumnyama apho abenzi bobubi bangazifihla khona.
KuThixo akuyomfuneko ukubancwina ngakumbi abantu xenikweni ebasa ematyaleni.
KuThixo akukho mfuneko yaluphando xa abakhiqayo abasezintanjeni, aze amisele abanye ezikhundleni zabo.
Kaloku uyazazi izenzo zabo; ubabhukuqa ngobusuku babhange.
Xa sukuba ebohlwaya ngenxa yobugwenxa babo, loo nto uyenza esidlangalaleni.
Andithi na kaloku basuke bakreqa, ababi sazikhathalela iindlela zakhe?
Ohlelelekileyo bamtsho wazibika kuThixo, waza ke yena wasiva isikhalo sabasweleyo.
Xa athe cwaka ngubani ongamgwebayo? Naxa efihle ubuso bakhe ngubani ongambonayo? Nguye ngokwakhe olawula uluntu nezizwe,
ukuze athintele isikhohlakali ekulawuleni, singababekeli umgibe abantu.
“Ukuba ngaba umntu ebenokuthi kuThixo: ‘Ndikuvukele, kodwa andiyi kuphinda ndone.
Ndifundise oko ndingenako ukukubona. Ukuba ndenze ubugwenxa andisayi kuphinda ndenjenjalo.’
Ngaba uThixo uthi useza kumohlwaya ngenxa yokumvukela kwakhe? Zikhethele ngokwakho, ingabi ndim. Into oyaziyo yithethe.
“Kambe ke iingqondi zosuka zithi, ewe, izilumko zona zingathi:
‘UYobi uthethiswa kukungazi; ewe, akathethi, koko uyabhibhidla.’
Akwaba uYobi ebenokucikidwa ngokupheleleyo, kuba impendulo yakhe ifana neyendoda ekhohlakeleyo.
Ewe, esi sono sakhe uyasandisa, kuba kaloku usuka adlongozele, aqhwabe ngolunya izandla zakhe phakathi kwethu, atheth' umlembelele ngoThixo.”
UElihu uqhube wathi:
“Ucinga ukuba bubulungisa na obu? Kaloku uthi: ‘Ndiya kugwetyelwa nguThixo.’
Kanti ubhekisa kuThixo usithi: ‘Khon' ukuba ndonile ke? Kundinceda ngani ukungoni?’
“Ke ngoku mna ndiza kukuphendula, wena ngokunjalo nabahlobo bakho.
Khawuqethuke ujonge amazulu, uwabone la mafu aphezu kwakho.
Noba uyona awumchukumisi nganto uThixo; ewe, awumenzi nto noba ungade uphinda-phinde!
Ukulungisa kwakho kumnceda ngantoni ke? Ewe, uThixo akazuzi nto esandleni sakho.
Ukona kwakho kuphazamisa kwa-abantu, nokulungisa kwakho kunceda kwabona.
“Abantu bayakhala ngenxa yobuninzi bengcinezelo; balangazelela ukukhululeka kwisandla sabanamandla.
Kodwa yinqaba ukubhenela kuThixo uMdali wabo ozisa ithemba xa sukuba lixubayele.
Nguye osinika ulwazi kunezilwanyana; yena usenza silumke kuneentaka.
Abantu noba sebekhala, uThixo akaphenduli, kuba abakhohlakeleyo bathiwe lwale likratshi.
Inene, uThixo akangeke awaphulaphule amampunge; uSomandla akawasi so tu.
Kunjalo maxa usithi akumboni uThixo, usithi umcimbi wakho uphambi kwakhe, usithi ulinde yena,
naxa uthi uThixo akacaphuki ohlwaye, usithi akasihoyi isono.
Ke uYobi uthetha amampunge, wenza umlembelele engenalwazi.”
UElihu uqhube wathi:
“Kambe ke khawundinyamezele kancinci, kuba kusekho ekufuneka ndikuthethe ndimele uThixo.
Olwam ulwazi luvela kude; lucacisa ukuba uThixo, uMdali wam, lilungisa.
Kaloku akukho buxoki kula mazwi am – ophakathi kwenu unolwazi olugqibeleleyo.
UThixo womelele, kodwa akadeleli mntu; unamandla, nolwazi lwakhe alugungqi.
Izikhohlakali akaziyeki zidle ubomi, kodwa uyabazelelela abo bahlelelekileyo.
Akawasusi amehlo akhe kumalungisa. Nguye obeka ookumkani ezihlalweni, abanye abayeke apho ixesha elide. Kodwa ukuba bayaziphakamisa
bakhonkxwa ngamatyathanga, bebanjiwe ngezintya zeentlupheko.
UThixo ubatyhilela izenzo zabo, esalatha izikreqo zabo xa babeziphakamisa.
Kaloku yena ubenza balulamele ululeko; ubayalela ukuba bahlukane nobugwenxa.
Ukuba ke bayamva bemthobela uThixo, boyigqiba imihla yabo bexhamla indyebo, neminyaka yabo ibe yeyokwaneliseka.
Kambe ke xa bengeva baya kutshabalala ngekrele, bafe ngenxa yokuswela kwabo ulwazi.
“Abantliziyo zingenaThixo bazongezelela ingqumbo yakhe; abazibiki kuye naxa bekhonkxiwe.
Bona bafa besebatsha, bexhwalekile ngamahlazo abahlala kuwo.
Kambe uThixo uyabafundisa abantu nangehambo-nzima; ubavula iindlebe ngokusebenzisa nembandezelo.
“Nawe wakukhupha enkathazweni, wakutsho waxhamla intlala-kahle, usitya uhlutha, ungaswele nto.
Kodwa ngoku isohlwayo esifanele abakhohlakeleyo siphezu kwakho; ukugwetywa nokohlwaywa kukufikele.
Lumka ke umsindo wakho ungawenzi umgibe wokubambisa abanye, ungazimiseli ukusebenzisa ukunyoba okukhulu ukuguqula imeko.
Ngaba kukubhomboloza kwakho na okunokukunceda? Hayi bo, yonke imigudu yakho ayingeke incede.
Sukulangazelela ukuza kobusuku, xesha elo batshabalala ngalo abantu.
Lumka ungayi ebubini; ungazilahleli kubo ngenxa yokubandezeleka.
Kaloku uThixo yimbalasane ngamandla; ke kumba wokufundisa uyingcungela.
UThixo akaxelelwa mntu amakakwenze; ngubani onokuthi kuye: ‘Wenze okugwenxa’?
Khumbula uwuphakamise umsebenzi wakhe, lowo abantu bawubongayo ngeengoma.
Bonke abantu bayayibona imisebenzi yakhe, noxa beyibona bekude nje.
Hayi ukuba mkhulu kukaThixo! Uyiphakamele ingqiqo yethu; inani leminyaka yakhe aligocagoceki.
“Nguye ofunxa amanzi emhlabeni, awajike awenze amathontsi emvula,
mvula leyo ina iphuma emafini, ibe zizandyondyo kumntu wonke.
Ngubani okuqondayo ukuhamba kwamafu, nokuzongoma kweendudumo ezulwini phaya?
Yena utshawuzisa umbane esibhakabhakeni; nguye ogubungela inzonzobila yolwandle.
Le yindlela aluxhasa ngayo uluntu, aluthi jize ngendyikityha yendyebo.
Ke yona imibane iselulawulweni lwesandla sakhe; uyayiyalela itsho ichan' ucwethe.
Kambe ke sona isiphango sixelwa ziindudumo, nditsho neenkomo ziyakwazi ukuza kwaso.
“Kuthi ke kwakuba njalo isuke igubhe intliziyo yam, ixhume endaweni yayo.
Khanikuve ukuzongoma kwelizwi lakhe, niphulaphule ukungqokola okuphuma emlonyeni wakhe.
Utshawuzisa imibane esibhakabhakeni, ayithumele eziphelweni zehlabathi.
Ikhatshwa kukududuma kwelizwi lakhe, lizongoma ngezwi lobungangamsha bakhe. Xa avakalisa izwi lakhe kuba zizabhokhwe zombane ezingathintelekiyo.
Ewe, uThixo wenza imimangaliso ngezwi lakhe, utsho ngezinto ezinkulu esingenako ukuziqonda.
Uthi kwikhephu: ‘Yiwa emhlabeni;’ kwimikhwitsho yemvula athi: ‘Yenza izandyondyo zomvimbi.’
Ke bona abantu batsho bayeke ukusebenza; kaloku ngoku nguye osebenzayo.
Iinyamakazi zitsho zingene emingxunyeni yazo, zizimele apho ezikhundleni zazo.
Iinkqwithela ziphuma endaweni yazo, imimoya enamandla ize nengqele.
UThixo uthi angaphefumla amanzi atsho abe ngumkhenkce, ububanzi bawo buqine bukhenkcezeke.
Kanti wona amafu uwahlohl' ukufuma, aze awahlwayele imibane.
Kaloku nguThixo owalawulayo, atsho enze eyakhe imiyalelo kulo lonke elimiweyo.
Unethisa imvula emhlabeni; kanti isenokuba sisibetho ebantwini, kwanjengokuba isenokuba ngumqondiso wothando lwakhe.
“Yobi, khawunqumame wondele, ujonge imimangaliso kaThixo.
Uyakwazi ukuhamba komyalelo kaThixo, esithi umbane mawulenyeze emafini?
Amafu la uthi ajinga kanjani esibhaka-bhakeni, into emangalisayo engumsebenzi walowo unolwazi olugqibeleleyo?
Uxakwa nje kukuzikhusela ngezambatho kwifuthe lolophu,
ungathini ukufuna ukubambisana naye xa atwabulula isibhakabhaka, esenza somelele okwesipili esityhidiweyo?
“Khawutsho, uthi masithini ke kuThixo? Kaloku kumnyama kuthi; asinamhlaba wakuziphendulela!
Uthi masicele ukuthetha naye! Ngubani ongazibizela intshabalalo?
Bekungekho bani unako ukubona ukukhanya; ukuqaqamba kwako bekusithwe ngamafu, kodwa kwakudlula umoya, kuthi qwenge.
Emantla phaya ukukhanya busabugoliderha; isihomo sikaThixo sisitsho sinkwantye ke thina.
Amandla akhe amtsho angafikeleleki; usulungekile, ebalasele ngobulungisa; akukho bani amcinezelayo.
Ngenxa yaloo nto ke, abantu bayamhlonela; kambe ke zona izindwebi akazikhathalele.”
Ke *uNdikhoyo waphendula esesaqhwithini, wathetha noYobi wathi:
“Wena kuxa ungubani, ukuba ude ufune ukulenza mfiliba icebo lam? Mazwi mani wona la, engenalwazi nje?
Khawuqule, ume njengendoda; mna ndiza kukubuza, wena ke uphendule.
“Wawuphi xa ndiseka ihlabathi? Yitsho kaloku, uyingqondi andithi?
Ngubani owamisa ubungakanani balo? Awunakungayazi loo nto! Ngubani owalijikelezayo etsala intambo?
Khona, zixhaswe yintoni iintsika zalo? Ingubani owalimisela ilitye lesiseko?
Ngaloo ntsasa iinkwenkwezi zamemelela, izidwangube zakwaThixo zona zanemincili.
Mhla lwagqabhuka ulwandle emhlabeni, ngubani owalumisela imida?
Kaloku ndim owalwambathisa ngamafu, ndaza ndalusonga ngobumnyama.
Ndim owalumisela imida, ndalubiyela ndaluvalela endaweni yalo.
Ndaluyalela ndathi: ‘Hamba, ungagqithi apha; amaza akho adlokovayo makaphele apha.’
“Ukhonje wakha wayiyalela intsasa yabakho? Wakha wasikhombisa indawo yaso na isifingo?
Nditsho umsobomvu okhanyisela iziphelo zehlabathi, khon' ukuze izikhohlakali zingabi nakuzimela ebumnyameni.
Kaloku ukusa kuzitsho ziphuhle iinduli neentili, zibe ngathi yingubo ebikade isongene; ewe, zitsho zicace oku kophawu olushicilelwe kumdongwe.
Abakhohlakeleyo bayoyiswa kukukhanya; kaloku ingalo yabo yokugonyamela yaphulwe.
“Ngaba wakha wayibona imithombo yolwandle? Sowukhe wathi cakatha ezintunjini zenzonzobila?
Uwatyhilelwe na amasango okufa? Wakha wakubona kwamnyama-ndawo?
Khawutsho, lingakanani ihlabathi? Phendula kaloku ukuba uyazazi ezi zinto!
“Ungalixela apho likhoyo ikhaya lokukhanya? Khona, wona umthombo wobumnyama uphi?
Ezi zinto ungazibuyisela na endaweni yazo? Khona, uyayazi na indlela esinga esikhundleni sazo?
Awunakungazazi; kaloku wawuseluzelwe, neminyaka yobomi bakho mininzi, ngabula wena!
“Wakha wababona oovimba bam bekhephu? Oovimba besichotho bona uyabazi?
Ezi zinto ndizigcinele mhla kwanyembeleka; ndizigcinele mhla kwathiwa ilizwe lifile.
Uyayazi na indlela eya apho kuvela khona ukukhanya? Uthini umoya wasempuma ukusasazeka phezu kwehlabathi?
Ngubani ovulela izandyondyo zemvula umjelo; ingubani yena khona ovulela iindudumo indlela?
Ngubani onisa imvula endle phaya? Inethiswa ngubani imvula enkqantosini,
ukuze ithobe unxano kumhlaba okhamisileyo, kutsho kuthi rhwelele utyani?
Kakade, imvula le yinto kabani; ingubani yena uyise wombethe?
Ke wona umkhenkce wakhawulwa ngubani; ingubani yena umzali weqabaka?
Kaloku amanzi ayaqina abe ngathi lilitye; inzongo-nzongo yamanzi itsho ikhenkcezele.
“Uthi ngaba unokuzidibanisa izilimela; khona unako ukuwakhulula amakroza?
Ungazilawula iinkwenkwezi namathuba azo, nditsho oozibhere ngokunjalo namatakane azo?
Uyayazi imithetho elawula ilanga nenyanga neenkwenkwezi? Unganako ukumisela impembelelo yazo emhlabeni?
“Unganako ukuliphakamisela emafini ilizwi lakho, khon' ukuze akugubungele ngezantyala-ntyala zemvula?
Ngaba unganako ukuyithuma imibane? Ngaba ingavuma ithi: ‘Ndiyaya’?
Ngubani oyazisayo intsikizi ngemvula, ingubani oxelela umqhagi ngemini entsha?
Sisiphi isilumko esinokubala amafu, ingubani onokuqubuda iingqayi zamanzi zasemazulwini?
Nditsho imvula ejika uthuli lube ludaka, ke wona amagade atsho ancamathelane.
“Unganako ukuzingelela imazi yengonyama? Ungawahluthisa khona amathole engonyama,
xa ahleli esikhundleni sawo, okanye xa ancathame ngetyholo?
Uthi ngubani owondla amahlungulu, xa amantshontsho awo akhala kuThixo, ebhadula ngenxa yendlala?
“Ngaba uyalazi ixesha lokuzala kwamagogo asemaweni? Wakha walibona na inxala xa lifikelwa yinimba yokuzala?
Lithatha iinyanga ezingakanani lithwele, lize lifike nini ke ixesha lokuzala kwalo?
Uyalazi ukuba lingqengqa nini na ukuze libeke itakane lalo, ibe ke ngokunjalo idlule intlungu yenimba?
Amatakane alo akhulela ezindle ade omelele, aze ke asuke emke angaze abe sabuya.
“Iqwarha eli layithatha phi inkululeko? Ngubani owalikhulula intambo ukuba libhadule?
Ndim owalinikela ukuba lihlale entlango, ikhaya lalo libe kuloo mathafa etyuwa.
Isiphithi-phithi sasezixekweni yintlekisa kulo; ngokunjalo nemikhwazo yombhexeshi aliyiva.
Libhadula ezintabeni lifuna amadlelo, lize limemethe naluphi na uhlaza elilufumanayo.
“Uthi ungaze uyisebenzise inyathi? Unganako ukuyivalela ebuhlanti?
Uthi ungayirhintyela ulime ngayo; mhlawumbi uyerhe entilini phaya?
Uthi ingaze ikuncede ngamandla ayo; ungawunikela kuyo umsebenzi wakho?
Ngaba unganako ukuvuna ngayo? Uthi ungabhula ngayo esandeni phaya?
“Hayi ukufaneleka kwamaphiko enciniba! Kambe ke iyagqweswa yingwamza ngokuphapha.
Amaqanda ayo iwabeka emhlabeni iwashiye ukuze ke afudunyezwe ngumhlaba lowo.
Ayinaloyiko lokuba osuka anyathelwe, okanye kuthi gqi inyamakazi iwakroboze.
Ayinankathalo ngamantshontsho ayo, ngathi asingawayo; ayivakalelwa kukubhanga kwemigudu yayo.
UThixo uyivimbe ubulumko inciniba, akayinika nokuyinika ingqiqo.
Kambe ke yakuwathi naa amaphiko ayo ibaleka iyalihleka ihashe nokhwele kulo.
“Ngaba nguwe na owenze ihashe lomelela kangaka? Nguwe owalivathisa ngeso singci siyakayaka?
Nguwe olenze lanako ukuthi qakatha njengeenkumbi? Nguwe olenze larhwaqelisa ngesandi somfutho walo?
Ligxanya ngamandla ngaloo manqina alo xa lijikela entilini phaya, selifunzele phakathi kwayiwayo!
Kaloku lona alinadyudyu nantaka; aliwazele nto umkhonto, alibuyi ngamva.
Kaloku lo uphezu kwalo uxhob' uf' amacala; oomikhonto noozincula ziyabengezela.
Ngaloo manqina alo lisiphula umhlaba, selingasakwazi ukuzibamba, lilindele ukuvakala kwexilongo.
Lakuva umtyangampo wexilongo lithi: ‘Ngxatsho ke!’ ze lithi lisekude lé, libe seliqonda ukuba izwe lifile! Kaloku liyabeva oomaqhuzu xa bayalelayo.
“Ngaba bubulumko bakho na obunika ukhetshe ubuchule bokubhabha? Nguwe omenza athi naa amaphiko abheke kwelasezantsi?
Ngaba nguwe oyalela ixhalanga ukuba lintinge, lakhe nendlu yalo emalenga-lengeni phaya?
Kaloku lona lihlala kwiinkelekethe zamawa; lizenzela inqaba kwiimfanta zamalenga-lenga.
Lithi cwaa apho lilonga-longe ixhoba, lize lilipopole noba selisekudeni.
Amathole alo amfimfitha igazi; nalapho zikhoyo izidumbu libutha khona ixhalanga.”
*UNdikhoyo uqhube wathi kuYobi:
“Ngaba ufuna ukubambana noSomandla, usalatha iimpazamo zakhe? Wena omangalela uThixo, phendula.”
Ke yena uYobi uphendule *uNdikhoyo wathi:
“Xa kungokunje ndiyaqonda ukuba andinto yanto. Ndingaba saphendula ndithini? Kungokunje ndidl' imu.
Ewe, ndithethe ndaphinda-phinda, kambe ke ngoku ndosuka ndiwuthunge.”
Ke *uNdikhoyo waphendula esesaqhwithini, wathetha noYobi wathi:
“Khawuqule, ume njengendoda; mna ndiza kukubuza, wena ke uphendule.
“Ngaba ufuna ukusisingela phantsi isigwebo sam? Ugweba mna ukuze wena ugwetyelwe?
Ngaba nawe womelele njengoThixo? Nelakho ilizwi lizongoma njengelakhe?
Xa kunjalo ke khawuvele uveth' isidima uzimasekile; khawuthi jize isihomo nesithozela.
Khawuphokoze loo msindo wakho, ubaphoxe abo bazigwagwisayo.
Ewe, badilize abo baqholosayo; ke zona izikhohlakali zinyhashele apho zikhoyo.
Xa zizonke zibandakanye uzingcwabe; zigqume zihlale kwelo labafileyo.
Xa kunjalo ke ndiya kuvuma, ndisithi unako ukuzisindisa ngawakho amandla.
“Imvubu le uyayiqonda? Njengawe nayo ndayidala; phofu yona injengenkomo, itya ingca.
Kambe ke, yeka – asimandla esinqeni sayo! Yinto emzimba unemisipha engwanyalala!
Yinto emsila ungqangqasholo okomsedare; ke zona izihlunu zemilenze ziphindene.
Amathambo ayo omelele njengobhedu; ewe, afana nemivalo yentsimbi.
Kuzo zonk' izidalwa ithe kratya ngokukhwankqisa; nguMdali wayo yedwa onako ukuyoyisa.
Ukutya kwayo kufumaneka ezintabeni phaya, apho zidloba-dloba khona izilwanyana.
Ungafika ingqengqe phantsi kwamatyholo akhula ngasemanzini, okanye izimele ezingcongolweni, emgxobhozweni phaya.
Ewe, iphumla emthunzini wamatyholo entlanjeni phaya, ufike ijikelezwe yimingcunube.
Yona ayiwoyiki umlambo ophuphumayo; ithi zole nakwiJordan elatyuza amanzi de abethe emlonyeni wayo.
Kodwa kodwa ngubani ongayihlaselayo? Ngaba uqale wayityhaphaza? Ngubani ongayithiyela ayithi qhoo ngaloo mpumlo?
“Uthi ungaze uyilobe ingwenya, okanye ubambe ulwimi lwayo ngentambo?
Uthi ungaze uyifake intambo impumlo yayo, mhlawumbi uyithi qhoo imihlathi ngegwegwe?
Ucing' ukuba ingaze itarhuzise kuwe? Uthi ingakukubongoza ngamazwi athambileyo?
Uthi ingenza isivumelwano kunye nawe, ithembise ukuba likhoboka lakho ngonaphakade?
Ngaba ungayenza intaka ongadlalisa ngayo, uyikhulekele amantombazana akho?
Abarhwebi uthi bangarhweba ngayo? Ucing' ukuba bangahlulelana ngayo?
Isikhumba sayo ungasigqobhoza ngamagwegwe? Mkhonto waphi ongangxwelerha intloko yayo?
Khawuyichukumise nje – soz' uphinde! Engak' imfazwe soz' uyilibale!
Ngamampunge ukucinga ukuba ungayoyisa. Umntu uthi nje akuyibona asuke avikiveke aphelelwe.
Kungekho bani nje unesibindi sokuyiphazamisa, ngubani ke ngoko onako ukumelana nam?
Ukhona na onako ukubanga into kum ukuze ndimbuyisele? Kaloku yonke into phantsi kwezulu yeyam.
“Andinakuthi cwaka ngemilenze yayo; makhe ndikuphokozele ngokomelela kwayo nokufaneleka kokwakhiwa kwayo.
Ngubani onokuyinyanzela ukuvula umlomo, ingubani onokuyifaka umkhala?
Ewe, ngubani ongavula loo mihlathi yayo ijikelezwe ziingxavula ezoyikekayo zamazinyo?
Umqolo wayo unoludwe lwamakhaka aphotheneyo ngathi atywiniwe.
Ewe, asondelelene ayimbumba; phakathi kwawo akungeni nomoya.
Hayi, anxibelelene angunonca, abambene nkwa, akanakwahlukaniswa.
Yintw' ethi yakuthimla kumenyeze, emehlo ngathi lilanga liphuma.
Yintw' emlomo ulatyuza amadangatye, kutsho kutak' iintlantsi.
Yintw' emarhanana alephuz' umsi, oku kwembiza ebaselwe ngeengcongolo.
Ngomphefumlo wayo ungáwuphemb' umlilo; kaloku kuthaphuz' amadangatye kuloo mlomo.
Yintw' etsho ngengwanyalala yesixhanti; bakuyibona abantu suka barhwaqele.
Izihlunu zayo zifumbene; ziyingwanyalala engenakuhluthuzwa.
Yintw' entliziyo iqine oku kwenyengane! Yomelele oku kwelitye lokusila.
Ithi ingaphakama kunkwantye neengangalala; yakushukuma zisuka zithi phithi.
Yona yomelele, ayinakungxwelerhwa naziintshuntshe, oomikhonto, noozincula.
Kuyo intsimbi ifana nomququ; ke lona ubhedu nqwa nevithi.
Okukokwalo utolo ayilwazele nto; kuyo ilitye *lenkwitshi linkumnka ngathi sisabhunge.
Ke lona ibhunguza lifana nodiza; iincula ziyinto yentsini kuyo.
Isisu sayo nqwa namaceba embiza; umhlaba siwukrazula oku kwesileyi sokubhula.
Amanzi enzonzobila iwatsho abile okwembiza, ulwandle iluzama-zamise okweqhaga leziqholo.
Emva kwayo ngumzila omenyezelayo emanzini. Inzonzobila isuka ifane neenwele zengwevu.
Ehlabathini akukho nto inokulinganiswa nayo, nditsho isilo esingenabo ubugwala.
Kaloku noozindlula-mthi izikrobile; ewe, ingukumkani kwizilo zonke ezinyalasayo.”
Ke kaloku uYobi uphendule *uNdikhoyo wenjenje:
“Ewe, ngoku ndiyaqonda ukuba wena unako ukufeza konke; konke okucebayo wena unako ukukwenza.
Bendingubani ukufuna ukulenza mfiliba icebo lakho, ndingenalwazi nje? Ngenene ndigabadele, ndithethiswa kukungaqondi; ndithethe ngemimangaliso nezinto ezinkulu kunam.
“Uthe kum: ‘Phulaphula, mna ndiza kukubuza, wena ke uphendule.’
Ngoko bendikwazi nje ngokuva ngeendlebe, kambe ke ngoku ndikubonile ngala wam amehlo.
Ngenxa yale nto ke ngoku ndiyazisola; ewe, ndiyaguquka; ndiseluthulini naseluthuthwini.”
Emva kwale ntetho *kaNdikhoyo noYobi uNdikhoyo ubhekise kuElifazi waseTema, wathi: “Umsindo wam uyavutha kuwe nakubahlobo bakho ababini, kuba anithethanga nto iyiyo ngam njengesicaka sam uYobi.

Ngoko ke thathani iinkunzi zeenkomo ezisixhenxe, neenkunzi zeegusha ezikwasixhenxe, niye nazo kwisicaka sam uYobi, nizenzele idini elitshiswayo. Ke yena uYobi isicaka sam uya kunithandazela; ibe ke mna ndiya kuwamkela loo mthandazo wakhe, ndinganiphathi ngokobudenge benu. Kaloku nina anithethanga nto iyiyo ngam njengoko enzileyo yena uYobi isicaka sam.”
Ngenene ke uElifazi waseTeman noBhildadi waseShuwa noZofare waseNama benza ngokomlomo *kaNdikhoyo, waza ke yena wawamkela umthandazo kaYobi.
Akuba ke uYobi ebathandazele abahlobo bakhe kuNdikhoyo, uNdikhoyo waphinda wambuyisela uYobi kundalashe. Ewe, ubutyebi bakhe wada wabuphinda-phinda.

Abantakwabo noodade bakhe, ngokunjalo nâbo babemazi ngaphambili, beza, batya kunye naye emzini wakhe. Bavelana naye, bamkhuza bemthuthuzela ngenxa yesithwakumbe awayebethwe ngaso nguNdikhoyo. Bonke ngabanye ngabanye bamnika imali nomsesane wegolide.

Ke kaloku uNdikhoyo walithamsanqela ikamva likaYobi nangaphezu kokuba wayenzile kubomi bakhe bangaphambili. UYobi waba neshumi elinesine lamawaka eegusha, isithandathu samawaka eenkamela, amawaka amabini eenkabi zeenkomo newaka leedonki.
Waphiwa isixhenxe soonyana neentombi zantathu.
Eyokuqala yayinguJimayima, kweza uKeziya, eyesithathu ke yanguKeren-hapuka.
Kulo lonke ihlabathi akukho ntombi yayifika kwezo ntombi zikaYobi ngobunzwakazi. Nazo ke uyise wazinika ilifa kwanjengabantakwazo.
Emva koku ke uYobi wahlala iminyaka elikhulu elinamashumi amane. Ewe, wada wabona abazukulwana nabantwana babo kwada kwaya kuthi xhaxhe ngesesine isizukulwana.
Ke kaloku uYobi wafa seleyingwevu, iminyaka selihambile.
Hayi inyhweba yomntu ongahambiyo ngecebo labantw' abagwenxa, ongahambiyo ekhondweni lamatshijolo, umnt' ongadlelaniyo nabaphoxisayo.
Lowo wonwatyiswa yimiyalelo *kaNdikhoyo, ayetyise emini nasebusuku.
Unjengomth' otyalwe ngasemijelweni yamanzi, umth' ovelisa iziqhamo ngexesha leziqhamo, umth' omagqabi angasoz' abune. Ewe, konk' akwenzayo umnt' onjalo kuyaphumelela.
Àbanjalo kambe bona abantw' abagwenxa; bona banjengomquq' ophetshethwa ngumoya.
Ngenxa yoko aboni abanako ukujongana nenkundla, koko bona baya kugxothwa embizweni yamalungisa.
Kaloku uNdikhoyo uyalusile indlela yamalungisa; ke indlela yabakhohlakeleyo iya kudaka.
Ngani na izizwe zisenza imbudumbudu nje? Ngani na abantu besenza amayelenqe azé nje?
Ookumkani bemi bume, neziphathamandla zenza amabhunga okuvukela *uNdikhoyo nomthanjiswa wakhe, besithi:
“Masiziqhawule ezo mbophelelo zabo, sikhululeke kuloo makhamandela abo.”
Lowo ungqendeve esihlalweni sakhe ezulwini uyabahleka; uNdikhoyo usuka abagxwale.
Uya kusuka akhalimele ngomsindo, abankwantyise ngengqumbo yakhe, athi:
“Ndim lo umisele lo kumkani wam phezu kweZiyon, intaba yam ncakasana.”
Ewe, ndivakalisa isibhengezo sikaNdikhoyo esithi: “Ungunyana wam wena; ndikuzele namhlanje.
Cela kum, ndikunike iintlanga zibe lilifa lakho, namaphethelo ehlabathi abe ngawakho.
Wòzilawula ngegqudu lentsimbi, ùzintlekeze zibe ziingceba oku kwezitya zomdongwe.”
Ngoko ke, nina bokumkani, lumkani, nina ziphathamandla zelizwe, yalekani.
Mkhonzeni ngembeko uNdikhoyo, nivuye ninokuzoyikela.
Khahlelani kuye unyana ngentobeko, hleze aniqumbele nitshabalale endleleni; kaloku umsindo wakhe uyakhawuleza. Hayi uyolo lwabo bonke abazimela ngoNdikhoyo!
*Ndikhoyo, hay' ukuba ninzi kwazo iintshaba zam! Ewe, zindivukela zinguMbo nomXesibe.
Zide zithi xa zithetha ngam: “Naloo Thixo wakhe akamhlanguli konke!”
Kambe ke, wena Ndikhoyo, ulikhaka lam. Usisidima sam; undenza ndibe neqhayiya.
Ndiyakhala, ndibhenele kuNdikhoyo, andiphendule esentabeni yakhe eyodwa.
Ndiyaphumla, ndilale ubuthongo, ndibuye ndivuke, kuba uNdikhoyo uyandixhasa.
Andiwoyiki amawaka-waka eentshaba, naxa zindirhawule nje, zindingqonge macal' onke.
Khawuphakame ume, Ndikhoyo! Ndisindise, Thixo wam! Kaloku nguwe ozoyisayo zonk' iintshaba zam; ewe, nguwe ozaphul' iimpondo iintshaba zam.
Ukuhlangulwa kuvela kuwe, Ndikhoyo; khawubathamsanqele ke abantu bakho!
Ndiphendule ndakukhala kuwe, Thixo, mlondolozi wamalungelo am! Wandikhulula embandezelweni yam; yiba nenceba ke ngoko, uwuve umthandazo wam.
Bantundini, koda kube nini na nindihlazisa? koda kube nini nithand' ilize, niphuthaphuth' ubuxoki?
Yazini ke ukuba *uNdikhoyo uyabathand' abantu bakhe; uyandiva xa ndizibika kuye.
Xa niqumbileyo, ze ningoni; loo nto yetyiseni nithe cwaka kwiimandlalo zenu.
Menzeleni amadini alungileyo, nikholose ngaye uNdikhoyo.
Baninzi abalangazelela okulungileyo. Ndikhoyo, sikhangele ngobubele,
usiphe ukuchulumacha okudlula okwâbo bakufumana ngomdliva wengqolowa newayini.
Ndiya kuphumla ngenzolo, ndilale; nguwe kuphela kaloku, Ndikhoyo, ondinqabisayo.
Khawuwabekel' iindlebe amazwi am, *Ndikhoyo, usigqale isingqala sam.
Kuve ukukhala kwam, kumkani wam, Thixo wam, xa ndithandazayo kuwe.
Uyawuva umthandazo wam, Ndikhoyo, kwakusasa: kwakusasa ndizibika kuwe, ndilinde impendulo.
Kaloku unguThixo ongadlelaniyo nobugwenxa; akukunyamezeli ukungcola phambi kwakho.
Akubanyamezeli abantw' abazingcayo; ubuthiye bonk' ubugqwirha.
Uyawatshabalalisa amaxoki; ewe, Ndikhoyo, abaxhaphi-gazi nabakhohlisi banezothe kuwe.
Ke mna ndiya kungena endlwini yakho, ngenxa yobubele bakho obuncamisileyo, ndikunqule endlwini yakho ekhethiweyo, ndikunqule ngembeko ndingcangcazela.
Ndikhokelel' ekwenzeni intando yakho, Ndikhoyo. Kaloku baninzi abandichasayo; yenze icace phambi kwam indlela yakho.
Azinanyani iintshaba zam, iintliziyo zazo zizel' inkohlakalo; Zizungula ukutshabalalisa ngentetho elalanisayo.
Zohlwaye, Thixo; zirhintyele kwangamacebo azo; zigxothe ngenxa yezono zazo, kuba ziphikisana nawe.
Bayavuya bonke abo bathembela ngawe; bohlala bechulumacha luvuyo. Kaloku uyabakhusela abo bakuthandayo; abo ke banemihlali ngenene.
Ndikhoyo, uyabathamsanqela abakuthobelayo, ubafukamele ngobubele ngathi bagqunywe ngekhaka.
Uze ungandikhalimeli unomsindo, *Ndikhoyo; ungandohlwayi uqumbile.
Yiba nenceba kum, Ndikhoyo, kuba ndityhafile; ndomeleze, Mhlekazi, ndiphelelwe.
Ndihleli ndinexhala elibi; koda kube nini kodwa kunje, Ndikhoyo?
Yiza, Ndikhoyo, undihlangule; ndikhulule ngenxa yothando lwakho olungajikiyo.
Kaloku akusekho kukukhumbula kwabafileyo; akukho bani unokukudumisa engcwabeni.
Sendide ndatyhafa sisingqala; ubusuku ngobusuku ndiyantywizisa; umqamelo umanzi tixi ziinyembezi.
Atyhumfutyhumfu amehlo am kukulila; sekude kwanzima nokujonga. Ndinje nje nje kungenxa yeentshaba zam.
Sukani kum, nonke nina mathol' esihulu-hulu! Kaloku uNdikhoyo usivile isingqala sam.
Ukuvile ukubongoza kwam, wawuphulaphula umthandazo wam.
Ziya kudana, zidideke zonk' iintshaba zam; ziya kujika ngephanyazo, ziphoxekile.
Thixo wam, Ndikhoyo, ndithembele ngawe! Ndihlangule, undisindise kubo bonk' abandileqayo,
hleze bandiqwenga-qwenge njengengonyama, bandiqangqulule ndibe zizijungqe ndingenamhlanguli.
Thixo wam, Ndikhoyo, ukuba kukho nto ndiyenzileyo kwezi zinto: ukuba kukho bani ndimonileyo,
nokuba ndingcatshe umhlobo wam, okanye ndifumane ndalwenzakalisa utshaba lwam,
malundileqe ke lundifumane utshaba, lundinqumle, ndife kube kanye, lundishiye apho ndilutywantsi.
Khalima ngomsindo, Ndikhoyo; undithethelele kule ngqumbo yeentshaba zam. Thixo wam, vuka undincede; kaloku wena ufuna kugwetywe ngobulungisa.
Mazibizwe zonke izizwe zikungqonge, ungqendeve esihlalweni sakho phezu kwazo.
NguNdikhoyo umgwebi wabo bonk' abantu. Ligwebe ityala lam ke, Ndikhoyo, bucace ubulungisa bam, kucace ukuba ndimsulwa.
Phelisa inkohlakalo yabantw' abagwenxa, uwazimase amalungisa, wena Thixo othand' ukulunga, ogocagoca iintliziyo neengcinga zabantu.
Likhaka lam uThixo, uyabakhusela abantw' abathand' ukulunga.
UThixo ngumgwebi olilungisa; unguThixo ocatshukisw' imihla nezolo.
Ukuba abazohlwayi abantu wolirhola ikrele lakhe elibukhali uThixo. Selesityedile isaphetha sakhe, wema kuhle;
uzikhuphile esingxotyeni sazo izikhali, wajolisa ngeentolo ezinomlilo.
Khangela, umnt' ogwenxa ukhawula ukungcola, amith' ubumenemene, azal' ubuxoki.
Umba umhadi onzulu, ajike eyele kwakuloo mgibe awenzileyo;
urhintyelwa kwabubumenemene bakhe, isikhuni sibuye nomkhwezeli.
Ndiyambulela uNdikhoyo ngenxa yobulungisa bakhe. Ndisaya kumbonga uNdikhoyo uPhezukonke.
*Ndikhoyo, Nkosi yethu, hayi ukubaluleka kwegama lakho ehlabathini! Wena uqaqambisa amazulu ngesithozela sakho,
nditsho abantwana kwaneentsana ziyakubonga, nto leyo ibamisela umqobo abachasi wokuvalela utshaba kwanomphindezeli.
Xa ndiqwalasela amazulu owenzileyo, inyanga, neenkwenkwezi ezidalwe nguwe,
ngubani yena umntu, le nto umkhumbulelayo, engubani yena unyana womntu, le nto umkhathalelayo?
Ngaphezu koko umenze wanganeno kancinane nje kuwe, Thixo; umthe jize ngesihomo nesithozela.
Umnike igunya kuyo yonke indalo yakho, wazibeka phantsi kwegunya lakhe zonk' izinto:
iinkomo neegusha, kwanazo neenyamakazi;
iintaka eziphaphazelayo, neentlanzi, nayo yonke into ephithizela elwandle.
Hayi ukubaluleka kwalo igama lakho ehlabathini liphela, Ndikhoyo, Nkosi yethu!
Mandikubonge ngomxhelo wam wonke, *Ndikhoyo, ndibalise ngayo yonke imimangaliso oyenzileyo.
Ndomemelela ngemincili, ndikuvumel' ingoma, ndibonge wena, Phezukonke.
Zithe xa zihlehlayo iintshaba zam, zawa zatshabalala, wakuvela wena, Ndikhoyo.
Kaloku undigwebele ityala lam; ungqendeve esihlalweni sakho, wena mgwebi olungileyo.
Uzikhalimele iintlanga, wabatshabalalisa abantw' abagwenxa, waliphanzisa kwaphela igama labo.
Iintshaba zethu zibhangile mpela, uzidilize didli izixeko zazo; sele zacimayo nasezingqondweni.
Kodwa uNdikhoyo uya kuhlal' elawula kude kube nini-nini; selengqendeve enkundleni yakhe, elungele ukugweba.
Ulilawula ngobulungisa elimiweyo; azigwebe kakuhle zonke iintlanga.
NguNdikhoyo inqaba yokuzimela abacinezelwayo; nguye ikhusi ngamaxesha eembandezelo.
Bathembele ngawe, Ndikhoyo, bonke abakwaziyo; kaloku akuzange ubafulathele abo bakufunayo.
Mbongeni uNdikhoyo ongqendeve ebhotwe eZiyon; zibhengezeni eluntwini izinto asenzele zona.
Uyaliphindezela igazi labacinezelweyo; akasilibali isikhalo sabo baselusizini.
Ndenzele inceba, Ndikhoyo; bona indlela abandiphethe ngayo abo bandithiyileyo, wena ondihlangula ethunzini lokufa.
Mandiluxele udumo lwakho phakathi kwabantu bakho eJerusalem. Ewe, ndinemincili ngenxa yokuba undihlangule.
Iintlanga zeyele kumhadi ebeziwembile, zabhajiswa sisabatha ebezisithiyile.
Uzibonakalisile uNdikhoyo, wasiwisa isigwebo; izikhohlakali zarhintyelwa kwayimisebenzi yazo.
Ziya kwelabafileyo izikhohlakali, neentlanga zonke ezimfulathelayo uThixo.
Kaloku akayi kusoloko elityalwa amahlwempu; ithemba labahlelelekileyo aliyi kusoloko lifuthaniselwe.
Lamla, Ndikhoyo; malungaphakami uluntu; mazize phambi kwakho uzigwebe iintlanga.
Zenze zikoyike, Ndikhoyo, ziqonde ukuba zingabantu nje kuphela.
Yini na, *Ndikhoyo? Wachasela? Kutheni? Wazifihla ngexesha longxunguphalo?
Abantw' abagwenxa banolunya; bayabaleqa ababuthathaka. Mabarhintyelwe kwangaloo mayelenqe abo.
Bayazidla ngaloo magugwana abo, bazicengezele konempumelelo, bamdele uNdikhoyo.
Libathe lwale ikratshi abantw' abagwenxa; bade bazikhohlise ngokuthi: “Akukho Thixo ngandawo!”
Zinempumelelo zonk' iinzame zabo, kodwa imiyalelo yakho ikude lee kubo. Bayazeya zonke iintshaba zabo.
Baziqhayisa ngokuthi abasoze boyiswe nto bona, abasoze balibone ishwangusha.
Umlomo wabo mbi, uzel' izishwabulo, ubuxoki, nezisongelo; basoloko beceba ububi nobutshinga.
Bahamba bencathama ngezindlu ezixekweni, bezungul' ukugwint' abantw' abangenatyala, balalel' abantw' abangenakuzikhusela.
Bazimel' engontsini, baxel' ingonyama, ilalel' ixhoba elingumnt' oludwayi; xhakamfu bambambise ngomgibe wabo!
Nal' olo sizana lungen' esigwini lusoyisakala.
Bathi xa bezikhohlisa: “UThixo akakhathali; akahoyanga nto; akasoz' aqonde.”
Lamla, Ndikhoyo; caca ukuba unguThixo! Sukubalibal' abantw' abahlelelekileyo!
Kungani bekudela nje abantw' abagwenxa? Kutheni le nto bade bathi: “Akukho nt' aya kuyenza loo Thixo”?
Ewe, wena uzijongile wazibona iintlupheko neentsizi, khon' ukuze ulungele ukusisiza. Ewe, zibalekela kuwe nazo iindwayi, wena ongumncedi weenkedama.
Zaphul' iimpondo ke izikrelemnqa nabantw' abagwenxa; bohlwaye ide iphele nya inkohlakalo yabo.
Ngukumkani uNdikhoyo kuya kude kube nini-nini. Zobhanga ziphele nya emhlabeni iintshaba zakhe.
Ndikhoyo, uyaziva izicelo zabantw' abathobekileyo; uyabavuselela, uziphendule izicelo zabo.
Iinkedama nabacinezelweyo uyabaqwebela, khon' ukuze oonyana babantu bangagrogrisi mntu ehlabathini.
Ndithembele *ngoNdikhoyo nje, ningathini ukuthi: “Balekela ezintabeni zenu njengentaka!
Kaloku abantw' abagwenxa sebejolisile ngesaphetha esinotolo, bajolisel' ukulidubul' emnyameni ilungisa.
Xa sekudilike neziseko nje, lingenzani ke lona ilungisa?”
UNdikhoyo ukwibhotwe lakhe elilodwa, uhlel' esihlalweni sakhe ezulwini. Uyabagqala oonyana babantu, uyazibona izintw' abazenzayo,
uyabavavany' abalungileyo nabagwenxa, abathiye ngentiyokazi enkulu abaphalazi-gazi.
Uya kubabetha ngesichotho sesalfa namalahl' avuthayo abantw' abagwenxa; iziphango nezaqhwithi ziba sisabelo sabo.
Kaloku ulilungisa uNdikhoyo; uyazithanda izenzo ezilungileyo. Abo balungisayo bobonana naye ubuso ngobuso.
Nceda, *Ndikhoyo! Akukho namnye umnt' olungileyo; baphelile abantw' abathembekileyo.
Bathetha ubuxok' abantu, bekhohlisana. Bav' amantyontyelo baxokisane ngeentethw' ezimbaxa.
Wobaqhawul' imilebe uNdikhoyo abantw' abakhohlisayo; wobashunqul' iilwimi abantw' abazigwagwisayo.
Nditsho nkqu abo bathi: “Sophumelela ngolwimi lwethu. Iyeyethu nje imilebe le, ngubani owosixelela emasikuthethe?”
“Ndiza kulamla ke ngoku,” utsho uNdikhoyo, “ngenxa yokuba amahlwempu ayacinezelwa, neentsizana ziyancwina. Ndobanika oko kuphumla bakulangazelelayo.”
Zithembekile izithembiso zikaNdikhoyo, azinasibhidi, zinjengesiliva enyityilikiswe eziko kasixhenxe. Uzigcinile izithembiso zakho, Ndikhoyo; sigcine sikhuselekile kubantw' abagwenxa.
Basingqonge macal' onke abantw' abagwenxa, lo gama wonke ubani ekuvuyela ukungcola.
Koda kube nini na, *Ndikhoyo, undilibele kwaphela? Koda kube nini na ndingakuboni?
Koda kube nini na ndinomva-ndedwa, ndinesingqala, ibuhlung' imini yonke intliziyo yam? Koda kube nini zindivuyelel' iintshaba zam?
Bek' iindlebe, Ndikhoyo, undive, Thixo wam. Ndihlaziye, hleze ndilal' ubuthongo bokufa,
hleze luthi lundoyisil' utshaba lwam, bachwayit' ababandezeli, kuba ndoyisiwe.
Kodwa ndithembe uthando lwakho olungajikiyo; ndochulumacha kuba uyandihlangula.
Ndombonga uNdikhoyo, kuba endiphethe ngobubele.
Iziyatha zithi akukho Thixo ngandawo. Zonakele, futhi zenza amasikizi; akukho ulungisayo kuzo.
Ke yena *uNdikhoyo ubabukele abantu; uhlel' ezulwini efuna ukuqonda ukuba ngaba sikho na isilumko, nditsho ofuna ukunqula uThixo.
Kambe ke bonke bemkile, xa bebonke bonakele; kuba akakho olungisayo, nditsho nokuba abe mnye.
Abanangqondo na abakhohlakeleyo; abo baxhaphaza amawethu, ngathi batya isonka, bangamnquliyo nokumnqula uNdikhoyo?
Baya kunkwantya benkwantyile, kuba uThixo ukunye nâbo bamthobeleyo.
Nangona aminxwayo amacebo osizana, nguNdikhoyo olixhadi lalo.
Akwaba ingavela eZiyon inkululeko yamaSirayeli, akuba uNdikhoyo eyibuyisile inkqubela yabantu bakhe. AbakwaYakobi baya kugcoba; ewe, ochulumacha amaSirayeli.
*Ndikhoyo, ngubani oya kuba lundwendwe lwakho; ingubani oya kutyelela kwakho?
Ngulowo uhambo ingenabala, owenza ubulungisa, ayithethe inyaniso engafihlisi.
Ngulowo unganyelisiyo, ungamenziyo into embi uwabo, ungamhlebiyo ummelwana wakhe.
Ngobadelayo abo babukulwe nguThixo, abancome abo bamoyikayo uNdikhoyo, ofunga angajiki noba kunyembelekile.
Ngongabolekisi ngemali yakhe, ngenxa yokuba efuna inzala; ngongekhe anyotywe ngokuthengisa umnt' ongenatyala. Lowo ke wenjenjalo ngumnt' ozinzileyo.
Ndikhusele kaloku, Thixo; ndithembele ngawe.
Ewe, ndiyazibika, *Ndikhoyo; nguwe iNkosi yam; ngaphandle kwakho, Mhlekazi, andinabani.
Kuba mna ulonwabo lwam luphakathi kwemilowo yakwaThixo; nditsho leyo itshatsheleyo kweli hlabathi.
Bazandisel' iintsizi abo bazinyulela *thixo wumbi. Andiyi kuba nanxaxheba kumadini abo; andiyi kubanqula ngomlomo wam oothixo babo.
Nguwe kuphela, Ndikhoyo, inxaxheba endiyabelweyo; lisentendeni yesandla sakhw' ibango lam.
Isabelo sam sisendaweni entle; hayi ukuba lihle kwalo ilifa lam!
Mbongeni uNdikhoyo ngokuba endiphe icebo; nesazela sam siyandiluleka ebusuku.
Ndihlala ndimbeke phambi kwam uNdikhoyo; ungasekunene kwam, ngoko ke andiyi kushukunyiswa nto.
Yiyo ke loo nto ndihleli ndichwayitile nje; ngenene ndiziva ndikhuselekile.
Kaloku akuyi kundishiya enyanyeni ndide ndife; akuyi kusiyeka sibole isicaka sakho esithembekileyo.
Wena undazisa iindlela zobomi; kaloku ndizala yimincili xa ndiphambi kwakho. Ngasekunene kwakho yimihlali yodwa kude kube ngunaphakade.
Kuphulaphule ukunyaniseka kwam, *Ndikhoyo; kubazel' iindlebe ukutarhuzisa kwam. Yiva, nas' isicelo sam. Kaloku mna andinankohliso.
Malicace kuwe ibango lam; amehlo akho makakhangele ngokungenaxanasi.
Uyicikidile intliziyo yam, wandivelela ebusuku; undivavanyile, akwafumana bugwenxa kum. Kaloku ndizimisele ukungoni, nditsho nangokuthetha oku.
Andixelisang' abany' abantu ngokuphikisana nomyalelo wakho; ndizikhwebule kwiindlela zamathanda-gazi.
Ndithe ngcembe, ndihamba ngendlela yakho; andaphambuka konke kuyo.
Ndizibika kuwe, Thixo; kaloku uyandiva; zibaze iindlebe, uwuve umthandazo wam.
Bonakalisa uthando lwakh' olungagugiyo, wena msindisi wâbo bathembela ngawe, ubakhusele ezintshabeni zabo.
Ndilondoloze ngokokhozo lweliso lakho, undisithelise ngethunzi lamaphiko akho
kubantw' abagwenxa abandihlaselayo, kwezo ntshaba zindingqongileyo, zifuth' inkohlakalo.
Azinalo novelwano; zithe lwale likratshi.
Ziyandizungula, zifun' ukundirhangqa; zindithe ntsho ngamehlo, zijong' ukundiqethula.
Zifun' ukundithi qwenge-qwenge zixel' ingonyama; zindilalele zincatham' engontsini njengerhamncwa.
Lamla, Ndikhoyo; zikhalimele iintshaba, uzichithe! Ndihlangule ngekrele lakho kubantw' abagwenxa.
Ndihlangule, Ndikhoyo, koohlohlesakhe abazisu zimbaxa, betsho ngenyambalala yoonyana. Bathi zubelele bafe, babushiyel' oonyana obo butyebi.
Mna ndobonana nawe ngenxa yobulungisa bam; ndokwaneliswa kukubona wena xa ndivukayo.
Ndiyakuthanda, Ndikhoyo, mandla am.
NguNdikhoyo iliwa lam; nguye inqaba yam; nguye umkhuseli wam. Xa ndizimele ngoThixo wam ndihlala ndikhuselekile. Nguye ikhaka lam, nguye ondigcina ndifihlakele.
Ndithi ndakukhala kuNdikhoyo, asuke andithi hlasi kwiintshaba zam. Ngenene, makabongwe uNdikhoyo!
Bendirhintyelwe ziintambo zokufa, amaza arhaxayo endigubungele.
Ukufa bekundirhangqile, ingcwaba selivuleke lithe ng'aa.
Ndazibika kuNdikhoyo ndikuloo ngxingongo, ndalucela uncedo kuThixo wam. Wandiva engqendeve ebhotwe lakhe, savakala kuye isikhalo sam.
Suka wagungqa wanyikima umhlaba, nditsho neziseko zeentaba zashukuma, kuba uThixo wayenomsindo.
Kwathi phoko umsi emathatheni akhe, walephuza amadangatye ngomlomo, kuliqika amalahle avuthayo.
Wasikrazula isibhakabhaka, wehla, ethe zukuva phezu kwelifu elimnyama.
Wandanda ngenqwelo *yezithunyw' ezimaphiko itshebeleza ngesantya emoyeni.
Wayethiwe gqume sisithokothoko, kumnyama thsu; engqingwe ziingqimba zamafu anemvula.
Kwaw' isichotho namalahl' avuthayo, ziphuma kumban' ongaphambi kwakhe, zagqobhoza kuloo ntshinyela yamafu.
Wazongoma esibhakabhakeni uNdikhoyo, lavakal' ilizwi loPhezukonke, satsho isichotho nemibane.
Wadubula ngeentolo zakhe, zee qhu saa iintshaba, eziswantsulisa ngokugqekreza kwemibane.
Ewe, watsho zoma qoko iilwandle, kwatsho kwavela neziseko zelizwe, wakukhalima, wena Ndikhoyo, ugragramela iintshaba unomsindo.
Wehla, wandithi hlasi uNdikhoyo, wandihlangula kumanzi enzonzobila.
Wandihlangula kwiintshaba zam nakwabo bandichasayo, bendivuyelela.
Bandihlasela ndisengxingweni, wandikhusela yena uNdikhoyo.
Wandihlangula ndisengozini, wandisindisa kuba ekholisekile ndim.
Wandivuza uNdikhoyo, kuba ndandilungisa; wandithamsanqela, kuba ndimsulwa.
Umthetho kaNdikhoyo ndiyawuthobela; andimfulathelanga uThixo wam.
Yonke imiyalelo yakhe ndiyigcinile; andiyaphulanga imithetho yakhe.
Uyandazi ukuba andonanga; ndiyazilumla ekwenzeni ububi.
Ngoko ke uyandivuza, kuba ndisenza okulungileyo; uyandivuza, kuba akukho sikhwa kum.
Uthembekile, Ndikhoyo, kwabo bathembekileyo; ubenzela ububele abo bandlela zithe tse.
Umsulwa kwabo bamsulwa; uchasene nabo bangamatshijolo.
Ungumsindisi wabathobekileyo; uyabathoba abo banekratshi.
Usisibane sokundikhanyisela, wena Ndikhoyo; undigxothela ubumnyama, wena Thixo.
Ewe, ngawe ndingawuchitha-chitha nomkhosi, ngamandla akho ndilutsibe nongqameko lwawo.
Hayi bo, zigqibelele izinto azenzayo lo Thixo! Hayi ukuthembeka kwelizwi lakhe! Uyabakhusela bonke abo bathembela ngaye.
NguNdikhoyo yedwa uThixo; nguye kuphela osikhuselayo.
Ewe, nguThixo ondinika amandla; nguye oyenza iphumelele indlela yam.
Undicondobisa kuhle njengenxala, ndichankcathe emaweni ndingatyibiliki.
Undiqhelisa ukulwa edabini, andifundise ukugoba isaphetha esomeleleyo.
Ndikhoyo, undinike ikhaka lokuhlanganisa, wandixhasa ngesandla sakho esinamandla; undibonelele ndatsho ndazimaseka.
Undimise endaweni ephangaleleyo; azinakutyibilika kuyo iinyawo zam.
Ndizisukela ndizifumane iintshaba zam; andijiki ndide ndizitshabalalise.
Ndizithi ntshinte-ntshinte zingavuki tu, ziqungquluze apho phambi kwam.
Undinika amandla edabini, undoyisele iintshaba zam.
Ziyandoyika iintshaba zam; abandithiyileyo ndibatshabalalisile.
Ziba ngafuna uncedo, zingancedwa bani; ziba ngazibika kuNdikhoyo, angaphenduli.
Mna ndizicumza zibe njengothuli luphetshethwa ngumoya, ndizinyhashe okodaka endleleni.
Wandihlangula kubavukeli, walimisa igunya lam ezizweni, ndada ndaphatha nabo bendingabazi.
Bayandithobela bakuwuva umthetho wam; ndikhahlelwe nangabasemzini abantu,
bephuma kwiinqaba zabo begubha, bephelelwe sisibindi xa bebonke.
Huntshu! Khul' ud' ukhokhobe, Ndikhoyo! Mawubongwe, wena mkhuseli wam, Thixo ongumhlanguli wam!
Wena undoyisela iintshaba zam; wena ugoba iintlanga zitsho zindikhahlele;
wena undihlangula kwabandichasayo! Ewe, undoyisele iintshaba zam, wandikhusela kubaphalazi-gazi.
Ngoko ke ndiya kukubonga phakathi kwezizwe, ndityibele ndivuma umbongo wakho, Ndikhoyo.
NguThixo omnika uloyiso ukumkani, omenzele izibele umthanjiswa wakhe, uDavide nayo yonke inzala yakhe kude kuse ephakadeni.
Amazulu abalisa ngobungangamsha bukaThixo, nesibhakabhaka sixela umsebenzi wezandla zakhe.
Imini ixelela imin' elandelayo, nobusuku bubikela ubusuk' obulandelayo.
Akukho ntetho namazwi nasandi sivakalayo;
kodwa kukho intlokoma kulo lonk' elimiweyo, nebali lazo liwugqibe wonk' umhlaba. UThixo ulakhele esibhakabhakeni ilanga.
Liphuma linyalasa njengomyen' ephum' entangeni, nanjengembalek' engxamel' ukubalek' elugqatsweni.
Liphum' emaphethelwen' esibhakabhaka, liye kutshw' emaphethelweni kwelinye icala; akukho nto inokusinda kwingqatsini yalo.
Ugqibelele won' umyalelo *kaNdikhoyo: uhlaziya amandla. Uthembekile wona, kub' unik' isiyatha ubulumko.
Imimiselo kaNdikhoyo ilungile: ivuyis' intliziyo. Imithetho kaNdikhoyo inyulu: ikhanyisel' amehl' indlela.
Kulungil' ukunqul' uNdikhoyo; koba njalo nanini-nini. Ziyinyanis' izigqibo zakhe, yaye zilunge kwaphela.
Zinqweneleka ngaphezu kwegolide, nditheth' igolid' engcwengileyo; zimnandi ngaphezu kobusi, ewe, ndixel' ikhephelele lenqatha lobusi.
Ngaphezu koko ziyasilulek' isicaka sakho, yaye ngumvuz' omkhulu ukukuthobela.
Kambe ke ngubani oziqiqayo iziphoso zakhe? Ndikhulul' ezonweni endingaziqondiyo.
Ndikhusel' ezonwen' ezibangwa likratshi, hleze zindongamele. Ndiyakwandul' ukuba msulwa ndakuba ndikhululekil' ezonweni ezoyikekayo.
Ngamana angamkeleka kuwe, Ndikhoyo, amazwi am neengcamango zentliziyo yam, wena mkhuseli wam nomkhululi wam.
Wanga *uNdikhoyo angakuphulaphula ngemini yeembandezelo! Wanga angakukhusela uThixo kaYakobi!
Wanga angakuthumela uncedo luvel' ebhotwe lakhe, akuxhase esentabeni yeZiyon.
Wanga angayamkela iminikelo yakho uThixo, akholiseke ngamadini omenzela wona.
Wanga angakunika umnqweno wentliziyo yakho, aziphumelelise zonk' iinquleqhu zakho.
Sokwandul' ukuba nemincili ngoloyiso lwakho, siphakamis' izindwe, simbong' uThixo. Wang' uNdikhoyo angaziva izicelo zakho!
Kaloku ndiyaz' ukuba uNdikhoyo uyamnceda umthanjiswa wakhe, uyamva ekwibhotwe lakhe elilodwa ezulwini, umnik' uloyiso ngamandla akhe.
Baqhayisa ngeenqwelo zokulwa abanye, abanye ngamahashe; thina siqhayisa ngoNdikhoyo uThixo wethu.
Bona babhukuqwa bawe; thina sisuka sime ngxishi.
Ndikhoyo, mnike amandla oloyiso ukumkani; sive naxa sizibika kuwe!
Uyavuya ukumkani ngenxa yamandla akho, *Ndikhoyo, uyachulumacha kuba umnike uloyiso.
Umnikile umnqweno wentliziyo yakhe; usivile isicelo sakhe.
Umhlangabeze ngeentsikelelo ezingathethekiyo, wamthi jize ngesithsaba segolid' entloko.
Wacela ubomi kuwe; wampha ubom' obude obuhlala buhleli.
Ufumene imbeko enkulu ngenxa yoncedo lwakho; umnike udumo nobungangamela.
Ewe, umnike uyolo olungapheliyo; kwanobukho bakho buyamchwayitisa.
Kaloku ukumkani uthembele ngoPhezukonke, yaye ngenxa yenceba kaNdikhoyo uya kuhlal' engukumkani.
Zonk' iintshaba zakho uya kuzibhaqa; uya kubafumana bonk' abakuthiyileyo.
Úya kubatshisa ngesihogo somlil' akufika; uNdikhoyo wobatshabalalisa ngomsindo, abaqwele ngomlilo.
Uya kuyiphelisa inzala yabo ehlabathini, bangabikho abantwana babo phakathi kwabantu.
Nokuba bayila ububi ngawe, nokuba benza iyelenqe, abanakuphumelela.
Kaloku úya kubadubula ebusweni ngeentolo zakhe, abachithe babe ziintsalu.
Mawubongwe, Ndikhoyo, ngenxa yobugorha bakho; thina sokubonga sikudumise ngenxa yamandla akho.
Thixo wam, Thixo wam, undishiyeleni na? Kudala ndizigixa, ndicel' uncedo, kodwa andikalufumani unangoku!
Thixo wam, emini ndikhalela kuwe, kodwa akundiva. Nasebusuku ndiyakhala, ndingafumani kuphumla phezu koko.
Kambe wena ungqendeve phakathi kwabakudumisayo; nditsho wena ngangamela yakwaSirayeli.
Babekholose ngawe ookhokho bethu; babekuthembile, wabahlangula wena.
Bakhala kuwe, wabakhulula wena; babethembele ngawe, akwabadanisa.
Ke mna andimntu, ndifana nqwa nombungu; ndiyintlekisa ebantwini, ndideliwe luluntu.
Bonk' abandibonayo bayandigxwala; bandinyevulele, bahlunguzelis' intloko besithi:
“Ubethembele *kuNdikhoyo, makamhlangule kaloku; makamkhulule ukuba uyamthanda.”
Kanti ke nguwe owawundikhusele kwasekuzalweni kwam, wandilondoloza ndisesemabeleni kama.
Ndahlulelwa wena kwasekuzalweni kwam; ubunguThixo wam wena ndingekazalwa.
Mus' ukuba kude kum. Kaloku sele isemnyango imbandezelo; ibe akukho namnye ongandincedayo.
Zindingqongile iintshaba zam, ngathi ziinkunz' ezomeleleyo zaseBhashan; zindivelele macal' onke.
Zikhamisile, zindivulel' imilomo; ziyandijamela zixel' ingonyam' egqumayo.
Ndiphelelwe; amandla aphalele njengamanzi, ahlukene onke amathambo am, intliziyo yam iyanyibilika ngathi ngumthwebeba.
Aphele mpel' amandla kum, ulwimi lwam lunamathel' ezinkalakahleni, undishiy' eluthulini njengofileyo.
Lindirhawul' igquba labantw' abagwenxa, ndangathi ndirhangqwe ligqiza lezinja; bandidlavul' izandla neenyawo,
ngoko ke amathambo am aphandle. Ke zona iintshaba zam zibukele.
Babelana ngeengubo zam; benzelan' amaqashiso ngesambatho sam.
Ke wena, Ndikhoyo, mus' ukuba kude nam; Mkhululi wam, khawuleza undincede!
Ndihlangule ekreleni, undisindise kwezi zinja.
Ndihlangule emlonyeni wengonyama; ndisindise kulo mngcipheko ndikuwo.
Ndowabalisela amawethu ngezint' ozenzileyo, ndikubonge ebandleni, ndithi:
“Mbongen' uNdikhoyo, nina bamhlonelayo; mdumiseni nonke, nina bonyana bakaYakobi; mhloneleni nonke, nina nzala kaSirayeli!
Kaloku akazideli engazicekisi iintsizi zehlwempu; uyaziva izicelo zalo, angalifulatheli.”
Ndiya kukubonga esidlangalaleni, ngenxa yezinto ondenzele zona; ndowafezekisa amadinga endawenzayo, phambi kwebandla lâbo bakuthobelayo.
Amahlwempu aya kutya ahluthe mpu; bombonga uNdikhoyo abo bamfunayo. Banga banganempumelelo engapheliyo.
Zonke izizwe zomkhumbula uNdikhoyo, zibuyele kuye ehlabathini liphela, ziqubude kuye zonke iintlanga.
Kaloku nguNdikhoyo ukumkani; nguye umlawuli weentlanga zonke.
Ewe, zonk' izinhanha ziya kudlelana, zimvume yena; nditsho yonk' intw' engumntu iya kumnqul' uNdikhoyo.
Izizukulwana ziya kumkhonza, ooyise babalisele abazukulwana ngoNdikhoyo.
Ewe, nâbo bangekazalwa boxelelwa ukuba uNdikhoyo wabasindisa abantu bakhe.
*InguNdikhoyo nje ondalusayo, ndingaswela ntoni na?
Nguye ondikhaphelela kumadlelo aluhlaza, andikhokelele kwimilambo empompozayo,
nditsho ndihlaziyeke emphefumlweni. Undithundezela kwezona ndlela zilungileyo, ukuze lidunyiswe igama lakhe.
Ngoko ke, nokuba ndihamba kwiingxondorha ezimnyama, andinadyudyu. Kaloku ungakum, wena Ndikhoyo; isagweba sakho nebhunguza lakho lixhadi lam.
Undamkela okondwendwe oluxabisekileyo, uqukeze ude undihlinzeke ngesidlo, iintshaba zam zibukele. Ngenene, iyaphuphuma indebe yam.
Ngoko ke ndiya kulandelwa kokulungileyo nabububele, umzi wakho ube likhaya lam yonke imihla yobomi bam.
*LelikaNdikhoyo ihlabathi liphela, nako konk' okukulo; ndixel' ilizwe elimiweyo kunye nabemi balo.
Walisekela phezu kweelwandle; walithi zinzi phezu kwayo imilambo.
Ngubani onganyukayo aye entabeni kaNdikhoyo; ingubani oya kuthi gcobho endlwini yakhe?
Ngulow' uzandla zimsulwa, untliziyo inyulu, lowo ungazinquliyo izintw' ezingento, low' ungafungiyo exoka.
Uya kumthamsanqela uNdikhoyo, kuye kube chosi, kube hele, kuba nguThixo umkhululi wakhe.
