Sinjalo ke isizukulwana sabo bamfunayo, abo bafuna ukubona uThixo kaYakobi.
Vulekani, masango; vulekani, minyango yakudala, angene uKumkani iNgangalala!
Ngubani loo Ngangalala yoKumkani? NguNdikhoyo igorha elinamandla onke; nguNdikhoyo onamandla onk' edabini!
Vulekani, masango; vulekani, minyango yakudala, angene uKumkani iNgangalala!
Ngubani loo Ngangalala yoKumkani? NguNdikhoyo onamandla onke; nguye uKumkani, nguye iNgangalala.
Ndiwuphakamisela kuwe, *Ndikhoyo, umphefumlo wam;
Thixo wam, ndithembele kuwe. Mandingakhe ndidane konke; mazingakhe zindivuyelele konk' iintshaba zam.
Ewe, mabangadani bonk' abathembele kuwe; mayibe ngâbo banxaxhayo amabadane.
Ndibonise indlela yakho, Ndikhoyo; ndifundise iindlela zakho.
Ndikhokelele enyanisweni yakho, undifundise. Kaloku nguwe, Thixo, umkhululi wam; ndihleli ndikulindele imini yonke.
Khumbula, Ndikhoyo, inceba yakho, nothando lwakho obukade unalo kwakudala.
Ungazikhumbuli izono zobutsha bam, nokungathobeli kwam umthetho wakho; kanye ndazelelele ngothando olungagungqiyo, ngenxa yobubele bakho, Ndikhoyo.
UNdikhoyo unobubele, ulungile. Yiyo loo nto abafundisayo indlela yakhe aboni.
Abathobekileyo ubakhokelela kokulungileyo, abafundise indlela yakhe abalulamileyo.
Zonk' iindlela zikaNdikhoyo zezothando nenyaniso kwabo bathobela umnqophiso nemithetho yakhe.
Ngenxa yegama lakho, Ndikhoyo, ndixolele ityala lam nakuba lilikhulu kangaka.
UNdikhoyo uya kumbonisa indlela umntu omoyikayo.
Uya kuhlala enenkqubela nabantwana bakhe ube lilifa labo umhlaba.
Ungumhlobo kwabo bamhlonelayo uNdikhoyo, uyabaqondisa umnqophiso wakhe.
Ndihleli ndilindele uncedo lukaNdikhoyo, kuba uyawusombulula umgib' ezinyaweni zam.
Buyela kum, Ndikhoyo, undenzele inceba; kaloku ndilikheswa, ndixhwalekile.
Ndikhulule kwintlungu endikuyo, undikhuphe ezimbandezelweni.
Qwalasela ubunzima nosizi endikulo, undixolele zonk' izono zam.
Zigqale ubuninzi bazo iintshaba zam, nendlela ebuhlungu ezindiphethe ngayo ngolunya.
Bukhusele ubomi bam, undihlangule; mandingadaniswa kaloku, kuba ndithembele ngawe.
Mandihlale ndingasoleki ndililungisa, kuba kaloku ithemba lam likuwe.
Bakhulule, Thixo, abantu bakho amaSirayeli kuzo zonke iimbandezelo zabo.
Ndigwebele, *Ndikhoyo; kaloku azisoleki iindlela zam, nethemba lam kuwe aligungqi.
Ndivavanye, undicikide, Ndikhoyo; yigocagoce intliziyo yam ngokunjalo neengcinga zam.
Ndisoloko ndikhokelwa zizibele zothando lwakho; ndihamba njalo nasenyanisweni yakho.
Andinanto yakwenza namamenemene, ndaye ndingenabudlelwana nabakhohlisi.
Ndiyithiyile imbutho yabantw' abagwenxa, ndaye ndingadlelani nabantw' abangcolileyo.
Ndazihlamba kubo ezam izandla, ndenjenjeya ukuy' esibingelelweni sakho, Ndikhoyo,
ndivuma ingoma yombongo, ndibalisa ngazo zonk' izenzo zakhw' ezingummangaliso.
Ndiyakuthanda ukuhlala endlwini yakho, Ndikhoyo, apho sikhoyo isidima nesithozela sakho.
Ungandikhukhulisi kunye naboni, ungandidibi nezigwinta,
abantw' abazandla zipheth' ukungcola, abasoloko begush' ukunyoba.
Ke mna ndohlala ndingasoleki; ndihlangule undenzel' inceba.
Iinyawo zam zithe zinzi emhlabeni; ndibonga uNdikhoyo ebandleni.
*InguNdikhoyo nje ondikhanyiselayo, inguye nje ondisindisayo, ndingoyika ntoni? InguNdikhoyo nje inqaba yam, ndingoyika bani?
Xa bendidlavula abantw' abakhohlakeleyo, iintshaba zam nabandileqayo, kokhubeka kwabona, bawe.
Nokuba ndingade ndingqongwe ngumkhosi, andiyi kuba naluvalo konke. Nokuba ndirhawulwe yimfazwe, ndiya kuthembela ngoNdikhoyo.
Ndinqwenela into enye kuphela kuNdikhoyo, ndaye ndifuna yona kanye: le yokuba ze ndihlale kwaNdikhoyo yonke imihla yobomi bam, ndiqwalasele ubuhle bakhe, ndimfune endlwini yakhe.
Kaloku wondikhusela enqabeni yakhe ngexesha lobubi, andifihle engontsini endlwini yakhe, ndithi ngcu phezulu eliweni.
Ngoko ke ndiya kuzikrobela iintshaba ezindingqongileyo, ndinikele uNdikhoyo idini endlwini yakhe, ndinemivuyo ndicula, ndivumela uNdikhoyo.
Ndive, Ndikhoyo, xa ndizibika kuwe; yiba nenceba kum, undiphulaphule.
Kweli wena uthi: “Funani ubuso bam,” intliziyo yam yathi: “Ewe, ndiyafuna ukukubona, Ndikhoyo.”
Mus' ukuzifihla kum, Ndikhoyo, ungasilahli ngomsindo isicaka sakho. Wena mncedi wam, mus' ukundilahla; uzungandishiyi, Thixo wam, Mkhululi wam.
Xa ndilahlwe ngubawo noma, wondichola yena uNdikhoyo.
Ndifundise indlela yakho, Ndikhoyo, undikhokele endleleni elungileyo, kuba zininzi iintshaba zam.
Uzungandiyekeli kwabandivukelayo, kuba andivukele amangqina obuxoki, afutha ukundenzakalisa.
Ngenene ndobuxhamla kambe ububele bukaNdikhoyo lo gama ndisadla amazimba.
Thembela kuNdikhoyo; yomelela, ube nesibindi! Ewe, thembela kuNdikhoyo wena!
Ndizibika kuwe, *Ndikhoyo, xhadi lam; musa ukuzenza isithulu, hleze ndifane nabeyel' emhadini xa uthe cwaka.
Live ilizwi lam xa ndizibika, xa izandla zam ndiziphakamisela kuwe ebhotwe.
Uzungandisingeli phantsi kunye nabantw' abagwenxa, abantw' abenza okungcolileyo, abathetha kamnandi nabamelwane, kanti bagush' ububi.
Babuyekeze ngokwemisebenzi yabo, ubohlwaye ngenxa yenkohlakalo yabo. Bavuze ngokwezintw' abazenzayo, bafumane loo nto ibafaneleyo.
Ngenxa yokuba bengayinanzi imisebenzi kaNdikhoyo, kwakunye nezintw' azenzileyo, yena wobabhubhisa baphele kuthi tu, bangaze babuye bavuke.
Makabongwe uNdikhoyo, kuba ukuvile ukutarhuzisa kwam.
NguNdikhoyo amandla am nekhaka lam; ndithembele ngaye ngomxhelo wam wonke. Ndoncedakala nditsho ndibe nemincili, ndimbonge ngengoma.
NguNdikhoyo obomelezayo abantu bakhe; nguye omkhuselayo nomsindisayo umthanjiswa wakhe.
Basindise abantu bakho, Ndikhoyo; lithamsanqelise ilifa lakho. Baluse, ubathwale ngoku kude kube nini-nini.
Mbongen' *uNdikhoyo, nina bemi baphezulu; mnikeni isihomo nesithozela namandla.
Lenzelen' imbeko igama lakhe, ninqule ningcangcazela phambi kwakhe.
Sivakal' emanzini elwandl' isandi selizwi lakhe; utsho kuzongome uThixo onesithozela. Kaloku nguNdikhoyo ogragramis' iilwandle.
Lindongondong' ilizwi lakhe, ngugquma-barhwaqele ngenkqu.
Liwis' imisedare ilizwi likaNdikhoyo; ndixel' imisedare yaseLibhanon.
Lidlobis' iLibhanon ixel' inkonyane; litsho iSiriyon ixel' ithole lenyathi.
Ndith' ilizwi likaNdikhoyo litshawuz' amadangatye;
ndith' ilizwi likaNdikhoyo linyakamis' intlango, ewe, nditsho intlango yaseKadeshe.
Litsho kungcangcazele amanxala; litsho kuvuthuluk' amahlathi. Batsho bathi bonk' abasendlwini yakhe: “Huntshuu!”
NguNdikhoyo olawula oozikhukula; kaloku nguye ukumkani, koda kube nini-nini.
Wanga angabaph' amandl' abantu bakhe; wanga angabathamsanqela abaph' inzolo.
Ndokudumisa, Ndikhoyo, kuba undisindisile, akwavuma ukuba zindivuyelel' iintshaba zam.
Ndikhoyo, Thixo wam, ndibhenela kuwe; kuba wena undihlangule ekufeni.
Wandikhupha kwelabafileyo wena, Ndikhoyo; wandikhetha kwabo behlela emhadini.
Mbongen' uNdikhoyo, nina milowo yakwakhe, nilibonge igama lakhe elingcwele.
Kaloku yeyomzuzwana ingqumbo yakhe; ukanti buhlala buhlel' ububele bakhe. Ewe, zibakho zon' iinzingo ebusuku, kodwa kusasa kuba yimincili yodwa.
Xa izinto zazindilungele, ndandidla ngokuthi: “Andisoze ndoyisakale.”
Ewe, ndandithe zinzi njengentaba ngenxa yobubele bakho, Ndikhoyo. Suka wena wasithela; ndaza mna ndakhathazeka.
Kodwa ndithembele kuwe, Ndikhoyo; ndiyazithoba kuwe, Nkosi yam.
Kukho nzuzoni na xa ndiye kwantshabalala? Lunganako na ukukudumisa uthuli? Khona lungabalisa na ngokunyaniseka kwakho?
Ndive, Ndikhoyo, undenzele inceba; Ndikhoyo, yiba ngumncedi wam.
Wabuguqula baluvuyo ubunzima bam; wandikhulul' ezokuzila, wandambathis' ezolonwabo.
Mandikubonge ndingayeki, Thixo wam; ewe, ndikubonge kude kube ngunaphakade, Ndikhoyo!
*Ndikhoyo, ndizifihla kuwe, mandingadani konke! Wena lungisa, uzundihlangule!
Ndibekele iindlebe, ukhawulez' undihlangule. Yiba yinqaba endizimela kuyo, nomkhuseli wam ondisindisayo.
Ewe, nguwe inqaba yam nekhusi lam; ndikhokele, undithundeze, lidunyiswe igama lakho.
Ndikhulule kwisabatha ebendigcayiselwe ngaso, kuba ungamandla am wena.
Ndiwunikela ezandleni zakho umoya wam; kaloku undihlangule wena, Ndikhoyo, Thixo othembekileyo.
Ndibathiyile abo banqula izintw' ezingento; mna ndikholosa ngawe, Ndikhoyo.
Ndovuya, ndigcobe ngenxa yezibele zothando lwakho, kuba uyibonile inkxwaleko yam, wakugqala nokungcungcutheka kwam.
Akundiyekelanga kwingcinezelo yeentshaba; koko usuke wandinika inkululeko.
Ndenzele inceba, Ndikhoyo, ndibandezelekile. Atsho adumba kukulila amehlo am, nam ndiphelile kukudinwa.
Ziyandaluphaza iinkxwaleko zam, nemihla yam iphelela ekungcungcuthekeni. Ndiphelelwe ngamandla ngenxa yeentlupheko, namathambo am selegugile.
Ndiyintlekisa kwiintshaba zam, isigculelo kubamelwane bam. Abandaziyo bayandoyika, bandibaleke, xa badibana nam esitalatweni.
Sele ndalityalwa mpela; ndinjengomfi ongasakhunjulwayo; sendalahlwa kwesinomhlwa.
Ewe, ndiyivile intlebendwane yabanye; kuthe saa luloyiko macal' onke, lo gama bandenzela amayelenqe, beceba ukundibulala.
Kodwa ithemba lam likuwe, Ndikhoyo; ewe, unguThixo wam wena.
Imihla yam isesandleni sakho; ndihlangule ezintshabeni zam nakwabanditshutshisayo.
Ndisisicaka sakho, Ndikhoyo, ndikhangele ngobubele; ndihlangule ezintshabeni zam ngenxa yezibele zakho.
Mandingadani konke, Ndikhoyo, xa ndizibika kuwe; mabadane abantw' abagwenxa, banyoshoze baye kufa.
Watsho athi cwaka amaxoki, wona anyelisa amalungisa ngeentetho zolunya nendelelo.
Hayi ubuhle bezinto ozigcinele abo bakuhlonelayo, Ndikhoyo; zintle kambe izinto ozenzela abo bakholose ngawe!
Uyabakhusela ngobukho bakho kumayelenqe abantu, ubagushe phantsi kwephiko lakho, bangagxijwa ziintshaba.
Makabongwe uNdikhoyo, kuba undenzele ububele obungummangaliso, xa ndandixiniwe, ndihlaselwa.
Ukothuka kwam ndathi ndilahlelwe kude nawe, kodwa wandiva ndakuzibika kuwe.
Mthandeni uNdikhoyo, nonke nina milowo yakwakhe, kuba uyabalondoloza abathembekileyo, abohlwaye abanekratshi.
Qinani nibe nesibindi, nonke nina nithembele ngoNdikhoyo.
Hay' uyolo lwabo baluxolelweyo ukreqo lwabo nguThixo, abo bazono zabo zingcwatyiweyo.
Ewe, unoyolo lowo athe *uNdikhoyo akabubalela kuye ubugwenxa bakhe, umnt' ongenayo konke inkohliso.
Ndithi ndakungasivumi isono sam, amandla atsho andiphelele, ngenxa yesingqala endiba naso imini yonke.
Isandla sakho sindicinezele ubusuku nemini, ndaphelelwa ngamandla, ngathi ndigqatswe lilanga lehlobo.
Ndithe ke ndakusivuma kuwe isono sam, ndabuxela ubugwenxa bam, ndisithi: “Ndisixela kuwe, Ndikhoyo, isono sam;” wandixolela wena ityala lam.
Yiyo ke loo nto bazibikayo xa kunzima abo banyanisekileyo, kuba ukufika komsinga abayi kugutyungelwa.
Wena uyinqaba endizifihla kuyo; uyandikhusela xa ndisebunzimeni. Undirhangqe ngosindiso lwakho; ngoko ke ndimemelela ndinemincili.
Ndokwazisa indlela omawuhambe ngayo, utsho uNdikhoyo, ndikufundise, ndikujonge.
Mus' ukuba sisititsi, uxel' ihashe nembongolo, izintw' ezilawulwa ngomkhala ukuze zingadlokovi.
Bajongene neentsizi ezininzi abantw' abagwenxa, kodwa yena othembele kuNdikhoyo uphahlwe zizibele zakhe.
Vuyani, nina malungisa, nichwayite ngenxa kaNdikhoyo; nina bamthobelayo uNdikhoyo, chulumachani!
Mdumiseni *uNdikhoyo, nina malungisa! Ewe, afanele ukumdumisa uNdikhoyo amalungisa.
Mbetheleni uhadi uNdikhoyo, nimenzele ingoma ngeehapu ezingcingo zilishumi.
Mombeleleni ingoma entsha uNdikhoyo; mdlaleleni ngobuchule nimemelela.
Kaloku ilizwi likaNdikhoyo linyanisekile, nemisebenzi yakhe yonke inyanisekile.
UNdikhoyo uyakuthanda ukunyaniseka nokulunga; lizele ihlabathi zizibele zakhe.
Wathetha nje ngelizwi, akho amazulu, wadala ilanga, inyanga, noozinkwenkwezi.
Wawaqokelela amanzi olwandle ngathi uwatha eselweni, wazivalela iinzulu zolwandle ngathi kukoovimba.
Malimbong' uNdikhoyo lonke ihlabathi, bamhlonele bonke abemi balo.
Wathetha kaloku, laza ladalwa; wawisa umyalelo, kwatsho kwavel' indalo.
Uyawaphuthisa uNdikhoyo amayelenqe ezizwe, awaphanzise amacebo eentlanga.
Kodwa awakhe amacebo ohlala ehleli; zohlala zikho iingcinga zakhe kude kube nini-nini.
Sinoyolo isizwe esiThixo unguNdikhoyo, eso asinyule sangabantu bakhe.
Wondela phantsi uNdikhoyo esezulwini, ababone bonke oonyana babantu.
Ubaqwalasele bonke abemi behlabathi, engqendeve kwibhotwe lakhe.
Zidalwe nguye iintliziyo zabo; uyazazi zonke izinto abazenzayo.
Asimkhosi mkhulu ohlangula ikumkani; asimandla agorha alisindisayo.
Akuthenjelwa ngahashe edabini, kungemandla alo amsindisayo umntu.
UNdikhoyo uyabanakekela abo bamhlonelayo nabo bathembe izibele zenceba yakhe,
aze abahlangule ekufeni, abondle ngelixa lendlala.
Thina sithembele kuNdikhoyo, kuba nguye umncedi nomkhuseli wethu.
Ewe, siya kuchulumacha ngenxa kaNdikhoyo, kuba sithembele kwigama lakhe elidumileyo.
Ndikhoyo, senzele ububele nenceba, njengoko kaloku sithembele kuwe.
Ndohlala ndimbonga *uNdikhoyo; andisayi kuyeka ukumdumisa.
Ndoqhayisa ngezinto andenzele zona uNdikhoyo, batsho bavuye abo babandezelekileyo.
Mbongeni uNdikhoyo, kunye nam; masilidumise kunye igama lakhe.
Ndazibika kuNdikhoyo waza wandiva, wandikhulula kuko konke ukoyika kwam.
Abacinezelweyo bathembela kuNdikhoyo, bagcobe; ewe, abasayi kuze badakumbe bona.
Lwazibika udwayi, waluva uNdikhoyo, walukhupha kuzo zonke iinkxwaleko zalo.
Bonke abahlonela uNdikhoyo isithunywa sakhe siyabakhusela, sibahlangule.
Khanibuxhamle ububele bukaNdikhoyo; ngenene unoyolo umntu othembela ngoNdikhoyo!
Mhloneleni uNdikhoyo, nina milowo yakwakhe, kuba abayi kuswela nto abo bamhlonelayo.
Neengonyama ziyaswela zilambe, kodwa abo bamfunayo uNdikhoyo akukho nto intle bayiswelayo.
Yizani, lusatshana; ndiphulaphuleni; ndonifundisa ukuhlonela uNdikhoyo.
Lowo unga angadla ubomi, abe nenkqubela, lowo unga angafumana imihla emnandi,
makazilumle ekuthetheni kakubi, ayeke ukuthetha ubuxoki;
makahlukane nobubi, enze okulungileyo; makaphuthume uxolo, ahlale kulo.
Kaloku uNdikhoyo uwalusile amalungisa, uyayiva imithandazo yawo;
kodwa ubafulathele abenzi bobubi, abaphanzise bangabi sakhunjulwa emhlabeni.
Uyaweva amalungisa akuzibika kuye, awakhulule kuzo zonke iinzima zawo.
UNdikhoyo ukufuphi nâbo badakumbileyo, ebaphakamisa abo baphelelwe lithemba.
Zininzi iingxaki ezivelela ilungisa, kodwa uyalikhulula kuzo zonke uNdikhoyo;
uwagcina onke amathambo alo, kungaphuki nalinye kuwo.
Abantw' abagwenxa bobulawa ngobubi babo, bagwetywe abo balithiyayo ilungisa.
UNdikhoyo wozihlangula izicaka zakhe; bonke abakholose ngaye abayi kugwetywa.
*Ndikhoyo, ndilamlele kwabo bandivuyelelayo, undilwele kwabo balwa nam.
Qubula ikhaka lakho nesikrweqe sakho, undincede undilamlele.
Wurhole umkhonto nentshuntshe yakho, ubavalele indlela abo bandileqayo, uthi kum: “Ndim umhlanguli wakho.”
Mabahlazeke, badane abandizungulayo; mabajike bedidekile abo bandenzela amayelenqe.
Mababe njengenkunkuma ephetshethwa ngumoya, sibaqweqwedise isithunywa sikaNdikhoyo.
Mayingacaci indlela yabo, mayibe mtyibilizi; masibasukele isithunywa sikaNdikhoyo.
Kaloku bebendigcayisele ndingenzanga nto, befun' ukunditshonisa emhadini kungekho sizathu.
Mabatshabalale ngequbuliso bengekaqondi, barhintyelwe nguloo mgibe bebendigcayisele ngawo, beyele kuwo, batshabalale.
Ndovuya ke, ndichulumache, kuba uNdikhoyo undihlangule.
Ndothi ngomxhelo wonke: “Akakho onjengawe, Ndikhoyo.” Wena uhlangula iindwayi kwabanamandla kunazo, ukhusele indwayinge kubacinezeli.
Kuvele amangqina athetha ulwimi ngam, andinkqangisa ngezinto endingazaziyo;
andibuyekeza ubuhle ngobubi, ndatsho ndaphelelwa lithemba.
Kodwa mna, okuya babegula, ndambatha ezirhwexayo, ndazicinezela nangokuzila ukutya, ndithandaza ngentobeko.
Ndangathi ndithandazela umhlobo wam nomntakwethu; ndathokombisa intloko ngokungathi ndizilela umama.
Ndithe ke ndakuba sengxakini, baqokelelana bandihleba, ndanyeliswa nazizinto endingazaziyo.
Bandenza intlekisa, bandingcungcuthekisa, bendijamela ngentiyokazi enkulu.
Koda kube nini na kodwa ubukele, Ndikhoyo? Nceda ndihlangule kwabandiqwengayo; busindise ubomi bam kwezi ngonyama.
Ndokubonga phakathi kwebandla, ndikuncome esidlangalaleni.
Mazingandivuyeleli ngobuxoki iintshaba zam, bangandisinekeli abo bandithiya ndingenatyala.
Bona abathethi ngemibandela yoxolo, koko bayila ubuxoki ngabathand' uxolo.
Bandivuyelela besithi: “Heke! Sikubhaqile!”
Ndikhoyo, nguwe ingqina lam, mus' ukuthi tu! Nkosi yam, mus' ukuchasela!
Lamla, Nkosi, ndiphendulele; Thixo wam, ndithethelele!
Ndikhoyo, Thixo olilungisa, ndigwebele; mazingandinyevuleli iintshaba zam.
Mazingandigcolotheli zithi: “Nantso ke! Simgqibile ngoku!”
Mabadane badideke abavuyiswa yinkxwaleko yam; mabadane baphoxeke abazikhukhumalisayo.
Makube yimincili kwabo bafuna ndigwetyelwe; mabamemelele bathi: “Makabongwe uNdikhoyo, yena ofuna impumelelo yesicaka sakhe.”
Ke mna ndovakalisa ukulunga kwakho, ndikubonge imini yonke.
Isono esendele entliziyweni siyamngxolela umnt' ogwenxa, asuke angamoyiki uThixo.
Simthi lwale ngokuzikhohlisa angaliboni isikizi lobubi baso.
Intetho yakhe ayilunganga; izele yinkohliso. Selephelelwe nakukwazi ukwenza okulungileyo.
Xa esemandlalweni ucinga amacebo aphuthileyo, azimisele ukuhamba ngendlela egwenxa, angayityesheli inkohlakalo.
Kodwa zona izibele zakho, Ndikhoyo, ziye kuthi gaa ngamazulu, nentembeko yakho yaya kuthi ngqu ngamafu.
Ukulunga kwakho akugungqi, kunjengentaba; zinzulu njengolwandle zona izigqibo zakho. Uyabanakekela abantu nezilo, wena Ndikhoyo.
Hayi izibele zakho, Thixo, ebantwini! Oonyana babantu bazimela phantsi kwephiko lakho.
Baxhamla intlutha yendlu yakho; ubaseze kumlambo wokulunga kwakho.
Wena ulithende lobomi; ngokhanyiso lwakho sibona ukukhanya.
Mazinganqamki izibele zakho kubo bonke abo bakwaziyo, uwabonelele amalungisa.
Mandinganyhashwa ngeenyawo ngabanolunya, ndingantlithwa zizandla zabagwenxa.
Bawile daxa abantw' abagwenxa; bakhahlelwe phantsi, abavuka.
Mus' ukuziduba ngamatshijolo wena, ungabamoneli abenzi bobubi.
Kwakamsinya baya kubuna njengengca, bavuthuluke njengamagqabi.
Thembela *kuNdikhoyo wena, wenze okulungileyo; uya kuba sisima-mhlaba, ube nekamva.
Zonwabise ngokululamela uNdikhoyo; wokunika umnqweno wentliziyo yakho.
Zilahlele kuNdikhoyo, ukholose ngaye; yena ke wokwenzelelela.
Wobutyhila bukhanye njengelanga ubulungisa bakho, kucace mhlophe ukulunga kwakho.
Zola phambi koNdikhoyo, ulindele kuye, ungazidubi ngabantu abaphumelela ngamaqhinga.
Zilumle emsindweni, uyilahle ingqumbo, ungazidub' umphefumlo, hleze unxunguphale.
Kaloku othi shwaka amatshijolo, kodwa boba zizima-mhlaba abathembele kuNdikhoyo.
Ngumzuzwana nje athi shwak' amatshijolo; uthi uwakhangela ungawaboni.
Kodwa bona abathobekileyo bowuma umhlaba, baxhamle intlutha noxolo.
Amatshijolo awenzela amayelenqe amalungisa, awajamele ngentiyokazi enkulu.
Kodwa uNdikhoyo usuka acubhuke yintsini, kuba uyazi yena ukuba imihla yamatshijolo selisongekile.
Arhola amakrele, ajolise iintolo zawo amatshijolo, efun' ukuwisa iintsizana namahlwempu, abulale amalungisa.
Otyakatywa kwangelawo ikrele, zaphulwe nezo ntolo zawo.
Obo buncinanana linabo ilungisa, bungcono kunentaphane ezinayo izikrelemnqa,
kuba uya kuzaphul' iimpondo uNdikhoyo izikrelemnqa, awenzelelele wona amalungisa.
UNdikhoyo uyawabonelela amalungisa, awenze awume umhlaba ngalo lonk' ixesha.
Akayi kuntshubaza ngamaxesh' endlala; ohlutha naxa ikati selilel' eziko.
Ke zona iintshaba zikaNdikhoyo zotshabalala, zibhange zixel' ingca etshayo edlelweni.
Izikrelemnqa ziboleka zingabuyisi, ke lona ilungisa lipha ngesisa.
Boba zizima-mhlaba abo abathamsanqelayo uNdikhoyo, bagxothwe abo abaqalekisayo.
NguNdikhoyo okhokelela umntu kwindlela amakahambe ngayo; nguye omenza akholeke kuye.
Nokuba uwile, uyavuka, kuba nguNdikhoyo omthundezayo.
Ndiyaluphala ngoku, ukanti andizange ndilibone ilungisa lintshubaza, nabantwana balo belamba.
Lisoloko libolekisa, lisipha ngesisa, nenzala yalo iyathamsanqelwa.
Yahlukana nobubi, wenze okulungileyo; uya kwalulelwa imihla yakho ebomini.
Kaloku uNdikhoyo uyakuthanda okulungileyo; akayi kubafulathela abantu bakhe. Wasoloko ebakhusela uNdikhoyo, kodwa yona inzala yamatshijolo iyanqunyulwa.
Amalungisa aya kuba zizima-mhlaba, ahlale ngoxolo kude kube nini.
Ilungisa lithetha amazwi obulumko; into eliyithethayo isoloko ilungile.
Lisoloko liwubambile umthetho kaThixo; alisoze licebuke kuwo nanini na.
Itshijolo lisoloko lizungula ukubulala amalungisa,
kodwa uNdikhoyo akayi kuliyekela kumatshijolo ilungisa, engayi kuliyekela lohlwaywe enkundleni yamatyala.
Thembela kuNdikhoyo, uthobele imithetho yakhe; wokunika umhlaba uwume, uwabone amatshijolo etshabalala.
Ndalibona lilawula ngegqudu itshijolo, lilugxibha ngathi ngumkhoba wamahlathi.
Ndaphinda ndadlula apho, ndabona lingasekho; ndalikhangela, andalifumana konke.
Kugqale ukulunga nobumsulwa, kuba kumzisela uxolo umntu ekugqibeleni;
kodwa bona aboni baya kutshatyalaliswa, nenzala yabo iphanziswe kuphele.
NguNdikhoyo umhlanguli wamalungisa; ulikhaka lawo ngexesha lobunzima.
Nguye owancedayo, awahlangule, awasindise kumatshijolo, kuba akholose ngaye amalungisa.
*Ndikhoyo, ungandingxolisi ngomsindo, ungandohlwayi ngengqumbo.
Zindityakatyile iintolo zakho, nesandla sakho sindicinezele kabuhlungu.
Nditsho ndayingxwelerha ngenxa yomsindo wakho; ndiyafa ziintlungu ngenxa yezono zam.
Ndintyumpa-ntyumpeka ezonweni; zindisinda oku komthwal' onzima.
Zitsho zabhidla izilonda zam, kuthi phuu ngenxa yobudenge bam.
Ndibandezelekile, ndiphelile, kangangokude ndizile imini yonke.
Ndiyapena-pena ziintlungu; andinampilo konke.
Ndoyisakele kwaphela; ndiyagcuma ziintlungu nalixhala.
Nkosi yam, uyawazi umnqweno wam, uyaziva zonke iincwina zam.
Ndinovalo, ndiphelelwe ngamandla, namehlo am selebona kaluzizi.
Ke zona izihlobo nabamelwana abasondeli kum, nkqu nentsapho yam le icezela phaya.
Bayandithiyela abafuna ukundibulala; bayandoyikisa abazungula ukundenzakalisa; bayandibhunga imini yonke.
Kodwa mna ndaba njengesithulu, andeva; ndanjengesimumu, andawuvula tu umlomo.
Ewe, ndinjengomntu ongaphenduliyo, kuba engeva.
Ndikhoyo, ndithembele ngawe; nguwe, Nkosi, Thixo wam, oya kundiphendulela.
Ndithandazela nje ukuba ungabayeki bandivuyelele abo bahlekayo xa ndiwayo.
Ndingawa nanini na; kaloku iintlungu zindiphethe.
Sendizivuma izono zam; ndiyazithiya izigqitho zam.
Banamandla abo baziintshaba zam, nâbo bandithiya kungekho sizathu.
Ubuhle bandibuyisela ngobubi, naxa mna ndizama ukwenza okulungileyo.
Zungandifulatheli, Ndikhoyo; Thixo wam, mus' ukuchasela kum.
Khawuleza undincede, Nkosi, Msindisi wam!
Ndathi: “Ndiya kuzilumkela iindlela zam, ndingoni ngokuthetha, ndilubambe ulwimi lwam xa ndiphakathi kwamatshijolo.”
Ndathi cwaka, andathetha nto. Ukuthula kwam akuncedanga nto, kodwa noko yona inkxwaleko yathath' unyawo.
Ndavalwa luvalo ndisacamanga, ndavukwa ngumva-ndedwa, ndavakala ndibuza ndisithi:
“*Ndikhoyo, ndazise isiphelo sobomi bam nenani lemihla yokuphila kwam. Ewe, ndazise ubufutshane bobomi bam.
Kaloku imihla yam uyicuthe kakhulu; àyinto konke kuwe imihla yobomi bam; umntu ufana nomphunga nje kuwe.
Uhla enyuke njengesithunzi silandelelana nomntu; ubila esoma nje ngenxa yelize; uqweba indyebo engazi nokuba yoba yekabani na.
“Xa kunjalo ke, Nkosi, mna ndikholose ngantoni? Elam ithemba likuwe.
Ndikhulule kuzo zonke izono zam, ndingade ndihlekwe nazizidenge.
Ndiya kuthi cwaka, ndingathethi, kuba nguwe ondifake kule meko.
Mus' ukuba sandohlwaya; mus' ukundinkula ndide ndenzakale.
Ngokumohlwaya umntu, umbonisa isono. Uyidlavula njengenundu loo nto ayithandayo. Ewe, kambe, umntu ufana nomphunga nje kuwe.
“Ndikhoyo, wubazel' iindlebe umthandazo wam; ndive, ndakuzibika kuwe. Ungàthi cwaka xa ndikhala kuwe, kuba ndiselugcinweni lwakho, nam ndisisibhadu-bhadu njengookhokho.
Khawundenzele umnyinyivana, khe ndiphefumle, ngoku ndingekemki kweli hlabathi.”
Ndakhala ndijonge *kuNdikhoyo, wada wandiva ndakuzibika kuye.
Wandikhupha emhadini onengozi, nasemgxobhozweni, wandibeka endaweni eyomileyo, ndatsho ndee ngxishishi, ndema.
Wandifundisa ingoma yombongo entsha, ingoma yokubonga uThixo wethu. Boyika abaninzi bakuyiqonda loo nto, balibeka kuNdikhoyo ithemba labo.
Hay' uyolo lomntu othembele ngoNdikhoyo, ongadlelaniyo nabanekratshi, abo banqula izithixo.
Mikhulu, Ndikhoyo, Thixo wam, imimangaliso osenzele yona. Kukwangako nokusazelelela kwakho; akakho onjengawe, Nkosi! Ngeba ndiyabalisa, koko ndiswel' imilomo eliwaka.
Wena akuwananze nganto amadini neminikelo, akuwathandanga amadini atshiswayo nawesono, kambe ke undinike indlebe evayo.
Kungoko ke ndathi mna: “Njengoko kubhaliwe ngam encwadini, ewe, ndim lo.
Iyandivuyisa intando yakho, Thixo wam; umthetho wakho ndiwumilisele entliziyweni.”
Ndizixelile ebandleni iindaba zakho zosindiso; Ndikhoyo, uyazi ukuba andikuyeka ukuzibalisa.
Andilufihlanga udaba losindiso lwakho; bendisoloko ndibalisa ngokunyaniseka noncedo lwakho; andilifihlelanga ibandla lakho izibele zakho nenyaniso yakho.
Uzungandibandezeli inceba yakho, Ndikhoyo; ndilondoloze ngenceba nenyaniso.
Zindivelela macal' onke iingxaki. Ndixakene nezono zam, azindiphi mtyhi konke. Nditsho ndatyhafa, kuba zininzi ngangeenwele zentloko yam.
Khawuncede undihlangule, *Ndikhoyo! Phuthuma, Ndikhoyo, undincede!
Mabadane badideke abandizondayo; mabarhoxe baphoxeke abazungula ukundenzakalisa.
Mabajike benyoshoza abo bathi tshotsho vityo.
Abakulangazelelayo mabavuye bagcobe ngawe; abaluthandayo usindiso lwakho mabangaphezi ukuthi: “Huntshu – uyingangalala uNdikhoyo!”
Ke mna ndilihlwepu, ndiludwayi; awu, Nkosi, khawundivelele! Umncedi nomhlanguli wam nguwe; sukuba saphozisa maseko, Thixo wam!
Hayi uyolo lomntu obonelela amahlwempu; womhlangula *uNdikhoyo xa yena esengxakini.
Womkhusela amlondoloze ebomini. Womthamsanqela emhlabeni, angamyekeli kwiintshaba zakhe.
UNdikhoyo womonga xa angaphilanga, ambuyisele empilweni.
Ke mna ndathi: “Ndikhoyo, ndenzele inceba! Ndikonile; nceda ndiphilise!”
Zahlekisa ngam iintshaba zisithi: “Uya kufa nini kakade, angabi sakhunjulwa bani?”
Nabo baze kundivelela abakho ntweni, bezela nje ukuza kuva ulwimi, bahambe besasaza intlebendwane.
Zihamba zindihleba iintshaba zam, zindinqwenelela okubi.
Zihamba zisithi: “Ukufa mumosele! Akanakuba savuka kumandlalo wakhe!”
Ewe, nesihlobo sam esisenyongweni ebendisithembile, nditsho kanye eso sabelana ngeqhekeza lesonka, naso sindivukele.
Ndikhoyo, ndenzele inceba, ndiphakame, ndize ndiziphindezele kwiintshaba zam.
Phofu ke ndiyazi ukuba undikhathalele, kuba azinakundivuyelela iintshaba zam.
Uyandinceda kuba ndimsulwa; undibeka phambi kwakho ngalo lonke ixesha.
Makabongwe uNdikhoyo, uThixo kaSirayeli, ngoku kude kube nini-nini! Amen, ewe, makube njalo!
Njengenxala elikhothekileyo kukunxanwa nam ndikwanjalo ukukulangazelela wena, Thixo.
Ewe, intliziyo yam iyakulangazelela, Thixo, nditsho wena Thixo ophilayo. Yaz'ba koda kube nini na ukuze ndide ndibe nonxibelelwano nawe, Thixo?
Imini nobusuku ndiyinyhididi kukugixa. Ke zona izibhoxi zasoloko zindiphoxa zisithi: “Ude abe phi na lo Thixo wakho?”
Kambe ke ndithi ndakukhumbula mandulo ijijitheke intliziyo yam. Kaloku fudula ndiwukhokela loo mngcelele uya endlwini kaThixo. Ewe, sasingumkhosi wochulumacho sonwabile, simemelela sidumisa.
Hee! Ngani ukuba ndidakumbe kangaka? Ngani ukuba ndikhathazeke kangaka? Hayi bo! Mandikholose ngoThixo, khon' ukuze ndibuyele ekumdumiseni uMsindisi noThixo wam.
Ke kaloku ndinomva-ndedwa, ngoku ke ndikhumbula wena, kobu bugxwayiba ndikubo, kwezi ntili zeJordan, ngakwiintaba zeHermon, neenduli zaseMiza.
Iziziba ezinzongo-nzongo ziyamemezana ngokukrotsha kweengxangxasi zakho. Amaza eze ngendlu yawo, ngokunjalo kwaneempuphuma. Ewe, ziwugubungele umphefumlo wam.
Kambe ke, ngeny' imini, *Ndikhoyo, luya kubalasela uthando lwakho. Ndiya kuphikelela ndikudumise ebusuku, ndithandaze kuThixo endixhomekeke kuye.
Ndiyakhala kuwe, mqolomba wam, Thixo: “Ngani ukuba undilibale? Ngani ukuba ndihlale ndizibambe ngeenkophe ngenxa yokubandezelwa ziintshaba?”
Ewe, sendixushekile zizenyeliso zabo. Kaloku basoloko bendigcolodela besithi: “Ude abe phi na lo Thixo wakho?”
Hee! Ngani ukuba ndidakumbe kangaka? Ngani ukuba ndikhathazeke kangaka? Hayi bo! Mandikholose ngoThixo, khon' ukuze ndibuyele ekumdumiseni uMsindisi noThixo wam.
Ngamana wandigwebela, Thixo. Ewe, mandiphume phambili ekumangalelweni ngabantu abakuchasileyo. Ndihlangule kubantu abanamaqhinga nobuqhokolo.
Kaloku ùnguThixo endizimela ngaye. Ngani ke ukuba undilahle? Ngani ukuba ndihlale ndizibambe ngeenkophe ngenxa yokubandezelwa ziintshaba?
Mandikhanyiselwe nguwe, ndikhokelwe yinyaniso yakho. Mazindise entabeni yakho engcwele, endlwini elikhaya lakho.
Ke mna mandingene *esibingelelweni sakho, wena Thixo ongumonwabisi wam. Ndiya kubeth' intambula ndintyiloze ndidumise wena, Thixo – Thixo wam!
Hee! Ngani ukuba ndidakumbe kangaka? Ngani ukuba ndikhathazeke kangaka? Hayi bo! Mandikholose ngoThixo, khon' ukuze ndibuyele ekumdumiseni uMsindisi noThixo wam.
Ewe kambe, sizivele ngezethu iindlebe, Thixo. Kaloku amanyange asibalisela ngezigigaba zakho zemihla yawo yamfamlibe.
Wena wazigxotha iintlanga, waza bona abantu bakho wabamilisela elizweni lazo. Wazitshutshisa iintlanga waza bona abakho wabathi jize ngenkqubela.
Hayi, eli lizwe abalizuzanga ngenxa yezikhali, bengaphumelelanga ngenxa yezigalo zabo; koko kwakungenxa yegunya nezigalo zakho nefuthe lobukho bakho, njengoko babethandeka kuwe.
Wena unguKumkani noThixo wam. Lumiselwa nguwe uloyiso lwakwaYakobi.
Ngoncedo lwakho siyazingqula iintshaba zethu; ngegama lakho siyabaxovula abasihlaselayo.
Andixhomekekanga kolwam utolo, ndingaqamelanga ngalo nekrele.
Hayi, nguwe owasihlangulayo ezintshabeni zethu; ikwanguwe owabaduba-dubayo abasithiyileyo.
Thina siqhayisa ngoThixo njalo-njalo, saye siya kumdumisa nanini-nanini.
Kambe ke usilahle satsho sahlazeka, njengoko ungasaphumi nemikhosi yethu.
Wena usiyekele zasiswantsulisa iintshaba, zaza zathimba amaxhoba ngokuthanda kwazo.
Wena usiyekele saxhelwa njengeegusha; usithathe wasisarhaza phakathi kweentlanga.
Abantu bakho wabathengisa ngelize, wena akwafumana nzuzo ngabo.
Usenze intsini kubamelwane, satsho sasisigculelo nesenyeliso kwezo zizwe zisingqongileyo.
Ngoku singundaba-mlonyeni phakathi kwezizwe; sesingabasizelwayo kulo lonke elimiweyo.
Ndisoloko ndithiwe mbende lihlazo. Ke zona iintloni zindongamele
ngenxa yempoxo nezenyeliso ezigityiselwa kum ziintshaba ezindivukeleyo.
Zonke ezi zinto zasihlela, nangona singazange sakulibala thina, okanye siwutshinizele umnqophiso wakho.
Asizange sikufulathele thina, singazange sanxaxha endleleni yakho.
Kodwa elethu linyhashwe laba linxuwa, silahlwe esithokothokweni sobumnyama.
Ukuba besikutyeshele, wena Thixo, okanye sanqula thixo bambi,
andithi, wena Thixo, ubuya kuyibhaqa na naleyo? Kaloku wena uyabazi ubunzulu beentliziyo.
Kambe ke kungenxa yakho sisesichengeni sokubulawa nje; yiyo loo nto sesifana neegusha zokuxhelwa nje.
Hayi bo! Vuka, Nkosi yam! Ngani ukuba uthurh' obentlombe? Vuka; sukusinyengez' uhle nomcinga!
Ngan' ukuba usilibale kangaka? Ngan' ukuba usifulathele ngolu hlobo, sibe sisisulu sembandezelo nengcinezelo?
Ewe, asisazelwe nto konke; sesingoogqush' eluthulini.
Ngenxa yothando lwakho olungatshitshiyo khawuvuke usihlangule kaloku!
Intliziyo yam suke yaphuphuma; kuthi mandibonge ndityibele. Ulwimi lwam lona luqule lwaligangatha, ndanga ndingumbhali ongenadyudyu. Kaloku ndingqungel' ukubhekisa kuMntwan' omhle.
Kubo bonke wen' uyinzwan' engenasiphako; uliciko elicikoza kuvokotheke. Kaloku uThixo ukuthamsanqele ngezingaphele ndawo iintsikelelo.
Yithi hlas' ikrel' uqule, Somagorha! Qula ngesidima nobungangamsha!
Nyantsul' uye kuqhawuk' unobathana! Qula uyilwele inyaniso nobulungisa! Ngobungangamsha bakho dubula ugeqa!
Iintolo zakho zibukhali; ziyazihlabanisela iintshaba zakho, izizwe zitsho zibe phantsi kwakho.
Kambe ulawulo lwakho, Thixo, aluphele ndawo; owakho umsimbithi ngowobulungisa.
Ungumathand' ubulungisa; uyithiyil' inkohlakalo. Ngenxa yaloo nto ke, Thixo, uThixo wakho ukuthambisile. Ewe, ukuthe jize ngesihomo nesithozela esisigqwesayo esoogxa bakho.
Iminweba yakho iqholwe ngomtsalane wemore, ikhala, nekasiya. Kwizixeko ezihonjiswe ngamabamba eendlovu wonwatyiswa ngezeentambula.
Phakathi kwezo zikuphahlileyo zikho neentombi zookumkani. Kufuphi nawe kuthe zinzi inkosazana ethe thande ecikiziweyo igolide yaseOfire.
Khawundiphe iindlebe, uphulaphule, ntombam. Uze ulincame ikhaya, ngokunjalo nendlu kayihlo.
Kaloku wena uyinzwakazi; ke yena ukumkani uyakulangazelela. Phofu ke yena ungumhlekazi, ngoko ke wena mthobele.
Wena ntombi yaseTire, baya kukucenga bakunyobe; ewe, izinhanha ngeendidi zonke zobutyebi.
Phaya entangeni bubuyokoyoko, inkosazana ivath' ezegolide.
Nantso irhuqisa ngamawezaweza, irholwa isiwa kukumkani. Nâzo neentombi eziyikhaphileyo ziyiphahlile zisiya nayo kuye.
Ziyaduda, ziyavuya, ziyamemelela; tsotsololo zagaleleka ebhotwe!
Ngxatsho ke, mntwan' omhle! Ezihlangwini zooyihlo kuya kungena abakho oonyana. Wena uya kubathi jize ngobungangamsha, babe zizinxiba-mxhaka ehlabathini liphela.
Ke mna ndiya kulubhengeza udumo lwegama lakho. Uya kudunyiswa zizizukulwana ziphela. Ewe, zonke izizwe ziya kutyibela, zikubonga kude kube ngunaphakade.
UThixo ulihlathi nenqaba yethu; ngexesha leenkathazo uluncedo oluhlala lulungile.
Ngoko ke asoyiki lutho, nokuba ihlabathi lingazama-zama, nokuba iintaba zingaphoswa enzulwini yolwandle.
Hayi, amanzi alo angade agqume alephuze amagwebu, iintaba zingcangcazeliswe kukulephuza kwawo.
Kukho umlambo omisinga isivuyisayo isixeko sikaThixo, esilikhaya elingcwele likaPhezukonke.
UThixo uthe zinzi apho kuso. Ngoko ke asinakuze sitshabalale, kuba yena usinceda kwasekuseni.
Izizwe ziyaphithizela; izikumkani ziyabhukuqwa. Lakuhlokoma ilizwi lakhe ihlabathi litsho linyibilike.
*UNdikhoyo uSomandla ungakuthi; ihlathi lethu nguThixo kaYakobi.
Yizani nibone akwenzileyo uNdikhoyo. Ewe, uliphanzisile ihlabathi.
Ngumaphelis' iimfazwe ehlabathini jikelele. Uyasiqoboza isaphetha, awuvikive umkhonto, amakhaka awantumek' umlilo.
Uthetha ngelizwi athi: “Phezani, ndim uThixo. Ndizivelele izizwe; nehlabathi ndilikrobele.”
UNdikhoyo uSomandla ungakuthi; ihlathi lethu nguThixo kaYakobi.
Qhwaban' izandla, nonke zizwe; dandulukani, niculel' uThixo nivuya.
*UNdikhoyo unguPhezukonke, ufanelwe kukuhlonelwa. Yena uyingangalala yokumkani elawula ihlabathi jikelele.
Yena wasithi jize ngoloyiso, izizwe sazinyathela ngeenyawo; kungaye sizilawula nje izizwe.
Yena wasikhethela ilifa, iqhayiya lakwaYakobi amthandayo.
UThixo unyuke ephelekwa yimikhwazo yovuyo; uNdikhoyo ukhawulelwe ngexilongo elihlokomayo.
Khanimemelele niculele uThixo; ntyilozani nibong' ukumkani wethu.
Kaloku uThixo ngukumkani; ewe, ngowehlabathi jikelele. Ngoko ke memelelani nibongisele.
UThixo ungqendeve kwibhotwe lakhe elingcwele; uThixo ngumakhonya phezu kwezizwe.
Amatshawe ezizwe aqukene ngeentloko; nawo amatwa nabendlu yoThixo ka-Abraham. Amagorha ehlabathi ngakaThixo; yena nguMongameli ovelele bonke.
*UNdikhoyo mkhulu kakhulu; masimbonge simdumise, esixekweni sikaThixo wethu, entabeni yakhe engcwele.
Ngamalengalenga, ikwayinzwakazi, izisa imihlali kwihlabathi jikelele. Ewe, leyo yiNtaba iZiyon. Emantla emalandalahla silaph' isixeko sengangalala yokumkani.
Kanye kwezo zakhiwo zinendili uThixo uzibalule, yena nqaba ingafikelelwayo.
Nâzo izikumkani zihlanganisana; nâzo zidibana zimanyana.
Kambe zithe zakuyalama, zasuka zamangaliswa, zasuka zankwantya, zasaba zingabhungisanga.
Ngoko nangoko zahlaselwa kukungcangcazela, zatsho zazibhija-bhija njengonenimba.
Iinqanawa zaseTashishe wena wazintlitha ngomoya wasempuma.
Sivile, futhi ngoku sizibonele esixekweni sikaNdikhoyo uSomandla. Nditsho isixeko sikaThixo wethu, isixeko asizinzise unaphakade uThixo.
Phakathi endlwini yakho, Thixo, siyakwetyisa ukubalasela kothando lwakho.
Ukudunyiswa kwakho, Thixo, kukwanjengegama lakho, kuthi xhaxhe ngeziphelo zehlabathi. Ulawulo lwakho lunobulungisa.
Mabavuye abemi beNtaba iZiyon; mazidlokove izixeko zelakwaJuda. Kaloku kulungile ukugweba kwakho.
Khanihamba-hambe nijikeleze iZiyon; zibaleni iinqaba zayo eziphakamileyo.
Ewe, zigqaleni iindonga zayo. Khanizihlole izakhiwo zayo, ukuze nibalisele izizukulwana.
Ewe, yena uThixo nguThixo wethu, ngoku nanini na. Yena uya kusikhapha kude kuse ephakadeni.
Phulaphulani, nonke zizwe! Yivani, nonke bemi behlabathi!
Iindidi zonke maziphulaphule, izityebi ngokunjalo namahlwempu!
Ngoku ndiza kuphokoza ubulumko, iingcamango zam zizal' ukuqiqa.
Ndiza kujongana nentsonkotha; ndiza kuyichaza ngengoma yehapu.
Ndingoyika ntoni ngemihla yobubi, xa ndingqongwe yinkohlakalo yabakhohlisi,
abantu abaqamele ngobutyebi, abaqhayisa ngentabalala yobutyebi?
Umntu akanako ukusindisa umntu; akanako ukunika uThixo ixabiso lobomi bakhe.
Nakanye! Kaloku ixabiso lobomi bomntu likhulu. Alifikeleleki mpela-mpela
elo linokumenza abe sisimakade, angaze alibone ingcwaba.
Uyabona, kaloku nezilumko ziyafa, izidenge kwanezityhakala! Ubutyebi babushiya kwabakhoyo.
Amangcwaba likhaya labo naphakade. Baya kuhlala khona njalo-njalo, nakuba babefudula benemihlaba ebizwa ngabo.
Umntu akanako ukukuphepha ukufa ngokuba esisinhanha. Hayi bo! Uyatshabalala njengezilwanyana.
Nâso ke isiphelo sabasweli-kuqonda, abo bakhohliswa ziingcinga zabo.
Bamiselwe ukufa njengeegusha; bona baxhatshazwa kukufa. Bathi ngqo behlele engcwabeni, onke amathambo abo avuthuluke, kuba kaloku bona abasekho.
Ke mna ke, uThixo uya kundikhulula; uya kundihlangula andithathele kuye.
Sukuxhala wakubona umntu ehluma, wakubona ubutyebi bakhe bukhula.
Akanakuhamba nabo xa afayo; ubutyebi buya kusala ngasemva.
Nakuba ebezicingela ukuba wonwabile ngokuya ebesaphila, nokuba ebenconywa ngempumelelo,
wohamba aye kuhlala namanyange angaze abonane nokukhanya.
Umntu osisinhanha, kodwa engenangqiqo, uyafana nje nezilwanyana ezi zitshabalalayo.
*UNdikhoyo, uThixo uSomandla, uyathetha; ubhekisa kwihlabathi jikelele, ukususela empumalanga kuye entshonalanga.
UThixo ubengezela eZiyon, isixeko esibalaseleyo ngobuhle.
Uyeza uThixo wethu; yena akayi kuthi tu. Phambi kwakhe kudangazela umlilo; uphahlwe sisitshu sesivungu-vungu.
Umema amazulu kwanehlabathi, xa aza kugweba abantu bakhe.
Uthi: “Bahlanganiseleni kum abam abathembekileyo, abanqophisene nam ngombingelelo.”
Amazulu ngokwawo abalisa ngobulungisa bukaThixo; kaloku umgwebi ikwanguye ngokwakhe.
“Khaniphulaphule, bantu bam, ndithethe; ndiyakumangalela, Sirayeli. Mna Thixo ndinguThixo wakho.
Andiyigxeki imibingelelo yakho; amadini akho atshiswayo asoloko ephambi kwam.
Kambe azisamkeleki iinkunzi zakho zeenkomo; ngokunjalo neebhokhwe zemihlambi yakho.
Kaloku zezam zonke izilwanyana neenyamakazi ezikumawaka-waka eenduli.
Xa zizonke iintaka ndiyazazi; nezinambuzane zamathafa zezam.
“Xa bendingalambayo, bendingayi kukubikela. Kaloku lelam ihlabathi nezinto zalo.
Ngaba ndiyayitya inyama yeenkunzi? Khona, ndiyalisela igazi leebhokhwe?
Umbingelelo wakho kuThixo mayibe kukubulela, uzifezekise izithembise zakho kuPhezukonke.
Zibike kum xa usengxakini; mna ndiya kukuhlangula, ke wena undidumise.”
Kambe ke kwabo bakhohlakeleyo uThixo uthi: “Ngani ukuba niyicengceleze imithetho yam, nincokole ngomnqophiso wam?
Kaloku niyayenyanya ingqeqesho; aniyithobeli nemiyalelo yam.
Nakudibana nesela, nihlobana nalo; abakrexezi niyevana nabo.
“Usoloko uthetha kakubi; uqhelene nentlebendwane.
Uncokola kakubi ngamawethu; uhleba nomntakanyoko lo.
Ndinibukele nizenza ezi zinto, andathetha nada nacinga ukuba nam ndifana nani. Kodwa ke ngoku ndiyakhalima; ndilaneka phambi kwenu ityala.
“Phulaphulani, nina bangandikhathalelanga, hleze ndiniqwenge, angabikho nonqandayo.
Obingelela ngokubulela uyandidumisa; uzilungiselela ukusindiswa nguThixo.”
Awu, Thixo, ndiyatarhuzisa! Ngenxa yezibele zothando lwakho, nobubanzi benceba yakho, nceda uzicime iziphoso zam!
Ndihlambe ndahlukane nabo bonke ububi; ndenze ndibe nyulu, ndingabi nasono!
Kaloku ndiyabuvuma ubugwenxa bam; isono sam sindithukuthezele.
Eyona ngcambu yesono sam kukuba ndone wena kanye, ndenze into ekuhlazisayo. Ngoko ke undigwebe ngakhona; isigwebo sakho sifanelekile.
Kaloku ndaba gwenxa kwasekuzalweni; ndaba ngumoni ndisakhawulwanje nguma.
Ewe, wena uthanda umntu onyanisekileyo; ndincede undiphe ingqiqo enzulu.
Ndihlambe undicokise ndicoceke; ndihlambe ndibe mhlophe qhwa, ndibe ngaphezu kwalo nekhephu.
Mandiphuphume luvuyo nemincili; nakuba undikrobozile nje, mandonwabe.
Bufihle ubuso bakho ezonweni zam, ubususe bonke ubugwenxa bam.
Ewe, Thixo, intliziyo yam yidale ngokutsha, ibe nyulu; wuhlaziye umoya wam, ndikhaliphe.
Musa ukundigxotha, Nkosi yam; ungamthathi uMoya wakho kum.
Ndibuyisele uvuyo losindiso lwakho, undixhase ngoMoya wakho, khon' ukuze ndikuthobele.
Ke, bona aboni ndiya kubafundisa imiyalelo yakho, baguquke, beze kuwe.
Awu, Thixo, ndihlangule ekufeni! Nguwe, Thixo, ondisindisayo. Ke mna ndiya kudanduluka, ndicule ngokulunga kwakho.
Vula imilebe yam, Nkosi, khon' ukuze ndikubhengeze ngawo umlomo wam.
Kaloku wena akunanze mibingelelo. Ndingafanelana ndisenza amadini atshiswayo; akangekwanelisi wena.
Umbingelelo owufunayo, Thixo, yintliziyo ethobekileyo. Intliziyo ethobekileyo neguqukayo, wena Thixo, akuyideli.
Khawuncede uyivelele iZiyon, uyilungiselele; khawuphinde uzakhe iindonga zeJerusalem.
Uya kwandula ke waneliswe yimibingelelo efanelekileyo; amadini atshiswayo, nditsho natshiswa ephelele. Kobingwa neenkunzi eqongeni lakho lamadini.
Uqhayisela ntoni ngobubi, gorhandini, usithi inceba kaThixo iphezu kwakho?
Usoloko uzungula ukutshabalalisa. Ulwimi lwakho alubukhali, yintshengeca! Uhlala uyila ubutshijolo.
Uthanda okubi kunokulungileyo; uthe phithi bubuxoki endaweni yenyaniso.
Hayi ke bethu umntu onolwini! Uyakuthanda ukuphixanisa.
Ke yena uThixo uya kukudiliza kuthi tu; uya kukuthi xhakamfu, akukhuphe endlwini yakho; uya kukuncothula umke ezweni labaphilayo.
Akuyibona le nto amalungisa omangaliswa ahlekise athi:
“Nanko ke umntu ongazange akholose ngoThixo, owasuka wakholosa ngobutyebi, waphumelela ngobutshijolo!”
Ke mna ndinjengomnquma oyokoyoko; ndihlala phakathi endlwini kaThixo. Ndihlala ndikholose ngezibele zothando lukaThixo; kuya kude kube ngunaphakade.
Ngenxa yesi senzo sakho, Thixo, ndiya kukudumisa njalo-njalo. Ndithembele kuwe kuba ulungile. Ewe, ndiya kukubhengeza phakathi kwâbo bakuthandayo.
Iziyatha zithi akukho Thixo ngandawo. Zonakele, futhi zenza amasikizi; akukho ulungisayo kuzo.
Ke yena uThixo ubabukele abantu; uhlel' ezulwini efuna ukuqonda ukuba ngaba sikho na isilumko, nditsho ofuna ukunqula uThixo.
Kambe ke bonke bemkile; xa bebonke bonakele; kubo akakho olungisayo; nditsho nokuba abe mnye.
Abanangqondo na abakhohlakeleyo, abo baxhaphaza amawethu, ngathi batya isonka, bengamnquli nokumnqula uThixo?
Baya kunkwantya ngendlela engaziwa mntu. Kaloku uThixo uyawasarhaza amathambo âbo bamchasayo. Baya kuhlazeka kuba uThixo ubalahlile.
Akwaba ingavela eZiyon inkululeko yamaSirayeli! Akuba uThixo eyibuyisele inkqubela yabantu bakhe, abakwaYakobi baya kugcoba, achulumache amaSirayeli.
Ngegunya lakho ndisindise, Thixo; ngamandla akho undikhulule.
Wuphulaphule umthandazo wam, sive isikhalo sam, Thixo.
Iintlanga ziyandihlasela; izikhohlakali zizungula ukundibulala. Zona azimkhathalele nganto uThixo.
Kodwa ke umncedi wam nguThixo, umxhasi wam nguMhlekazi.
Ngamana wayibuyisela kwasezintshabeni zam inkohlakalo yazo. Zibhangise, kuba uthembekile wena.
*Ndikhoyo, ndilangazelela ukukwenzela umbingelelo. Ndiyabulela kuwe, kuba wena ulungile.
Kuzo zonke iingxaki zam wena undihlangule; ukoyiswa kweentshaba zam ndikubone ngamehlo.
Ndincede uwubekele iindlebe umthandazo wam, Thixo. Ndibhenela kuwe; sukundifulathela.
Sabela, undiphendule. Kaloku iinkathazo zindongamele. Ngenxa yezisongelo zeentshaba zam ndididekile; ingcinezelo yabangendawo indixinile. Bafumba inkxwaleko phezu kwam; futhi bandingcikiva ngolunya.
Ndiyajijitheka ngaphakathi; izoyikiso zokufa zindivingcele.
Andoyiki ndiyagubha! Ukunkwantya kuyandirhwaqelisa.
Ndide ndithi: “Akwaba bendinamaphiko njengehobe! Bendiya kuntinga ndiye kuphumla kude lee.
Ewe, bendiya kubethwa ngumoya, ndihlale entlango.
Ndandiya kukhawuleza ndizifunele umqolomba, ndiyizimele kuyo imimoya ebhudlayo.”
Nqanda, Mhlekazi! Waphuthise amacebo abo! Kubhidanise ukuthetha kwabo, bangevani, kuba ndibona ugonyamelo nesidube-dube esixekweni.
Imini nobusuku bajikeleza ezindongeni zesixeko; siyaphuphuma bububhoja nobutshijolo.
Ewe, siphuphuma intshabalalo; ezindaweni zeembutho yingcinezelo nobukrelemnqa.
Kambe ke andingcikivwa lutshaba. Ukuba ibilulo bendinganyamezelayo. Asinguye ondichasayo lo undiqholoselayo, okanye bendingamphephayo.
Koko nguwe, ntangam, wena gxa wam, mhlobo wam osenyongweni.
Fudula sisidl' imbadu kunye; endlwini kaThixo sasikunye, singumtya nethunga.
Ngamana zahlaselwa kukufa iintshaba zam. Ewe, ngamana zehlela kwelabafileyo zihleli. Koloku amakhaya azo aqhelene nobubi.
Kambe ke ndibhenela kuThixo. Ewe, *uNdikhoyo uya kundihlangula.
Kusasa emini nangokuhlwa ndithiwe mbende ngumva-ndedwa; saye ke isililo sam sinyukela kuye, futhi ke uza kundiphulaphula.
Yena uza kundikhulula, ndingenawo nowempumlo, kweli dabi ndikulo, kwezingaka zona iintshaba.
Ewe, uThixo owaba sesihlalweni kwamandulo uza kusabela; waye ke eya kuzibhukuqa. Kaloku zona aziguquki, zingamkhathalele noThixo.
Ewe, obefudula engugxa wam suka wavukela izihlobo zakhe, wasaphula isithembiso sakhe.
Yena wayethetha kamnandi, kodwa intliziyo yona ifukam' inkohlakalo. Amazwi akhe ayelalanisa, kodwa engebukhali, eyintshengeca!
Iingxaki zakho ziphose kuNdikhoyo; yena uya kukuxhasa, akayi kuze aliyekele ilungisa.
Kambe ke, Thixo, uya kubeyelisela enzonzobileni abangendawo, ababulali namatshijolo, bengekagqibi nesiqingatha sobomi. Ukanti ke mna ndiya kukholosa ngawe.
Awu, Thixo, velana nam, kuba iintshaba ziyandihlasela; maxa onke ziyanditshutshisa.
Ewe, ndixinekile yintshutshiso yotshaba; yinyambalala abahlaseli abaqholosayo.
Ndakuxineka ndikholosa ngawe.
UThixo olizwi ndilidumisayo ndikholosa ngaye ndingenadyudyu. Soze andenze nto umntu.
Iintshaba zam ziyaphixanisa; zasoloko ziyila amacebo okundilimaza.
Ziphum' izithuba, ziyandilalela; zithene mbende nam. Kaloku ziyandizungula.
Babuyekeze ngenxa yezenzo zabo, Thixo; ngamana wabakhahlela phantsi ungenalusizi.
Uyakubona ukubhadula kwam, neenyembezi zam uyazibona. Kaloku uyazibhala ezi zinto.
Mhla ndabhenela kuwe iintshaba ziya kuphethuka. Ndotsho ndiqonde ukuba uThixo ungakum.
UThixo olizwi ndilidumisayo, *uNdikhoyo olizwi ndilidumisayo,
ndokholosa ngaye ndingenadyudyu. Soze andenze nto umntu.
Ewe, Thixo, ndozifezekisa izithembiso zam, ndenze umbingelelo wokukubulela;
kuba undihlangule ekufeni, undisindise ekoyisweni, ukuze ndibe phambi koThixo, ndidle ubomi njalo-njalo.
Khawube nenceba uvelane nam, Thixo; kaloku igwiba lam nguwe. Ndizimela kuloo maphiko akho zide zidlule iinkqwithela.
Ndibhenela kuThixo uPhezukonke, kuThixo ongenakundiyekela,
eve esezulwini andihlangule, abahlazise abo bandixobongayo. Ngokuthembeka kwakhe uThixo, ngokunjalo nangezibele zothando lwakhe, yena uya kuphendula.
Ndiphahlwe ziingonyama ezibaqwengayo oonyana babantu. Zisineke ngeengxavula ezingathi yimikhonto neentolo; zitsho ngeelwimi ezilencayo.
Awu, Thixo, zimaseka phezulu esibhakabhakeni; isidima nesihomo sakho masibe phezu kwehlabathi jikelele.
Bandithiyela ngezabatha; ndatsho ke ndaminxeka. Bandimbela umwonyo; suka kweyela kwabona.
Awu, Thixo, ndizimisele ngokupheleleyo; ewe, ngenene, andithandabuzi; ndiza kumemelela nditsholoze!
Awuhoyi na, mphefumlo wam? Ndosuka ndiqubul' ihapu nekatala; ewe, ndovuka xa kumpondo zankomo.
Ndiya kukuncoma phakathi kweentlanga, Nkosi; ewe, ndokudumisa naphakathi kwezizwe.
Izibele zakho zibalasele ezulwini; ukuthembeka kwakho kurhec' amafu.
Awu, Thixo, zimaseka esibhakabhakeni; isidima nesihomo sakho masibe phezu kwehlabathi jikelele!
Ngaba anikhethi buso na kodwa, nina balawuli, xa nilawulayo? Anibalamli ngegobe kodwa abantu?
Hayi bo! Niyila inkohlakalo; kweli hlabathi naba ugonyamelo.
Abakhohlakeleyo banxaxha bezalwa nje; ewe, banxaxha besesesizalweni, bathethe ubuxoki.
Banobuhlungu njengeenyoka; banjengenyushu ezenza isithulu,
ukuze ingeva tu xa iculelwa ngabo banemilingo; ubuqili benkintsela bungasebenzi.
Khawubaphule loo mazinyo, Thixo; wafohloze amabamba engonyama, *Ndikhoyo.
Mabaphel' emehlweni, baxel' amanzi ehamba ngomsele. Mabajolise ngeentolo ezibuthuntu.
Mabanyibilike, baxel' inkumba. Mabaxel' imva-mbilini ejik' endleleni.
Imbiza ingekawuva umlilo, noba wokhekile, noba awokhekanga, izikhohlakali ziqweqwediswa zingabi sabonakala.
Ke lona ilungisa liya kugcoba lisakuyibona le mpindezelo; liya kugxampuza egazini labakhohlakeleyo.
Abantu baya kutsho bathi: “Kuthe kanti kuneziqhamo ukuba lilungisa; ngenene ukho uThixo olilawulayo ihlabathi.”
Khawundihlangule ezintshabeni, Thixo wam; ndikhusele kwabo bandihlaselayo.
Ndihlangule kubantu abagwenxa; ndisindise kwizikrelemnqa.
Uyabona bayandilalela. Izikhohlakali zidibana ngam, ndingonanga nokona, *Ndikhoyo.
Hayi, andenzanga nento le, kodwa nâbo bendiqulela.
Ndikhoyo, Thixo Somandla, wena Thixo kaSirayeli, phakama uze kundinceda! Vela undibone kaloku. Zivukele uzohlwaye iintlanga. Mabangasindi abaphembi boqhushululu.
Baphuma ngamarhatya, ngathi zizinja ezilambayo, benze umkhulungwane esixekweni.
Nâbo begragrama, iilwimi zabo ngathi likrele; bathi ngubani obakhathaleleyo.
Ke wena, Ndikhoyo, uyabahleka; ewe, ziyintlekisa kuwe iintlanga.
Ungumkhuseli wam, ndizimela ngawe; ulikhakha lam, wena Thixo.
Ngenxa yokuba undithanda uyandihlangabeza, Thixo wam; uya kuziswantsulisa iintshaba zam.
Musa ukubatshabalalisa, Thixo, khon' ukuze abantu bakho bafumane umzekelo. Ngaloo mandla akho basarhaze babe zizibhadu-bhadu. Ulikhakha lethu, wena Ndikhoyo.
Kukrwada ukuthetha kwabo; mabaxakane nekratshi labo, kuba bayaqalekisa, futhi bayaxoka.
Babhubhise ngomsindo wakho; batshabalalise kuthi tu, khon' ukuze ihlabathi lazi ukuba kwaYakobi kulawula uThixo.
Baphuma ngamarhatya, ngathi zizinja ezilambayo, benze umkhulungwane esixekweni.
Bafunana nokutya, barhaqaze bakuba benganeli.
Kodwa ke mna ndiya kucula ndibonga amandla akho; ndiya kumemelela kwasekuseni, kuba uthando lwakho luyamangalisa. Kaloku wena uyinqaba yam, ungumqolomba ngomhla wembandezelo.
Ndiya kukubonga, mkhuseli wam. Mna ndizimela ngoThixo; ewe, uThixo ondithandayo.
Awu, Thixo, usilahlile! Ngoku sitsho soyisakala. Wena usivelele ngomsindo. Nceda, khawube nebuyambo.
Wena uwunyikimisile umhlaba; wona utsho wazama-zama; kungokunje uyaqhaqhazela. Nceda ungcibe ezo ntanda.
Abantu bakho ubavise inkxwaleko; ewe, usitsho sazizinxada-nxada.
Ubanike intshinga abakuhlonelayo; ubahluphezile ukuze bazuze uloyiso.
Nceda ngamandla akho usivelele, ukuze basinde abo ubathandayo.
UThixo uthethe *esesibingelelweni sakhe, wathi: “IShekem ndiyayahlula-hlula, ngoloyiso ndiyayihlahlela; intili yeSukoti yona ndiyibenge.
IGiliyadi yeyam, noManase ngowam. UEfrayim lelona xhadi lam; uJuda ngumsimbithi wam.
UMowabhi yintili yam yebhongo; ke yena uEdom ndiyambanga. EFilistiya ndikhwaza uloyiso.”
Ngubani onokundisa emzini oxhotyisiweyo? Ngubani onokundisa e-Edom?
Noko usilahlile, Thixo. Awusaphumi nemikhosi yethu.
Sincedise ezintshabeni zethu: kaloku olomntu uncedo luphuthile.
Ukuba uThixo ungakuthi siya kuphumelela; uya kuzinyhasha iintshaba zethu.
Thixo, ndiyakhala; nceda undiphulaphule.
Ndibhenela kuwe ndisekudeni; ndisuke ndanengevane. Nceda undikhokele, undise entabeni ephakamileyo.
Kaloku wena uyinqaba yam; uyandikhusela ezintshabeni.
Ndiya kuhlala kwakho njalo-njalo, ndithi ncwaba phantsi kwaloo maphiko.
Kaloku, wena Thixo, uzivile izithembiso zam; undinike ilifa labakuhloniphayo.
Yandise imihla yokumkani; makakhule ade akhokhobe.
Makangqendeve kwaThixo njalo-njalo, umkhusele ngothando lwezibele zakho; ewe, maluse ngokuthembeka kwakho.
Mna ke ndiya kukubonga mihla le, ndihlale ndizifezekisa izithembiso zam.
Ndithe cwaka ndikholose ngoThixo; kaloku nguye yedwa ondikhululayo.
Ndizimela ngaye, nguye ondisindisayo. Yinqaba yam, soze ndichukunyiswe.
Koda kube nini nimhlasela umntu, ninxanel' igazi lakhe, noba enjengodonga olukekeleyo, enqwa nothango oluwayo?
Nizungula ukumbhukuqa awe; niqhayisa ngokuxoka. Ngomlomo niyathamsanqelisa, ukanti niyaqalekisa ngaphakathi.
Ndithe cwaka, ndikholose ngoThixo; kaloku nguye yedwa ithemba lam.
Ndizimela ngaye, nguye ondisindisayo. Yinqaba yam, soze ndichukunyiswe.
Ndisindiswa nguThixo, uliwonga lam. UThixo yinqaba yam, ndizimela ngaye.
Maxa onke thembelani kuye, bantundini, nizityand' igila kuye; kaloku uThixo yinqaba yethu.
Abantu bafana nomphunga. Umntu yinto engento yanto. Akubekwa esikalini ukhaphukhaphu; hayi, kubhetele kwaphepha.
Musa ukuqamela ngezigalo; musa ukuthembela ekuphangeni. Noba bungade bufumbe ubutyebi, wena musa ukuqamela ngabo.
Nto zimbini azithethileyo uThixo: Le yokuba amandla ngawakhe,
nenkqu yothando ivela kuMhlekazi. Kaloku wena, Nkosi, uyazelelela, umntu umvuza ngokwemisebenzi yakhe.
Wena Thixo, unguThixo wam, ndithe swi nguwe. Umphefumlo wam uyakulangazelela. Ndihlala ndizula-zula ndikufuna; ndinxanele wena oku komhlaba obharhileyo.
Ndikuzingela phakathi *esibingelelweni, ukuze ndibone amandla nesidima sakho.
Kaloku izibele zothando lwakho ziyabugqwesa nobomi, ngoko ndiya kuhlala ndikudumisa.
Ndiya kukubonga lo gama ndisaphilayo; ndiya kunyukela kuwe ngomthandazo.
Ndiya kutya ndide ndincinde amafutha; ndiya kumemelela ndicule ndinemihlali.
Emandlalweni wam ndicinga ngawe; ndicamngca ngawe phakathi kobusuku.
Kaloku wena uluncedo lwam; ngamaphiko akho uyandikhusela, nditsho ndicule ndinemincili.
Ndizimisele ukuthi nca kuwe; kaloku wena uyandixhasa.
Ke bona abafunana nobomi bam baya kweyela kwelabafileyo.
Baya kubulawa ngekrele, babe lixhoba leengcuka.
Ke yena ukumkani uvuyiswa nguThixo. Bonke abaqamela ngaye baya konwaba. Amaxoki ke wona aya kusikw' umlomo.
Bek' iindlebe, Thixo, ndiyakhala; ndikhusele kwizoyikiso zotshaba.
Ndifihle kumayelenqe abakhohlakeleyo, kwihlokondiba eliyila inkohlakalo.
Ulwimi lwabo lubukhali njengekrele; bajolisa ngamazwi abukhali okweentolo.
Balalela badubule abamsulwa; babaqubula bengenasazela.
Bayakhuthazana kobu bukrelemnqa; bafuthelana ngamayelenqe; bathi: “Soze sibonwe!
Ngubani onokulibhaqa eli yelenqe lethu? Iqhinga lethu silenze ngobuchule.” Kaloku intliziyo yomntu lulwandle!
Kodwa ke uThixo uya kubadubula ngotolo; uya kubachana benzakale bengalindelanga.
Uya kubabhubhisa ngenxa yokuthetha kwabo, abababonayo banikine iintloko.
Bonke baya kutsho boyike, bakubhengeze akwenzileyo uThixo, bayetyise imisebenzi yakhe.
Amalungisa makonwatyiswe *nguNdikhoyo. Ewe, makazimele ngaye; onke amalungisa makaqhayise ngaye.
Ufanelwe kukubongwa, Thixo, eZiyon, zifezekiswe kuwe izibhambathiso.
Wena uyawugqala umthandazo; bonke baya kuza kuwe.
Ngenxa yobugwenxa bethu iziphoso zethu ziyasongamela, kodwa wena uyasixolela.
Uthamsanqelekile omnyulayo wena. Lowo umhlalisa enkundleni yakwakho. Siya kufumana ukwanela endlwini yakho, apho kukho ubunewu-newu nobungcwele.
Ngemisebenzi yakho emangalisayo uyasiphendula usikhulule. Thixo, wena uyinkululeko kuthi. Ihlabathi liphela lithembele ngawe, nditsho neelwandle jikelele.
Iintaba waziseka ngegunya lakho, zingumzobo wamandla akho.
Ungumthozamisi weelwandle ezilwayo, umthibazi wamaza alatyuzayo, umthomalalisi wezizwe ezixokozelayo.
Nabaseziphelweni zehlabathi bathi, bakuzibona ezi zinto, barhwaqele. Ngapha nangapha wena uhlwayela ulonwabo.
Ilizwe wena ulalusa ngemvula; wena ulitsho libe yintombazana. Ke yona imilambo iyankcenkceza; uyabalungiselela bafumane indyebo.
Amasimi uwavathisa ngemvula, atsho ee thinte ngamanzi. Umhlaba uwunyakamisa ngomvimbi, zitsho ziqhame izityalo.
Unyaka uwuthi jize ngendyebo, kuvuz' ubusi namafutha kwimizila yeenyawo zakho.
Amadlelo athe thande yimfuyo; iinduli zimbeje-mbeje, ziyavuya.
Idobo liphanjwe yimihlambi; iintili zivathiswe likhaba. Ziyakratsha, ziyacula zinemincili.
Khanitsho ngentsholo nidumisa, nibong' uThixo, nonke bemi behlabathi!
Culani nidumise isidima sakhe; khanimtyibele nimemelele!
Dandulukani, nithi kuThixo: “Iyamangalisa imisebenzi yakho; ubungangamsha bakho bunabile; buzitsho neentshaba zakho zinkwantye.
Ihlabathi liphela likhahlela kuwe, livum' amaculo, lidumisa wena; liyamemelela, libong' igama lakho.”
Yizani niyibone imisebenzi kaThixo; izenzo zakhe ziyalumangalisa uluntu.
Ulwandle walujika lwayinkangala. Umlambokazi bawuwela betabhata. Ngenene sachulumacha ngenxa yakhe.
Igunya lamandla akhe alinamida. Iliso lakhe lizalusile izizwe; nezibhoja mazingajambalazi.
Mncomeni uThixo wethu, nonke zizwe! Izibongo zenu maziviwe nangabakude.
Yena wasithundeza wasixhasa; akasiyekelanga ekutyibilikeni.
Kaloku, wena Thixo, usivavanyile; usicikide njengesiliva.
Wasiyeka sagaxeleka elubobeni; wasiyekela sathandelwa ziinkxwaleko.
Wasivula, iintshaba zasityakatya, sadada emililweni nasemanzini; wabuya wasithi jize ngendyebo.
Ndoya endlwini yakho, ndikuphathele amadini atshiswayo; ndiza kuzifezekisa izithembiso zam,
ndizenze izinto endazithethayo mhla kwakugos' okwaphukayo.
Ndiza kukwenzela amadini ngezityebileyo, ndiqhumise ngombingelelo weenkunzi zeegusha, ndibingelele ngeenkunzi zeenkomo nezeebhokhwe.
Nonke nina nimhlonelayo uThixo, yizani ndinibonise izinto andenzele zona.
Ndadanduluka kuye ndizibika; ndandipheth' iindumiso nemibongo.
Ukuba ndandizigushile izono zam uMhlekazi ebengayi kundiphulaphula.
Kambe ke uThixo undivile; uwuphendule umthandazo wam.
Ngenene ngowokubongwa uThixo. Yena akakhalalanga ndakuzibika kuye; akazibandezanga izibele zothando lwakhe.
Ngamana wanesisa wasithamsanqelisa, Thixo! Ewe, ngamana ungenza kube hele kube chosi kuthi,
ukuze yaziwe intando yakho emhlabeni, izizwe ziluxhamle usindiso lwakho.
Zonk' iintlanga mazikubonge, Thixo; bonk' abantu mabakudumise.
Mazidanduluk' izizwe zicule ngemincili, kuba wena ulawula ngobulungisa, zaluswa nguwe zonk' izizwe.
Zonk' iintlanga mazikubonge, Thixo; bonk' abantu mabakudumise.
Ilizwe liphuphum' indyebo. UThixo usithamsanqele; nditsho uThixo wethu.
Ngenene uThixo uyasithamsanqela; ngamana lamthobela ihlabathi jikelele.
Ngamana waphakam' uThixo, waziswantsulis' iintshaba zakhe. Banga bangaba ziintsali abamthiyileyo.
Mabaphaphatheke; bavuthele, bathi shwaka, baxel' umsi. Mabanyibilike, baxel' umthwebeba emlilweni. Mababhubhe phantsi koThixo abakhohlakeleyo.
Ke wona amalungisa makonwabe. Wona makavuye phambi koThixo. Ewe, makabe nemihlali nemincili.
Culelani uThixo, nibong' igama lakhe. Ewe, mbongeni lowo ucand' emafini. Igama lakhe *nguNdikhoyo, vuyani ngenxa yakhe.
UThixo usendlwini yakhe engcwele. Nguyise weenkedama, umthetheleli wabahlolokazi.
Abangenabani ubenzela izihlobo. Amabanjwa uwakhokelela enyhwebeni; ke bona abavukeli bohlala kwelingumqwebedu.
Ke wena, Thixo, wabakhokela abantu bakho; wanyantsula, wacanda entlango.
Umhlaba watsho wanyikima, yagalelek' imvula, ngokufika kukaThixo waseSinayi; ewe, nditsho uThixo wamaSirayeli.
Wena, Thixo, wathulula izandyondyo zemvula, walinyanga ilizwe lakho elibharhileyo.
Abantu bakho watsho bazuza umhlaba wokuma; ngenceba yakho wabazelelela abahlelelekileyo.
INkosi inika umyalelo, batsho babe baninzi abavakalisa iindaba.
Iinjengele zomkhosi nâzo zibaleka; ke bona abafazi basala besab' amaxhoba.
Sebengathi ngamahobe ahonjiswe ngesiliva; amaphiko ehonjiswe ngegolide.
Wathi uSomandla ukubasarhaza ookumkani, kwatsho kwalal' ikhephu eZalmon.
Iphakamile ke kambe intaba iBhashan; yintaba encopho zininzi.
Zintabandini, ngani ukuba niyigxeleshe intaba, nditsho intaba enqwenelekayo kuThixo, apho wohlala khona ngonaphakade uNdikhoyo!
UNdikhoyo weza ngeenqwelo ezimawaka-waka, ephuma eSinayi, esiza ebhotwe.
Wantinga, wanyukela phezulu, erhuqa umngcelele wabathinjwa, wamkela izipho ebantwini, ewe, nditsho nakwabamvukelayo, ukuze uNdikhoyo uThixo ahlale khona.
Yibongeni iNkosi! Mihla le iyasazelelela, uThixo ngumsindisi wethu.
UThixo wethu ungosindisayo; uMhlekazi uNdikhoyo uyasihlangula ekufeni.
Kodwa ke uThixo uya kuzintlekeza iintshaba zakhe, abo bathene nca nenkohlakalo.
INkosi yathi: “Ndiya kuzibuyisa eBhashan; ndiya kuzirhola enzonzobileni yolwandle;
ukuze nina nigxampuze egazini lazo, zona izinja zihluthe kukuxhaph' igazi.”
Umngcelele wakho, Thixo, uyabonakala, umngcelele oya esibingelelweni, nditsho okaThixo, ukumkani wam.
Phambili ngabantyilozayo, belandelwa ngabangqungqayo; phakathi kwabo iintombi zibeth' iingqongqo.
Mbongeni uThixo embizweni yakhe; mbongeni, nina bandla likaSirayeli!
Zikhokelwa nguBhenjamin inci. Nâlo neqela lamatshawe akwaJuda. Ayalandela awakwaZebhulon nawakwaNafetali.
Bonakalìsa ubungangamsha bakho, Thixo; loo mandla wasinceda ngawo, Thixo.
Ngenxa yesidima sendlu yakho eJerusalem izikumkani ziza zipheth' imirhumo.
Bakhalimele abo bahlala eJiputa, isizwe esiziphetheleyo izizwe, esicinezela ezinye ngenxa yomrhumo. Isizwe esingumnqay' ulambile sizichitha-chithile ezinye izizwe.
Imirhumo mayize iphuma eJiputa; amaKushe makaphakamele kuThixo azibike.
Culelan' uThixo, zizwe zehlabathi; memelelani nimbonge uMhlekazi;
kulowo ucanda amazulu, nditsho amazulu amandulo, otsho ngelizwi ngathi liyazongoma.
Wancomeni amandla kaThixo obungangamsha buphezu koSirayeli, omagunya akhe asesibhakabhakeni.
Uyamangalisa uThixo kwikomkhulu lakhe; ewe, nditsho uThixo kaSirayeli. Abantu bakhe ubabela amandla nokomelela. Huntshu-u-u, mbongeni uThixo!
Awu, khawundihlangule, Thixo! Ndithe gabhu ngentamo emanzini.
Ndiyazika eludakeni olubizelayo, apho kungekho nokuxhathisa. Ndithe dyumpu esizibeni; umsinga uyandintywilisela.
Sendikhale zada zoma, kungokunje ndom' umqala; amehlo afiphele kukujong' enkalweni, ndilangazelela wena, Thixo wam.
Abo bandithiyileyo ngaphandle kwesizathu bagqitha inani leenwele zentloko yam. Zizigantsontso ezifuna ukunditshabalalisa, ezindihlasela ngokundityhola. Ndingathini ukuhlawula ndingebanga nje?
Ke wena, Thixo wam, uyasazi isono sam; amatyala am' aselubala kuwe.
Awu, *Ndikhoyo, Thixo onamandla onke, mandingabahlazisi abo bakholosa ngawe; abakulangazelelayo mabangangcikivwa ngenxa yam, Thixo kaSirayeli.
Kaloku kungenxa yakho ndinyeliswa nje; ngoku sendintywil' ehlazweni.
Sendaba yintlanga kumawethu; ndingumhambi kwiinto zikabawo.
Ke kona ukuzondelela indlu yakho kundongamele; izithuko zabakunyelisayo ziphezu kwam.
Ndalila ezimathontsi, ndizila ukutya, kodwa naleyo yaba sisingcikivo.
Ndithi ndakunxiba ezirhwexayo zokuzila ndisuke ndibe ngundaba-mlonyeni.
Bancokola ngam ezimbuthweni; sendide ndayingoma yamanxila.

Kambe ke, Ndikhoyo, mna ndiyakuthandaza. Ngeli xesha lifanelekileyo, Thixo, nangenxa yendyebo yezibele zothando lwakho, khawuncede undiphendule. Ngenxa yokuthembeka kwakho ndihlangule; naku sendizika eludakeni.
Ndisindise ezintshabeni zam; ndikhuphe emanzini anzongonzongo.
Ewe, mandingantywiliselwa ngumsinga; mandingarhaxwa kwisiziba esimnyama; mandingaginywa yinzonzobila.
Hayi ubuhle bezibele zakho! Ndikhoyo, ndivelele undiphendule; ewe, ngokobuninzi beenceba zakho ndive!
Musa ukusifulathela isicaka sakho. Ndibandezelekile; nceda undiphendule.
Sondela undisindise; ndikhulule ezintshabeni zam.
Uyayazi indlela endingcikivwa ngayo; uyazi ukuba andinto yanto, ndihlazekile; uyazazi zonke iintshaba zam.
Izinyeliso ziwaphule umoya wam; kungokunje ndivikivekile. Ndathemba ukukhuzwa, kodwa nya! Nokuthuthuzelwa andakufumana.
Ndaweni yokutya ndanikwa ityhefu; endaweni yamanzi yaba yiviniga.
Mabenzakaliswe kwakukutya kwabo, amatheko abo abe ngumgibe kubo.
Mabamfanyekiswe bangaboni; umzimba wabo mawutyhutyhwe lidumbe.
Mabagutyungelwe yingqumbo yakho; mabatshiswe ngumsindo wakho.
Mawube linxuwa umzi wabo, makungahlali nabani kuwo,
kuba bayamtshutshisa ombethileyo, baphoxise ngaye omenzakalisileyo.
Bancine ngesona sohlwayo; mabaphoswe yinceba yakho.
Mabacinywe kwincwadi yoludwe lwabaphilayo, mabangadweliswa namalungisa.
Kambe ke ndiyajwaqeka yintlungu; ndonyule undisindise, Thixo.
Ndiya kumemelela ndibonge uThixo; ndiya kumncoma ndidomboze.
Lo ke wona umbulelo ubalasele; ungaphezulu kokubulela ngethole kuNdikhoyo, uyidlula lee inkunzi yenkomo.
Ke bona abahlelelekileyo baya kuvuya; abamlangazelelayo uThixo bokhuthazeka.
Kaloku uNdikhoyo uyabeva abahlelelekileyo; akabacekisi abakhe ababanjiweyo.
Dandulukani, mazulu nani hlabathi, nimbonge, nani zilwandle nako konke okushukumayo kuni!
Kuba uThixo uya kuyisindisa iZiyon, aphinde azakhe izixeko zakwaJuda. Izicaka zakhe ziya kuba ngabemi bakhona,
izizukulwana zona zidle ilifa, bathi nabamthandayo bahlale khona.
Awu, khawuncede undihlangule, Thixo! Khawuleza, *Ndikhoyo, undincede!
Mabadane badideke abandizondayo; mabarhoxe baphoxeke abazungula ukundenzakalisa.
Mabajike benyoshoza abo bathi tshotsho vityo.
Abakulangazelelayo mabavuye bagcobe ngawe; abaluthandayo usindiso lwakho mabangaphezi ukuthi: “Huntshu – uyingangalala uThixo!”
Ke mna ndilihlwempu, ndiludwayi; awu, Thixo, khawundivelele! Umncedi nomhlanguli wam nguwe; sukuba saphozisa maseko, Ndikhoyo!
*Ndikhoyo, ndizimela ngawe, mandingaze ndidaniswe.
Njengokuba ulilungisa, ndihlangule undisindise; ndiphulaphule, undikhulule.
Yiba ngumqolomba wokuzimela; yiba yinqaba endiphephela kuyo. Thetha ngezwi ndikhuseleke; kaloku uligwiba elindikhuselayo.
Thixo wam, ndihlangule kwabakhohlakeleyo, ndingabanjwa ngabagwenxa nezikhohlakali.
Kaloku ithemba lam nguwe, Nkosi; ndakholosa ngawe ndisengumntwana, Ndikhoyo.
Ndaqamela ngawe kwasekuzalweni; ndakhutshwa nguwe kumama. Ndiya kukubonga njalo-njalo.
Ndisisimanga kwabaninzi, kodwa ke wena uyandikhusela.
Ndiswel' imilomo yokukubonga, ndikudumise maxa onke.
Ungandilahli ndakuguga; ungandishiyi ndakuphelelwa ngamandla.
Iintshaba zifakan' imilomo ngam; abandizungulayo bayacebisana.
Bathi: “Ulahliwe nguThixo. Masimsukele simgxagxamise. Akukho uya kumhlangula.”
Sondela kum, Thixo! Khawuleza undincede, Thixo wam!
Abandihlaselayo mabahlazeke babhubhe. Ngamana baphoxeka bahlazeka abazungula ukundenzakalisa.
Ndiya kuthembela kuwe rhoqo, ndikubonge njalo-njalo.
Ndiya kububhengeza ubulungisa bakho, ndihlale ndiluvakalisa usindiso lwakho nakuba lungenakuphicothwa.
Ndize kukudumisa, Mhlekazi Ndikhoyo, ngenxa yamandla akho, ndikubonge ngobulungisa obungakanana.
Wandifundisa kwasebuncinaneni, Thixo. Unangoku ndisayincoma imisebenzi yakho, kuba iyamangalisa.
Nangona ndiyingwevu nje, sukundilahla, Thixo, ndide ndiwabhengeze amandla akho nakwizizukulwana ezizayo.
Amandla nobulungisa bakho, Thixo, bufikelela emazulwini. Kambe zinkulu izinto ozenzileyo. Awu, Thixo, akakho onjengawe!
Undithubelezise ezinkathazweni ezininzi; kambe ke uya kundihlangula ekufeni, undikhuphe emathunjini omhlaba.
Uya kundizimasa, undithuthuzele kwakhona.
Ndiya kubeth' ihapu ndikubonge, kuba uthembekile, Thixo wam. Ndobeth' ikatala ndikudumise, wena Ngcwele kaSirayeli.
Ndiya kumemelela ndinemincili, ndicule ngokuzimisela okukhulu ngenxa yokuba undihlangule.
Ndiya kubalisa ngobulungisa bakho, ndithethe ngabo ndingaphezi, kuba abo babezama ukundenzakalisa bahlazisiwe batsho baphoxeka.
Mthi jize ngobulumko bokulawula ukumkani, Thixo; mabele ukunyaniseka kwakho umntwan' egazi;
ukuze abaphathe ngobulungisa abantu bakho, abalawule ngokubazelelela abahlelelekileyo.
Mazihlaziyeke iinduli neentaba ziqhame; makube yinzolo inkqubela nobulungisa.
Ngamana yena wawakhusela amahlwempu, abancede abo bahlelelekileyo, abanyhashe abacinezeli.
Abantu mabambuse bamkhonze xa lisaman' ukuvela ilanga, lo gama isakhanyisa nenyanga, kuye kwizizukulwana ngezizukulwana.
Makabe njengemvula emasimini, abe njengomvimbi emhlabeni.
Makande amalungisa ngemihla yakhe; ewe, axhamle inzolo de ingabi sabikho inyanga.
Ngamana olwakhe ulawulo lwasuka elwandle lwesa elwandle, lusuke emlanjeni iEfrati luse eziphelweni zehlabathi.
Ngamana baqubuda kuye abasentlango, iintshaba zakhe zity' umhlaba.
Ngamana ookumkani baseTashishe nabeziqithi bakhuph' imirhumo, abaseSheba nabaseSebha bakhuph' isithabathaba.
Bonk' ookumkani mabakhahlele kuye, zonk' izizwe zimbuse.
Uyabahlangula abakhalayo, amahlwempu nabangenabani.
Uyavelana nababuthathaka neentsizana, abasindise abahlelelekileyo.
Ubakhulula kwingcinezelo nakwizibhovubhovu; kuye lixabisekile igazi labo.
Kuye sithi: “Mpilo-nde-ntle!” Mayize kuye igolide yaseShebha; makathandazelwe njalo-njalo, iintsikelelo zihlale zivuza phezu kwakhe.
Ngamana kwayindyebo emhlabeni, neencopho zeentaba ziqhame, kuchume njengaseLebhanon. Mabanyakazele abantu ezixekweni, baxel' ingca emadlelweni.
Igama lakhe malingaze liphele; malibe sisimakade lixel' ilanga. Ngamana bonk' abantu bamdumisa; ewe, mabamnqwenelele iintsikelelo, zonk' izizwe zimthamsanqele.
Ngamana wadunyiswa *uNdikhoyo, uThixo kaSirayeli, ekukuphela kwakhe owenza imimangaliso enje.
Huntshu-u-u! Masibongwe isidima segama lakhe kude kube nini nanini! Ngamana waphuphuma umhlaba sisihomo nesithozela sakhe! Huntshu-u-u! (
Iyaphela apha incwadi yemihobe kaDavide unyana kaJese.)
Ngenene uThixo umphethe kakuhle uSirayeli; ulungile kwabantliziyo zinyulu.
Kodwa ke mna suka ndathandabuza, ewe, gcwizi ndityibilike,
kuba ndinekhwele ngabaqhayisayo, kukubona inkqubela yabakhohlakeleyo.
Kaloku bona abazani nantlungu; baphile bayimiqaba-qaba.
Abakhathazwa nto njengabanye abantu; abafunyanwa zizibetho njengabanye.
Ngoko ke bagaxel' ikratshi; bathi wambu ugonyamelo.
Badumb' amehlo kukutyeba; iintliziyo ziphuphum' ubuqhophololo.
Bayangcikiva benentlamba; baziphakamisile basongela ngengcinezelo.
Bangcikiva nkqu namazulu; batheth' unothanda emhlabeni.
Ke bona abantu bayabamkela; barhorhozela emva kwabo.
Bathi: “UThixo ngeke aqonde; uPhezukonke ngeke asibhaqe.”
Banjalo ke abakhohlakeleyo; abazihluphi nganto, kodwa bayahluma.
Ngani ke ukuba ndiziphathe kakuhle, ndizigcine ndinyulu?
Kaloku andahlukani nentlupheko; miso le ndiyohlwaywa.
Xa bendithetha kanjalo bendingaba ndingcatsha abantu bakho.
Ndizamile ukuyiphonononga le nyewe, kodwa suka yayinkinge kum.
Ndide ke ndabhenela engcweleni kaThixo, ndacacelwa ke sisiphelo sabo.
Ngenene ubabeka emtyibilizini, bawe batshabalale.
Ngephanyazo baba nesiphelo esilumezayo, beyela bephanziswa kukunkwantya.
Nkosi, banjengephupha ekuphaphameni komntu; ubume balo buyalibaleka akuvuka.
Ngokuya ndandibindekile, ndikhathazekile entliziyweni,
ndandingaqondi, ndisisidenge; ndandiziphethe njengesilwanyana.
Kambe ke ndisoloko ndikuwe; undithe chu ngesandla.
Ewe, wena uyandithundeza; kamva ke wondamkelela ewongeni.
Ndikholosa ngawe usemazulwini; ungowam nje ke, andilinanze nganto ihlabathi.
Umzimba nentliziyo zingade ziphelelwe, wona amandla am nguThixo, ulibango lam naphakade.
Abakutyeshelayo baya kubhanga; uyabatshabalalisa abaqhankqalazi.
Kum ke kuluyolo ukuba kufuphi kuwe, Thixo. Nkosi yam *Ndikhoyo, ndikhuselwa nguwe, ukuze ndibalise ngemisebenzi yakho.
Awu, Thixo! Ngani ukuba wenjenje ukusilahla? Awusathothi na umsindo wakho kubantu bakho?
Khawulikhumbule ibandla lakho owalifumana mandulo, owalikhululayo ukuze libe lilifa lakho; khumbula ikhaya lakho intaba iZiyon.
Khawuye kuloo mabhodlo; iintshaba zabhuqa konke endlwini yakho.
Zabharhumla phakathi endaweni engcwele, zaza zamisa eyazo indwe.
Ezo zinxosha-nxosha zabhulula konke, ngathi ngabagawuli begec' imithi.
Zona izinto ezenziwe ngomthi bazintlekeza ngooncelemba nezando.
Zayintumek' umlilo indawo engcwele, zayixabhela zayidiliza indlu yakho engcwele.
Zathi: “Masibabhangise kuthi tu.” Kulo lonke bazitshisa iindawo zokunqula.
Eyakuthi indwe ayisabonakali; akusekho namshumayeli, kungekho waziyo ukuba koda kube nini na.
Koda kube nini, Thixo, utshaba lungcikiva? Lohlala lukunyelisa njalo-njalo?
Kutheni ukuba ungasincedi? Ngani ukuba usonge izandla?
Kambe ke wena, Thixo, waba ngukumkani kwamandulo. Uyabahlangula abantu ehlabathini liphela.
Ngaloo mandla walahlula-hlula ulwandle, waziqhekez' intloko iingwenya,
wasintlekeza intloko isilo solwandle, sakukutya kwelo libharhileyo.
Wena wampompozisa imithombo nemilanjana, waza wayomisa imilambo engatshiyo.
Yadalwa nguwe imini, ngokunjalo nobusuku; ivela kuwe inyanga, ngokunjalo nelanga.
Yamiswa nguwe imida yehlabathi; ngokukwanjalo ihlobo nobusika.
Awu, *Ndikhoyo, khumbula ukuba iintshaba ziyakusinekela; izibhoja ziyalingcikiva igama lakho.
Ungabayekeli ezintshabeni abantu bakho; khumbula ngokubandezeleka kwabantu bakho.
Khawucinge ngomnqophiso wakho, kuba eli lizwe liphethwe zizibhoja zona zigoxa kwamnyama-ndawo.
Sukubayekela abacinezelweyo; nawo amahlwempu neentsizana makakudumise.
Khawuvuke uhlanganise, Thixo; izibhoja zisoloko zikungcikiva.
Sukuyilibala intsholo yotshaba lwakho, umlembelele wengxolo yabakuchasayo.
Ngxatsho ke, siyakubulela, Thixo! Siyalibabaza igama lakho ngenxa yemisebenzi yakho emangalisayo.
“Ngexesha endilimisileyo ndiya kugweba ndingakhethi buso.
Lakuhexa ihlabathi nabemi balo iintsika zalo zomelezwa ndim.
Kwabazingcayo ndithi: ‘Kahleni ngamabhongo.’ Kwizikhohlakali ndithi: ‘Sanukuqholosa.’
Yahlukanani nokuzigqatsa; kuyekeni ukubhobhoza.”
Unyuselo aluveli empuma nasentshona, lungaveli nasentlango.
Kaloku nguThixo ogwebayo: uyamthoba lo, amnyuse lowa.
*UNdikhoyo uphethe indebe ngesandla, iphuphuma ingqumbo ebilayo; ubarhabulisa kuyo abagwenxa, boyisela bafince nentlenge.
Kodwa ndohlala ndimncoma njalo-njalo; ndiya kumemelela ndibonga uThixo kaYakobi.
Abagwenxa ndiya kubaphul' iimpondo; ndiluphakamis' uphondo lwamalungisa.
UThixo uyaziwa kwaJuda; igama lakhe lidumile kwaSirayeli.
IseJerusalem indlu yakhe; ikhaya lakhe liseZiyon.
Wazikroboza iintolo namakhakha, amakrele nezikrweqe zemfazwe.
Kambe wena uyamangalisa ngokuqaqamba, ubalasele kuneentaba eziyokoyoko.
Amagorha uwahluthe amaxhoba; amajoni alala undolala, akabi nako ukuzisebenzisa izikrweqe.
Uthi nje wakukhalima, Thixo kaYakobi, amahashe nabawakhweleyo babe zizigede.
Awu, uyamangalisa kambe! Ngubani onokujongana nawe wakuvutha umsindo wakho?
Wena wagweba usemazulwini, ihlabathi latsho lakhwankqiswa.
Ngokuya wena wawisa isigwebo sokusindisa abacinezelwa behlabathi.
Ngenene ngomsindo wakho uyadunyiswa; abasindileyo kuwo bayayaleka.
Zifezekiseni izithembiso zenu *kuNdikhoyo uThixo; abamngqongileyo mabezise izithabathaba barhume kulowo ufanele ukoyikwa,
kulowo unqamla umoya wamatshawe, ewe, kumrhwaqelisi wezikumkani zehlabathi.
Ndiyakhwaza, ndibhekisa kuThixo; ndikhala kuye, ukuba andiphulaphule.
Ngomhla wenkathazo ndibhenela eNkosini; ebusuku ndiyazingisa, ndiziphakamisela kuyo izandla, umoya wam ungavumi ukuthuthuzeleka.
Ndakucinga ngoThixo, ndiba nesingqala; ndakucamngca, uyatyhafa umoya wam.
Andisabazi nobuthongo; ndixakwe nakukuthetha ziinkathazo.
Hay' imihla yamfamlibe; ndikhumbul' iminyaka yamandulo.
Ebusuku ndidliwa ngumva-ndedwa; ndiyacamngca ndiyicikida intliziyo yam, ndisithi:
“Ngaba yondilahla kuphele iNkosi, ingaze ibuye indamkele?
Ngaba lutshitshile na uthando lwayo? Sibhangile na isithembiso sayo?
Selekulibele na uThixo ukubuya ngetarhu? Ngaba umsindo wakhe uluvalile uvelwano?”
Ndide ndithi: “Nantsi eyona indixhelayo: kukunqamka kwamandla kaPhezukonke.
Ndikhumbula izenzo zakho, *Ndikhoyo; ewe, ndicinga ngemimangaliso yamandulo.
Ndicamngca ngemisebenzi yakho; ndetyisa izenzo zakho ezikhwankqisayo.”
Hayi ke beth' ubunyulu bukaThixo! Thixo wuphi ofana noThixo wethu?
Wena unguThixo owenza imimangaliso; amandla akho abonakele phakathi kwabantu;
Wabakhulula ngamandla akho abantu; ewe, nditsho oonyana bakaYakobi nabakaJosefu.
Uthi wakuvela wena, Thixo, arhwaqel' amanzi, nenzongonzongo yolwandle ingcangcazele.
Amafu wona atsho avuz' amanzi, isibhakabhaka sona sagragrama, imibane yona yaphithizela.
Izithonga zeendudumo zazihamba nezaqhwithi, imibane yalikhanyisa lonke ihlabathi, umhlaba wangcangcazela wanyikima.
Wena wadabul' ulwandle, wacand' amanzi anzongonzongo. Ke wona umkhondo wakho awufumaneki.
Wabakhokela njengomhlambi abantu bakho ngesandla sikaMosis noAron.
Khaniyibekel' iindlebe, mawethu, imfundiso yam; khanindiph' iindlebe ndithethe.
Ndiza kuthetha nani ngemizekeliso; ndiza kuphokoz' iintsonkotha zamandulo.
Ndixel' izinto esazivayo nesizaziyo, izintw' esazixelelwa ngoobawo.
Asinako ukubafihlela abantwana babo, koko sozibhengeza kwizizukulwana ezizayo: imisebenzi emihle *kaNdikhoyo namandla akhe, ewe, nditsho nemimangaliso ayenzileyo.
Wamisela umthetho kwaYakobi, wanikela imimiselo kwaSirayeli; wabanqonqozisa ngayo oobawo, ukuze bafundise abantwana babo,
khon' ukuze ziyazi izizukulwana ezizayo, ewe, nditsho nabangekalibon' ilanga. Bona ke bayigqithisele kubantwana babo,
ukwenzela ukuba bakholose ngoThixo, bangaze bayilibale imisebenzi yakhe, koko bayithobele imimiselo yakhe;
ewe, bona bangafuzi ooyise, isizukulwana esineenkani nesigwilikayo, abantu abantliziyo zibhetyebhetye, abangazange banyaniseka kuThixo.
AmaEfrayim axhoba ngeentolo, engàxhob' ef' amacala, kodwa aswantsula ngomhla wedabi.
Akawuthobelanga umnqophiso kaThixo, asuka ala ukuhamba ngokomthetho.
Suke ayilibala imisebenzi yakhe, imiqondiso awayewabonise yona.
UThixo wenza imimangaliso phambi kooyise, eJiputa kumathafa aseZowan.
Walahlula-hlula ulwandle, bawela, amanzi aba yinduli ngapha nangapha.
Wabakhokela ngelifu emini, ebusuku wabakhokela ngomlilo.
Waqhekeza amawa entlango, basela amanzi ampompozayo.
Wavelisa imithombo elulwalweni, amanzi aqukuqela ngathi yimilambo.
Kodwa baphindelela ukona, bavukelana naye uPhezukonke entlango.
Bamvavanya ngabom uThixo ngokubiza ukutya ababekubawela.
Baphoxisa ngoThixo bathi: “Angakuthatha phi na ukutya apha entlango?
Ewe, waliqhekeza iliwa, antyunty' amanzi, kwaza kwagqobhoza imilambo. Ewe, makasinik' isonka kaloku, abaph' inyama abantu bakhe.”
Akuyiva le nto uNdikhoyo wacaphuka, waza wamlenya ngomlilo uYakobi. Ewe, wanoburhalarhume kuSirayeli,
kuba bengakholosanga ngoThixo, bengathembanga ukuba angabasindisa.
Kambe ke wayalela isibhakabhaka, zaza zavuleka iingcango zezulu,
yaza *imana yawa njengemvula, wabanika batya ukutya kwaphezulu.
Ewe, abantu batye ukutya kwezithunywa zezulu, baza batya bada bahlutha.
Wathumela umoya wasempuma wabhudla, ngamandla akhe wavusa umoya wasezantsi.
Wabathobela inyama, kwangathi sisivungu-vungu; inyambalala yeentaka ezingangentlabathi yolwandle
waziwisa apho babemise khona, ewe, zajikeleza iintente zabo.
Abantu batya bada bahlutha; kaloku wabanika loo nto babeyifuna.
Kanti ke bathe bengekadikwa, besaxakekile besatya njalo,
suka wavutha umsindo kuThixo, wababulala abona bomeleleyo, wabageqa abafana bakwaSirayeli.
Nakuba kunjalo baphikelela ukona, bangenelwa kukudelela, àbakholwa.
Waza ke wababhangisa okomphunga, imihla yabo yaphela lishwangusha.
Akubohlwaya babuyela kuye, baguquka bazinikela kuThixo.
Bakhumbula ukuba nguThixo inqaba yabo, bangáhlangulwa nguThixo uPhezukonke.
Kodwa kuloo nto yonke bamqhatha; bâthi: “Lala, gusha, ndikuchebe.”
Zabe iintliziyo zona zikude lee kuye, bengakhange bawunanze umnqophiso wakhe.
Kambe ke yena uThixo waba nenceba, wabaxolela iziphoso zabo, wazibamba akabatshabalalisa; ewe, wayewubamba futhi umsindo wakhe, wayithomalalisa ingqumbo yakhe.
Wakhumbula ukuba bangabantu, into edlula njengomoya iphele.
Kwaba kaninzi bemvukela entlango; ewe, babemtsho abe neenzingo kwelingamiwayo.
Baphinda-phinda ukumvavanya, bamcaphukisa oyiNgcwele kaSirayeli.
Bamlibala àbamkhumbula ngamandla akhe, bawulibala umhla wokuhlangulwa kwabo elutshabeni.
Abayikhumbulanga imiqondiso yakhe yaseJiputa, nemimangaliso yakhe kumathafa aseZowan,
apho wawajika khona amanzi aba ligazi, kwayinqaba kumaJiputa ukusela emithonjeni.
Wabathumela ngamabubu eempukane, zabangcungcuthekisa, ngokunjalo namasele abazisela imbubho.
Izilimo zabo wazithumela ngesihlava, isivuno sabhuqwa ziinkumbi.
Idiliya yabo wayivuthulula ngesiphango, ke wona amakhiwane wawarhawula ngeqabaka.
Iinkomo zabo wazintlitha ngesichotho, imihlambi yabo yalenywa yimibane.
Wasuka ke wavutha umsindo wakhe, wayivulela ingqumbo yakhe ecaphukile, wababandezela ngolunya, umkhosi wezithunywa wabatshabalalisa.
Zange abe sazibamba, wawuvulela umsindo wakhe, akabasindisa ekufeni; ewe, wasuka wabathumela ngobhubhani.
Wawathi qwaka onke amazibulo amaJiputa, wabageqa abaligugu neqhayiya lakwaHam.
Kanti ke wabakhokela njengeegusha abantu bakhe, entlango wabalusa ngathi ngumhlambi.
Wabalondoloza batsho baphelelwa ngamaxhala, kambe ke ulwandle lwaziginya iintshaba zabo.
Wabakhokela wabasa kwelilelakhe ilizwe, entabeni awayizuza ngamandla akhe.
Bakufika wazidudula izizwe zabhaca, abantu bakhe wabacandela umhlaba wazo, amaSirayeli athi zava ezikhundleni zazo.
Kanti ke bamlinga bamvukela uThixo uPhezukonke; ewe, abazange bawuthobele umthetho wakhe.
Bamvukela, bahamba ngobutshijolo booyise; basuka àbanyaniseka, àbathembeka okwesaphetha esityokololo.
Bamcaphukisa ngokukodwa ngokunqula izithixo, bamkhweletisa ngemifanekiso ababeyinqula.
Akuyibona le nto uThixo waqumba kangangokuba wasuka wamhlamba uSirayeli.
Ewe, wafuduka emzini wakhe eShilo, wayishiya indlu awayehlala kuyo phakathi kwabantu.
Wabayekela yathinjwa ityesi yomnqophiso, iqhayiya labo lemka notshaba.
Abantu bakhe baba zizisulu zekrele, ilifa lakhe waliqwenga ngengqumbo.
Abafana batshayelwa ngumlilo, zatsho iintombi zaphoswa ngumtshato.
