Ababingeleli bageqwa likrele, kodwa abahlolokazi babo àbalila.
INkosi yathi khwaphuphu njengobelele, njengegorha elishushiswa yiwayini.
Wazikhaba iintshaba zakhe, zatsho zaxabheleka umlibe.
Wayilahla indlu kaJosefu, wayibukula indlu kaEfrayim.
Kodwa wayichonga indlu kaJuda, intaba iZiyon ayithandayo.
Wayakha yafana nezulu indlu yakhe; ikhaya lakhe sisimakade, linjengomhlaba.
Wasinyula isicaka sakhe uDavide, wasiphuthuma ekwaluseni.
Wamkhupha ekwaluseni amatakane, wamenza umalusi wabantu bakhe, wangumalusi kaSirayeli ilifa lakhe.
Wabalusa ngokuzimisela nangenyameko; ewe, wabakhokela ngobuchule.
Iintshaba ziwuhlasele umhlaba wakho, Thixo; ziyixabhele indlu yakho engcwele, iJerusalem itsho yalinxuwa.
Imizimba yezicaka zakho kukutya kweentaka, izidumbu zazo zityiwa ziinyamakazi.
Igazi lazo laphalala njengamanzi, laba ngumgxobhozo ojikelez' iJerusalem, kungekho bani wokuzifihla.
Sesiyintlekisa kubamelwane; bayakrwecana bephoxisa ngathi.
Koda kube nini, *Ndikhoyo? Uya kusoloko ucaphukile? Lohlala livutha ikhwele lakho?
Wugalele ezintlangeni umsindo wakho, kwabo bangakukhathalelanga wena, kwizikumkani ezingakunquliyo.
Kuba bamqwengile uYakobi, babhuqe bavuthulula konke.
Ungasixhibi ngenxa yezono zoobawo; nceda velana nathi kuba siphelelwe.
Khawuncede usisindise, Thixo wethu, ngenxa yesidima segama lakho. Sihlangule usixolele amatyala ethu ngenxa yegama lakho.
Ngani ukuba iintlanga zide zithi: “Uphi lo Thixo wabo?” Liphindezele igazi lezicaka zakho; masikubone uzohlwaya iintlanga.
Yive incwina yâbo bathinjiweyo; ngaloo mandla akho basindise abo bagwetyelwe ukufa.
Babuyisele kasixhenxe abamelwane ngenxa yezenyeliso abakuthuka ngazo, Mhlekazi.
Ke thina bantu baziigusha ozalusayo siya kukubulela njalo-njalo; ewe, soze sipheze ukukuncoma!
Khawubek' iindlebe, malusi kaSirayeli! Wena makhokel' uJosefu njengomhlambi, wena osesihlalweni *ngakwizithunywa ezimaphiko,
khanya kwaEfrayim nakwaBhenjamin nakwaManase; ngaloo mandla akho yiza usisindise.
Awu, Thixo, yiba nebuyambo; velana nathi usisindise!
*Ndikhoyo Thixo onamandla onke, koda kube nini ungayamkeli imithandazo yabantu bakho?
Wena usondle ngeentsizi, wasiseza iinyembezi.
Usitsho abamelwane baxhwithana ngathi; ngoku iintshaba zihlekisa ngathi.
Awu, Thixo Somandla, yiba nebuyambo; velana nathi usisindise!
Wena weza nomdiliya eJiputa, wazigxotha iintlanga, watyala wona.
Walima wawulungiselela umhlaba, wamila waxanda emhlabeni wonke.
Ithunzi lawo lafikelela ezintabeni, lawagquma amasebe emisedare.
Amasebe awo afikelela elwandle, iingcambu zafikelela e-Efrati.
Uludilizeleni ke uthango lwawo, abadlulayo sebegqwathula iziqhamo nje?
Ngoku sewunqunqudwa nayingulube; iinyamakazi zizifikisela kuwo.
Khawusivelele, Thixo onamandla onke; khawuphos' amehlo uzibonele, uwuhlangule umdiliya.
Nditsho isebe owalityalayo, ewe, elo latyalwa zizandla zakho.
Bawugecile baza bawutshisa; batshabalalise ngomsindo wakho.
Kodwa ke basindise abantu bakho abayinqobo, abo uzomelezele bona.
Thina ke soze sabuya mva; sihlaziye saye sohlala sikudumisa.
Awu, Thixo Somandla, yiba nebuyambo; velana nathi usisindise!
Dandulukani ngovuyo, nibonge uThixo osikhuselayo; memelelani nidumise uThixo kaYakobi.
Hlabelani nitsho ngohadi; dlobani ngoncuthu lweehapu neekatala.
Vuthelani ixilongo ukuthwasa kwenyanga, nasekuhlanganeni kwenyanga mhla ngetheko.
Kaloku lowo ngummiselo wakwaSirayeli, lisiko loThixo kaYakobi.
Walenza langummiselo kwaSirayeli, mhla wahlasela elamaJiputa. Ndiva ilizwi endingaliqondiyo, lisithi:
“Ndawothula umthwalo owawusemagxeni enu, zaxibilika iingobozi ezandleni.
Nakhala ngomhla wengxingongo, ndanihlangula; ndaniphendula ndingabonakali ndisezindudumeni; ndanivavanya emthonjeni waseMeribha.
“Ndathi sigqaleni isilumkiso sam, bantu bam; Sirayeli, akwaba ubuya kundiva!
Ze ningamnquli *uthixo wesinye isizwe; ongomnye eningamaziyo ze ningamnquli.
Ndim mna *Ndikhoyo uThixo wenu owanikhuphayo kwelamaJiputa; khamisani, mna ndiza kunifunza.
“Phi ke! Abantu bam zange baphulaphule; abafunanga nokuva oku ngam.
Ndaza ke ndabayekela kwezo nkani zabo, ukuze benze ngokuthanda kwabo.
Ngamana nandiphulaphula, bantu bam; akwaba ubungandithobela, Sirayeli.
Bendingazigeqayo iintshaba zakho; ewe, bendiya kuzinyhasha iintshaba zakho.
Abamthiyileyo uNdikhoyo bebeya kushwabana, isigwebo sabo sibe ngumlibe.
Bendiya kunondla ngeyona-yona ngqolowa, ndinanelise ngobusi obupholileyo.”
UThixo uchophele intlanganiso *yoothixo; nguye olawulayo koothixo bonke;
uthi: “Kunini nilawula ngegobe, nibabonelela abakhohlakeleyo!
Khanilungiselele abaxakekileyo neenkedama, nibonelele iintsizana namahlwempu.
Khanikhulule abahlelelekileyo nama-athalala; bahlanguleni abagonyamelwa zizikhohlakali.
“Basemnyameni ombode-mbode; bayafathula njengempumputhela, nangona lona ihlabathi lizama-zama.
Ndithi: Ewe kambe, ningoothixo; nonke ningoonyana bakaPhezukonke.
Kambe ke niya kufa njengamntu wonke, nibhange njengamatshawe.”
Awu, Thixo, khawulingenele ngomgwebo ihlabathi; andithi kaloku zonke izizwe zisesandleni sakho!
Awu, Thixo, ungathini ukuthi cwaka? Ngani ukuba wonwabe, Thixo?
Nâzo iintshaba zakho zikuvukela. Nâbo abakuthiyileyo bephithizela.
Ewe, babenzela amayelenqe abantu bakho; badibene ngabo abo ubakhuselayo.
Bathi: “Yizani sisibhangise esi sizwe, uSirayeli angabi sakhunjulwa.”
Kaloku bona bathetha nto-nye, bevana ngawe ngegobe.
Nditsho amaEdom namaIshmayeli, amaMowabhi kunye namaHagare,
amaGebhali, ama-Amoni, nama-Amaleki, amaFilistiya nabemi baseTire.
Angenelele nama-Asiriya, bebonke bancedisana nenzala kaLothe.
Khawubafumanise esamaMidiyan ngomhla kaSisera noJabhin entlanjeni iKishon,
abatshabalela e-Endore, banyhashwa batsho bangumgquba.
Iinjengele zabo zifanise no-Orebhe noZebhe; amatshawe abo wanyhashe njengoZebha noZalmuna.
Kaloku bona bafuna ukuwohlutha umhlaba wabantu olibango likaThixo.
Thixo wam, baphephethe njengothuli, babe njengomququ ophetshethwa ngumoya.
Mabatshayelwe okwehlathi lilenywa ngumlilo, okweentaba zibhuqwa ngumlilo.
Ewe, yiba sisitshu emva kwabo, barhwaqelise ngesaqhwithi.
Mabambatshe bade banyoshoze, ukuze badane bakulangazelele, *Ndikhoyo.
Baswantsulise, bahlale bengcungcutheka; ewe, mabafele ehlazweni.
Mabavume ukuba nguwe wedwa onguNdikhoyo, uPhezukonke obhijel' ihlabathi jikelele.
Hay' ubuhle nokuthandeka komzi wakho, *Ndikhoyo onamandla onke.
Umphefumlo wam uzele lulangazelelo; ewe, ulangazelela inkundla yakwakho, Ndikhoyo. Ndiyamemelela ndicula ngochulumacho, ndidumisa uThixo ophilayo.
Namasomi azakhela iindlwana zawo khona; kwaneenkonjane zifumana ikhaya khona. Amathole azo ziwagcina *esibingelelweni sakho, Ndikhoyo onamandla onke, wena kumkani noThixo wam.
Hay' ithamsanqa lâbo bahlala endlwini yakho, abasoloko bentyiloza bememelela bebonga wena.
Hay' ithamsanqa labantu abaxhotyiswa nguwe, abasoloko belangazelela ukuya eZiyon.
Bathi xa bedlula kwelibharhileyo kutsho kugqabhuke imithombo, iimvula zokuqala zilitsho lithi thande ngamaqula.
Baya besomelela ngokomelela, bade bavele phambi koThixo eZiyon.
Ndikhoyo, Thixo Somandla, wuve umthandazo wam; ndiphulaphule, Thixo kaYakobi.
Thixo, mbone ukumkani wethu; mvelele umamkele umthanjiswa wakho.
Imini enye echithelwe kwakho, Thixo, ingaphezulu kwewaka lemihla echithwe ndaweni yimbi. Kubhetele ndibe ngumgcini-mnyango kwaThixo ndaweni yokungqendeva phakathi kwezaphula-mthetho.
Kaloku uNdikhoyo uThixo ngumkhuseli nelanga lethu; usithi jize ngendili nangobubele. UNdikhoyo akazibandezi izinto ezintle kwabo bamthobela ngokupheleleyo.
Hay' ithamsanqa lomntu okholosa ngawe, Ndikhoyo onamandla onke!
Ewe, *Ndikhoyo, ulazelelele eli lizwe; uYakobi umthe jize ngendyebo nenkqubela.
Ubaxolele abantu bakho ngobugwenxa babo; ubuye wazilibala izono zabo.
Ubuye wayibamba ingqumbo yakho; uphinde wathomalala umsindo wakho.
Yiba nebuyambo, Thixo, usisindise, ungabi sakhathazeka sithi.
Ngani ukuba ungabi saphela umsindo wakho? Koda kube zizizukulwana ucaphukile na?
Nceda ubuye usihlaziye, abantu bakho bagcobe ngawe.
Maziphuphumele kuthi izibele zothando lwakho; awu, Ndikhoyo, sithi jize ngenkululeko yakho.
Mandiweve amazwi kaNdikhoyo uThixo; kaloku uzisa uxolo kubantu bakhe, kwabo bayimilowo yakhe engajika-jikiyo.
Ngenene usindiso lwakhe lukufuphi kwabo bamthobelayo; nobungangamsha bakhe bohlala kweli lizwe.
Kodibana uthando nokunyaniseka, ubulungisa noxolo bulale ngengub' enye.
Ukunyaniseka kuya kuntshula emhlabeni; ubulungisa bona boqwalasela busesibhakabhakeni.
Ewe, uNdikhoyo wosithi jize ngenkqubela, lona ilizwe lethu libe yintombazana.
Yena uya kukhokelwa bubulungisa; ewe, buya kumgabulela izigcawu.
Khawusabele, *Ndikhoyo, undilungiselele; kaloku mna ndiyimpula kalujaca.
Ndikhusele kaloku, kuba ndiyakuthobela; sihlangule isicaka esikholosa ngawe.
UnguThixo wam, ndibabale, Nkosi. Kaloku mna ndihlala ndikhala kuwe.
Ewe, khawusonwabise isicaka sakho. Nkosi, ndiwunyusela kuwe umthandazo wam.
Kuba wena, Nkosi, ulungile, uyaxolela; uphuphuma luthando kwabo bakholosa ngawe.
Ndikhoyo, wuve umthandazo wam; khawundivele, ndiyakubongoza.
Ndakuba sengxakini, ndibhenela kuwe, kuba wena uyavelana nam.
Nkosi, kubo bonke *oothixo akakho onjengawe, engekho nonemisebenzi enjengeyakho.
Zonke izizwe owazidalayo ziya kukhahlela kuwe, Nkosi, zibonga zibabaza igama lakho.
Kuba wena uyingangalala, uyamangalisa; ewe, nguwe wedwa uThixo.
Khawundifundise iindlela zakho, Ndikhoyo, khon' ukuze ndinamathele enyanisweni. Ewe, ndifundise ukukuhlonela, Nkosi; ndikunqule ndingankwalambisi.
Ndikubulela ngomxhelo wam wonke, Nkosi; Thixo wam, ndolidumisa njalo igama lakho,
kuba ziyandimangalisa izibele zakho; undihlangule enzonzobileni yengcwaba.
Awu, Thixo, zindivukele izibhoja. Ewe, izikrelemnqa ziyandizingela; zona azikukhathalele nganto.
Kambe ke wena, Nkosi, unguThixo onenceba nesisa. Wena ucaphuka kade, uphuphuma uthando nokunyaniseka.
Buya uvelane nam; khawusomeleze isicaka sakho, umhlangule unyana wesicakazana sakho.
Ndinike umqondiso wokundazelelela kwakho, ukuze abandithiyileyo babone badane, kuba wena, Ndikhoyo, undincedile wandithuthuzela.
*UNdikhoyo wasithi zinzi isixeko sakhe phezu kwentaba engcwele.
Ewe, yena akaziva ngeZiyon; ingaphezu kwayo yonke imizi yakwaYakobi.
Ewe, kuthethwa kamnandi ngawe, Ziyon, sixeko sikaThixo:
“Phakathi kwabo bandaziyo ndibalula iJiputa neBhabheli; ewe, amaFilistiya, amaTire, namaKushe, xa ewonke aphuma eJerusalem.”
IZiyon kuya kuthiwa ngunozala wezizwe zonke, kuba uPhezukonke uyayixhasa.
Akuzidwelisa zonke izizwe uNdikhoyo, xa zizonke zoba ngabemi baseJerusalem.
Iimvumi nabangqungqayo baya kuthi: “Thina singabomthonyama.”
Emini ndibhenela kuwe, *Ndikhoyo, Msindisi wam; nasebusuku ndizibika kuwe, Thixo wam.
Mawuvakale umthandazo wam kuwe; ndive xa ndikhala kuwe, Thixo wam.
Kuba ndiphahlwe ziinkxwaleko; sendimi phezu kwengcwaba.
Ewe, sendibalelwa kubafi; akusekho yam kwaphela.
Sendinikelwe kwabafileyo; sendifana nowoselweyo othe gangalala engcwabeni. Ndinjengâbo ungasabakhumbuliyo, abo bangasenakuncedakala.
Undithe tywa kwelimnyama ingcwaba, ezantsi emathunjini omhlaba.
Ingqumbo yakho indisibekele, amaza alatyuzayo andongamele.
Undihluthe izihlobo zam ezisenyongweni; kungokunje ziyandenyanya. Ndixinekile, futhi andisenakuphuncula;
ndiyayengezelisa ngenxa yembandezelo. Ndikhoyo, ndikhala kuwe yonke imihla; ndiphakamela kuwe ngomthandazo.
Imimangaliso ngaba uyenzela abafileyo na? Boze bavuke bakudumise na?
Uthando lwakho luxelwa ngabafileyo na? Ukunyaniseka kwakho kwaziwa kwantshabalala na?
Ngaba imimangaliso yakho yaziwa enzonzobileni na? Okanye usindiso lwakho lusebenza kwelokulibala na?
Hayi bo! Ndikhoyo, ndibhenela kuwe; ntsasa zonke ndizibika kuwe.
Awu, Ndikhoyo, ngani ukuba undilahle? Ngani ukuba undifulathele?
Ndaxhwaleka ndasemngciphekweni kwandisemtsha; ndiyangcungcutheka, andisento yanto.
Ingqumbo yakho iyandigubungela; ewe, izithonga zakho zindicim' igama,
zindirhawula njengamanzi imini yonke, zindigubungela ngeenxa zonke.
Undihluthe izihlobo nezizalwane zam; ngoku sendihlobene nobumnyama kuphela.
*Ndikhoyo, ndiya kucula ngezibele zakho njalo-njalo; ukuthembeka kwakho ndokubhengeza kuzo zonke izizukulwana.
Ndiya kububengeza obakho ububele ukuba soze butshitshe; ukuthembeka kwakho ukuzinzisile emazulwini.
Kaloku wena wathi: “Ndenze umnqophiso kunye nomnyulwa wam; ndinqophisene nesicaka sam uDavide, ndathi:
‘Ndiya kuyimisela ngonaphakade inzala yakho; ndoluxhasa ulawulo lwakho lungabi nasiphelo.’ ”
Amazulu ababaza imimangaliso yakho, Ndikhoyo, ukuthembeka kwakho ebandleni lemilowo yakwakho!
Esibhakabhakeni ngubani onokulinganiswa nawe, Ndikhoyo, ingubani kwabasemazulwini ofana nawe?
UnguThixo ohlonelwayo kwibandla labamsulwa; umkhulu uyoyikeka ngaphezu kwabo bonke abakungqongileyo.
Ndikhoyo, Thixo onamandla onke, ngubani oyingangamsha njengawe? Ngeendlela zonke uthembekile!
Iilwandle ezinzongo-nzongo zilawulwa nguwe; wena uyawazolisa amaza agugumayo.
Wena wasinyhasha isilo esikhulu saselwandle; ngaloo mandla akho wazisarhaza iintshaba zakho.
Amazulu ngokunjalo nehlabathi lelakho; ihlabathi nako konke okukulo kwasekwa nguwe.
Umntla nomzantsi wadalwa kwanguwe; iintaba iTabhore neHermon ziyakudumisa.
Ubungangamsha bakho buyakhamnqisa; ubugorha nobukroti bakho buyamangalisa.
Ulawulo lwakho lusekwe ngobulungisa nolungelelwano; wena ukhokelwa bububele nokuthembeka.
Basethamsanqeni abantu abakubhengeza ngendumiso; ewe, Ndikhoyo, abo basoloko bekufutshane nawe,
abonwatyiswa nguwe imini yonke, bekudumisa ngenxa yobulungisa bakho.
Wena uyindili yokomelela kwabo; batshatshele kuba baxhaswa nguwe.
LikuNdikhoyo ikhaka lethu; ukumkani wethu uvela koyiNgcwele kaSirayeli.
Kwamandulo wena wathetha ngombono nâbo bathembekileyo, wathi: “Ndiyithe jize ngembasa ingangalala; ulawulo ndilunikele umfana okhethwe ebantwini.
Ndimfumene uDavide isicaka sam; yena ndimthambise ngamafutha angcwele.
Ke ngoko isandla sam soba naye njalo-njalo; ewe, uya komelezwa ndim.
Akasoze onganyelwe lutshaba, nezibhoja soze zimthibaze.
Ndiya kuzinyhasha iintshaba zakhe, ndibatshabalalise abo bamthiyileyo.
Ndohlala ndimthanda, ndilithemba lakhe; ndiya kumenza ahlale eyintshatsheli.
Ulawulo lwakhe luya kuma ngeelwandle, luya kuthi xhaxhe ngemilambo.
Uya kubhenela kum, athi: ‘Wena unguTata; unguThixo wam, umqolomba ondihlangulayo.’
Yena uya kuba yinkulu yam, abe yingangalala yookumkani behlabathi.
Ububele bam kuye buya kuma njalo-njalo; umnqophiso wam naye soze utshitshe.
Ulawulo soze luphume endlwini yakhe; Ewe, lona lohlala luhleli njengamazulu.
“Sothi isizukulwana sakhe sakundilahla, ewe, sakuyilahla imiyalelo yam,
ukuba sithe sayaphula imimiselo yam, asayithobela imithetho yam,
ndisohlwaye ngoswazi, ndibakatse ngenxa yesono sabo.
Kambe ke soze ndipheze ukumthanda, ingasoze inxaxhe intembeko yam.
Soze ndiwutshitshise umnqophiso wam, lingasoze liwe phantsi ilizwi endalithethayo.
Ewe, kaloku ndafunga ubungcwele bam, ngoko ke soze ndimxokise uDavide.
Indlu yakhe soze ithini nanini-nanini; ulawulo lwakhe luqiniseke njengelanga.
Soze luthini, lunjengenyanga yona ilingqina elithembekileyo elisesibhakabhakeni.”
Phi ke, ngoku umlahlile nje, wanengcwangu ngakumthanjiswa wakho?
Uwutshitshisile umnqophiso wakho nesicaka sakho; uyohluthile naloo mbasa yakhe.
Uzidilizile iindonga zesixeko sakhe; uzitsho zangamabhodlo iinqaba zakhe.
Ngoku abadlulayo bayazixhwithela; uyintlekisa nakubamelwane bakhe.
Wena uziphakamisile iintshaba zakhe; iintshaba zakhe ziyamqholosela.
Ewe, ikrele lakho ulitsho layindunyuva; ngoku usisisulu edabini.
Uwohluthile umsimbithi oliwonga lakhe, walubhangisa ulawulo lwakhe.
Uyinqamle imihla yobutsha bakhe; ewe, umthe wambu ngehlazo.
*Ndikhoyo, koda kube nini ufulathele – ngumlibe na? Koda kube nini ivutha njengomlilo ingqumbo yakho?
Ndikhoyo, khawukhumbule ukuba bufutshane kwabo ubomi bam; khumbula ukungabi nto kwabo ubomi bomntu.
Nguwuphi umntu oya kuhlala ngonaphakade, ingubani ongaliphephayo ingcwaba?
Nkosi, zaya ngaphi izibele zakho zamandulo, nditsho ezo wazifungela uDavide?
Nkosi, khawukubone ukungcikivwa kwesicaka sakho, ndlela le ndijijithekiswa yintlamba yoluntu ngayo.
Ndikhoyo, iintshaba zihlekisa ngam; ewe, ziphoxisa ngaye umthanjiswa wakho naphi na apho anyathela khona.
Huntshu-u-u! UNdikhoyo ngowokubongwa naphakade! Makube njalo – ewe; amen!
Usoloko ulikhaya lethu, wena Nkosi, izizukulwana ngezizukulwana.
Zingekadalwa iintaba, ungekalenzi ilizwe nehlabathi, ubusel' ukade unguThixo wena kwanini-nini.
Umbuyisela kwaseluthulini umntu, usithi: “Buyela apho ubuvela khona, mntundini!”
Linjengemini enye iwaka leminyaka kuwe, lona liyafana nemini yezolo, lifutshane okwexesha labalindi ebusuku.
Uphephetheka njengephepha umntu; uphela okobuthongo, abune njengengca,
yona iba luhlaza kusasa, ithi kwakuhlwa ibe selintshwenyile.
Siyaphela kaloku yingqumbo yakho, uyasigqiba umsindo wakho.
Izono zethu zaziwa nguwe, nezifihliweyo zisekuhleni kuwe.
Uyinqumle imihla yethu ngenxa yomsindo, yadlula ngathi kukuqhwanyaza.
Iminyaka yomntu iba ngamashum' asixhenxe, xa ngaba womelele ibe ngamashum' asibhozo; kodwa iza neenkxwaleko neentsizi, imihla yethu ithi tshe iphele.
Ngubani owaziyo umsindo wakho; ingubani oluqondayo unkwantyo oluza nengqumbo yakho?
Sifundise ukuyiqingqa imihla yethu, ukuze sizuze ubulumko.
Yiba nebuyambo, *Ndikhoyo; koda kube nini usifulathele? Yiba nenceba kuthi zicaka zakho.
Sithululele izibele zakho kwangentseni, size sonwabe, simemelele yonke imihla yobomi bethu.
Sithuthuzele kaloku wakuba usohlwayile; sonwabe kangangoko ubusibandezele.
Bubonakalise ububele bakho kuthi zicaka zakho, ukuze nesizukulwana sethu sisazi isihomo sakho.
Nkosi, Thixo, sithamsanqelise! Siphumelelise kuyo yonke imizamo yethu; ewe, yiphumelelise yonke imizamo yethu.
Lowo uhleli ekhuselwe nguPhezukonke, uhlala esemthunzini kaSomandla.
Yena uya kuthi: “*Ndikhoyo, ungumkhuseli wam; uyinqaba yam, wena Thixo, ndiya kuthembela kuwe.”
Kuba nguye okuhlangula emgibeni wabakugcayiseleyo nakubhubhani wesifo,
akwambathise ngamaphiko akhe, akufihle ekhusini lakhe, kube likhaka nekhuselo lakho ukuthembeka kwakhe.
Akuyi koyika zingozi zasebusuku, nakuhlaselwa ngequbuliso emini,
nabhubhani wangobusuku, nasifo sigqugqisayo emini emaqanda.
Nokuba kungawa iwaka ecaleni kwakho, neshumi lamawaka liwe likungqonge, akusayi kuchukunyiswa nto wena.
Uya kuqwalasela ukubone ngamehlo akho ukohlwaywa kwawo amatshijolo.
Ngenxa yokuba uthembele ngoNdikhoyo, wamenza umkhuseli wakho uPhezukonke,
akuyi kuhlelwa bubi; akuyi kusondela nasibetho emzini wakho.
Kaloku woziwisela umthetho ngawe izithunywa zakhe wokuba zikugcine endleleni yakho,
zikufunqule hleze ukhubeke elityeni.
Wonyathela phezu kweengonyama neenyoka, unyhashe amathol' eengonyama noogqoloma.
Ngenxa yokuba endithanda, ndomhlangula; ndimphakamise, kuba elazi igama lam.
Akuzibika kum, ndiya kumva; ndiya kuba naye ezimbandezelweni, ndimhlangule, ndimbek' ezimbekweni,
ndimvuze ngobomi obude, ndimbonise ukuba ndiyasindisa.
Yinto entle ukumbulela *uNdikhoyo; yinto entle ukubonga igama loPhezukonke.
Kulungil' ukubalisa ngezibele zakhe kusasa, nangokunyaniseka kwakhe ngokuhlwa,
kuvakala uncuthu lwengoma yeentambula, nehapu itsho ngesongo sengom' emyoli.
Kub' undivuyisile, Ndikhoyo, ngezinto ondenzele zona; ndokubonga ndinemincili ngenxa yemisebenzi yakho.
Hay' ukubaluleka kwemisebenzi yakho, Ndikhoyo! Hay' ukuba nzulu kweengcamango zakho!
Isidenge asinakuyazi loo nto, nesiyatha asinako ukukuqiqa:
le yokuba amatshijolo aya kubhangiswa, nokuba selede amila njengokhula, nokuba selede aphumelela.
Kaloku wena, Ndikhoyo, unguPhezukonke; wena unguye nanini-nanini.
Iintshaba zakho, Ndikhoyo, zotshabalala kuphele, kananjalo abhangiswe onke amatshijolo.
Undomeleze ndanga ndiyinyathi; undithe jize ngombhiyozo nolonwabo.
Ndikubone ngala wam amehlo ukuwa kweentshaba zam; ndiyive ngezi zam iindlebe intshabalalo yâbo bandizungulayo.
Amalungisa achuma njengesundu, akhula njengemisedare yaseLibhanon.
Amilile emzini kaNdikhoyo; ayakhula endlwini kaThixo.
Avelisa iziqhamo naxa selaluphele, aqhelezele omelele.
Kutheth' ukuthi ke uNdikhoyo ulilungisa, yena ngumkhuseli wam, akukho khwiniba kuye.
*UNdikhoyo ungukumkani; uthe wambu isihomo nesithozela namandla. Ewe, ulimise zinzi ihlabathi, aligungqi.
Isihlalo sakho, Ndikhoyo, sasekwa kwantlandlolo; wena wawukho kwanini-nini.
Iyagquma imilambo, Ndikhoyo, ivakalisa isandi sayo; iyavakala imigqumo yayo.
UNdikhoyo yingangalala yaphezulu; unamandla kunamaza alephuzayo, nangaphezu kwamaza agqumayo.
Imiqondiso yakho ayiguquki, Ndikhoyo; iyingcwele ngenene indlu yakho, Ndikhoyo, kuya kuda kube nini-nini.
*Ndikhoyo, Thixo ongumgwebi, wena Thixo ophindezelayo, zibonakalise.
Lamla, wena mgwebi woluntu; babuyekeze kwangezitya zabo abantw' abazingcayo!
Koda kube nini na, Ndikhoyo, koda kube nini kakade esivuyelela amatshijolo?
Koda kube nini eqhayisa; koda kube nini ezidla ngokungcola kwawo?
Ayababulala abantu bakho, Ndikhoyo; ayawucinezela umzi wakho amatshijolo.
abandezele abahlolokazi neenkedama, abulale nabantu basemzini.
Ade athi: “Akaboni nto uNdikhoyo; akaqondi konke uThixo kaYakobi.”
Lumkani, bantundini bazizidenge! Noda niqiqe nini, zityhifilindini?
Nithini? Nithi uThixo owadala iindlebe akeva? Nithi lo wenza amehlo enu akaboni?
Lo ulawula zonk' iintlanga nithi akanakuzohlwaya? Lo ufundise abantu nithi akazi nto?
Ulogocagoca iingcinga zabantu, uyazi ukuba zibubuvuvu nje bodwa.
Unoyolo lowo uyalwa nguwe, Ndikhoyo; nditsho ofundiswa nguwe umyalelo wakho.

Kaloku akayi kubafulathela abantu bakhe uNdikhoyo; akasoze ayilahle indlu yakhe.
Kobakho ubulungisa ezinkundleni, abulandele onke amalungisa.
Azi, ngubani owondilwela kumatshijolo? Yoba ngubani na ongakum?
Ukuba bendingancedwanga nguNdikhoyo, ngesele ndikwantsonga-nyawana.
Xa ndandisendisithi ndiyoyisakala, wandixhasa ngezibele zakho wena, Ndikhoyo.
Xa ndandinxubile, ndixhalabile, wandithuthuzela, wandonwabisa wena.
Akunabudlelana nabalawuli abakhohlakeleyo, bona bayenza umthetho intswela-bulungisa.
Bayalihlanganyela ilungisa bona, bamgwebele ukufa umnt' engenatyala.
Kodwa ngumkhuseli wam yena uThixo; yinqaba endizimela ngayo.
UNdikhoyo wobohlwaya ngenxa yenkohlakalo yabo, batshabalalele kobo bugwenxa babo; wobabhangisa kuphele tu uThixo.
Yizani sombelele *uNdikhoyo, simculele sigcobile umkhuseli nomsindisi wethu!
Masiye kuye sinombulelo, simombelele iingoma zokubonga.
Kaloku uNdikhoyo nguThixo onamandla, ngukumkani omkhulu *kwizithixo zonke.
Lisesandleni sakhe ihlabathi liphela; iinzulu neencopho zilawulwa nguye.
Ulawula ulwandle kuba walwenza; nomhlaba wawudala ngezandla zakhe.

Mombeleleni ingoma entsha *uNdikhoyo! Mombelel' uNdikhoyo, hlabathi lonke!
Mombelelen' uNdikhoyo, nibonge igama lakhe; zivakaliseni mihla le iindaba zakhe zosindiso.

Mbongeni uNdikhoyo, nina bemi bomhlaba; mbongeni kuba unewonga namagunya.

Gcobani nonke malungisa, nibulel' uNdikhoyo ngezintw' ezintl' anenzele zona.
Mombelelen' ingoma entsha *uNdikhoyo, kuba unenzele izinto ezintle. Kaloku woyisile ngamandla akhe nangegunya lakhe.

Mombeleleni ngemihlali uNdikhoyo, nonke hlabathi! Dandulukani, nimemelele, nivum' imibongo!
Mbongeni uNdikhoyo ngesandi sengoma yehapu; mbethelen' uncuthu lwengoma ngehapu.
Bethan' amaxilongo, kukhal' isigodlo, nenz' intshol' emnandi phambi koNdikhoyo ukumkani.
Gquma, wena lwandle, nako konk' okukuwe; nawe hlabathi, hlabel' ingoma!
Bethan' izandla, milambo; nani zinduli, mombelelen' uNdikhoyo!
Kuba uza kuligweb' ihlabathi, alawule konke ngobulungisa, engenamkhethe.

UNdikhoyo yingangalala eZiyon; ngumlawuli wazo zonk' iintlanga.

Wayethetha nabo ekwintshinyela yelifu, kuba babeyithobela imiyalelo nemithetho yakhe.
Ewe, Ndikhoyo, Thixo, wabeva abantu bakho; wababonisa ukuba unguThixo oxolelayo, kodwa ukwangoyohlwayayo intw' embi.
Mbongeni uNdikhoyo uThixo wethu. Mnquleleni entabeni yakhe eyodwa! Kaloku ungcwele uNdikhoyo uThixo wethu.
Mombeleleni *uNdikhoyo, nonke hlabathi!
Mnquleni uNdikhoyo nivuya, nize kuye nisombela iingom' ezimyoli!
Yazin' ukuba uNdikhoyo nguThixo; nguye owasidalayo, yaye singabakhe, singabantu bakhe, singumhlambi wakhe.

Kaloku lilunga uNdikhoyo; izibele zakhe ziya kuhlala zihleli, ahlale ethembekile kude kube nini-nini.
Igwijo lam lingentembeko nokulunga; ndiya kukombelela lona, *Ndikhoyo.

Andiyi kungathembeki; andiyi kusondela ebubini.
Ndomlumkela umnt' onentlebendwane, ndingalinyamezeli ikratsha negumasholo.
Ndobamkela abahlonela uThixo kwibhotwe lam, amagosa am abe ngabantw' abathembekileyo.
Akukho mkhohlisi uya kuba semzini wam, naxoki liya kuhlala apho ndikhoyo.

Ndikhoyo, wuve umthandazo wam, nesikhalo sam masifike kuwe!
Sukundizimela xa ndisebunzimeni; ndiphulaphule undive kamsinya ndakukhala.

Ndixusheke ndada ndalityéba; senditsho ndaphelelwa nangumdla wokutya.
Ndiyagcuma kukugula; andibhitye nditsho ndangamathambo.
Ndifana nesikhova enkangala; ndinjengesihulu-hulu senxiwa.
Ndilal' obentaka kukumana ndiphuthelwa; ndifana nentak' ehleli yodwa exhantini.
Ziyandigxibha yonk' imini iintshaba zam; ziphoxisa ngam, ziqalekisana ngegama lam.
Ndinesingqala, ukutya akuvumi kuhla; intw' endiyiselayo seliziinyembezi zam.

Ziyayithand' izicaka zakho, naxa seliziindonga nje; ziyahlabeka xa ziyibona selingamabhodlo iZiyon.
Zolihlonel' igama likaNdikhoyo zonk' iintlanga, neekumkani zonke zisibeke isihomo sakhe.
Kuba kaloku uNdikhoyo woyivusa iZiyon, sicace ke isidima nesithozela sakhe.
Uyawuva umthandazo weendwayi, azisabele nezicelo zazo.
Le mbali mayibhalelwe isizukulwana esizayo ze bamdumise uNdikhoyo nâbo bangekazalwa.

Mna uNdikhoyo wandaphul' iimpondo ndiselula, wayifinyeza imihla yobomi bam.
Kodwa ndazibika ndathi: “Thixo wam, sukundithatha kwangoku ndingekaluphali. “Wena uzityhutyha zonke izizukulwana;
ladalwa nguwe kwantlandlolo ihlabathi; enziwa nguwe nawo amazulu.
Xa zizonke ziya kudlula, ube wena usahleli; ziya kuguga njengeempahla, uzisonge njengeengubo. Zona ziya kutshintshwa njengesambatho,
ube wena ungaguquki, ube wena ungagugi.
Iintsapho zethu zohlala zikhuselekile, nenzala yabo yohlala phantsi kwekhusi lakho.”
Mbonge *uNdikhoyo, moya wam! Mandimbonge uNdikhoyo ngomxhelo wam wonke!
Moya wam, mbonge uNdikhoyo, ungaze uyilibale imisebenzi yakhe emihle nanini-nanini:
uloxolela zonk' izono zam; ulophilisa zonk' izifo endinazo;

NguNdikhoyo obonelela abacinezelweyo ubulungisa; ewe, nguye obagwebelayo bonke ngokungenaxanasi.

UNdikhoyo unenceba nesisa; uqumba kade, yimvuze-mvuze enobubele.

Bufana nomzali kubantwana ububele bukaNdikhoyo kwabamnik' imbeko.

UNdikhoyo ungqendev' esihlalweni sakhe ebhotw' ezulwini; ulawulo lwakhe luqhakamshela ihlabathi liphela.
Mbongeni uNdikhoyo, nina zithunywa zakhe ezinamandla; mbongeni, nina nibalasele ngokumthobela; liphulaphuleni ilizwi lakhe.

Zabekwa nguw' iziseko zomhlaba ze zingashuku-shukunyiswa bani.

Ikumkani yamhlangula, umlawuli wezizwe wamkhulula,

Naye uYakobi waya eJiputa, waba ngummi elizweni lakwaHam.
UNdikhoyo wabanika inzala eninzi abantu bakhe, wabanika amandla kunababandezeli babo.

Emva koko uthumele uMosis isicaka sakhe kunye noAron umnyulwa wakhe.

Amanzi emilambo ajika aligazi, zafa zaphela nezo ntlanzi zabo.
