Ndancekelela, ndathemba, nakuba ndandisithi sendivuthulukile.
Ekuncameni ndakhala ndathi: “Abathembekanga kambe abantu.”
Yaz'ba ndingambuyisela ngantoni na uNdikhoyo ngezibele ezingaka andenzele zona?
Ndothatha indebe yosindiso, ndibize igama likaNdikhoyo.
Izithembiso zam ndozifezekisa kuNdikhoyo; ewe, nditsho phambi kwabantu bakhe.
Ayithandeki kambe kuNdikhoyo into yokufa kwabantu bakhe.
Awu, Ndikhoyo, ndisisicaka sakho; ewe, ndingunyana wesicakazana sakho; ndilapha nje ndakhululwa nguwe.
Ndiya kukwenzela idini lombulelo; ewe, ndobiza igama likaNdikhoyo.
Izithembiso zam ndozifezekisa kuye; ewe, nditsho phambi kwabantu bakhe,
enkundleni yendlu kaNdikhoyo, kanye phakathi eJerusalem. Huntshu-u-u! Sithi: “Bayethe, Mhlekazi!”
Dandulukani nibong' *uNdikhoyo, nonke nina zintlanga! Mtyibeleni nimncome, nonke nina zizwe!
Kaloku izibele zakhe zibalasele ngakuthi; ibe ke uNdikhoyo wohlala enyanisekile kude kuse ephakadeni. Kungoko sisithi: “Bayethe, Mhlekazi!”
Mdumiseni *uNdikhoyo, kuba elungile; izibele zakhe zohlala zihleli.
Ewe, makatsho uSirayeli athi: “Izibele zakhe soze zitshitshe.”
Ngokunjalo nendlu ka-Aron mayithi: “Ngenene izibele zakhe soze zithini.”
Ewe, abamthobelayo uNdikhoyo mabathi: “Izibele zakhe zifikelela ephakadeni.”
Xa ndandisebunzimeni ndabhenela kuNdikhoyo, waza yena wasabela wandihlangula.
Andinadyudyu, kuba uNdikhoyo ungakum; okokwakhe yena umntu akanakundenza nto konke.
Ngenene uNdikhoyo ungakum, uyandinceda; ngoko ke ndiya kuboyisa abandithiyileyo.
Into ebhetele kukuzimela ngoNdikhoyo, kunokuba uthembele ngomntu.
Kubhetele ukholose ngoNdikhoyo, ndaweni yokukholosa ngamanene.
Ndakha ndarhawulwa ziintlanga, kodwa egameni likaNdikhoyo ndaziqwakanisa.
Ewe, zazindirhawule mbombo zone, kodwa ngamandla kaNdikhoyo ndalalisa ugodo.
Wena wakha wagutyungelwa libubu leenyosi? Hayi, zazidangazela njengomlilo wameva, kodwa ngamandla kaNdikhoyo ndaziswantsulisa.
Zazindityhala ndaphantse ndakhahlelwa phantsi, kodwa nalapho uNdikhoyo wandinceda.
Ingoma yam namandla am nguNdikhoyo; ewe kaloku, ndisindiswa nguye.
Nantso intsholo yoloyiso ivakala; kaloku amalungisa ayamemelela, athi: “Ubungangamsha bukaNdikhoyo bugqwesile;
amandla kaNdikhoyo abalasele; ewe, ubungangamsha bukaNdikhoyo bugqwesile!”
Mna andiyi kufa; ndiya kudla ubomi, ndibalise ngezenzo zikaNdikhoyo.
Yena undohlwaye kabukhali; kambe ke akandiyekelanga ekufeni.
Khanindivulele amasango endlu kaThixo, khon' ukuze ndingene ndidumise uNdikhoyo.
Nali isango lokungena kwaNdikhoyo; ngamalungisa odwa angenayo ngalo.
Ndiyabulela kuba undivile; kaloku wena ungumhlanguli wam.
Kaloku ilitye abalidelayo abakhi laba lelona libalulekileyo lesiseko.
Ewe, lo ngumsebenzi kaNdikhoyo; kambe ke thina uyasimangalisa.
Namhla kunamhla, yimini kaNdikhoyo; masizonwabise sibe nemihlali ngayo.
Sisindise, siyakubongoza, Ndikhoyo! Awu, siyatarhuzisa, Ndikhoyo; masiphumelele ngawe!
Banoyolo abangena ngegama likaNdikhoyo; siyanithamsanqela thina sisendlwini kaNdikhoyo.
UNdikhoyo nguThixo, usikhanyisele. Yenzani umngcelele wokubulela, niphethe amahlamvu, ningqungqe, nilijikeleze iqonga lamadini.
UnguThixo wam, ndiyakubulela; ubungangamsha bakho, Thixo, ndiya kububhengeza.
Mdumiseni uNdikhoyo, kuba elungile; izibele zakhe zohlala zihleli.
Hay' inyhweba yabantu abamsulwa; nditsho abo baziphatha ngokwemiyalelo *kaNdikhoyo.
Banoyolo abo bayithobelayo imfundiso kaNdikhoyo, abayilulamelayo ngomxhelo wabo wonke,
abantu abangabenziyo ububi, koko abahamba endleleni kaNdikhoyo.
Kaloku wena, Ndikhoyo, wasinika imimiselo yakho, ukuze siyithobele ngenyameko.
Akwaba bendingachul' ukunyathela, ndiyinonophele imithetho yakho.
Ukuba ndizibambile iziyalo zakho, andisoze ndibhaqwe lihlazo.
Ndakusazi isigwebo sakho esingenagobe, ndiya kukuncoma ngenene nangenyaniso.
Mna ndiya kuyithobela imithetho yakho; awu, nceda ungandilahli kuphele.
Lungaziphatha kanjani ulutsha ukuze ihambo yalo ibe nyulu? Ngokuthobela ilizwi lakho.
Ndizimisele ukukulandela ngokupheleleyo; ndincede ndingaze ndizidele iziyalo zakho.
Ndihamba ngokomlomo wakho, khon' ukuze ndingoni.
Awu! Bayethe, *Mhlekazi! Khawundifundise imithetho yakho.
Mna ndiya kuzibhengeza zonke izigqibo zakho.
Kum ziluyolo izithethe zakho; zingaphezu kwabo bonke ubutyebi.
Ndiya kucamngca ngemimiselo yakho, ndizinyamekele iindlela zakho.
Ndiyayithakazelela imithetho yakho; soze ndilityeshele ilizwi lakho.
Ndazelele, mna sicaka sakho, ukuze ndibudle ubomi, ndilithobele ilizwi lakho.
Nceda undivule amehlo, ndiziqonde iintsonkotha ezisemyalelweni wakho.
Ndilundwendwe apha emhlabeni; ndicacisele imiqathango yakho.
Umoya wam uhlala wonganyelwe kukulangazelela isigwebo sakho.
Wena uyabakhalimela abaziphakamisayo; baseshweni abanxaxhayo kwiziyalo zakho.
Ndihlambe kwizinyeliso nezigculelo, kuba ndiyayithobela imfundiso yakho.
Nokuba zingade zindibhunge iziphathamandla, mna sicaka sakho ndiya kucamngca ngemithetho yakho.
Kambe ke andiziva ngezithethe zakho, kuba ziyintonga yam yasekhosi.
Awu, ndiphelelwe, ndiyimvuthuluka; ndihlaziye ngokwesithembiso sakho.
Undivile ndakuzandlala; nceda undifundise imithetho yakho.
Ndifundise amasolotya emimiselo yakho, khon' ukuze ndicamngce ngemimangaliso yakho.
Iinzingo ziwuvikivile umoya wam; khawundomeleze ngokwelizwi lakho.
Ndihlangule kuyo inkohliso; ewe, ndibabale undifundise imiyalelo yakho.
Ndenze isigqibo sokuba ndinyaniseke; ndizimisele ukusithobela isigwebo sakho.
Ndinamathele kwizithethe zakho, *Ndikhoyo, ngoko ke mandingaphoxeki.
Ndiya kuhamba ngokwemiqathango yakho, kuba wena uyivulile ingqiqo yam.
Awu, *Ndikhoyo, ndifundise imithetho yakho, ukuze ndihlale ndiyithobela maxa onke.
Ndivule ingqondo, ndiwuthobele umyalelo wakho; ndiya kuwulandela ngomxhelo wam wonke.
Ndikhokele ngeziyalo zakho, kuba zona ziligugu lam.
Intliziyo yam mayinxanele imfundiso yakho ndaweni yokusukelana nenzuzo yobuqhophololo.
Ndincede ndingalibali zizinto eziphuthileyo; mandiphile ngokwenza ukuthanda kwakho.
Idinga lakho malifezekiswe kum, mna sicaka sakho; kaloku lelâbo bakuthobelayo.
Ndihlangule ezenyelisweni, kuba ndiyazoyika; ke zona izigqibo zakho zifezekile.
Ewe, andiziva ngemimiselo yakho; ndihlaziye ngobulungisa bakho.
*Ndikhoyo, ndibonise ububele bakho; mandiluxhamle usindiso ngokwesithembiso sakho.
Ndiya kuba nako ke ukujongana nabandenyelisayo, kuba ndikholosa ngelizwi lakho.
Ndincede ndiyithethe inyaniso, kuba ithemba lam zizigqibo zakho.
Ndohlala ndiwuthobela umyalelo wakho; ewe, kude kube ngunaphakade.
Mna ndiya kuxhamla inkululeko, kuba ndihamba ngemimiselo yakho.
Izithethe zakho ndozivakalisa nakwizinxiba-mxhaka, kuba kaloku mna andinadyudyu,
kuba iqhayiya lam ziziyalo zakho – andizithandi ngako, ndiphupha ngazo!
Ndiyayihlonela imiqathango yakho, nditsho leyo ndiyithandayo; ewe, ndicamngca ngemithetho yakho.
Ungalilibali idinga lakho kwisicaka sakho. Andithi kaloku wandithembisa!
Nasebunzimeni ndiyathuthuzeleka, kuba isithembiso sakho siyandihlaziya.
Abangakhathalele Thixo baphoxisa ngam; kambe ke mna andihexi emyalelweni wakho.
Ndakukhumbula izimiso zakho zantlandlolo, nditsho ndithuthuzeleke, *Ndikhoyo.
Ndikhathazeka gqitha ndakubona abanxaxhayo, abo bangawukhathalelanga umyalelo wakho.
Imithetho yakho yingoma yam; ndimemelela ngayo xa ndikwelasemzini.
Ndicinga ngawe noba ndilele, *Ndikhoyo; ewe, ndiyayithobela imiyalelo yakho.
Ngenene mna andinakumbi, koko ndithobela imimiselo yakho.
Ndathi ke mna: Isabelo sam nguwe, *Ndikhoyo; ndiya kulithobela ilizwi lakho.
Awu, velana nam, ndiyakubongoza; ndibabale ngokwesithembiso sakho.
Ndiyiqondile indlela endiziphethe ngayo; ngoko ke ndibuyela kwizithethe zakho.
Sendingxamile, andisayi kulibazisa; ndozithobela iziyalo zakho.
Noba bangandirhintyela abakhohlakeleyo, soze ndiwulibale umyalelo wakho.
Nasezinzulwini zobusuku ndiyavuka; ewe, ndivuka ndikudumise ngenxa yokusulungeka kwesigwebo sakho.
Amaqabane am ngabakuthobelayo, abahamba ngemimiselo yakho.
Ihlabathi liphuphuma izibele zakho, Ndikhoyo; nceda undifundise imithetho yakho.
*Ndikhoyo, usazelelele isicaka sakho; wenze ngokwesithembiso sakho.
Ndithi jize ngobulumko nokuqonda, kuba mna ndikholosa ngemiqathango yakho.
Phambi kokuba undohlwaye ndandibhadula, kodwa ngoku ndiyalithobela ilizwi lakho.
Hay' ukulunga kwakho, uyindlezane! Khawundifundise imithetho yakho.
Izikhohlakali zindityabeka ngobuxoki, kodwa mna ndithobela imimiselo yakho ngomxhelo wam wonke.
Zona zingamagumasholo angachukumisekiyo; ke mna ndithakazelela umyalelo wakho.
Ewe, tshotsh' undohlwaye, Ndikhoyo, ukuze ndiyifunde imithetho yakho.
Umyalelo wakho kum ubhetele kunobutyebi, nditsho nkqu nekhipha legolide nesiliva.
Ndinje nje nje ndidalwe nguwe; ndifundise ndiziqonde iziyalo zakho.
Abakuthobelayo bovuya bakundibona, kuba mna ndikholosa ngamadinga akho.
Ndiyakuvuma ukufaneleka kwesigwebo sakho; ewe, *Ndikhoyo, undohlwaye ngakhona.
Ndithuthuzele ngezibele zakho, njengoko wasithembisayo isicaka sakho.
Velana nam, ukuze ndiphile, kuba iqhayiya lam ngumyalelo wakho.
Zona izibhoja mazihlazeke, kuba zindirhintyela ngobuqili; ke mna ndocamngca ngemimiselo yakho.
Mabeze kum bonke abakuthobelayo, abo bayiqondayo imfundiso yakho.
Mandingabi nabala kwimithetho yakho, khon' ukuze ndingahlazeki.
*Ndikhoyo, kuncamekile kum, ndisindise! Ithemba lam lilizwi lakho.
Amehlo amnyama kukujong' enkalweni; yaz'ba uya kundithuthuzela nini na?
Andinto yanto, ndigqole oku kwentsuba yewayini esemsini; kambe ke andiyilibalanga imithetho yakho.
Koda kube nini sinyamezele isicaka sakho? Ngani ungabohlwayi nje abanditshutshisayo?
Abanekratshi bayandithiyela, abo bangawuthobeliyo umyalelo wakho.
Imiqathango yakho ithembekile; nceda, nâbo bendibhijela ngobuxoki.
Sebephantse bandicim' igama, kanti ke unotshe ukuba ndiyilahle imimiselo yakho.
Ngenxa yezibele zakho ndihlaziye, ukuze ndihambe ngokwezithethe zakho.
*Ndikhoyo, ilizwi lakho sisimakade; lithe zinzi emazulwini.
Wena uya kuhlala uthembekile; ihlabathi walenza, soze lashukuma.
Izigqibo zakho zohlala zihleli; iinto zonke zikhahlela kuwe.
Ukuba bendingawulangazeleli umyalelo wakho ngezindibulele iimbandezelo.
Soze ndiyityeshele imimiselo yakho, kuba ndibufumana kuyo ubomi.
Mna ndingowakho, ndisindise, kuba ndiyayilandela imimiselo yakho.
Abakhohlakeleyo bafuna ukunditshabalalisa; ke mna ndiyayetyisa imfundiso yakho.
Ndiyaqonda ukuba ayikho into efezekileyo; ke yona imiqathango yakho ayinantanga ngemfezeko.
Ndiyawuthanda kambe umyalelo wakho; ndiphicothana nawo imini yonke.
Iziyalo zakho zendele kum; zindenza ndilumke kuneentshaba zam.
Ndibavelele nabafundisayo, kuba ndizinonelele iimfundiso zakho.
Ngokuqonda nditshatshele nakwabadala, kuba ndiyazithobela izithethe zakho.
Ndiyazicezela iindlela ezinengozi, kuba ndithobela ilizwi lakho.
Andiphambuki kwisigwebo sakho, njengoko wandifundisayo.
Izithembiso zakho zimnandi, ziyanandipheka; ewe, ziyolile kunobusi.
Imfundiso yakho indivul' ingqondo, ngoko ke ndibuthiyil' ubugwenxa.
Ilizwi lakho sisibane sendlela yam; liyandikhanyisela eluhambeni.
Ndizibophelele ngesifungo; ndiya kusithobela isigwebo sakho.
*Ndikhoyo, ndixhwaleke ngokungathethekiyo; ndihlaziye ngokwedinga lakho.
Ndikhoyo, wamkele umbulelo wam, undazise izigqibo zakho.
Ubomi bam buhlala busesichengeni, kodwa andishenxi kumyalelo wakho.
Abakhohlakeleyo bayandithiyela, kodwa andiphambuki kwimimiselo yakho.
Imfundiso yakho lilifa lam nanini na; ewe, iluyolo entliziyweni.
Ndizimisel' ukuyenza imithetho yakho; ewe, ndoyithobela kude kube sekupheleni.
Ndibathiyile abantu abambaxa, kodwa ndiyawuthanda umyalelo wakho.
Wena ulikhaka nekhusi lam; ndiqamele ngelizwi lakho.
Khanindiyeke, nina bantu bangcolileyo, ndithobele imiqathango yoThixo wam.
Ndixhase ngokwesithembiso sakho, khon' ukuze ndibudle ubomi; mandingadani kukufadalala kwethemba lam.
Ndomeleze, khon' ukuze ndisinde, ndihlale ndinonelele imithetho yakho.
Wena ubachasile abanxaxhayo emithethweni yakho; kona ukundweba kwabo ngamampunge.
Wena izikhohlakali uzishenxisa njengenkunkuma; ngoko ke ndiyazithanda izithethe zakho.
Ke mna ndiziva ndikoyika; sona isigwebo sakho siyandirhwaqelisa.
Ndizithobele izimiso zakho, andinabala; sukundiyekela ngabo banditshutshisayo.
Ndivelele undilungiselele, mna sicaka sakho; mandingaxhatshazwa zizijama-nkungwini.
Amehlo am selenikezela, ejonge ukusindiswa, nditsho ukufezekiswa kwesithembiso sakho.
Ndazelelele ngokokuphuphuma kwezibele zakho, undifundise imithetho yakho.
Ndingowakho, ndiphe ukuqonda, ukuze ndizazi izithethe zakho.
Ngoku ke kungawe, *Ndikhoyo; abantu bawunyathele umyalelo wakho.
Iziyalo zakho ndiyazithanda ngaphezu kwayo negolide yodidi;
kungoko ndiyilandela imimiselo yakho; ke kona ukunxaxha ndikuthiyile.
Imfundiso yakho ibalulekile; ndoyithobela ngomxhelo wam wonke.
Lithi lakuchazwa ilizwi lakho kutsho kuthi qwenge; abangazi nto libanika ukuqonda.
Ndisuka ndikhefuze ndithe nkebe, kuba ndiyazilangazelela iziyalo zakho.
Khawuze kum undibabale, kakade wenjenjalo kwabakuthandayo.
Khawundisekele ngokwesithembiso sakho, ungandiyekeli ndonganyelwe bububi.
Ndikhulule kwingcinezelo yabantu, ukuze ndiyenze imimiselo yakho.
Ndivelele undazelelele, undifundise imithetho yakho.
Ngenxa yabantu abangawuthobeliyo umthetho wakho zitsho ziphalale iinyembezi kum.
Hayi kambe ukulunga kwakho, *Ndikhoyo! Ewe, isigwebo sakho asinagobe.
Usinika imfundiso enobulungisa; ewe, inolungelelwano, ithe ngqo.
Ikhwele lindongamele ngenxa yeentshaba ezingalikhathalelanga ilizwi lakho.
Izithembiso zakho zivavanyiwe zagqwesa; ke mna ndizixabise gqitha.
Nakuba ndidelekile, ndingazelwa nto, andishenxi kwimimiselo yakho.
Ubulungisa bakho bohlala buhleli, nomyalelo wakho wohlala uthembekile.
Ndiphahlwe ziinzima neenkathazo, kodwa ke mna andiziva ngeziyalo zakho.
Imfundiso yakho iya kuhlala ifezekile; ndiphe ukuqonda, ukuze ndiphile.
Yo-o-o! Khawundivelele, *Mhlekazi! Ke yona imithetho yakho ndiya kuyithobela.
Ndizibika kuwe, ndikhulule; imfundiso yakho ndoyithobela.
Ndikhala kuwe kusathi qheke ukusa; kaloku ndikholosa ngezwi lakho.
Ndivuk' ezinzulwini zobusuku; ndicamngca ngezithembiso zakho.
Ngenxa yezibele zakho, *Ndikhoyo, sabela, undihlaziye ngokwesigqibo sakho.
Abandenzela amayelenqe bayasondela, bona abayikhathalelanga imiyalelo yakho.
Kanti ke wena ukufutshane nam, Ndikhoyo, neziyalo zakho zithembekile.
Kwantlandlolo ndizifundile izithethe zakho; zaye ke zona zisisimakade.
Velana nam, kuba ndibandezelekile, undisindise, kuba andishenxi emyalelweni wakho.
Zabalaza undihlangule; ndihlaziye ngokwesithembiso sakho.
Kwizikhohlakali usindiso luthe qelele, kuba aziyikhathalele imithetho yakho.
Ke wena, *Ndikhoyo, unguSozinceba; ndihlaziye ngokwesigqibo sakho.
Zininzi iintshaba nabandibandezelayo, kodwa andishenxi kwimfundiso yakho.
Ndiyakhamnqa ndakubona abangcatshi; kaloku bona abalise so idinga lakho.
Ndiyayithanda kambe imimiselo yakho, Ndikhoyo; ngokwezibele zakho ndazelele ebomini.
Oyena ndoqo wodaba lwakho yinyaniso; xa zizonke izigqibo zakho soze zithini.
Iziphathamandla ziyanditshutshisa ngaphandle kwesizathu; ke mna ndiyalihlonipha ilizwi lakho.
Izithembiso zakho ziyandonwabisa; nditsho ndifane nomntu oxhaphaza isisulu.
Ndibuthiyil' ubutshijolo, bunezothe kum; kanti ke umyalelo wakho ndiyawuthanda.
Lide liye kutshona ndikubulela ngenxa yokulunga kwezigqibo zakho.
Abathobela umyalelo wakho bahlala banelisekile; kaloku akukho nto ingabaphazamisayo.
Ndikhoyo, ndijonge kuwe, ndisindise; kaloku ndizithobele iziyalo zakho.
Imfundiso yakho ndiyilandela ngomoya wam wonke; kaloku andizenzi, ndiyayithanda.
Ndiyayithobela imimiselo nezithethe zakho, kambe ke wena wazi konke ngam.
Ndiyatarhuzisa; ndive, *Nkosi; ndivul' ingqondo ngokwesithembiso sakho.
Ndiyakubongoza, ndiphulaphule; ndihlangule njengoko wathembisayo.
Ndiya kusoloko ndikuncoma, ndikubonga, kuba uyandifundisa imithetho yakho.
Ingoma yam ngamadinga akho; kaloku iziyalo zakho zilungile.
Hlala ulungele ukundinceda; kaloku ndizikhethele imimiselo yakho.
Wowu! Ndiyakulangazelela ukusindiswa! *Ndikhoyo, andiziva ngemithetho yakho!
Ndiphe ubomi, ukuze ndikudumise; isigqibo sakho masindixhase.
Ndibhadula njengegusha elahlekileyo. Awu, phuthuma usifune isicaka sakho, kuba andiyilibali imiqathango yakho!
Ndazibika *kuNdikhoyo ndixhwalekile; yena wandiva, wasabela.
Ndathi: “Mhlekazi, ndihlangule kumaxoki nakubakhohlisi.”
Nithi makenze ntoni ngani uThixo? Nisalindele ntoni eyenye, maxokindini,
ngaphandle kotolo lwemfazwe olubukhali, ngokunjalo neziko elimalahle avuthayo!
Athi ke mna, mnt' ubhacele kwaMesheki, mna mntu uxhwarhe phakathi kwamaKedare!
Kunini ndihlalele ukungcuchalaza phakathi koompayipheli.
Phi ke, ndisithi nje ndakuthetha, basuke bahlab' umkhosi.
Amehlo am ndiwajongis' enkalweni; yaz'ba lovela ngaphi na uncedo lwam?
Umncedi wam *nguNdikhoyo, yena ungumenzi wamazulu nehlabathi.
Yena wondibamba lungatyibiliki unyawo lwam; kaloku akozeli, walusa mna.
Khangela, umalusi kaSirayeli akozeli, engalali nokulala oku.
Kaloku nguNdikhoyo okwalusayo – nguye okwenzela umthunzi.
Emini ilanga aliyi kukugqatsa; kanti ke nenyanga ebusuku ayinakukwenza nto.
NguNdikhoyo ixhadi lakho lakubhek' umoya; ewe, uya kukwalusa ungachukunyiswa nto.
Ngenene, uNdikhoyo uya kukwalusa, xa uhambayo naxa ubuyayo, kuqalela ngoku kude kube nini-nini.
Hay' imincili endaba nayo basakuthi kum: “Masihambe siye endlwini *kaNdikhoyo.”
Naku ke ngoku iinyawo zethu zime bhuxe ngaphakathi kwamasango akho, Jerusalem.
Ke kaloku iJerusalem yingxikela yesixeko esakhiwe sabandakanywa saba sinye.
Kulapho zityelela khona izizwe; nditsho izizwe zikaNdikhoyo. Kaloku lowo yaba ngummiselo kumaSirayeli ukuba aye kudomboza abulele uNdikhoyo.
Apha kulapho zikhoyo iinkundla; nditsho iinkundla zendlu kaDavide.
Thandazani kubekho inzolo eJerusalem, nithi: “Makube yinkqubela kwabakuthandayo, Jerusalem;
kuwe makube chosi, kube hele, ukhuseleke umzi wakho jikelele.”
Ngenxa yezihlobo nabalingane bam nangoku ndithi: “Makube chosi, kube hele!”
Kanti ke nangenxa yendlu kaNdikhoyo uThixo wethu ndiya kuzabalaza ndikufunela intlala-kahle.
*Ndikhoyo, ndikhangela kuwe, wena ohlala emazulwini.
Kaloku namaphakathi ajonga izinwe zenkosi yawo, nanjengokuba namaphakathikazi elindele izinwe kwinkosazana. Nathi ke senjenjalo ukukhangela kuwe, Ndikhoyo Thixo wethu, ude wena usenzele inceba.
Awu, Ndikhoyo, sikwa yimfesane; velana nathi, siyakubongoza! Koda kube nini sisisigculelo?
Ewe, kudala sinyamezele, sigxijwa ngabazingcayo, sidodotyaliswa ngabacinezeli abanekratshi.
USirayeli makatsho athi: “Ukuba *uNdikhoyo ebengekho ngakuthi,
ewe, ukuba besingaxhaswa nguNdikhoyo ekuhlaselweni kwethu lutshaba,
ngelusiginye sihleli ngokuya lwaluvutha ngumsindo.
Ngezasitshayela iimpuphuma; ewe, umsinga ngewawusirhaxile.
Ngesantywiliselwa, satshona lè, kuloo manzi alatyuzayo.”
UNdikhoyo ngowokubongwa, kuba yena akasiyekelanga saba ngamaxhoba okuqwengwa.
Thina siphuncule njengentak' esigwini; ewe, isigu saphukile, sasinda ke thina.
Uncedo lwethu luvela kuNdikhoyo ongumdali wamazulu nehlabathi.
Abo bakholosa *ngoNdikhoyo banjengentaba iZiyon, yona ingasoze yashukunyiswa koko izinzile ngonaphakade.
Kwanjengokuba iintaba ziyingqongile iJerusalem noNdikhoyo wenjenjalo ukubaphahla abantu bakhe, nangoku kude kube ngunaphakade.
Izikhohlakali soze zilawule elizweni lamalungisa, hleze namalungisa asuke enze ububi.
Awu, Ndikhoyo, walungiselele amalungisa, abo bantliziyo zingaphambukiyo.
Kodwa ke bona abaphambukayo babandakanye nezikhohlakali, Ndikhoyo. Makube chosi, kube hele kwaSirayeli!
Ekusibuyiseleni *kukaNdikhoyo eZiyon, ngokuya sasiphuma ekuthinjweni, kwasuka kwaba ngathi liphupha.
Safumana sagigitheka yintsini, kwayintswahla yemincili novuyo. Zade zatsho nezizwe zathi: “Ngenene uNdikhoyo ubenzele izinto ezinkulu.”
UNdikhoyo usincede kakhulu, ngoko ke siyavuya.
Khawusibuyisele inkqubela, Ndikhoyo, njengamanzi empompoz' entlango.
Abo bahlwayela behlininika besezinyembezini banga bangavuna bebobotheka yimincili.
Abo baphuma bahambe bezibambe ngeenkophe, bepheth' imbewu, besiya kuhlwayela, bobuya bedanduluka, bememelela ngemincili. Kaloku bobuya besikaza, bethwel' isivuno.
Ukuba *uNdikhoyo akayakhi indlu, bafumana bebulaleka abayakhayo. Ukuba asaluswa nguNdikhoyo isixeko, ancam' ubuthongo ngelize amajoni alindayo.
Ngamampunge ukuzabalaza uzam' ukuzixhasa, uvuka ngentseni, ulal' ezinzulwini, ungumaphila-kukuzenzela. Kaloku uNdikhoyo uyabaxhasa abakhe; ewe, yena ubaxhasa belele.
Uyabona ke, oonyana lilifa elivela kuNdikhoyo; ngenene, abantwana sisipho esivela kuye.
Oonyana bendodana bafana neentolo elixhobe ngazo ijoni.
Hay' ukuzimaseka kwendoda enesiphampa sazo! Ayisoze yadeleka mpela, naxa ixambulisana neentshaba enkundleni.
Hay' inyhweba yomntu omthobelayo *uNdikhoyo, ohamba ngokwemimiselo yakhe.
Onjalo uyazibona iziqhamo zemisebenzi yakhe; uhlala ngokonwaba enenkqubela.
Inkosikazi yakhe ifana nomdiliya oyokozelayo, omi ngasendlwini; abantwana bakhe bafana nezithole zomnquma ezingqonge isithebe sakhe.
Ewe, ngenene unenyhweba umntu omthobelayo uNdikhoyo.
Ngamana waphokoza amathamsanqa eseZiyon uNdikhoyo, ke wena uyibone inkqubela yeJerusalem ngayo yonke imihla yobomi bakho,
ukhule ude ukhokhobe. Makube chosi, kube hele kwaSirayeli!
USirayeli makabalise athi: “Iintshaba zandihlasela kwandiseyimveku.
Ewe, zanditshutshisa kwandiselula, kodwa zange zindongamele.
Zandixobula umqolo, ndangathi bendilinywa.
Kambe ke yena *uNdikhoyo ulilungisa; undikhulule kwiimbophelelo zabakhohlakeleyo.”
Bonke abayithiyileyo iZiyon mababuye bephoxekile.
Mabafane nengca entshula phezu kwendlu, yona idodobalayo ingakhuli.
Ayide isikwe nokusikwa; futhi ayiqokelelwa ibe zizipha.
Nabadlulayo abatsho nokutsho ukuthi: “UNdikhoyo makanithamsanqele; thina siyanithamsanqelisa egameni likaNdikhoyo!”
*Ndikhoyo, ndiyazibika kuwe; ndikhala kuwe ndibindekile.
Awu, Nkosi, ndive ndiyakuthandaza, usiphulaphule isikhungo sam.
Ukuba ubuzigcina izono zabantu, Ndikhoyo, ngubani obengasindayo?
Kambe ke wena uyaxolela, khon' ukuze uhlonitshwe.
Ndithembele ngokupheleleyo kuNdikhoyo; ewe, ndikholosa ngelizwi lakhe.
Umoya wam ukholosa ngoNdikhoyo ngenzondelelo, ngaphezu komlindi ojonge ukusa, nangaphezu komantshingilane ojong' umsobomvu.
Sirayeli, thembela kuNdikhoyo, kuba yena unobubele, futhi yena ukhulula ngokupheleleyo.
Ewe, yena uya kumkhulula uSirayeli kuzo zonke izono zakhe.
Awu, *Ndikhoyo, mna andizigwagwisi; ngokunjalo mna andiziphakamisi. Kaloku andizixakekisi ngemicimbi ephakamileyo kunokuba ndinjalo mna.
Kodwa ndanelisekile, ndaye ndixolile. Ndinjengosana oluthe cwaka ezingalweni zikanina; ngenene umoya wam uphuphuma ukwanela.
Sirayeli, khawuthembele kuNdikhoyo, kususela ngoku kude kube nini-nini.
Awu, *Ndikhoyo, mkhumbule uDavide ngawo onke amasuka-ndihlale akhe,
nesifungo awakwenzela sona, Ndikhoyo, eso akuthembise ngaso, Ngangalala yakwaYakobi.
Wathi: “Andisayi kugoduka, ndingasayi kulala,
ngenene andisoze ndiwavale amehlo, ndingasoze ndibuthurhe ubuthongo,
ndingamakhelanga umzi uNdikhoyo, nditsho ikhaya lengangalala kaYakobi.”
Ewe, seva ngaloo mnqophiso e-Efrata, sagagana nawo kumathafa aseYeharim, sathi:
“Masiye kuye ebhotwe; masiye kumnqula simkhahlele.”
Ndikhoyo, khawuye endaweni yakho yokuphumla, wena ndawonye netyesi yomnqophiso; nditsho leyo ingumqondiso wamandla akho.
Ababingeleli mabavathe ubulungisa, abantu bakho batsholoze ngovuyo.
Ngenxa yesicaka sakho uDavide ungamfulatheli umthanjiswa wakho.
Kaloku, Ndikhoyo, wamenzela isifungo uDavide, futhi ke soze usijike, usithi: “Omnye koonyana besinqe sakho ndiya kumthambisa abe ngukumkani, angene esikhundleni sakho.
Ukuba ke bathe bawugcina umnqophiso lo oonyana bakho, kwanemimiselo endibafundisa yona, noonyana babo bolawula, bachophe esikhundleni sakho ngonaphakade.”
Kaloku uNdikhoyo uyinyule iZiyon; uyikhethele ukuba ibe likhaya lakhe, esithi:
“Eli likhaya lam lokuphumla naphakade; ndiya kuma apha ngokomnqweno wam.
Ndiya kuyithi jize ngentabalala yendyebo; abahlelelekileyo ndiya kubondla.
Ababingeleli bovatha usindiso, abantu bam batsholoze ngemihlali.
Kuya kuvela omnye kubazukulwana bakaDavide; ndiya kuwugcina umlibo womthanjiswa wam.
Iintshaba zakhe ndozigalela ngehlazo; ke olwakhe ulawulo loba nesidima nenkqubela.”
Khawukhangele ukubukeka nomkhitha wokuhlala kwezalamane ngemvano!
Kunjengesiqholo esigalelwe entloko, esihla ngeendevu zika-Aron, side sithi xhaxhe ngomphetho wengubo yakhe.
Kufana nombethe entabeni iHermon, lowo ulala kwiinduli zeZiyon. Kulapho *uNdikhoyo awafumbe khona amathamsanqa nobomi obungaphele ndawo.
Yizani nimbonge nimncome *uNdikhoyo, nonke nina zicaka zakhe, nina nonke nima bume ebusuku, nisebenza endlwini kaNdikhoyo.
Ziphakamiseleni esibingelelweni izandla zenu, nimbonge nimncome uNdikhoyo.
UNdikhoyo, umenzi wamazulu nehlabathi, wanga angakuthamsanqela eseZiyon.
Huntshu-u-u! Khanityibele nimbonge *uNdikhoyo; ewe, lidumisen' igama likaNdikhoyo! Zicaka zakhe, khahlelani nidumisa uNdikhoyo;
nditsho nina nitabhata endlwini kaNdikhoyo, nasenkundleni yomzi woThixo wethu.
Mdumiseni, kuba uNdikhoyo yindlel' enqwelo ngokulunga; memelelani nimdumise, kuba kuluyolo ukwenjenjalo.
Andithi kaloku uNdikhoyo wazinyulela uYakobi! Ewe, wazikhethela uSirayeli wangowakhe ncakasana!
Ndiyaqonda ukuba uNdikhoyo ubavelele, ewe, ubakrobele bonke abanye *oothixo.
Kaloku uNdikhoyo wenza ngokubona kwakhe – nditsho emazulwini nasemhlabeni, kwiilwandle nakwiinzongo-nzongo zeenzulu.
Ngumavus' iingqimba zamafu eziphelweni zehlabathi, ulokhaph' imvula ngemibane elenyayo, aze akhuph' isaqhwithi ngendlu yaso.
Kaloku nguye owabhubhisa amazibulo eJiputa; ewe, wageqa awabantu nawezilwanyana.
Kanye phakathi kwelaseJiputa wenza imiqondiso nemimangaliso, wamohlwaya ukumkani nezicaka zakhe.
Wazingenela izizwe, kwajub' ugodo, wabageqa ookumkani abaziwayo.
Nditsho ooSihon ukumkani wama-Amori, noo-Ogi ukumkani waseBhashan, nazo zonke izikumkani zaseKanana.
Umhlaba wazo wona wawohlutha, waza waba lilifa labantu bakhe amaSirayeli.
Igama lakho, Ndikhoyo, lohlala ngonaphakade; udumo lwakho lovakala kwizizukulwana ngezizukulwana.
Kaloku uNdikhoyo uya kubalungiselela abantu bakhe, avelane nazo izicaka zakhe.
Oothixo beentlanga benziwe ngegolide nesiliva; basisiqhamo sobuchule bezandla zomntu.
Benemilomo nje, abakwazi ukuthetha; banawo namehlo, kodwa ababoni.
Nakuba beneendlebe nje, bazizithulu; baziziduli ezingenawo nomphefumlo.
Bakwafana nazo abenzi bazo, nabo bonke abakholosa ngazo.
Khanidume nibonge uNdikhoyo, ndlu kaSirayeli, nani ndlu ka-Aron, mbongen' uNdikhoyo.
NabaLevi mabakhahlele bebonga uNdikhoyo, nabamthobelayo uNdikhoyo mababonge bade babongisele.
Izibongo mazihlokome, ziphuma eZiyon, zidumisa uNdikhoyo okhaya liseJerusalem. Awu! Sitsho sonke, sithi: “Bayethe, Mhlekazi!”
Bulelani nidomboze ngenxa yokulunga *kukaNdikhoyo. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Bulelani kuThixo onguyedwa. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Bambani ngazibini kwiNkosi yamakhosi. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Nguye yedwa owenza imimangaliso. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Ngobulumko bakhe wawadal' amazulu. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Ulotwabulula ihlabathi phezu kwamanzi. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Yena ngumenzi welanga nenyanga. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Ilanga laba ngumongameli wemini. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Yona inyanga neenkwenkwezi zongamela ubusuku. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Yena ngumaqwakanis' amazibulo aseJiputa. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Yena wamkhupha uSirayeli phakathi kwamaJiputa. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Wolula isandla sakhe, wamkhulula ngengalo yakhe engwanyalala. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Yena walahlula-hlula uLwandle oluBomvu. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
USirayeli wanqumla kulo wawela. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Kambe ke wamntywilisela ukumkani nomkhosi wakhe. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Ulokhokel' abantu bakhe entlango, Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
umqwakanisi wookumkani abanamagama, Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
umhlabaniseli wookumkani abadumileyo, Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
uSihon ukumkani wama-Amori, Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
uOgi ukumkani waseBhashan. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Umhlaba wabo wawenza ilifa lamaSirayeli. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Loo mhlaba waba lilifa lesicaka sakhe uSirayeli. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Nguye owasivelelayo sigqusha eluthulini. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Yena wasihlangula ezintshabeni zethu. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Yena ngumondli wazo zonke izinto eziphilayo. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Bulelani nidomboze kuThixo wamazulu. Kaloku ububele bakhe buhlala buhleli.
Ngasemilanjeni yaseBhabheli sahlala phantsi sagixa sakucinga *ngeZiyon.
Iikatala zethu sazixhoma emingcunubeni kwalapho.
Kaloku abo babesithimbile suka bathi: “Khanisonwabise ngengoma; khanihlabele enye kwezaseZiyon.”
Besingathini kambe ukucula *ezikaNdikhoyo kwelasemzini!
Ukuba ndingakulibala, Jerusalem, sanga singashwabana isandla sam sokunene.
Malunamathele ezinkalakahleni ulwimi lwam, ukuba ndinokukulibala, xa ndinokusuka ndingayibaluli iJerusalem njengeyona ntshinga yovuyo lwam.
Awu, Ndikhoyo, yikhumbule into eyênziwa ngamaEdom, mhla yahlaselwa iJerusalem. Kaloku agcoloda athi: “Yidilizeni niyisiphule neengcambu.”
Athi ke wena, Bhabheli, sisulundini sentshabalalo! Hayi inyhweba yalowo ukubuyekezayo ngazo zonke izinto osenze zona.
Unoyolo ozithathayo iintsana zakho azintlekeze emaweni.
Awu, ndibamba ngazibini, *Ndikhoyo. Ewe, ndinongazenzisiyo umbulelo; ndikuncoma ndikubonge naphi na.
Ndikhala ndijongise ngasendlwini yakho engcwele, ndibonga ndincoma igama lakho, ngenxa yezibele nokunyaniseka kwakho, kuba uzicacisile ukuba wena, ndawonye nezithembiso zakho, ubalasele.
Ndathi ndakukhala kuwe wandiphendula kangangokuba ndatsho ndomelezeka.
Zonke izikumkani zehlabathi mazikudumise, Ndikhoyo, kuba zizivile izithembiso zakho.
Ziya kumemelela, zibonga iindlela zikaNdikhoyo, kuba kaloku sibalasele isidima sakhe.
Ewe, nakuba uMhlekazi enguSomaqhuzu nje, ubanonophele abagqush' eluthulini; ke bona abaqholosayo ubabukele.
Nokuba ndidavuza ezinkathazweni, wena uyandikhusela; ulwa nazo iintshaba zam, undihlangule ngamandla akho.
UNdikhoyo uyalifezekisa icebo lakhe ngam. Kambe ke, Ndikhoyo, izibele zakho zisisimakade; ungabi sawushiya umsebenzi wezandla zakho.
Ewe, *Ndikhoyo, undigoca-gocile, uyandazi.
Wena undazi ukusuka nokuhlala; iingcamango zam uziqonda zingekaveli.
Mna andinako ukukunqabela nganto – nditsho ndihamba okanye ndilele, wena uyaziqonda iindlela zam zonke.
Kaloku wena wazi ndingekathethi; ewe, Ndikhoyo, wazi nento endiza kuyithetha.
Kaloku wena undiphahle macal' onke; isandla sakho sindifumbathile.
Ndlela le undazi ngayo indongamele; ewe, ndiyalabalaba, isemajukujukwini kum.
Ndingamzimela ndithini uMoya wakho? Ndingasabela phi apho ungekhoyo khona?
Ukuba ndingenyukela emazulwini, ndingafika ukho; nokuba ndingalala kwelabafileyo, ukho nalapho.
Ndingafanelana ndihamba nokusa, ndiye kutsho eziphelweni zolwandle,
nalapho ndingakhokelwa sisandla sakho; ewe, ndohlala ndisemandleni akho.
Noba ndingathi mandisongelwe bubumnyama, nokukhanya kujike kube bubusuku,
kwabumnyama obo abumnyamanga kuwe. Kaloku nobusuku bukhanya njengemini kuwe, kuba nobumnyama buyakhanya kuwe.
Andithi na kaloku ndadalwa nguwe; nditsho mna kanye lo! Ewe, wandixonxa wandilunga-lungisa kwandisekumama.
Ndikubonga ndikubulela ngenxa yomntu endinguye, ngenxa yokumangalisa nokukhwankqisa kwento endiyiyo. Ewe, iyakhamnqisa kambe imisebenzi yakho. Leyo ke into ndiyiqonde pheleleyo.
Uphahla lomzimba wam alungomnqa kuwe; okuya ndandibunjwa ekusitheleni wawukho. Ewe, ndabunjwa ngokunqabileyo emajukujukwini.
Kaloku wena wandibona ndingekenziwa; imihla owandimisela yona yabhalwa encwadini yakho, ndingekayiqali nokuyiqala mna.
Hayi bo, zintsonkothile kambe iingcamango zakho, Thixo wam! Yaz'ba zingakanani na ubuninzi!
Xa bendinokuzibala, zingaphaya kwentlabathi; noba bendingazigqibayo, andikabi phi. Ndoba ngalala ndivuke, usengulowa.
Akwaba ubungabatshabalalisa abakhohlakeleyo, Thixo; izijama-nkungwini mazisuke kum,
abantu abakwenyelisayo bengakukhathalele, abakuvukelayo beqhutywa yinkohlakalo.
Ewe, ndibathiyile abakuthiyileyo, Ndikhoyo; kum banezothe abakuchasayo.
Ngenene ndibathiyile mpela; ndibathatha njengeentshaba zam.
Ndibhenela kuwe, Thixo wam: khawundigoca-goce, undiphicothe, undiqondisise; ndivavanye uziqonde iingcamango zam!
Ndiqwalasele, hleze ndithi kanti ndiphambukile; undikhokelele kwindlela eyeyona-yona.
*Ndikhoyo, ndihlangule kubantu abagwenxa; ndilondoloze ndingenzakaliswa zizijama-nkungwini,
kwabasoloko beyila amayelenqe, behamba bephemba uchuku,
abalwimi zilenca njengezeenyoka, abamilomo inobuhlungu obunjengoberhamba.
Ndikhoyo, ndaluse ndingabi lixhoba lezikhohlakali; ndilondoloze ndingawi ezandleni zezijama-nkungwini ezifutha amacebo okunditshabalalisa.
Izibhoxi zindimbela umhadi, zona ziyandithiyisela zindigcayisele; ewe, zindibekela izabatha endleleni.
Hoyina! Ndibhenela kuwe, Ndikhoyo; ndithi: “Wena unguThixo wam.” Ndive, ndiyatarhuzisa, Mhlekazi.
Athi ke wena, Ndikhoyo, Nkosi yam, Mandlandini andisindisayo, wena ulixhadi lam mhla ngedabi.
Mayingafezeki iminqweno yezikhohlakali, Ndikhoyo; mazibuye nembande yesikhova kumayelenqe azo.
Abo bandirhawulayo bayabhobhoza; izisongelo zabo mazenzakalise kwabona.
Akwaba bebengabuxulwa ngamalahle avuthayo, bahalakatsheke enzonzobileni, bangaze babuye.
Abaphixanisi mabangaze bahlume; izijama-nkungwini mazonganyelwe bububi, zitshabalale.
Ndiyazi ukuba wena uyabalungiselela abacinezelweyo; ewe, Ndikhoyo, uyababonelela abo bagqush' eluthulini.
Ngenene amalungisa aya kukudumisa; ewe, kaloku wona aya kuhlala nawe.
*Ndikhoyo, ndibhenela kuwe; nceda ndivelele. Khawubek' iindlebe, usabele ndakukhala.
Umthandazo wam mawube sisiqhumiso kuwe, ukuphakama kwezandla zam kube ngumnikelo wamatshona.
Ndikhoyo, wumisele umlindi umlomo wam; imilebe yam mayihlale yalusiwe.
Ndenze ndikucezele ukwenza ububi, ndingazixakekisi ngezenzo zenkohlakalo, ndingahambisani nabantu abakhohlakeleyo. Mandingaze ndizixhamle izimuncu-muncu zabo.
Noba lingandohlwaya ilungisa – yinyhweba leyo; nokuba liyandikhalimela – yintsikelelo leyo; ewe, andinakuphikisana nayo. Umthandazo wam uchasene nezenzo zamatshijolo.
Iziphathamandla ke zophoswa emaweni; izikhohlakali ke zona zotsho ziqonde, zivume ukuba amazwi am afanelekile.
Bosuka baphoxise ke bathi: “Kutsho kwangathi kuyakhutyelwa, namathambo ethu nango ethe saa; ewe, athe xhaxhe ngamangcwaba.”
Ke mna ndijonge enkalweni kuwe, Ndikhoyo, Thixo wam. Ndilangazelela ukukhuselwa nguwe; ungandishiyi ndisesichengeni.
Ndihlangule kwimigibe abandibekele yona, nakuzo izabatha zabakhohlakeleyo.
Abakhohlakeleyo mababanjiswe kwayimigibe yabo, mna ke ndingabi nawo nomkrwelo.
Ndiyabhomboloza, ndizibika *kuNdikhoyo; ndiyahlahlamba, ndibhenela kuNdikhoyo.
Ndiphokoza isikhalo sam phambi kwakhe; ndimbikela zonke iingxaki zam.
Ndakuba ndidakumbile yena uyayazi imeko yam. Iintshaba zindithiyisela endleleni yam.
Ndakukhangela ngasekunene, akakho ozidubayo ngam; ayikho indawo yokuzimela, kungekho namntu undikhathaleleyo.
Ndibhenela kuwe, Ndikhoyo; kaloku wena uyinqaba yam, nguwe ibango lam kweli lizwe.
Sibazele iindlebe isikhalo sam, kuba kaloku ndixhwalekile. Ndihlangule kwabo banditshutshisayo; kaloku bona bomelele kunam.
Ndikhulule kula makhamandela, ukuze ndilibonge igama lakho. Amalungisa aya kundiphahla, kuba wena undithamsanqele.
Wuphulaphule umthandazo wam, *Ndikhoyo; sive isikhungo sam. Wena uthembekile, ulilungisa; nceda undiphendule.
Musa ukusixoxisa isicaka sakho; kaloku akukho bani umsulwa phambi kwakho.
Kaloku utshaba luthene mbende nam; lundixushe lwada lwandishikixa. Lundivalele kwamnyama-ndawo, ndanga ndingowafa kudala.
Xa kungokunje ndiyayoba; intliziyo yam iyangcungcutheka.
Ndikhumbula imihla yamfamlibe, ndicamanga ngezinto ozenzileyo, ndiphicotha imisebenzi yezandla zakho.
Ndizolulela kuwe izandla zam; ndikunxanele njengomhlaba owomileyo.
Nceda usabele, Ndikhoyo; umoya wam ufadalele. Hayi, musa ukundifulathela, hleze ndifane nâbo baya enzonzobileni.
Ububele bakho mandibuve kwakusasa; kaloku mna ndikholosa ngawe. Ndifundise indlela endifaneleyo; kaloku mna ndizibika kuwe.
Ndikhoyo, ndihlangule ezintshabeni zam; kaloku mna ndizimela ngawe.
Wena unguThixo wam, ngoko ke ndifundise ukuthanda kwakho. UMoya wakho wobubele makandikhokelele endleleni esisithabazi!
Ndikhoyo, ngenxa yesidima sakho ndihlaziye, ngenxa yobulungisa bakho ndihlangule ekuxinanisweni.
Ngenxa yezibele zakho nceda uzinqamle iintshaba zam. Batshabalalise abanditshutshisayo; kaloku mna ndisisicaka sakho.
Makabongwe *uNdikhoyo ondikhuselayo, yena ondiqeqeshela idabi, andenze ndiyiqulele imfazwe.
Yena ulixhadi nenqaba yam, umqolomba nomhlanguli wam, umkhuseli endincathama ngaye. Izizwe uzifaka phantsi kwam.
Awu, Ndikhoyo, yaz'ba kuxa eyintoni na umntu le nto ude uzidube ngaye? Ngani ukuba ude uzikhathaze ngaye?
Umntu ufana nqwa nomphunga, imihla yakhe injengesithunzi sisiya kusithela.
Wakuwashukumisa amazulu, Ndikhoyo, suka akhahleleke phantsi. Wakuzichukumisa iintaba zithuquza umsi.
Lekuza ngemibane, ubasarhaze; binza ngeentolo batsho baduba-dubeke.
Yolula isandla sakho kweliphezulu, undonyule ndiphume kulo mgxobhozo. Ndihlangule esandleni seentlanga
ezimilomo impompoza ubuxoki, ezifunga ubuqhophololo.
Thixo wam, ndiya kukudumisa ngengoma entsha; ndiya kukuculela ngekatala.
Ngumavathis' ookumkani ngoloyiso, umhlanguli kaDavide isicaka sakhe. Ndisindise kwikrele lezikhohlakali;
ndihlangule esandleni seentlanga ezimilomo impompoza ubuxoki, ezifunga ubuqhophololo.
Oonyana bethu ebutsheni babo banga banganjengezityalo eziyokozelayo; iintombi zethu zibe njengamatye akroliweyo alungiselelwe ukuvathisa ibhotwe.
Akwaba bangaphuphuma oovimba bethu, bazale ziintlobo ngeentlobo zesivuno. Akwaba zingazala amawaka iigusha zethu, zande ngamawaka aphindwe kalishumi emaphandleni.
Ngamana zathatha iimazi zethu zeenkomo; zingemi ngenxa yokuphunza. Ngamana akungebikho zimbonono ezitalatweni zethu; ewe, singaphithizeliswa kukuthinjwa.
Hayi uyolo lwabantu abayixhamlayo le ntsikelelo! Sinenyhweba kambe isizwe esiThixo waso unguNdikhoyo!
Ndiya kukuncoma, Thixo ongukumkani wam; igama lakho ndolibonga nanini nanini.
Ndiya kukubulela mihla le; igama lakho ndolidumisa kude kuse ephakadeni.
Ngenene *uNdikhoyo yingangalala, ufanele ukudunyiswa; obakhe ubukhulu abuphengululeki.
Isizukulwana siya kubalisela esilandelayo ngemisebenzi yakho; siya kuzibhengeza izigigaba zakho kwisizukulwana esilandelayo.
Ndiya kucamngca ngemisebenzi yakho emangalisayo, nesidima sobuqaqawuli bobungangamsha bakho.
Abantu baya kububhengeza ubukhulu bezenzo zakho ezikhwankqisayo, ndaye ndiya kububabaza ubukhulu bakho.
Baya kuluxela udumo lokulunga kwakho; ewe, baya kutsholoza bencoma ubulungisa bakho.
UNdikhoyo unesisa, yaye enovelwano. Yena unomonde; uyimvuze-mvuze bububele.
UNdikhoyo uyabalungiselela bonke abantu; unemfobe ngazo zonke izinto azenzileyo.
Zonke izinto ozenzileyo ziya kudomboza zibulele, Ndikhoyo; imilowo yakwakho iya kukudumisa.
Baya kuyibhengeza indili nesidima solawulo lwakho; amandla akho aya kuba ngundaba-mlonyeni,
ukuze uluntu luzazi izigigaba ozenzileyo kwanesidima nobuqaqawuli bolawulo lwakho.
Ulawulo lwakho alunamida yasiphelo; ubukhosi bakho bozityhutyha zonke izizukulwana. Ilizwi alithethileyo uNdikhoyo alidliwa nja, yaye unesisa kuko konke akwenzileyo.
UNdikhoyo uyabaxhasa bonke abagqush' eluthulini, abaphakamise bonke abathobekileyo.
Iinto zonke zikhangela kuye ngethemba, ke yena uyazondla ngexesha elililo.
Ewe, yena zivulekile izandla zakhe, izinto zonke uyazanelisa ngokweentswelo zazo.
UNdikhoyo ulilungisa ngeendlela zonke, unobubele kuko konke akwenzayo.
UNdikhoyo ukufuphi kwabo babhenela kuye, kwabo bamfuna benyanisekile.
Uyabahlangabeza abo bamhlonelayo; uyasabela bakuzibika, abahlangule.
UNdikhoyo uyabalondoloza abo bamthandayo; ke bona abakhohlakeleyo uya kubatshabalalisa.
UNdikhoyo ndiya kusoloko ndimdumisa. Mazimdumise zonke izidalwa, zilincome igama lakhe elihloniphekileyo; ewe, kude kube ngunaphakade.
Aa! Bayethe, Mhlekazi! Duma ukhahlele *kuNdikhoyo, mphefumlo wam!
Ndiya kumbonga uNdikhoyo lo gama ndisadla ubomi; ndiya kuhlabela indumiso, ndibonge uThixo wam bonke ubomi bam.
Musa ukukholosa ngamanene; sukuthemba umntu, kuba akaloncedo.
Uthi akuba efile abuyele emhlabeni; ngaloo mini buyatshitsha ubuchule bakhe.
Hay' inyhweba yalowo uluncedo lunguThixo kaYakobi, lowo uthembele ngoNdikhoyo uThixo wakhe;
ongumenzi wamazulu nehlabathi, ulwandle neento zonke ezilapho kulo; yena ungajikiyo kwizithembiso zakhe;
umthetheleli wâbo baxhatshazwayo; umondli wâbo balambayo. UNdikhoyo uwathi jize ngenkululeko amabanjwa.
UNdikhoyo ngumvuli wamehlo eemfama, umphakamisi wâbo bawileyo. UNdikhoyo ngumathand' amalungisa.
UNdikhoyo ngumkhuseli wabahambi nabangeneleli, umxhasi wabahlolokazi neenkedama. Ke bona abakhohlakeleyo uyabatshabalalisa.
Kambe ke yena uNdikhoyo uya kulawula naphakade, uThixo wakho, Ziyon, kuzo zonke izizukulwana. Siyakhahlela, sithi: “Bayethe, Mhlekazi!”
Dumani nithi: “Bayethe, Mhlekazi!” Kaloku yinto entle ukumemelela, sibonge uThixo wethu; ewe, luyolo, kwaye kufanelekile ukumdumisa.
*NguNdikhoyo umakhi weJerusalem, umqokeleli weembacu zakwaSirayeli,
umnyangi wabantliziyo zenzakeleyo, ewe, umbophi wamanxeba abo.
Ngumqingqi wenani leenkwenkwezi; iyileyo naleyo kuzo uyibiza ngegama layo.
Hay' ubukhulu bukaNdikhoyo, uyingangalala ngamandla! Ubulumko bakhe abunamda.
UNdikhoyo uyabaphakamisa abagqush' eluthulini; ke bona abakhohlakeleyo ubakhahlela phantsi.
Hlabelani nimombelele uNdikhoyo nibulela; tsholozani niculele uThixo wethu ngezeengcingo –
umtwabululi wamafu afihl' isibhakabhaka, nguye owabela umhlaba imvula, ulontshulis' ingca ezintabeni,
umondli wezilwanyana ngokutya kwazo, umfunzeli wamathol' ehlungulu azibikayo.
Yena akakuhoye nganto ukukhalipha kwehashe, engabukhathalele nobungwanyalala bezitho zendoda,
koko yena uNdikhoyo uthanda abamhlonelayo, abo bakholosa ngezibele zakhe ezingatshitshiyo.
Duma ubonge uNdikhoyo, Jerusalem! Mbonge uThixo wakho, Ziyon!
Kaloku nguye owomeleza imivalo yamasango akho; nguye othamsanqela abantu bakho.
Nguye omisela inzolo phakathi kwemida yakho; ikwanguye okwanelisa ngeyona-yona ngqolowa.
Yena uthetha ngelizwi nje qha, ngoko nangoko lityhutyhe ihlabathi.
Ukhitikisa ikhephu, libe njengoboya; unisa iqabaka, kube mhlophe okothuthu.
Usarhaza umkhenkce, ngathi sisichotho; ngubani onokumelana nengqele yakhe?
Uthetha ngelizwi, zinyibilike ezo zinto; athumele umoya, kubaleke amanzi.
Ngumazisi wodaba lwakhe kuYakobi, imithetho nezigqibo zakhe kuSirayeli.
Kwezinye izizwe zange enjenjalo, nemimiselo yakhe aziyazi. Dumani nithi: “Bayethe, Mhlekazi!”
Aa! Bayethe, Mhlekazi! Bongan' *uNdikhoyo, nimdumise emazulwini; mdumiseni kweliphezulu!
Mbongeni, nonke nina zithunywa zakhe; mdumiseni, nani mikhosi yakhe!
Mbongeni, wena langa nawe nyanga; mdumiseni, nonke zinkwenkwezi eziqaqambileyo!
Mbongeni, nani mazulu asemajuku-jukwini; ewe, makube njalo nakuni, manzi angaphaya kwesibhakabhaka!
Ewe, mazilidumise igama likaNdikhoyo; kaloku yena wathetha ngelizwi, zabakho ke zona.
Wazimisela ukuze zihlale zihleli nanini-nanini; ewe, wazimisela umda ongasoze washukunyiswa.
Dumani kuNdikhoyo nalapha emhlabeni! Nditsho kuni, bominenga, nani nonke, manzi anzongonzongo,
wena mlilo, nawe sichotho, khephundini, nani mafu, nawe saqhwithi sofezekisa ilizwi lakhe.
Dumani, zintaba, nani zinduli, mithi yeziqhamo, nani nonke misedare!
Mbongeni, nina marhamncwa, nani nonke zinkomo, nina zinto zirhubuluzayo, nani zintaka ziphaphayo!
Khahlelani, zikumkani zehlabathi, nani nonke zizwe, matshawe, nani nonke zinxiba-mxhaka zehlabathi!
Dumisani xa ninonke, mlisela kwanani mthinjana; yenzani njalo, maxhego kwanani bantwana!
Ewe, mabalibonge igama likaNdikhoyo; kaloku yena ngugama-khulu. Ke bona ubungangamsha bakhe bulivelele ihlabathi ndawonye namazulu.
Ewe, abantu bakhe ubathe jize ngodumo nobungangamela, ke yona imilowo yakhe ithwel' intshinga yendumiso – nditsho amaSirayeli, isizwe esisenyongweni kuye. Masitsho sonke sithi: “Bayethe, Mhlekazi!”
Aa! Bayethe, Mhlekazi! Memelelani niculele *uNdikhoyo ingoma entsha abongwa ngayo ebandleni lakhe labanyanisekileyo!
USirayeli makagcobe agcolode ngoMdali wakhe; oonyana beZiyon mabachulumache ngoKumkani wabo.
Mabadude bamdumise bememelela, betsholoza bembonga ngegubu nekatala.
Kaloku uNdikhoyo akaziva ngosapho lwakhe; abazithobayo ubathi jize ngoloyiso!
Imilowo yakhe mayitaka-take ngemincili; mayimemelele ngemihlali naxa ilalayo;
mayitsho ngentsholo idumisa uThixo, amakrele abazwe macala esezandleni,
ukuze iphakele iintlanga impindezelo, ixhaphaze izizwe ngesohlwayo,
ibasonge ibakhonkxe ookumkani ngamakhamandela, zona izikhulu zabo izikhuleke ngemixokelelwana,
khon' ukuze ifezekise isigwebo sikaThixo phezu kwabo. Nântso ke intshinga yemilowo yakhe. Masikhahlele sithi: “Bayethe, Mhlekazi!”
Sithi: “Bayethe, Mhlekazi!” Khahlelani, nimbonge uThixo endlwini yakhe engcwele; mdumiseni ngenxa yamandla akhe esibhakabhakeni.
Mbongeni ngenxa yemisebenzi yobugorha bakhe, nimdumise kuba yena usisihandiba sesikhulu!
Yitshoni ngomtyangampo wexilongo nimdumise; yombelani nimbonge ngomrhubhe nehapu!
Dumisani nimbonge ngegubu nomdudo; ngqungqani nimbonge ngezeengcingo nesigodlo!
Tshilani nimbonge ngamacangci akhenkcezayo; yitshoni ngentswahla nimdumise ngamacangci ahlokomayo!
Ewe, konke okushukumayo makudume kubonge *uNdikhoyo! Masidanduluke sonke sithi: “Bayethe, Mhlekazi!”
Ezi zizafobe zikaSolomon unyana kaDavide ukumkani wakwaSirayeli.
Ezi zafobe ziluncedo: umntu ziyamqeqesha, zimnike ubulumko, abe nokuziqonda neentetho ukuba ngaba zezengqondo na.
Ewe, zimenza aqeqesheke, akwazi ukuziphatha, abe ngumntu owenza okulungileyo, nothe ngqo engenagobe.
Ongekabi namava zimenza abe krele-krele, nomfana atsho akwazi ukwenza izigqibo ngobulumko.
Isilumko siyeva, sivune ulwazi; kanti nengcaphephe itsho ifumane amacebo aphilileyo,
khon' ukuze ikwazi ukuqonda izaci nezafobe, nditsho amazwi ezilumko nokuntsonkotha kwawo.
Isiseko sobulumko kukuthobela *uNdikhoyo, kambe ke zona izityhakala zibujongele phantsi ubulumko nengqeqesho.
Mfo wam, yithobele ingqeqesho kayihlo, ungazityesheli neziluleko zikanyoko.
Zona ziya kuyiphuhlisa ihambo yakho, oku kwentsimbi ehombisa intloko, nditsho oku kwamaso anika intamo umfaneleko.
Nyana wam, sukuvuma xa uwexulwa ngoongantweni.
Mhlawumbi bangathi: “Yiza silalele umntu ongenatyala, ukuze simhlasele simbulale engacingele nto.”
Basenokuthi: “Yiza, siza kumcim' igama njengosengcwabeni, abe ngathi uginywe lelabafileyo,
size ke thina sizithathele konke okunexabiso, izindlu zethu zitsho zizale ngamaxhoba.
Hayi, mfondini, yiza, uzibandakanye nathi; yoba nye ingxowa yethu sonke.”
Nyana wam, zikhwebule kwiindlela zabo, ulubuyise nonyawo lwakho kuzo.
Kaloku iinyawo zabo aziva ntambo ukuleqeka esonweni; bayakhawuleza ukuphalaza igazi.
Nakuba kungancedi nto nje ukuthiyela intaka xa isibona isabatha eso,
kodwa bona balalela elabo igazi; ewe, bazonda owabo umphefumlo.
Sinjalo ke isiphelo sazo zonke izikrelemnqa: ophila ngobugebenga ufa kwangobugebenga.
Ke bona ubulumko bumemeza nasezitalatweni; kanti ke bude bukhwaze nasezindaweni zembutho.
Izwi labo aligqunyelelwa nayingxolo yasezitalatweni; ewe, buvakala nasemasangweni ezixeko:
“Ziyathandini, koda kube nini nithe nca ebudengeni? Yaz'ba koda kube nini na abagculeli bekuvuyela ukuphoxisa? Koda kube nini izityhakala ziluthiyile ulwazi?
Kambe ke xa beninokukugqala ukukhalima kwam, bendinganiphokozela umoya wobulumko, ndabelane nani ngolwazi lwam.
Kaloku ndibe ngabiza, anisabeli; ndibe nganolulela isandla sam, akukho bani usamkelayo!
Ewe, anilikhathalele icebiso lam; anivumi kusamkela nesilumkiso sam.
Ke mna ndiya kuhlekisa ngani nakungena enkathazweni; ndiya kuphoxisa ngani ngomhla wonxunguphalo.
Ewe, nditsho naxa senirhwaqele lunxunguphalo, lunihlasela njengesaqhwithi; seningathi nirhiwulwa sisivunguvane, imbandezelo neenzingo zinifikele.
“Ngenene, niya kuzibika kum, kodwa ke mna ndingasabeli. Niya kuba ngabhadula nindifuna, ningandizuzi.
Kaloku nisuke naluthiya ulwazi, anakukhathalela ukuthobela *uNdikhoyo.
Ewe, anilamkelanga icebiso lam, anivumanga naxa ndinilumkisa.
Ngoko ke niya kuvuna loo nto niyilimileyo; amacebo enu lawo niya kuwatya nide niwatyekeze.
Kaloku iziyatha zifa kuba zibumangala ubulumko; zona izityhakala zizibhubhisa ngokungakhathaleli nto.
Kambe ke bona abandiphulaphulayo bahlala bekhuselekile; ewe, bathi zava, bengaxhalele kwenzakaliswa nto.”
Mfo wam, wathathele ingqalelo amazwi am, ungaze uyishiye imiyalelo yam.
Ewe, bubazele iindlebe ubulumko, nentliziyo yakho uyilahlele ekwazini.
Kubizele kuwe ukuqiqa, uliphakamisele ilizwi lakho ekuqondeni.
Ubulumko buzingele njengesiliva, ubufune njengobutyebi obombelweyo.
Ukuba uyenzile loo nto uya kukuqonda into okuyiyo ukuthobela *uNdikhoyo, utsho ufikelele ekumazini uThixo.
Kaloku nguNdikhoyo onika ubulumko; luphuma emlonyeni wakhe ulwazi nokuqonda.
Abo bathembekileyo ubathululela ingqiqo, aze abe likhaka lâbo banyanisekileyo.
Uhlala eyalusa indlela yamalungisa, aze abakhusele kwihambo yabo âbo banyanisekileyo kuye.
Ukuba uyandiphulaphula uya kuba nako ukubuqonda ubulungisa, ukwazi okufanelekileyo nokulungileyo. Ewe, uya kutsho uyazi yonke indlela ethe ngqo.
Kaloku ubulumko buya kuhlala entliziyweni yakho, umphefumlo wakho uchwayite lulwazi.
Ukuba neembono eziphangaleleyo kuya kukugcina; ukuqonda kuya kukukhusela,
utsho ukhwebuke ekwenzeni izinto ezigwenxa, usinde kubantu abaphembelela iinkathazo –
nditsho asebazilahlayo iindlela ezithe ngqo, asebehamba ngeendlela zobumnyama.
Abo ke bangabantu abavuyayo xa besenza into embi, abayichwayitelayo imikhwa ephuthileyo yobubi.
Ewe, aba bantu ngamaqhophololo; iindlela zabo zingamagoso-goso.
Ngenene uya kutsho usinde kumfazi ongakwaziyo ukuziphatha, umfazi wasemzini omazwi alalanisayo.
Nditsho lowo ungathembekanga nasendodeni awazimanya nayo kwasebutsheni bakhe, ongawukhathalelanga nomnqophiso awawenza phambi koThixo wakhe.
Kaloku indlela eya emzini wakhe iya ekufeni, nabo bonke ke abahamba ngayo basinga kwelabafileyo.
Ewe, kuloo mzi wakhe akuyi lubuyayo; uthi umntu angangena khona angaze aphinde ayifumane indlela yobomi.
Ngoko ke hamba ekhondweni labantu abalungileyo, uziphathe ngeendlela zamalungisa.
Kaloku ngabantu abanyanisekileyo abaya kuma kweli lizwe; ewe, ngâbo bamsulwa abaya kuhlala behleli kulo.
Ke bona abantu abakhohlakeleyo baya kunqanyulwa elizweni; abo bangamatshijolo baya kuncothulwa kulo.
Mfo wam, sukuyilibala imfundiso yam, koko mayihlale ihleli imiyalelo yam engqondweni yakho.
Kaloku imfundiso yam iya kukongezela imihla emininzi, ikwandisele iminyaka noxolo.
Ungaze wahlukane nentembeko nokunyaniseka. Maxa onke ezi zinto mazibe sisivatho entanyeni yakho. Ewe, zikrole elucwecweni lwentliziyo yakho.
Ukuba uyayenza ke loo nto uya kuhlala wamkelekile, ube negama elihle kuThixo nasebantwini.
Kholosa *ngoNdikhoyo ngomxhelo wakho wonke, ungaze ungqiyame ngezakho iimbono.
Mkhumbule uNdikhoyo kuyo yonke ihambo yakho, waye ke yena eya kukukhokela kuzo zonke iindlela zakho.
Musa ukuzibona usisilumko wena ngokwakho; ndaweni yaloo nto hlala umhlonela uNdikhoyo, ubucezele ububi.
Loo nto iya kuwunika impilo umzimba wakho, atsho omelezeke amathambo akho.
Rhuma ngobuncwane bengeniso yakho, uzimase uNdikhoyo; ewe, menzele umnikelo ngolibo lwemveliso yakho.
Ukuba uyayenza le nto ziya kutsho zizale izisele zakho yindyebo; kanti ke neentsuba zakho ziya kuhlala ziphuphuma yiwayini entsha.
Mfo wam, musa ukuyidela ingqeqesho kaNdikhoyo, ungasicekisi isiluleko sakhe.
Kaloku uNdikhoyo uyamluleka umntu amthandayo, kwanjengokuba uyise emohlwaya unyana anebhongo ngaye.
Unenyhweba kambe umntu obufumeneyo ubulumko; nditsho lowo ukuzuzileyo ukuqonda.
Kaloku bona ubulumko yingeniso engaphezu kwayo nesiliva; nditsho negolide ayithathi nto kubo.
Ewe, bungaphezulu lee nakumatye axabisekileyo. Kuzo zonke izinto onokuzinqwenela ayikho edlula ubulumko.
Kaloku isandla sabo sokunene siqhelezela bubomi, kanti kwesokhohlo buxakathe ubutyebi nesidima.
Iindlela zabo ziindlela ezimnandi; ewe, xa zizonke zizisa uxolo.
Bungumthi wobomi kwababambelela kubo; bonwabile abo babuzuzileyo.
Kaloku uNdikhoyo ihlabathi waliseka ngobulumko, namazulu ngokwawo wawazinzisa ngengqiqo yakhe.
Bubugcisa bakhe obagqabhuza iinzonzobila, namafu atsho afukama avuza umbethe.
Mfo wam, buxabise ubuchule ndawonye nobulumko bokuvisisana; ezi zinto mazingasitheli emehlweni akho.
Ziya kukuthi jize ngobomi, zibe sisihombiso sentamo yakho,
utsho uhambe ungenaxhala, unyawo lwakho lungenakukhubeka ntweni.
Ngokuhlwa uya kungqengqa ungaphaphazeli, ulale uthi yoyi ubusuku bonke.
Awuyi kuba sayixhalela intshabalalo equbulayo, ngokunjalo nesibetho esifikela izikhohlakali.
Kaloku uNdikhoyo uya kukugcina ukhuselekile; soze aluyekele unyawo lwakho lungene emgibeni.
Musa ukwala nento elungileyo konelungelo ngayo, ngakumbi xa kusemandleni akho ukumnceda.
Musa ukuthi kummelwane wakho: “Hamba, uze uphinde ubuye; ndiya kukunika ngomso,” kanti unalo uncedo kuwe.
Ungaze umenzele iyelenqe ummelwane wakho; kaloku uhlala ngakuwe ekuthembile.
Musa ukuxabana nomntu ngaphandle kwesizathu, engakwenzanga nto imbi.
Musa ukuyilangazelela inzuzo yomntu okhohlakeleyo; ndaweni yaloo nto zicezele iindlela zakhe.
Kaloku ulisikizi kuNdikhoyo umntu olitshijolo; kodwa abathe tye bangamathenjwa akhe.
UNdikhoyo uwushwabulele umzi womntu okhohlakeleyo; kanti ke wona umzi welungisa uyawuthamsanqela.
Ke bona abantu abagxekayo uphoxisa ngabo, aze abenzele isisa abo bazithobayo.
Abantu abalumkileyo baya kulidla ilifa udumo; ke zona iziyatha ziya kwambathwa lihlazo.
Yiphulaphuleni, bonyana, ingqeqesho kayihlo; yigqaleni, khon' ukuze nizuze ukuqonda.
Ndininika eyona mfundiso iyiyo, ngoko ke musani ukuwutyeshela umyalelo wam.
Ngokuya ndandiseyinkwenkwana katata, ndiselula, ndinguyedwa kamama,
utata wayendiyala athi: “Wazikise engqondweni yakho amazwi am, ungayilibali imiyalelo yam; yigcine imithetho yam, uphile.
Thabatha, nabu ubulumko, nantsi ingqiqo! Ungaze wahlukane okanye ushenxe kumazwi omlomo wam!
Ungaze ubushiye ubulumko, ke bona buya kukulondoloza. Thandana nabo, khon' ukuze bukukhusele.
Ubulumko ngoyena ndoqo, bufunisise! Fumana ingqiqo, nokuba kudle konke onako.
Ewe, bunonelele ubulumko, ke bona buya kukuphakamisa; bukhwaphe, ke bona buya kukuthi jize ngesihomo.
Boba njengentsimbi ehombisa intloko yakho, bukuthi jize ngesithsaba esingayiwayo.”
Phulaphula, nyana wam, uwathathele ingqalelo amazwi am, uze udle ubomi iminyaka emininzi.
Mna ngokwam ndikufundisile ubulumko, ndakukhokelela endleleni ethe ngqo.
Xa uhamba, ukunyathela kwakho akuyi kuphazanyiswa, ngokunjalo naxa ubaleka akuyi kukhubeka.
Ungaze wahlukane nengqeqesho, koko bambelela kuyo; yilondoloze, kuba ibubomi bakho.
Musa ukuhambisana nabantu abakhohlakeleyo, ungahambi nasekhondweni labenzi bobubi.
Ewe, ndithi zicezele iindlela zabo, ungahambi ngazo. Shenxa kuzo, uhambe uzigqithe.
Kaloku izikhohlakali azaneli kukulala zingenzanga nto imbi. Ewe, ziphuthelwa ubusuku bonke, zide zibe zenzakalise umntu.
Kaloku inkohlakalo sisonka abasidlayo; ubundlobongela yiwayini abayiselayo.
Ke yona indlela yamalungisa ifana nemitha yokusa, yona iya iqaqamba ngokuqaqamba de ibe yimini epheleleyo.
Kambe ke zona iindlela zabakhohlakeleyo zingumnyam' ombonde-mbonde. Naxa bekhubeka abayazi into abakhubeka kuyo.
Ke wena, mfo wam, wagqale amazwi am, uyibazele iindlebe into endikuxelela yona.
Amazwi am makangacimi emehlweni akho, koko wamilisele phakathi entliziyweni yakho.
Ewe, abubomi kwabo bawafumeneyo; ayimpilo kumzimba xa uwonke.
Eyona nto emawuyilondoloze ngaphezu kwazo zonke ezinye yintliziyo yakho, kuba yona ingumthombo wobomi.
Mabungabikho ubuxoki emlonyeni wakho, nentetho ekhohlisayo ibe kude lee emilebeni yakho.
Makathi ntshoo phambili amehlo akho, neenkophe zamehlo akho zithi ngqo.
Qiqa phambi kokuba ubeke unyawo lwakho endleleni, ukuze ihambo yakho iqiniseke.
Musa ukujika-jika uye ngasekunene nangasekhohlo; unyawo lwakho malubucezele ububi.
Mfo wam, buve ubulumko bam, ukubazele iindlebe ukuqonda kwam,
ukuze ube nako ukuzilungelelanisa izinto, futhi ukwazi ukuthetha ngengqiqo.
Kaloku imilebe yomfazi ongakwaziyo ukuziphatha ivuza ubusi; kwaye nenkalakahla yakhe igudile kunamafutha omnquma.
Kanti ke ekugqibeleni uba nobukrakra okomhlonyane, akwenzakalise okwekrele elibukhali macala.
Kaloku iinyawo zakhe zisinga ekufeni; ukunyathela kwakhe kubheka ngqo engcwabeni.
Uyakuwexula kwindlela eyeyobomi; ube wena ungayazi loo nto.
Ngoko ke, bonyana, ndiphulaphuleni, ningashenxi koko ndinixelela kona.
Ewe, ndithi mcezeleni umfazi onjalo, ningasondeli nasemnyango wendlu yakhe,
hleze amandla enu axhatshazwe ngabanye, niyinike isikhohlakali iminyaka yenu.
Ewe, xa ningeva ikamva lenu liya kuxhanyulwa ngabasemzini, zize zona izinto eniziqwebileyo zibe sisisulu seentlanga.
Ekugqibeleni ke yoba ziincwina zodwa ugcuma, ube wona umzimba wakho uvuthuluka nezihlunu zawo.
Uya kuthi: “Akwaba ndandingazange ndiyithiye ingqeqesho; akwaba ndandiziphulaphule iziluleko.
Ngenene zange ndiwaphulaphule amazwi âbo babendiyala, zange ndiyibazele iindlebe imfundiso yabandilulekayo.
Ngoku ke naku ndizibhaqa sendisehlazweni ekuhlaleni naseluntwini.”
Nyaniseka kumfazi wakho; ewe, sela amanzi kwelakho iqula.
Ngani ukuba abantwana bakho bathi saa, oku komthombo omanzi wawo aphuphumela esitalatweni?
Abantwana bakho mayibe ngabakho wedwa; sukuvuma baxhatshazwe nangabasemzini.
Ewe, ziyolise nomfazi wakho weenkomo, abe ngumthombo olithamsanqa lakho –
nditsho loo nzwakazi imanz' andonga, elo bhadikazi lihle kunene! Isifuba sayo sanga singakutsho ube nemihlali, ikurhawule ngolo thando lwayo, utsho uthi ncithi.
Mfo wam, ngani ukuba ude uthinjwe ngumfazi ongakwaziyo ukuziphatha? Ngani ukuba ugonane nomka-mntu?
Kaloku zonke izinto ezenziwa ngumntu ziyabonwa *nguNdikhoyo; zonke iindlela zakhe uzijongile.
Ke zona izenzo zomntu okhohlakeleyo zibambisa kwayena, ajike akhonkxwe kwasisono sakhe.
Ubulawa kukungaqeqesheki; ewe, uphuphuthekiswa bubuhiba bakhe.
Mfo wam, ukuba uthe wamela omnye umntu, wabambana nomnye ngesandla,
waza ke ngaloo ndlela warhintyeleka ngamazwi omlomo wakho, wavaleleka emgibeni ngenxa yesithembiso sakho,
nantsi ke into omawuyenze, nyana wam, ukuze ukhululeke ezandleni zommelwane wakho: hamba uzithobe kuye, umbongoze akukhulule.
Ewe, ungakhe ulale ungayenzanga loo nto, ungaphumli nokuphumla oku.
Xelisa inxala elizihlangulayo esandleni somzingeli, okanye intaka ephuncuka esandleni somthiyeli.
Yiya embovaneni, vilandini; qwalasela indlela eziphethe ngayo, nawe ulumke.
Kaloku yona ayinankosi, ingenamlawuli nankokheli,
kodwa nakuba injalo iyaxakeka ehlotyeni iqokelela umphako, izilungiselela ukutya ngexesha lokuvuna.
Kodwa kodwa, vilandini, koda kube nini uthe tywa kuloo mandlalo? Uya kuvuka nini kobo buthongo bakho?
Ulibele kukuthi: “Hayi noko, makhe ndithi qwaka, ndithi ntlithi kancinane, khe ndisonge izandla, ndiphumle.”
Kambe ke bona ubuhlwempu nâbo bukuchwechwela njengomkhuthuzi. Ewe, nantso ihambo-nzima isiza kukuhlasela oku kwendoda exhobileyo!
Ke yena umntu ohamba ejikeleza ethetha ezolwimi ngungantweni wetshijolo.
Ewe, onjalo ungafika emana encwina amehlo, egobhana nabanye, ekhomba ngaloo minwe yakhe.
Ngalo lonke ke elo xesha uqulunqa amayelenqe entliziyweni yakhe; ewe, uyila ububi, aphembelele uqhushululu.
Kuthi kunjalo ke afunyanwe yinkxwaleko ngebhaqo, atsho enzakale ngephanyazo, angabi nakunyangeka.
Zintandathu izinto azithiyileyo *uNdikhoyo; gxebe, zisisixhenxe izinto ezilizothe kuye:
amehlo endelelo, ulwimi oluxokayo, izandla eziphalaza igazi elimsulwa,
intliziyo eceba amayelenqe, iinyawo ezikhawuleza ukuquqela ebubini,
ingqina elixokayo liyigqwethe inyaniso, nomntu ophembelela ingxabano phakathi kwabazalanayo.
Mfo wam, yithobele imimiselo oyinikwa nguyihlo, ungazityesheli neziluleko zikanyoko.
Amazwi abo wamilisele engqondweni yakho nanini nanini, uwagaxele abe sisihombo entanyeni yakho.
Ewe, la mazwi aya kukukhokela endleleni yakho, abe ngumlindi wakho xa ulele, aze athethe nawe xa uvukile.
Kaloku imiyalelo isisibane; zona iziluleko zilukhanyiso; ingqeqesho ekukhalimelayo ingundoqo wobomi.
Zizo ezinokukukhwebula kumfazi oziphethe kakubi, zikuhlangule kumfazi wasemzini olwimi lugudileyo.
Sukunikezela umncwase ngenxa yobuhle bakhe; sukumkhathalela nokuba selecela amehlo.
Ihenyukazi ungalithenga nangesonka, kanti yena umkrexezikazi angakwenza uphulukane nobomi bakho.
Khawutsho! Uthi ungawufaka esifubeni sakho umlilo ize impahla yakho ingatshi?
Uthi ungawanyathela amalahle avuthayo zize zingatshi iinyawo zakho?
Kunjalo ke kumntu owambatha umka-mntu: akukho namnye omchukumisayo oya kuba msulwa.
Aligxekwa kangako isela xa lisiba kuba lilambile.
Noxa kunjalo lihlawuliswa kasixhenxe xa libanjiwe, lithinjwe yonke impahla yendlu yalo.
Ke yena umntu okrexezayo ngathi ushiywe ziingqondo; ewe, uyazibhubhisa yena ngokunokwakhe.
Isiqhamo salo msebenzi wakhe ziinduma nokuhlazeka; futhi ke oko kuphoxeka kwakhe kuya kuhlala kungenakucinywa.
Kaloku indoda enobukhwele inengcwangu; ithi ke apho iziphindezela khona ingabi nanceba.
Ewe, xa sele ikuloo meko ayiva zicengo, kungekho nantlawulo iya kuyamkela noba ingakanani na.
Mfo wam, wagcine amazwi am, uyimilisele kuwe imiyalelo yam.
Ukuba uyayilandela imimiselo yam uya kubudla ubomi. Ewe, imfundiso yam yilondoloze njengokhozo lweliso lakho.
Imiyalelo yam zikhumbuze ngayo ngokungathi ibotshelelwe eminweni yakho, ihlale ibhaliwe engqondweni yakho.
Yithi kubulumko: “Wena ungudade wethu,” kwingqiqo uthi: “Wena ungumwethu.”
Xa kunjalo ke uya kusinda kumfazi okrexezayo, ungabi nakufumaneka kumfazi wasemzini okulalanisayo ngamazwi.
Ndikrobe ngefestile yendlu yam, ndalunguza ndingasemva kwenqwanqwa,
ndabona abafana abaswele ukuqonda, phakathi kwabo ndaqaphela omnye osisityhakala.
Wahamba ke esitalatweni apho, waya kubhijela ngekona ngasendlwini yomfazi othile.
Ngelo xesha ke kwakungongcwalazi, imini seyisangene, ubusuku nobumnyama sebunkqonkqoza.
Nâko ke kusithi gqi umfazi emkhawulela, ethe wambu ezobuhenyukazi, eneenjongo ezigwenxa.
Wayengungantweni womfazi othethela phezulu, engunyawo lwambethe indlela.
Uthi esezitalatweni abe sezindaweni zembutho, abe elunguza nasezirhangeni.
Lo mfazi usuke wamgona umfana lowo, wamanga; ngobuso obungenazintloni wathi kuye:
“Ekhaya ndenze amadini obudlelwane; namhlanje ndizifezekisile izibhambathiso zam.
Ndilapha nje ke bendikhangela wena, kambe ke ngoku nguwe lo, ndikufumene!
Nomandlalo wam ndiwulungisile; ndiwuthe wambu ngengayiwayo ilinen yaseJiputa.
Ewe, umandlalo wam sendiwuqhole ngoozimore, ikhala, ndawonye nesinamon.
Yiza ke, masibe seluthandweni kude kuse; ewe, masizonwabise ngalo!
Kaloku owakwam usathe tshalala; uthathe uhambo olude, akekho ekhaya.
Umke isipaji sakhe sizele yimali; uya kubuya ukuthwasa kwenyanga.”
Wamlalanisa ngaloo ntetho yakhe igudileyo, wamwexula ngamazwi ezicengo zakhe.
Nanko ke selerhorhozela kwangoko emva kwaloo mfazi, selengathi yinkomo eya ekuxhelweni. Ungena okwesiyatha emgibeni,
luze utolo lumchane isibindi. Oku kwentaka engqala esigwini ulahlekelwa bubomi bakhe engaqondi.
Ngoko ke, bonyana, ndiphulaphuleni, niwathathele ingqalelo amazwi am!
Musa ukulandelana neendlela zomfazi onjalo, ungaze ulahlekele kuzo.
Kaloku zininzi iingxwelerha aziwisileyo; linani eliphezulu amadoda awabuleleyo.
Xa usiya endlwini yakhe usinga ekufeni; ewe, uhlela kumagumbi elabafileyo.
Yivani, nâbo ubulumko bumemeza! Nayo ingqiqo nantso izazisa.
Kaloku bumi ngasezindleleni phezu kweentaba; ewe, nabu buthe bhunxe eziphambukeni zeendlela.
Nabo bungxang' emasangweni edolophu; ewe, buyamemelela ekungeneni esixekweni:
“Hoyina, ndibhenela kuni, nina nonke luntu; ndiyanibiza nani, nzala yakwantu.
Kambe nani, ziyatha, fundan' ingqiqo, nani, nina zidenge, qalisan' ukuqonda.
Phulaphulani, kuba ndiza kutheth' izintw' ezibalaseleyo; yivani, kuba ndiza kuyixel' imfanelo.
Kaloku ngomlomo wam ndiza kutheth' inyaniso, kuba ke mna ndiyithiyil' inkohlakalo emilebeni yam.
Onke amazwi omlomo wam anyanisekile; ubuqhophololo nobuxoki abukho kuwo.
Kumntu oqondayo onke acacile; kwâbo baziyo onke alungile.
Nawe ke, yamkela ingqeqesho kunesiliva; ndithi thatha ulwazi kuneyona golide.
Mna bulumko ndiyawagqitha namatye exabiso; nakwiindidi zobutyebi mna andidlulwa nto.
“Mna bulumko ndihlala ndithe qwa; ndixakath' ulwazi kunye nokulungelelanisa.
Ukumthobela *uNdikhoyo kukubuthiya ububi. Yiloo nto ndikuchasileyo ukuzigwagwisa, ikratshi, ukungabi nasimilo, kunye nentetho egwenxa.
Ndingusomacebo, ndingumthombo weembono ezichubekileyo; ndinako ukuqonda, kanti nokomelela kokwam.
Ewe, oozikumkani balawula ngam, neziphathamandla zilawula ngobulungisa nje ndim.
Bonke abasemagunyeni bancedwa ndim lo: oomatshawe, noozikhulu, nabagwebi ngokwabo.
Kaloku ndiyabathanda abo bandithandayo, futhi ndiyafumaneka kwabo bandifunayo.
Ndibathi jize ngesihomo nendyebo, batsho babe nobutyebi obuzinzileyo nenkqubela.
Inzala engenxa yam ingaphezu kwayo negolide; imveliso yam iyayibetha neyona siliva.
Ihambo yam bubulungisa bodwa; iindlela zam zifanelekile.
Ubutyebi lilifa endibanikayo abo bandithandayo; ndibathi jize ngoovimba abaphuphumayo.
“Ekuqalekeni kwendalo kaNdikhoyo mna ndandikho ndingowakhe; ewe, ndandikho ingekabikho imisebenzi yakhe yamandulo.
Mna wandiqingqa kwasephakadeni, kuqala ngqa, nehlabathi lingekabikho.
Ndavela engekabikho namanzi anzongo-nzongo, tanci ingekaveli nemithombo ephuphuma amanzi.
Ndingowokuqala phambi kwazo neentaba; neenduli zilibone emva kwam ilanga.
Ndabakho ungekabikho umhlaba neentili zawo; ewe, kwakungekabikho nothuli olu ehlabathini!
Ndandikho ekumiselweni kwamazulu nguThixo, xa wayetwabulula isibhakabhaka kumanzi anzongo-nzongo.
Xa wayesambathisa isibhakabhaka ngamafu ndandilapho, nangokuya wayeseka imithombo yeelwandle ndandikho.
Ndandilapho xa wayemisa imida yolwandle, xa wayesithi: ‘Latyuza, kodwa ungagqithi apha.’ Ekuzimiseni kwakhe iziseko zehlabathi ndandikho.
Ewe, ndayingcali yomsebenzi, ndiyintonga yakhe yasekhosi; ndandizele yimincili iimini ngeemini, ndivuya apho ecaleni kwakhe.
Ngenene ndandichulumacha kulo elimiweyo; ndandiziva ndinemihlali phakathi koluntu.
“Ngoko ke, bonyana, ndiphulaphuleni, kuba banoyolo abo bahamba ngeendlela zam.
Yamkeleni ingqeqesho, ukuze nibe zizilumko; sanukuyityeshela, koko bambelelani kuyo.
Unenyhweba kambe umntu ondiphulaphulayo; nditsho lowo uhlala enkundleni yam yonke imihla, osoloko elindile emasangweni am phaya.
Ozuze mna ke ubufumene ubomi; uxhamla ukwaneliseka kukaNdikhoyo.
Kambe ke yena ondiphosileyo uzenzakalisile; kanti ke lowo undithiyileyo uthand' ukufa.”
Ubulumko buyakhile indlu yabo, bayenzela iintsika ezisixhenxe.
Ubulumko buxhelile, bayixuba newayini; kwaye netafile sebuyidekile.
Buthume izicakazana ukuba zime ezindulini, zazise apho edolophini, zithi:
“Yizani nonke, nina bangaqondiyo.” Kanti ke kwabaswele ukuqonda buthi:
“Ngenani nitye ukutya endikulungisileyo, nisele newayini endiyixubileyo.
Lahlani ubuyatha, khon' ukuze niphile; hambani ngendlela yeengqondi.
“Othethisa umgxeki uzibizela ukuthukwa; okhalimela isikhohlakali udibana nokunyeliswa.
Sukuziduba ngokululeka umgxeki kuba wosuka akucaphukele; kambe ke wakululeka isilumko sitsho sikuhloniphe.
Wakusifundisa isilumko sitsho silumke ngaphezulu. Ukuba uyalicebisa ilungisa litsho longeze ulutho kulwazi lwalo.
“Isiseko sobulumko kukuthobela *uNdikhoyo; umntu omaziyo oyiNgcwele kanye uzuza ingqiqo.
Mna bulumko ndoyenza ibe mininzi imihla yakho, ndiyongeze iminyaka yobomi bakho.
Xa usisilumko woncedwa bubulumko bakho; kanti xa ungumgxeki iya kuba nguwe kanye ohluphekayo.”
Umfazi onguNobudenge usoloko engxola; yindlavinikazi engazi nto.
Uthanda ukuhlala emnyango endlwini yakhe okanye kwiindawo eziphezulu edolophini,
ufike selemana ekhwaza abantu abadlula ngendlela, behamba bexakeke yimicimbi yabo,
esithi: “Yizani apha nonke, nina bangaqondiyo!” Kwabaswele ukuqonda uthi:
“Akamnandi ngako amanzi abiweyo! Kanti ke nokutya okutyiwa ekufihlekeni kokona kunencasa.”
Abamphulaphulayo abaqondi ukuba kukufa okubalindele apho; abazi ukuba abo bakhe bamtyelela xa kungokunje bakwelabafileyo.
Nazi izafobe zikaSolomon: Unyana osisilumko ulibhongo likayise, ke yena osisityhakala ungumva-ndedwa kanina.
Ubutyebi obufunyenwe ngobuqhophololo abuphumelelisi, kodwa ke kona ukuziphatha kakuhle kuhlangula ekufeni.
*UNdikhoyo soze abayeke abantu abalungileyo balambe, kambe ke zona izikhohlakali uyazithintela ingafezeki iminqweno yazo.
Umntu oqhokrwe izandla uba lihlwempu; ke yena okhutheleyo uba sisityebi.
Unyana oxakekayo evuna ngexesha lokuvuna ukhaliphile; kambe ke yena olalayo xa isivuno silungile lihlazo.
Amalungisa athiwa jize ngesithsaba sentsikelelo, ke zona izikhohlakali ubundlobongela zibufihla ngokuthetha.
Kuyintsikelelo ukukhumbula amalungisa, kambe ke lona igama lezikhohlakali liyaphutha.
Umntu onengqondo uyayiphulaphula imiyalelo; kambe ke sona isityhakala esilavuzayo siya kubhanga.
Umntu onyanisekileyo uhamba engaxhalele nto; ke yena onamaqhinga uya kubhaqwa.
Umntu oyivalela amehlo inkohlakalo ubangela intlupheko, kambe ke isityhala esilavuzayo siya kubhanga.
Amazwi omntu olilungisa angumthombo wobomi; kanti ke zona izikhohlakali ubundlobongela zibufihla ngokuthetha.
Intiyo iphembelela ingxabano; ke lona uthando luyazingcwaba zonke izono.
Umntu oqondayo uthetha ubulumko, kanti ke umhlana wesinyabi ufanelwe yintonga.
Isilumko siyaluqoqosha ulwazi, kanti ke kona ukuthetha kwesityhakala kuza nentshabalalo.
Ubutyebi besinhanha lixhadi laso; ke bona ubuhlwempu yintshabalalo yosweleyo.
Ilungisa lixhamla ubomi ngemigudu yalo; ke yona inzuzo yesikhohlakali iphelela esonweni.
Umntu oyithobelayo ingqeqesho usekhondweni lobomi; ke yena ongaphulaphuliyo ulahlekene nendlela.
Umntu oyifihlayo intiyo lixoki; ke yena osasaza iindaba zolwimi sisiyatha.
Ekuthetheni kakhulu isono sidla ngokubakho, kambe ke ozibambayo ekuthetheni unengqiqo.
Amazwi elungisa afana nesiliva ecwengileyo; ke zona iingcinga zesikhohlakali ziphuthile.
Amazwi omntu onengqondo ayinzuzo kwabaninzi; kanti ke zona izityhakala zibulawa kukungayisebenzisi ingqondo.
Yintsikelelo kaNdikhoyo enika umntu ubutyebi; kambe ke yona ayihambi nazintsizi.
Isiyatha siyavuya xa sisenza ubugwenxa; phofu ke yena umntu onengqondo uyabuvuyela ubulumko.
Umntu okhohlakeleyo uzuza kanye le nto imnxunguphalisayo, kodwa yena olilungisa unikwa oko akufunayo.
Zakufika iinkqwithela zimka nabo abantu abakhohlakeleyo; kanti ke bona abanyanisekileyo bema ngxishi ngonaphakade.
Asinto umdintsi ukusetyenzelwa livila, nqwa neviniga emazinyweni okanye umsi emehlweni.
Ukuthobela uNdikhoyo kuyabongeza ubomi bomntu; kanti ke yona iminyaka yezibhoja iyanqanyulwa.
Ithemba lelungisa liza novuyo; ke lona ithemba lesikhohlakali liphelel' emoyeni.

Ngenene uyihlo nonyoko mabavuye ngawe – menze abe nemihlali lowo wakuzalayo.
Yinikezele kum intliziyo yakho, mntwan' am; indlela endiziphethe ngayo mayibe semehlweni akho.
Kaloku ihenyukazi ngumhadi onzulu, nomfazi oziphethe kakubi liqula elimxinwa.
Ewe, uncathama oku kwesikrelemnqa, alongeze inani labakrexezi.
Nguwuphi umntu osezintsizini nonesingqala, osoloko esezingxwaba-ngxwabeni ekhalaza; nditsho ofumana enzakale nje ngelize, umntu ongafik' etyofu-tyofu amehlo?
Lowo ke ngulo mntu ungafika ejikelezana newayini, esoloko ezingelana newayini exutyiweyo.
Inkangeleko ebomvu yewayini mayingakukhangi, noba ingade imenyezele endebeni – ewe, nditsho seyinambitheka, isihla kamnandi!
Ekugqibeleni iwayini iluma njengenyoka, ibinza njengerhamba.
Ikutsho ubone izinto ezingekhoyo, ushwaqe ubhude yonk' into.
Ewe, ikutsho ube ngathi uphakathi elwandle, ube ngathi ujinga epalini ebamba iseyile yesikhephe.
Uya kubuza uthi: “Ingathi ndibethiwe nje phofu? Hayi suka, ndingakhange ndive nje! Akwaba bendinganako ukuphinda ndiphakame, khe ndithi nje intwana ndiziqabule!”
Musa ukumonela abantu abakhohlakeleyo ngezinto zabo, ungakunqweneli ukuzibandakanya nabo.
Kaloku intliziyo yabo iyila ubundlobongela, nomlomo wabo uthetha ngokuvusa uqhushululu.
Indlu yona yakhiwa ngobulumko, izinziswe ngengqondo.
Lulwazi oluzalisa amagumbi endlu, itsho ivathiswe ngezinto ezintle nezixabisekileyo.
Umfo osisilumko unamandla; ewe, indoda enolwazi iya isomelela ngokomelela.
Phambi kokuba uye emfazweni hlala phantsi ucwangcise kuqala; uloyiso lungabakho xa unabacebisi abaninzi.
Ubulumko yintsokotha kumntu osisiyatha; yena uyalabalaba xa kuxoxwa kwindibano ngasesangweni.
Umntu osoloko eyila ukwenza ububi uya kwaziwa ngokuba nguSomayelenqe.
Amayelenqe esidenge ayafadalala; ke yena umntu osoloko egxeka abanye uthiyiwe ngabantu.
Ukuba unamathidala ngamaxesha eenkathazo, awunawo amandla okujongana nawo.
Bahlangule abantu abaqweqwediselwa ekufeni; basindise abo bagxadazelela ekubulaweni.
Mhlawumbi ungathi wena: “Besingazi nto ngale nto,” kodwa ke yena uThixo onganqatyelwa nto uyayibona inyaniso – ukujongile, yaye uyakwazi. Ke yena uvuza umntu ngokwezenzo zakhe.
Mfo wam, butye ubusi, kuba bumnandi; ewe, incindi inencasa emlonyeni wakho.
Bukwanjalo ukuyola kobulumko: ukuba uthe wabufumana lotsho liqiniseke ikamva lakho, nethemba lakho linganqanyulwa.
Sukufana nesikhohlakali ngokulalela indlu yomntu olilungisa, nomzi wakhe sukuwonakalisa.
Noba angawa kangaphi na umntu olilungisa ubuya avuke; ke zona izikhohlakali zikhubeka zitshabalale.
Sukuluvuyelela lwakuwa utshaba lwakho, ungavuyi xa ulubona lukhubeka,
hleze olo vuyo lwakho lube bububi emehlweni kaNdikhoyo, awurhoxise umsindo wakhe kulo.
Sukuvutha ngumsindo ngenxa yabantu abenza ubugwenxa, ungabamoneli abantu abakhohlakeleyo ngezinto abanazo.
Kaloku umenzi wobubi akanakamva; isibane sabantu abakhohlakeleyo siya kucinywa.
Mntwan' am, mhlonele uNdikhoyo, ngokunjalo nokumkani, ungadlelani nabavukeli.
Kaloku bona babhanga ngephanyazo, ibe ke akukho bani waziyo ukuba botshatyalaliswa nini na nguNdikhoyo okanye ngukumkani.
Nanga amanye amazwi ezilumko: Yinto embi ukuba umgwebi ajonge ubuso bomntu.
Xa esuka athi konetyala: “Umsulwa wena,” abantu bayamthuka, zimgxeke izizwe.
Kambe ke yena umgwebi omohlwayayo umntu owonileyo uba nentsikelelo kunye nenkqubela.
Impendulo ethe gca nqwa nokuncamisa umhlobo emlonyeni.
Qala ulungise ishishini lakho, ulime amasimi akho, emva koko wakhe indlu yakho.
Sukuthi kungekho sizathu unike ubungqina obumtshonisayo ummelwane, okanye ukhohlise ngomlomo wakho.
Musa ukuthi: “Ndiya kwenza kuye njengoko enzile kum; ndiya kumenzakalisa ngokwezenzo zakhe.”
Ndathi ndihamba ndagqitha entsimini yevila; ewe, ndadlula kwisidiliya somntu ongenangqondo.
Sasitshone lé elukhuleni, sifuthwe nayinkunzane; ke lona udonga olwalubiyele lwaludilikile.
Ndakha ndee nqumama ndawubukela loo mhlola, ndacinga nzulu ndaza ndafumanisa ukuba
xa uthe: “Hayi noko, makhe ndithi qwaka, ndithi ntlithi kancinane, khe ndisonge izandla, ndiphumle,”
ubuhlwempu bosuka bukuchwechwele njengomkhuthuzi. Ewe, ihambo-nzima iza kukuhlasela oku kwendoda exhobileyo.
Nezi ikwazizafobe zikaSolomon ezaqokelelwa ngamagosa kakumkani uHezekiya wakwaJuda:
Isihomo sikaThixo siphuhliswa zizinto eziyimfihlakalo; kambe ke sona isidima sokumkani kukuphengulula imicimbi.
Njengokuphakama kwesibhakabhaka nobunzulu bomhlaba, zikwanjalo ukungabi nakugocagocwa iingcamango zookumkani.
Wakuyicwenga isiliva, nengcibi itsho ikwazi ukuyisebenzisa;
akukhiqwa amaphakathi aphuthileyo, ulawulo lokumkani lutsho ludume ngokuzinza.
Xa ukomkhulu musa ukuzigqatsa; sukuhlala endaweni yezikhulu.
Kaloku kubhetele ukuba yena athi: “Nyukela apha,” kunokuba akususe kwindawo yezikhulu amatshawe ebukele.
Sukungxamela enkundleni ngento oyibonileyo, hleze kuvele omnye umntu nabungqina bumbi, utsho uhlazeke ke wena.
Xa usematyaleni nommelwane wakho musa ukudiz' imfihlelo oyixelelweyo,
hleze uvelwe utsho uphoxeke, kuze ke ukuba negama elibi kwakho kuthane mbende nawe.
Amazwi afanelekileyo nqwa neeapile zegolide ezithiwe nca kwisiliva.
Isilumkiso esiwa kwindlebe evayo sifana necici legolide nesidanga segolide ecikizekileyo.
Umthunywa onyanisekileyo kwabo bamthumayo uhlaziya inkosi yakhe oku kwekhephu ngexa lokuvuna.
Umntu ozigwagwisa ngokupha omnye isipho angenaso ufana namafu anomoya angenamvula.
Umlawuli uyacengeka ngumntu onomonde, namazwi athambileyo amenza anikezele.
Wakufumana ubusi butye uzilinganisela, hleze bubuye wakubutya gqitha.
Malungaquqi gqitha unyawo lwakho kwammelwana, hleze akruquke nguwe, akucaphukele.
Umntu otshonisa ummelwana wakhe ngobungqina obubuxoki uyingozi nqwa negqudu, umkhonto, okanye utolo.
Ukuthembela ngomntu ongathembekanga xa usenkathazweni kufana nezinyo elonakeleyo nonyawo oluqhwalelayo.
Ukuculela umntu oneenzingo kufana nokumhambisa ze mhla kubandayo, okanye kunjengokonakalisa isoda ngokuyixuba neviniga.
Xa ufumana utshaba lwakho lulambile, luphe ukutya; lwakunxanwa, luphe amanzi.
Ngokwenjenjalo ke woba uluqhubela enguqukweni, *noNdikhoyo wokuvuza.
Umoya wasentla uzisa imvula, kodwa ke yona intlebendwane iza nengxabano.
Akunani kwaukuhlala wedwa noba kuphezu kwendlu, ndaweni yokuhlala ndlwini-nye nomfazi ongunogqwashu.
Iindaba ezimnandi ezivela kwelikude zihlaziya oku kwamanzi abandayo emntwini odiniweyo.
Akoyiswa sisikhohlakali umntu olungileyo loo nto ifana nequla eligxobhekileyo okanye nomthombo ongcolisekileyo.
Ukubutya kakhulu ubusi akulunganga; kukwanjalo ukuhlala uzifunela imbeko.
Umntu owoyiswayo kukuzilawula usesichengeni oku kwesixeko esindonga ziwileyo.
Ukuncoma isityhakala ngumhlola onjengokuba kusuke kukhithike ehlotyeni, okanye kune imvula ngexesha lokuvuna.
Isishwabulo kungekho sizathu asiphumeleli; sifana nokundanda kwamahlankomo neenkonjane ezingahlali phantsi.
Ihashe liyabethwa, ke yona idonki ilawulwa ngomkhala, kanti ke sona isinyabi sivuswa ngentonga.
Sukuphendulana nesiyatha, hleze nawe lo uzibhaqe sewufana naso.
Xa umntu ebuza umbuzo wobudenge mlinganisele, hleze azicingele ukuba usisilumko.
Ukuthemba isidenge somthunywa kukuzenzakalisa nqwa nokuzinqumla imilenze.
Iqhalo emlonyeni womntu ongaqondiyo lifana nomlenze ojingayo wesiqhwala.
Ukuncoma isityhakala nqwa nokubophelela ilitye *kwinkwitshi.
Iqhalo emlonyeni wesiyatha nqwa nesebe elinameva esandleni senxila.
Umntu oqesha isidenge okanye nabani na odlulayo akanankathalo, ufana nejoni elidubula nje nabani na.
Umntu ophinda-phinda into yobudenge nqwa nenja ebuyela emhlanzweni wayo.
Akunani kwaisityhakala kunomntu osisilumko kwawakhe amehlo.
Ivila lithi: “Kukho ingonyama endleleni! Ewe, ingonyama ihla inyuka ezitalatweni.”
Oku kocango oluvula luvaleke kwiihenjisi oluxhonywe kuzo linjalo ivila ukuqika-qikeka emandlalweni walo.
Ivila liyakha esityeni, kodwa linqene ukufaka emlonyeni.
Umntu olivila usisilumko kwawakhe amehlo; kuye ngathi ungaphezulu nakumadoda asixhenxe akwaziyo ukuphendula ngengqiqo.
Umntu ogxuphuleka kwiingxabano zabanye ufana nomfo osuka athi nqaku inja ngeendlebe.
Ufana negeza elidubula ngeentolo zomlilo
umntu okhohlisa ummelwane wakhe aze ajike athi: “Hayi, bendiqhula nje.”
Zakuphela iinkuni uyacima umlilo. Xa kungekho mntu uphixanisayo kuyaphela ukungevani.
Ziinkuni ezivuthisa umlilo kwanjengokuba iintlantsi ziwavuthisa amalahle; ukwanjalo ke nomntu onochuku ukuphembelela ingxabano.
Amazwi omntu ohlebayo anencasa; abantu basuka bawathi bimbilili.
Amazwi alalanisayo efihla inkohlakalo nqwa nesitya somdongwe esigqunywe ngesiliva ngaphandle.
Umntu onentiyo usenokuyifihla ngendlela athetha ngayo, kodwa ngaphakathi abe esabambelele enkohlakalweni.
Ewe, walumkele loo mazwi akhe amnandi, kuba intliziyo yakhe iyaphuphuma ngamanyondololo.
Nokuba angayifihla intiyo yakhe ngenkohliso, kodwa inkohlakalo yakhe yona iya kudandalaza esidlangalaleni.
Umntu owomba umngxuma kweyela kwayena kuwo. Lowo uqengqa ilitye losuka ligubungele kwayena.
Umntu onolwimi uyabathiya abo abenzakalisayo; umntu okhohlisayo udala intshabalalo.
Musa ukuqhayisa ngengomso, kuba akuyazi loo mini ukuba iya kukuphathela ntoni na.
Yeka ibe ngomnye okuncomayo, ingabi ngowakho umlomo; ewe, mayibe ngowasemzini, kungaphumi emilebeni yakho.
Amatye nesanti ngumthwalo onzima; kodwa kona ukucatshukiswa sisityhakala luxanduva olungaphezulu.
Umsindo unenkohlakalo, ingqumbo sisiphango; kodwa ke akakho onokumelana nobukhwele.
Akunani kwaisiluleko esisekuhleni kunothando olufihlwayo.
Isihlobo sinyanisekile noba singade sikwenzakalise; siyakugqitha ukwangiwa kaninzi lutshaba.
Umntu ohluthayo akabukhathalele nobusi, kanti ke olambayo ukufumana kunencasa nokutya okukrakrayo.
Umntu okude nekhaya unjengentaka elahlekene nendlu yayo.
